papers.title: Twin Algebras: Condensable Algebras beyond Anyons
papers.abstract: Condensable algebras in 2+1d non-chiral topological orders characterize gapped boundary conditions and interfaces. Applied to the Symmetry Topological Field Theory, they allow classification of symmetric gapped phases and impose sharp constraints on possible phase transitions. A condensable algebra is specified not only by its underlying set of anyons, which end on the boundary or interface, but also by its algebra structure. We introduce the concept of twin condensable algebras, which have the same anyon decomposition, but inequivalent algebra structure. We revisit the classification of condensable algebras in $\mathcal{Z}(\text{Vec}_G^ω)$, i.e. in group-theoretical topological orders for finite groups $G$ with anomaly $ω$. In this context we are able to identify twin algebras that arise from different mechanisms, such as subgroup data, SPT cocycles, and symmetry actions. In particular, we construct infinite families of examples of twins from so-called Gassmann triples, and exhibit cases in which the reduced topological orders are inequivalent despite having identical anyon content. Physically, twin algebras describe distinct symmetric phases that have isomorphic spaces of ground states, but inequivalent order parameters. Such twin phases never exhibit relative spontaneous symmetry breaking, and can be used to construct phase transitions without hidden symmetry breaking, which are intrinsically beyond Landau transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：condensable algebras, Symmetry Topological Field Theory, classification, theoretical framework。；研究对象：2+1维非手征拓扑序中的可凝聚代数（condensable algebras），特别是群论拓扑序 $\mathcal{Z}(\text{Vec}_G^\omega)$ 中的可凝聚代数及其分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了“孪生可凝聚代数”（twin condensable algebras）——具有相同任意子分解但不等价的代数结构，并证明它们可以描述具有相同基态空间但不等价序参量的不同对称相，这些相之间不会发生相对自发对称性破缺，可用于构造超越朗道相变理论的相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了“孪生可凝聚代数”（twin condensable algebras）——具有相同任意子分解但不等价的代数结构，并证明它们可以描述具有相同基态空间但不等价序参量的不同对称相，这些相之间不会发生相对自发对称性破缺，可用于构造超越朗道相变理论的相变。；创新点：首次提出并系统研究了“孪生可凝聚代数”概念，揭示了即使任意子内容完全相同，可凝聚代数的代数结构仍可不等价，从而导致拓扑约化后的拓扑序不等价。这一发现为理解超越朗道自发对称性破缺范式的相变提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 基于对称拓扑场论（Symmetry Topological Field Theory）框架，对有限群 $G$ 及其反常 $\omega$ 的群论拓扑序 $\mathcal{Z}(\text{Vec}_G^\omega)$ 中的可凝聚代数进行分类，通过子群数据、SPT上循环和对称性作用等不同机制识别孪生代数，并利用Gassmann三元组构造无穷族实例。

papers.title: Twin Phases: Phase Transitions Without Hidden Symmetry Breaking
papers.abstract: We introduce the concept of twin phases for a symmetry $\mathcal{S}$, defined as inequivalent phases, whose order parameters are part of the same generalized charge under $\mathcal{S}$. Stable, direct transitions between such twin phases are never spontaneous-symmetry-breaking transitions, even after (partially) gauging the initial symmetry $\mathcal{S}$: they are phase transitions without hidden symmetry breaking. We illustrate this with an (anomalous) finite group symmetry in 1+1d, which exhibits such intrinsically beyond Landau transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“introduce the concept”“we illustrate with”等理论构建和论证性表述，未提及实验或计算手段。；研究对象：相变理论中的“孪生相”概念，具体针对具有对称性 \(\mathcal{S}\) 的量子系统，并以1+1维（反常）有限群对称性为例进行说明。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了“孪生相”概念：对于同一对称性 \(\mathcal{S}\)，存在不等价的相，其序参量属于 \(\mathcal{S}\) 下的同一广义荷。这类孪生相之间的稳定直接相变并非自发对称性破缺相变，即使在（部分）规范初始对称性 \(\mathcal{S}\) 后也是如此——这是一种没有隐藏对称性破缺的相变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了“孪生相”概念：对于同一对称性 \(\mathcal{S}\)，存在不等价的相，其序参量属于 \(\mathcal{S}\) 下的同一广义荷。这类孪生相之间的稳定直接相变并非自发对称性破缺相变，即使在（部分）规范初始对称性 \(\mathcal{S}\) 后也是如此——这是一种没有隐藏对称性破缺的相变。；创新点：首次提出“孪生相”概念，并证明其间的直接相变不涉及任何（隐藏的）对称性破缺，从而揭示了一类“内在地超越朗道”的相变类型。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：基于对称性 \(\mathcal{S}\) 的广义荷与序参量分类，结合（反常）有限群对称性在1+1维体系中的分析，论证了此类相变本质上超越了朗道相变范式。

papers.title: Floquet Engineering of Quantum Transport through two Driven Impurities
papers.abstract: Floquet engineering offers powerful tools to manipulate quantum states by periodically driving physical parameters. In this work, we investigate the quantum transport through two periodically driven impurities in a mesoscopic one-dimensional channel. By mapping the time-dependent Hamiltonian into an effective multichannel scattering problem, we unveil a rich landscape of transport phenomena arising from the interplay between Fabry-Perot cavity modes and Fano interference. We demonstrate that the inter-impurity distance acts as a critical control parameter, allowing for the formation of Bound States in the Continuum (BICs). Furthermore, we identify Quasi-BICs, extremely narrow resonances with finite lifetimes, that can be dynamically tuned by the drive amplitude. We show that these states enable a robust coherent trapping mechanism, allowing the system to switch from perfect transparency or reflection to strong localization with giant Wigner time delays. Our results suggest possible applications for tunable delay lines and quantum memories, with feasible experimental realizations in the context of cold atoms.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“mapping the time-dependent Hamiltonian into an effective multichannel scattering problem”，属于理论建模与解析计算。；研究对象：一维介观通道中两个受周期性驱动的杂质构成的量子输运系统。具体物理现象包括：法布里-珀罗腔模与法诺干涉的相互作用、连续谱中的束缚态（BICs）以及准束缚态（Quasi-BICs）的形成与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调节两个驱动杂质之间的距离，可以形成连续谱中的束缚态（BICs）和准束缚态（Quasi-BICs），后者可通过驱动幅度动态调谐，从而实现系统在完美透明/反射与强局域化（伴随巨大维格纳时间延迟）之间的鲁棒切换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调节两个驱动杂质之间的距离，可以形成连续谱中的束缚态（BICs）和准束缚态（Quasi-BICs），后者可通过驱动幅度动态调谐，从而实现系统在完美透明/反射与强局域化（伴随巨大维格纳时间延迟）之间的鲁棒切换。；创新点：揭示了驱动杂质间距离作为关键控制参数，在Floquet驱动体系中实现BICs和准BICs的机制，并展示了这些态在相干捕获和动态开关输运行为中的潜力。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用Floquet工程方法，将含时哈密顿量映射为有效多通道散射问题，通过解析散射理论分析输运性质。

papers.title: Recovering the Shape of a Contact Line
papers.abstract: We study the conditions for a three-phase contact line to return to a previous position. We drive a water-air-glass contact line between two horizontal plates, by slowly adding and removing water with a constant volume amplitude. For the first several cycles, the contact line ends each cycle with a different shape, in contrast with previously published work. Eventually the shapes begin to repeat, and the system has memory: a cycle with a smaller amplitude ends in a different shape, but even one cycle at the original amplitude recovers the steady-state shape. After a cycle at a larger amplitude, the steady-state shape is erased. We find that our tight control of the enclosed volume creates a global interaction, wherein only the least stable part of the contact line can move. Using theory and minimal models, we show that this interaction gives rise to the transient behaviors. Our study sheds light on the origins of reversibility and memory in a system where neither is guaranteed, and shows that the physics of contact line motion changes in a confined environment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：experiment、driving、adding and removing water、measurement of shape）；研究对象：三相接触线（水-空气-玻璃体系）在受限环境（两平行板之间）中的形状恢复与记忆行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在恒定体积振幅的循环驱动下，接触线经过若干周期后形状开始重复，表现出记忆效应：较小振幅的循环会改变最终形状，但一次原始振幅的循环即可恢复稳态形状；而较大振幅的循环则会擦除该记忆。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在恒定体积振幅的循环驱动下，接触线经过若干周期后形状开始重复，表现出记忆效应：较小振幅的循环会改变最终形状，但一次原始振幅的循环即可恢复稳态形状；而较大振幅的循环则会擦除该记忆。；创新点：揭示了在封闭受限环境中，接触线运动的物理机制发生变化：对封闭体积的精确控制产生全局相互作用，使得只有最不稳定的部分可以移动，从而产生瞬态行为，并阐明了在不可逆系统中可逆性与记忆的起源。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过缓慢加水和排水控制封闭体积，驱动两平行板之间的水-空气-玻璃接触线运动，并记录其形状变化；理论上使用最小模型分析全局相互作用对接触线运动的影响。

papers.title: Migdal-Eliashberg and SUS-$Y^2$-SYK
papers.abstract: This note addresses a number of subtle issues pertaining to the long-standing problem of strong phonon-like fermion-boson coupling. Among the central topics are the customary Migdal-Eliashberg approximation in the pertinent Schwinger-Dyson gap equation and its solutions. The previously gained insight is assessed by contrasting it against the various (non-)supersymmetric variants of the Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model. Also, some previously discussed (pseudo-)holographic aspects of fermion pairing in such models are commented upon.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Migdal-Eliashberg approximation、Schwinger-Dyson gap equation、supersymmetric variants、Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model。；研究对象：强声子型费米子-玻色子耦合问题，具体涉及Migdal-Eliashberg近似及其在超导能隙方程中的适用性，以及Yukawa-Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev（SUS-$Y^2$-SYK）模型中的费米子配对现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过对比Migdal-Eliashberg近似与（非）超对称Yukawa-SYK模型，评估了传统强耦合近似方法的有效性，并评论了相关模型中费米子配对的（赝）全息方面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过对比Migdal-Eliashberg近似与（非）超对称Yukawa-SYK模型，评估了传统强耦合近似方法的有效性，并评论了相关模型中费米子配对的（赝）全息方面。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于Schwinger-Dyson能隙方程的Migdal-Eliashberg近似，并与各种（非）超对称Yukawa-SYK模型进行对比。

papers.title: Nonperturbative renormalization of Haldane pseudopotentials from the exact two-electron spectrum
papers.abstract: Haldane pseudopotentials $V_{|m|}$ provide the effective interaction parameters governing correlated states in the fractional quantum Hall regime. In conventional formulations, these quantities are obtained by projecting the Coulomb interaction onto relative-angular-momentum states within the lowest Landau level, thereby neglecting virtual transitions to higher Landau levels. Here, we formulate a nonperturbative description of effective interactions directly from the exact two-electron spectrum in a magnetic field. By solving the relative-motion problem beyond the lowest-Landau-level approximation, we define renormalized pseudopotentials $V^*_{|m|}$ from the exact eigenenergies and introduce dynamical corrections $Δ_{|m|}=V^*_{|m|}-V_{|m|}$. The corrections remain systematically negative and depend strongly on both interaction strength and relative angular momentum, reflecting dynamical correlation effects associated with higher-state virtual admixture. The exact results reproduce the perturbative Landau-level-mixing limit at weak coupling while exhibiting substantial deviations in the strong-mixing regime, signaling the breakdown of low-order perturbative expansions. In particular, the short-range interaction channels relevant to Laughlin-type correlations undergo strong renormalization, leading to substantial modification of the effective interaction hierarchy in strongly interacting systems such as ZnO/MgZnO heterostructures. The present formulation establishes a microscopic framework for incorporating nonperturbative Landau-level-mixing effects into effective interaction theories of quantum Hall systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：非微扰重整化、有效相互作用理论、Landau能级混合。；研究对象：分数量子霍尔效应体系中的Haldane赝势，特别是ZnO/MgZnO异质结等强相互作用系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确求解两电子相对运动问题（超越最低朗道能级近似），定义了重整化赝势V*_{|m|}，发现其修正Δ_{|m|}始终为负且强烈依赖于相互作用强度和相对角动量，在强耦合区域显著偏离微扰结果，表明短程相互作用通道（如Laughlin关联）受到强重整化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确求解两电子相对运动问题（超越最低朗道能级近似），定义了重整化赝势V*_{|m|}，发现其修正Δ_{|m|}始终为负且强烈依赖于相互作用强度和相对角动量，在强耦合区域显著偏离微扰结果，表明短程相互作用通道（如Laughlin关联）受到强重整化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 非微扰方法：直接求解磁场中两电子相对运动问题的精确本征能量，从中提取重整化Haldane赝势，并与传统最低朗道能级投影下的赝势进行比较。

papers.title: Discovering Thermodynamically Admissible Dissipation Potentials via Grammar-Based Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract: Constitutive laws for inelastic materials must satisfy strict thermodynamic admissibility requirements, yet current data-driven approaches sacrifice interpretability, even when formal guarantees are provided by physics-encoded architectures. We propose a symbolic regression framework for the data-driven discovery of dissipation potentials governing the evolution of internal variables within the Generalized Standard Materials (GSM) formalism. Starting from the Clausius--Duhem inequality, we enforce the thermodynamic requirements, convexity and non-negativity, that the dual dissipation potential must satisfy to guarantee non-negative mechanical dissipation. These requirements are formulated in the general subdifferential setting, encompassing rate-dependent (viscoelastic) and viscoplastic dissipative mechanisms, including potentials with genuine elastic domains, within a unified framework. Candidate potentials are generated by a composition-extended convexity-preserving grammar that guarantees thermodynamic admissibility \emph{by construction}. The framework is validated on synthetic datasets spanning Newtonian, power-law, and Bingham viscoplastic ground truths under process and measurement noise, and on experimental oscillatory shear measurements of a synthetic elastomer across multiple strain amplitudes and frequencies, where the discovered potentials reproduce the amplitude-dependent softening of the dynamic moduli and outperform a calibrated linear Zener baseline.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：symbolic regression（符号回归）、data-driven discovery（数据驱动发现）、thermodynamic admissibility（热力学容许性）。；研究对象：非弹性材料的耗散势（dissipation potential），具体涵盖率相关（粘弹性）和粘塑性耗散机制，包括具有弹性域的本构模型，研究对象为广义标准材料（GSM）框架下的内变量演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于语法的符号回归框架，能够自动发现满足热力学容许性（凸性和非负性）的耗散势，并在合成数据与实验数据上成功复现了牛顿型、幂律型、Bingham粘塑性等本构行为，以及弹性体的振幅依赖软化现象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于语法的符号回归框架，能够自动发现满足热力学容许性（凸性和非负性）的耗散势，并在合成数据与实验数据上成功复现了牛顿型、幂律型、Bingham粘塑性等本构行为，以及弹性体的振幅依赖软化现象。；创新点：通过语法约束保证所发现的耗散势函数在构造上即满足热力学容许性（凸性和非负性），无需后验验证或物理编码架构，同时保持了符号回归的可解释性。
papers.method_zh: 采用组合扩展的凸性保持语法（composition-extended convexity-preserving grammar）生成候选耗散势函数，结合符号回归进行数据驱动发现。理论框架基于Clausius-Duhem不等式和次微分（subdifferential）设定，确保所发现势函数自动满足热力学约束。验证数据包括含噪声的合成数据集和实验振荡剪切测量数据。

papers.title: Multiplet-Selective Photoelectron Diffraction from an Altermagnet
papers.abstract: Direct real-space probes of altermagnetic order remain scarce. Here we introduce multiplet-selective photoelectron diffraction (PED), a methodology in which different regions of a transition-metal core-level multiplet act as distinct photoemission source waves. Using multiple-scattering calculations for the metallic altermagnet candidate CrSb, we show that selected Cr $3p$ multiplet features with predominantly $Y_1^{+1}$ and $Y_1^{-1}$ character generate robust diffraction asymmetries sensitive to altermagnetic domains. We demonstrate that both circularly and linearly polarized light provide access to the effect, while suitable combinations of domains, light polarizations, and multiplet-energy windows suppress nonmagnetic diffraction backgrounds. The proposed approach can be implemented using standard momentum-resolved photoemission instrumentation and establishes core-level PED as a practical route toward domain-resolved studies of altermagnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到“使用多重散射计算”（using multiple-scattering calculations），未提及实验数据。；研究对象：金属性交变磁体候选材料 CrSb，具体研究其 Cr 3p 芯能级多重态的光电子衍射现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过选择 Cr 3p 多重态中具有主要 Y₁⁺¹ 和 Y₁⁻¹ 特征的不同组分作为光电子发射源波，可以产生对交变磁畴敏感的稳健衍射不对称性，从而实现交变磁序的实空间探测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过选择 Cr 3p 多重态中具有主要 Y₁⁺¹ 和 Y₁⁻¹ 特征的不同组分作为光电子发射源波，可以产生对交变磁畴敏感的稳健衍射不对称性，从而实现交变磁序的实空间探测。；创新点：提出了“多重态选择性光电子衍射”（multiplet-selective PED）这一新方法，利用过渡金属芯能级多重态中不同组分的轨道特征差异来区分交变磁畴，而非依赖传统自旋分辨或磁圆二色性手段。
papers.method_zh: 多重散射计算（multiple-scattering calculations），模拟芯能级光电子衍射（core-level photoelectron diffraction, PED），并分析不同偏振光（圆偏振和线偏振）及多重态能量窗口下的衍射图案。

papers.title: Kohn-Luttinger Superconductivity of Weyl Fermi Arcs in PtBi$_2$
papers.abstract: Recent experimental observations in the noncentrosymmetric Weyl semimetal PtBi$_2$ indicate unconventional superconductivity hosted by topological surface states -- Weyl Fermi arcs -- with a node at the center of each arc. Focusing on these Fermi arcs, we calculate the electronically mediated pairing interaction using a Kohn-Luttinger approach and find that, in a large region of the phase diagram, the leading superconducting instability has an $i$-wave symmetry featuring precisely such an intra-arc node. We study the dependence of the leading superconducting instabilities on electronic interaction parameters and chemical potential and show that the $i$-wave state is robust to changes in the model parameters. Our results provide a possible mechanism for the observation of topological $i$-wave superconductivity on the surface of PtBi$_2$ and may have implications for the broader landscape of superconducting instabilities arising from repulsive interactions on the surfaces of Weyl semimetals.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：Kohn-Luttinger approach、calculate、phase diagram。；研究对象：非中心对称Weyl半金属PtBi₂表面上的Weyl费米弧（拓扑表面态）及其非常规超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在相图的大片区域中，由电子间排斥相互作用诱导的配对不稳定性具有i波对称性，且该i波态在每个费米弧中心恰好有一个节点，与实验观测一致。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在相图的大片区域中，由电子间排斥相互作用诱导的配对不稳定性具有i波对称性，且该i波态在每个费米弧中心恰好有一个节点，与实验观测一致。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Kohn-Luttinger方法计算由电子介导的配对相互作用，并分析超导主导不稳定性随电子相互作用参数和化学势的变化。

papers.title: General-purpose LLMs as Constrained Crystal Composition Generators
papers.abstract: The targeted discovery of inorganic materials remains challenging due to the vastness of compositional design spaces and the high cost of exhaustive screening. Task-specific generative artificial intelligence represents a particularly efficient alternative to screening, yet demands tedious collection of training data before providing real benefit. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) have recently shown tremendous potential for the targeted generation of single, optimal materials compositions without the need for task-specific fine-tuning. However, it is unclear whether LLMs generally pose an advantage compared to specialized generative models, in particular in large design spaces. Here, we demonstrate that such models are capable of covering entire regions of the targeted property space effectively and systematically. Using Elpasolite materials as an established benchmark for generative tasks in large chemical spaces, we find that an iterative prompt-and-response framework is able to recover on average 96% of all low-energy Elpasolites in the target region. This performance, driven mainly by iterative in-context learning, surpasses the generative abilities of previous, task-specific models. Our results establish general-purpose LLMs as flexible and accessible components for inverse materials design workflows.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“生成式人工智能”“大语言模型”“迭代提示-响应框架”等计算与模型方法，未涉及实验手段。；研究对象：无机晶体材料的成分生成，具体以Elpasolite（埃尔帕索石）材料体系作为基准测试对象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通用大语言模型（LLMs）通过迭代上下文学习，能够有效且系统地覆盖目标性质空间中的整个区域，平均恢复96%的低能量Elpasolite材料，性能超越此前专门训练的生成模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通用大语言模型（LLMs）通过迭代上下文学习，能够有效且系统地覆盖目标性质空间中的整个区域，平均恢复96%的低能量Elpasolite材料，性能超越此前专门训练的生成模型。；创新点：证明了通用大语言模型无需专门微调即可在大型化学设计空间中有效生成目标材料成分，其覆盖目标性质空间的能力和生成性能超越了此前需要大量训练数据的任务特定生成模型。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 采用通用大语言模型（未指定具体模型名称），通过迭代提示-响应框架（iterative prompt-and-response framework）进行约束条件下的晶体成分生成，主要依赖迭代上下文学习（iterative in-context learning），无需任务特定的微调。

papers.title: Nonequilibrium scaling of drag forces in counterdriven fluid mixtures
papers.abstract: We address the effective nonequilibrium drag force field that emerges from the microscopic interparticle interactions in steady states of counterdriven binary fluid mixtures. Using power functional scaling arguments for adaptive Brownian dynamics computer simulation results, we establish quantitatively the crossover between near-equilibrium linear response and far-nonequilibrium square root asymptotics. An algebraic expression captures both limiting cases and remains applicable in the crossover regime. Using simulation results as benchmarks, we verify that a local power functional approximation based on the scaling law reproduces the spatial nonequilibrium structure formation in inhomogenously driven systems. The crossover scenario transcends dynamical density functional theory and it sheds light on general nonequilibrium scaling of driven fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合类型。关键词：power functional scaling arguments、adaptive Brownian dynamics computer simulation、local power functional approximation。；研究对象：对向驱动二元流体混合物（counterdriven binary fluid mixtures）中由微观粒子间相互作用产生的非平衡拖曳力场（nonequilibrium drag force field）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 建立了拖曳力从近平衡线性响应到远非平衡平方根渐近行为的定量交叉（crossover），并发现一个代数表达式能同时描述两种极限情况及其交叉区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：建立了拖曳力从近平衡线性响应到远非平衡平方根渐近行为的定量交叉（crossover），并发现一个代数表达式能同时描述两种极限情况及其交叉区域。；创新点：该交叉场景超越了动力学密度泛函理论（dynamical density functional theory），揭示了驱动流体中一般的非平衡标度行为。摘要未突出说明与具体实验体系的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用自适应布朗动力学计算机模拟（adaptive Brownian dynamics computer simulation），结合功率泛函标度论证（power functional scaling arguments）进行理论分析，并基于标度律构建局域功率泛函近似（local power functional approximation）来验证空间非平衡结构形成。

papers.title: Ab Initio Spinor Kadanoff-Baym Approach to Nonequilibrium Electron, Phonon and Magnon Dynamics in Itinerant Ferromagnets
papers.abstract: This work introduces a theoretical framework based on the Kadanoff-Baym equations in spinor space to study ultrafast magnetization dynamics in itinerant ferromagnetic systems from first principles. By incorporating spin-orbit coupling into the ab initio Hamiltonian and generalizing the self-energies to include terms beyond the charge sector, I derive scattering integrals within the Markov approximation and quasiparticle renormalizations for electrons and phonons in the presence of spin-dependent effective interactions within a many-body perturbation theory approach. I explicitly discuss how magnons emerge in this framework, and derive, through suitable approximations, a close and tractable set of equations for coupled electron,phonon and magnon dynamics that can be solved from first principles. This approach allows to treat coherent and incoherent magnetic dynamics on an equal footing, paving the way for a first principles understanding of ultrafast magnetic dynamics and demagnetization, and opening to a truly predictive theory of femtomagnetism in periodic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical framework”、“derived”、“first principles”、“many-body perturbation theory”。；研究对象：巡游铁磁体中的超快磁化动力学，具体涉及电子、声子和磁振子的非平衡动力学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于自旋空间的Kadanoff-Baym方程，从第一性原理出发推导了一套可求解的耦合电子、声子和磁振子动力学方程组，能够统一处理相干和非相干磁动力学，为理解超快退磁和飞秒磁学提供了预测性理论框架。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于自旋空间的Kadanoff-Baym方程，从第一性原理出发推导了一套可求解的耦合电子、声子和磁振子动力学方程组，能够统一处理相干和非相干磁动力学，为理解超快退磁和飞秒磁学提供了预测性理论框架。；创新点：首次在自旋空间中将Kadanoff-Baym方程推广到包含自旋-轨道耦合和超越电荷区的自能项，并明确推导出磁振子在该框架中的涌现机制，实现了电子、声子和磁振子动力学的第一性原理耦合求解。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理Kadanoff-Baym方程（自旋空间），结合自旋-轨道耦合的ab initio哈密顿量，在马尔可夫近似下推导散射积分，并利用多体微扰理论处理自旋依赖有效相互作用下的准粒子重整化。

papers.title: Cooperative Conformational Transitions in Macromolecules under Mechanical Stretching. An Exactly Solved Model for Single Molecule Experiments
papers.abstract: The stretching behavior of linear macromolecules undergoing conformational transitions is investigated. An exact solution is provided for a two-state system within the elastic freely jointed chain model. This minimal framework contains the smallest set of parameters required to describe such transitions: two Kuhn lengths, two elastic force constants, a free energy difference between both states and a nearest-neighbor interaction energy accounting for cooperativity. Explicit analytical expressions are derived for the chain extension and the probabilities of each state as functions of the applied force.The approach accurately reproduces the experimental force-extension curves of poly(ethylene-glycol) (PEG) and hyaluronic acid (HA), revealing no cooperativity for PEG and negative cooperativity for HA. It also describes the B-DNA to S-DNA conformational transition, a process that exhibits positive cooperativity.We analyze the mathematical conditions required for a transition and identify two fundamental driving mechanisms: differences in Kuhn lengths and differences in force constants.Extensions of the model to systems with more than two conformational states per Kuhn segment are also discussed. The results presented here apply equally to transitions that are intrinsic to the macromolecular structure or induced by ligand-receptor interactions, unifying both cases within a single thermodynamically consistent framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：exact solution, analytical expressions, model）；研究对象：线性大分子在机械拉伸下的构象转变行为，具体包括聚乙二醇（PEG）、透明质酸（HA）以及B-DNA到S-DNA的构象转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该两态弹性自由连接链模型能精确再现PEG、HA和B-DNA到S-DNA的力-伸长曲线，并揭示PEG无协同性、HA具有负协同性、B-DNA到S-DNA转变具有正协同性；构象转变的两种基本驱动力为Kuhn长度差异和力常数差异。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该两态弹性自由连接链模型能精确再现PEG、HA和B-DNA到S-DNA的力-伸长曲线，并揭示PEG无协同性、HA具有负协同性、B-DNA到S-DNA转变具有正协同性；构象转变的两种基本驱动力为Kuhn长度差异和力常数差异。；创新点：在最小参数框架内提供了构象转变的精确可解模型，统一描述了由大分子结构固有转变和配体-受体相互作用诱导的转变，并明确区分了两种驱动机制。
papers.method_zh: 基于弹性自由连接链模型，构建包含两个Kuhn长度、两个弹性力常数、两态自由能差及最近邻相互作用能（协同性）的最小参数两态系统，并推导出链伸长和状态概率作为外加力函数的显式解析表达式。

papers.title: What controls the superconducting dome of electron-doped FeSe?
papers.abstract: Superconducting domes are conspicuous features of the phase diagrams of most unconventional and high-temperature superconductors. The superconducting transition temperature ($T_{c}$) of FeSe can be dramatically enhanced with electron doping, but unlike all other high-temperature and unconventional superconductors, its full phase diagram and superconducting dome have yet to be fully explored. Here, we employ a combination of molecular beam epitaxy synthesis, alkali surface doping, in-vacuum electrical transport, and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to investigate the entire superconducting dome of electron-doped FeSe, achieving a fully metallic state where superconductivity is suppressed in the heavily overdoped regime. We discover a robust scaling between $T_{c}$ and the residual resistivity ($ρ_{0}$) which holds across the entire superconducting dome, suggesting that the evolution of $T_{c}$ is heavily influenced by the evolution of the elastic scattering rate in the high-$T_{c}$ electron-doped phase. This in turn suggests that the superconducting dome in electron-doped FeSe appears to be fundamentally different than that of other unconventional superconductors where doping plays the primary role, and may be driven primarily by the sensitivity of the superconductivity to disorder.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到了“分子束外延合成”、“碱金属表面掺杂”、“真空电输运”和“角分辨光电子能谱”等具体实验手段。；研究对象：电子掺杂的FeSe超导体。具体研究其整个超导穹顶（superconducting dome）的相图，特别是重过掺杂区域超导电性被抑制的完全金属态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现电子掺杂FeSe的超导转变温度（Tc）与残余电阻率（ρ₀）在整个超导穹顶范围内存在稳健的标度关系。这表明Tc的演化主要受高Tc电子掺杂相中弹性散射率变化的影响，而非像其他非常规超导体那样主要由掺杂浓度控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现电子掺杂FeSe的超导转变温度（Tc）与残余电阻率（ρ₀）在整个超导穹顶范围内存在稳健的标度关系。这表明Tc的演化主要受高Tc电子掺杂相中弹性散射率变化的影响，而非像其他非常规超导体那样主要由掺杂浓度控制。；创新点：首次完整探索了电子掺杂FeSe的整个超导穹顶，并揭示了其超导穹顶的物理机制可能与其他非常规超导体（如铜氧化物）有本质不同——即超导电性对无序（disorder）的敏感性可能比掺杂本身起着更主导的作用。
papers.method_zh: 结合了分子束外延（MBE）薄膜生长、碱金属（如钾、钠等）表面掺杂技术、原位（in-vacuum）电输运测量以及角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）。

papers.title: Solving models with generalized free fermions II: Path-product expansion and conserved charges
papers.abstract: Free-fermion solvability in quantum spin systems is increasingly understood to be governed by a graph Clifford algebra defined from the frustration graph of the Hamiltonian. When the frustration graph belongs to certain classes, such as the even-hole-free and claw-free (ECF) class, the Hamiltonian is solvable by hidden free fermions: it admits a free-fermion solution although it does not reduce to a Majorana bilinear under the Jordan-Wigner transformation. However, unlike in the Jordan-Wigner case, where each mode is a linear combination of single Majorana fermions, the explicit operator structure of the hidden free-fermion modes -- and that of the local conserved charges -- has remained obscure. In this work, we derive a path-product expansion that expresses each free-fermion mode as a linear combination of path products along induced paths in the extended frustration graph. The expansion is obtained from the generating function of the Krylov basis and yields the modes directly, without using the transfer matrix or the nonlocal conserved charges as input. As an application, the mode decomposition computes infinite-temperature dynamical correlation functions for arbitrary ECF frustration graphs. We further obtain explicit expressions for local conserved charges as linear combinations of path products along induced paths; these charges apply beyond the free-fermion (ECF) class to more general claw-free frustration graphs. We also identify a unified family of generalized conserved charges that contains both the previously known nonlocal conserved charges and these local conserved charges as special cases. For Fendley's original FFD chain with homogeneous couplings and periodic boundary conditions, in a suitable basis, the structure of these local conserved charges exhibits the same Catalan-tree pattern as in the spin-$1/2$ XXX chain.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：free-fermion solvability、graph Clifford algebra、path-product expansion、generating function、Krylov basis。；研究对象：量子自旋系统中的广义自由费米子可解模型，特别是具有偶空穴自由且无爪（ECF）类受挫图的哈密顿量，以及更一般的无爪受挫图。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出路径积展开，将每个隐藏自由费米子模式表达为扩展受挫图中诱导路径的线性组合，并获得了局域守恒荷的显式表达式；这些局域守恒荷在更一般的无爪受挫图中也适用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出路径积展开，将每个隐藏自由费米子模式表达为扩展受挫图中诱导路径的线性组合，并获得了局域守恒荷的显式表达式；这些局域守恒荷在更一般的无爪受挫图中也适用。；创新点：首次直接给出了隐藏自由费米子模式（而非通过Jordan-Wigner变换）的显式算符结构，并得到了局域守恒荷的显式路径积表达式；同时识别出一个统一的广义守恒荷族，将已知的非局域守恒荷与这些局域守恒荷作为特例包含在内。
papers.method_zh: 基于受挫图的图Clifford代数，利用Krylov基的生成函数推导路径积展开，无需使用转移矩阵或非局域守恒荷作为输入；通过模式分解计算无限温度动力学关联函数。

papers.title: Strain-Engineered s-C$_3$N$_6$ Monolayer for Efficient Water Splitting: A first-principles study
papers.abstract: Photocatalytic water splitting offers a sustainable route for solar-to-hydrogen energy conversion, yet identifying stable, metal-free semiconductors with suitable electronic, optical, and band-alignment properties remains challenging. Here, we investigate the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical, and photocatalytic properties of the two-dimensional s-C$_3$N$_6$ monolayer using first-principles calculations. Ab initio molecular dynamics and elastic constant analysis confirm its thermal and mechanical stability. Hybrid HSE06 calculations reveal pristine s-C$_3$N$_6$ is a direct-band-gap semiconductor (2.62 eV). However, its conduction-band minimum lies below the hydrogen reduction potential, preventing spontaneous hydrogen evolution. To overcome this limitation, we employ biaxial and uniaxial strains (-10% to +10%) to modulate its electronic structure. We find that compressive biaxial strains of -8% and -10% uniquely tune the band edges to straddle the redox potentials, enabling spontaneous overall water splitting. Crucially, these photocatalytically active states remain mechanically and thermally stable. Optical properties calculations show the fundamental gap in both pristine and strained structures is optically dark, with the primary absorption peak in the UV region. Furthermore, a strain-induced mobility mismatch between electrons and holes facilitates efficient charge separation. However, thermodynamic modeling of surface kinetics reveals that the s-C$_3$N$_6$ surface binds intermediates strongly, necessitating a co-catalyst to overcome kinetic barriers. Our results establish strain engineering as an effective strategy to tailor band-edge alignment, carrier dynamics, and optical transitions in s-C$_3$N$_6$, highlighting its potential for stable 2D photocatalytic water splitting.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：first-principles calculations、HSE06、ab initio molecular dynamics。；研究对象：二维s-C₃N₆单层材料的光催化水分解性能。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过施加-8%和-10%的双轴压缩应变，可将s-C₃N₆单层的能带边缘调至跨越水的氧化还原电位，实现自发全解水；同时应变诱导的电子-空穴迁移率失配有利于电荷分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过施加-8%和-10%的双轴压缩应变，可将s-C₃N₆单层的能带边缘调至跨越水的氧化还原电位，实现自发全解水；同时应变诱导的电子-空穴迁移率失配有利于电荷分离。；创新点：首次系统研究了应变工程对s-C₃N₆单层光催化性能的调控作用，发现特定压缩应变可使其从非自发产氢转变为可自发全解水，并揭示了应变对光学吸收和载流子迁移率的影响。
papers.method_zh: 第一性原理计算（基于密度泛函理论），具体包括：HSE06杂化泛函计算电子结构、从头算分子动力学（AIMD）评估热稳定性、弹性常数分析评估力学稳定性、光学性质计算、以及表面动力学热力学建模。

papers.title: Optimization of multisite reactions in complex compartmentalized media
papers.abstract: In complex media, transport and geometric properties deeply influence the kinetics of random encounters between reactants. Here, we consider the situation where a random walker, moving in a regularly diffusing medium, has to reach and activate a target located inside a compartment characterized by fractal (obstructed) sub-diffusion. We focus on dual-site reactions, which end when two activation events occur within a given time window. Each activation event happens with a finite probability whenever the random walker visits the target. For weakly reactive targets, we demonstrate that the reaction time can be minimized for an optimal compartment size and can even be accelerated when compared to the same system without compartment. Our analytical predictions are validated through simulations of a random walker on a cubic lattice, where some sites inside the compartment are obstructed at the critical percolation threshold. Our theory illustrates the fact that adding a crowded compartment around a target, even if it slows down the motion in its vicinity, can accelerate the kinetics of complex reactions, especially for weakly reactive targets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词“analytical predictions”“simulations of a random walker on a cubic lattice”。；研究对象：复杂介质中多位置反应（dual-site reactions）的动力学，具体为：一个在规则扩散介质中运动的随机行走者，需激活位于一个具有分形（受阻）亚扩散特性的隔室内的靶点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于弱反应性靶点，存在一个最优隔室尺寸可使反应时间最小化；与无隔室的系统相比，添加拥挤隔室反而能加速复杂反应的动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于弱反应性靶点，存在一个最优隔室尺寸可使反应时间最小化；与无隔室的系统相比，添加拥挤隔室反而能加速复杂反应的动力学。；创新点：揭示了在靶点周围添加拥挤隔室（即使会减慢局部运动）可以加速弱反应性靶点的多位置反应动力学，并给出了最优隔室尺寸的存在性及解析预测。摘要未突出说明与已有模型的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合数值模拟。采用随机行走者在立方晶格上的模拟，其中隔室内部分格点处于临界逾渗阈值（critical percolation threshold）下的受阻状态，以模拟分形亚扩散环境。

papers.title: Odd-Parity Magnons
papers.abstract: Magnons, as charge-neutral spin excitations, can transport spin information without Joule heating and therefore offer a promising platform for low-power spintronics. However, in collinear magnets, the effective time-reversal symmetry forbids odd-parity magnon band splitting. Here we propose odd-parity magnons and establish a general mechanism for realizing them in collinear antiferromagnets. We provide a complete spin-point-group classification of odd-parity magnon splitting in two-dimensional collinear antiferromagnets by identifying the leading splitting types and their symmetry-allowed basis functions. This classification serves as a practical guide for searching for odd-parity magnons. We show that breaking effective time-reversal symmetry, for example by circularly polarized light or loop currents, can induce highly tunable $p$- and $f$-wave magnon splitting. In bilayer systems, the dynamical modulation can drive a topological magnon phase transition, accompanied by chiral edge modes and an abrupt jump in the magnon thermal Hall conductivity. Material-specific first-principles calculations further demonstrate the feasibility of this mechanism in real van der Waals antiferromagnets. Our study identifies the odd-parity magnons as a new class of spin excitations and provides a theoretical foundation for odd-parity magnons and ultrafast optically controlled topological magnonic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（含第一性原理计算）。判断依据：提出理论机制、对称性分类、模型分析、第一性原理计算验证。；研究对象：奇宇称磁振子（odd-parity magnons），具体在二维共线反铁磁体中的实现，以及其在范德瓦尔斯反铁磁材料中的可行性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共线反铁磁体中，通过打破有效时间反演对称性（如圆偏振光或环电流），可以实现高度可调的p波和f波磁振子劈裂，并驱动拓扑磁振子相变，伴随手性边缘模和热霍尔电导的突变。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共线反铁磁体中，通过打破有效时间反演对称性（如圆偏振光或环电流），可以实现高度可调的p波和f波磁振子劈裂，并驱动拓扑磁振子相变，伴随手性边缘模和热霍尔电导的突变。；创新点：首次提出“奇宇称磁振子”这一新概念，并建立了在共线反铁磁体中实现奇宇称磁振子劈裂的普适机制，提供了完整的二维共线反铁磁体自旋点群分类，为超快光控拓扑磁振子器件奠定了理论基础。
papers.method_zh: 自旋点群对称性分类（识别劈裂类型及对称性允许的基函数）、模型分析、第一性原理计算（材料特异性计算，验证在真实范德瓦尔斯反铁磁体中的可行性）。

papers.title: Crystallisation kinetics of supercooled liquid palladium
authors: Robert W. E. van de Kruijs
papers.abstract: In this study, we employ classical molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to investigate the crystallisation kinetics of supercooled liquid palladium and relate the results to time-resolved X-ray diffraction measurements on rapidly quenched Pd thin films. Crystal nucleation and growth rates are determined over the temperature range $700$--$1150~\mathrm{K}$ ($0.38$--$0.65 T_{\mathrm{m}}$) by analysing the evolution of the microstructure during the liquid-to-crystal transition. The self-diffusion coefficient of Pd, obtained from the atomic mean-squared displacement, follows Arrhenius behaviour over the investigated temperature range, with an activation energy of $467(6)~\mathrm{meV/atom}$, consistent with available data for supercooled liquid metals. The steady-state homogeneous nucleation rate exhibits a maximum of approximately $4 \times 10^{35}~\mathrm{m^{-3} s^{-1}}$ near $0.5 T_{\mathrm{m}}$. Crystal growth occurs at velocities of the order of metres per second, with a temperature dependence consistent with diffusion-limited Wilson-Frenkel kinetics rather than the collision-limited regime. Based on multiple statistically independent simulations, a time-temperature-transformation (TTT) diagram for crystallisation onset is constructed. The TTT curve exhibits a nose near $0.5 T_{\mathrm{m}}$ and $100~\mathrm{ps}$, corresponding to a critical cooling rate for vitrification on the order of $10^{13}~\mathrm{K s^{-1}}.$ The simulations reproduce the crystallisation onset time and temperature observed in time-resolved X-ray diffraction experiments on optically molten Pd thin films quenched at $5 \times 10^{11}~\mathrm{K s^{-1}}.$ These results indicate that homogeneous, rather than heterogeneous, nucleation governs the achievable supercooling in the experimentally studied films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：classical molecular dynamics simulations、MD simulations、statistically independent simulations）；研究对象：过冷液态钯（supercooled liquid palladium）的结晶动力学，包括晶体成核与生长过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 过冷液态钯的稳态均匀成核速率在约0.5 Tm（熔点）附近达到最大值约4×10^35 m^{-3} s^{-1}，晶体生长速度达米/秒量级，且受扩散限制的Wilson-Frenkel动力学支配而非碰撞限制。模拟构建的TTT曲线鼻点位于约0.5 Tm和100 ps处，对应玻璃化临界冷却速率约10^13 K s^{-1}，并成功复现了实验观测的结晶起始时间与温度，表明实验中可达到的过冷度由均匀成核而非异质成核主导。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：过冷液态钯的稳态均匀成核速率在约0.5 Tm（熔点）附近达到最大值约4×10^35 m^{-3} s^{-1}，晶体生长速度达米/秒量级，且受扩散限制的Wilson-Frenkel动力学支配而非碰撞限制。模拟构建的TTT曲线鼻点位于约0.5 Tm和100 ps处，对应玻璃化临界冷却速率约10^13 K s^{-1}，并成功复现了实验观测的结晶起始时间与温度，表明实验中可达到的过冷度由均匀成核而非异质成核主导。；创新点：将MD模拟结果直接与时间分辨X射线衍射实验（快速淬火Pd薄膜）进行定量对比，并明确指出在实验条件下均匀成核是决定过冷度的主导机制。
papers.method_zh: 经典分子动力学（MD）模拟，通过分析液-晶转变过程中微观结构的演化确定成核与生长速率；利用原子均方位移计算自扩散系数；基于多次统计独立模拟构建时间-温度-转变（TTT）图。

papers.title: Direct Observation of Chemical Short-Range Order in CoCrNi Alloy Using Neutron Diffraction
papers.abstract: This study provides experimental evidence of chemical short-range order (CSRO) in the equiatomic CoCrNi alloy, identified through neutron diffraction. The phenomenon manifests as a distinct diffuse peak at Q = 1.85 A-1, the intensity increases under thermodynamically favorable conditions for CSRO development such as prolonged aging (100 h and 240 h) at 748 K or shorter aging (24 h) at slightly higher temperature (798 K). The degree of ordering was measured by integrating the diffuse scattering intensity, revealing that the gas-atomized sample, i.e. the sample with the least amount of CSRO, still displays approximately 70% of the CSRO level observed in the sample subsequently aged for 240 h at 748 K, i.e. the sample with the highest amount of CSRO produced in this study. Predictive atomistic simulations reproduced both the presence and position of the diffuse peak, while two-dimensional fast Fourier transform (FT-2D) analyses indicated that reflections at (1 1/2 0) within the <001> zone axis originate from some structural projections associated with like D022, Pt2Mo and D1a motifs. Complementary small-angle neutron scattering (SANS) measurements identified Ni-rich, disk-shaped domains with radii of approximately 11 A and thicknesses of about 1 A, consistent with nanoscale CSRO characteristic length scale. These findings demonstrate that CSRO is an intrinsic and energetically favorable feature of the CoCrNi system, remaining stable even under rapid solidification and further enhanced by low-temperature aging. Combined use of neutron diffraction and atomistic modeling provides a framework for probing local ordering phenomena in multi-principal element alloys (MPEAs).
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（兼有计算模拟）。判断依据：neutron diffraction（中子衍射）、SANS（小角中子散射）等实验手段为主，辅以predictive atomistic simulations（预测性原子模拟）和FT-2D分析。；研究对象：等原子比CoCrNi合金中的化学短程有序（CSRO）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过中子衍射直接观测到CoCrNi合金中CSRO的存在，证明CSRO是该体系内禀且能量上有利的特征，即使在快速凝固条件下也能保持稳定，低温时效可进一步增强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过中子衍射直接观测到CoCrNi合金中CSRO的存在，证明CSRO是该体系内禀且能量上有利的特征，即使在快速凝固条件下也能保持稳定，低温时效可进一步增强。；创新点：首次通过中子衍射实验直接证实CoCrNi合金中CSRO的存在，并定量测量了不同热处理条件下CSRO的程度（如气雾化样品CSRO水平已达充分时效样品的约70%），结合SANS给出了CSRO的特征尺度（半径约11 Å、厚度约1 Å的盘状畴）。
papers.method_zh: 中子衍射（观测Q=1.85 Å⁻¹处的漫散射峰）、小角中子散射（SANS，识别Ni-rich盘状纳米畴）、预测性原子模拟（复现漫散射峰位置）、二维快速傅里叶变换（FT-2D，分析<001>晶带轴内(1 1/2 0)反射对应的结构投影，如D0₂₂、Pt₂Mo、D1a motif）。

papers.title: Spontaneous flows and interfacial instabilities in oxygen-sensitive living active matter
papers.abstract: Active fluids generate motion and stress internally, but in living systems this activity is often regulated by environmental fields that the organisms consume or produce. Here we show that oxygen gradients organise and destabilise dense suspensions of the flagellated microswimmer \textit{Euglena gracilis}. In circular chambers open to air at the periphery, oxygen exchange and cellular consumption generate a radial chemical gradient. An initially homogeneous suspension spontaneously forms a dense cellular ring through oxygen-dependent motility and bidirectional oxytaxis. The ring then develops collective rotation and destabilises into a long-lived corona of protrusions. We reproduce this sequence with an oxygen-coupled polar active-fluid model in which oxygen controls both the direction and speed of cell motion, while dipolar active stresses drive the instability of the dense interface. The simulations show that oxygen taxis creates the annular active interface, but the subsequent corona is an activity-driven interfacial instability. Our results reveal how a self-generated chemical gradient can position and activate a living fluid, providing a route to environmental control of active-matter flows and interfaces.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与理论计算结合）。判断依据：实验观察了活物质体系中的自发流动与界面失稳现象，并构建了氧耦合极性活流体模型进行数值模拟。；研究对象：论文研究的是对氧气敏感的活物质体系，具体为鞭毛微生物 *Euglena gracilis*（眼虫）的密集悬浮液，在氧气梯度作用下的自发流动与界面失稳现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氧气梯度能够组织并失稳密集的微生物悬浮液：初始均匀的悬浮液通过氧气依赖的趋氧性自发形成致密细胞环，随后该环产生集体旋转并失稳为长寿命的冠状突起结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氧气梯度能够组织并失稳密集的微生物悬浮液：初始均匀的悬浮液通过氧气依赖的趋氧性自发形成致密细胞环，随后该环产生集体旋转并失稳为长寿命的冠状突起结构。；创新点：揭示了自生化学梯度（氧气梯度）如何定位并激活活流体，提供了一条通过环境控制活物质流动与界面的途径。摘要未突出说明与已有活物质研究在机制上的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用圆形腔室，其外围与空气接触，通过氧气交换和细胞消耗产生径向化学梯度；理论上构建了氧耦合极性活流体模型，其中氧气同时控制细胞运动的方向和速度，偶极活性应力驱动致密界面的失稳。

papers.title: Co-optimization of spin coherence and valley splitting in Si/SiGe heterostructures
papers.abstract: Single electron spins can be used to encode and process information in semiconductor quantum devices. Progress has been hindered by materials challenges, such as the small energy splitting between low-lying valley states and hyperfine coupling to nuclear spins. Here we use density functional theory to optimize the valley splitting and spin dephasing time in realistic Si/SiGe heterostructures. Reductions in the Si quantum well width generally increase the valley splitting. However, in narrow quantum wells, a larger fraction of the electronic wavefunction resides in the SiGe buffer layers, which increases the hyperfine coupling with spinful $^{73}$Ge. Our work shows that Si/SiGe heterostructures with 3~--~4~nm wide quantum wells and $^{73}$Ge and $^{29}$Si concentrations of 50 ppm should support average valley splittings $E_{v}$~$>$~500~$μ$eV and spin dephasing times $T_2^*$ exceeding 15~$μ$s assuming an effective quantum dot area of 700 nm$^2$. In addition, sharper Si/SiGe interfaces in general result in larger valley splittings and longer spin dephasing times.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory（密度泛函理论）、optimize（优化）、realistic Si/SiGe heterostructures（实际Si/SiGe异质结构）。；研究对象：Si/SiGe异质结构中的单电子自旋量子比特，具体关注量子阱宽度、界面陡峭度、同位素浓度对谷分裂（valley splitting）和自旋退相时间（spin dephasing time）的协同优化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过优化量子阱宽度（3~4 nm）并控制⁷³Ge和²⁹Si浓度至50 ppm，可在有效量子点面积700 nm²下实现平均谷分裂>500 μeV和自旋退相时间>15 μs；更陡峭的Si/SiGe界面同时有利于增大谷分裂和延长自旋退相时间。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过优化量子阱宽度（3~4 nm）并控制⁷³Ge和²⁹Si浓度至50 ppm，可在有效量子点面积700 nm²下实现平均谷分裂>500 μeV和自旋退相时间>15 μs；更陡峭的Si/SiGe界面同时有利于增大谷分裂和延长自旋退相时间。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用密度泛函理论（DFT）对实际Si/SiGe异质结构进行第一性原理计算，系统扫描量子阱宽度、同位素浓度和界面形貌等参数对谷分裂和超精细耦合的影响。

papers.title: Feasibility study of continuous electronic Pomeranchuk cooling with a flavor-degenerate Wigner crystal
papers.abstract: Achieving sub-millikelvin electron temperatures in nanoelectronic devices could unveil new transport phenomena, extend quantum coherence times, and enhance the precision of quantum metrology. However, maintaining such low temperatures continuously remains a long-standing challenge. Here, we propose and simulate an on-chip cooling cycle that harnesses the entropy difference between an electron liquid (EL) and a Wigner crystal (WC) in flavor-degenerate flat-band materials. Cooling is driven by a current through a device with a locally gated region. Within this region, the charge carrier density is tuned such that a WC forms beneath the gate. As carriers transition from an EL to WC phase, their entropy increases, extracting heat and the sliding WC advects this heat along the device. The heat is then released when carriers transition back to the EL phase, which establishes distinct hot and cold regions and a steady temperature gradient over the device. Simulations show net cooling for sufficiently low current densities, typically below $1~\mathrm{nA}/μ\mathrm{m}$, whereas Joule heating dominates at higher currents. Within the gated region, we estimate cooling powers of up to $8.4~\mathrm{aW}/μ\mathrm{m}$ at a bath temperature of $4~\mathrm{mK}$. Our approach can achieve electron temperatures well below $1~\mathrm{mK}$ under suitable conditions, promising a route towards continuous on-chip cooling in this temperature regime. Our approach applies to any flat-band material with low-energy flavor degeneracy (valley and/or orbital) and low disorder, including gapped Bernal-stacked bilayer graphene, rhombohedral-stacked multilayer graphene, and magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：propose and simulate（提出并模拟）、simulations show（模拟显示）、estimates（估算）。；研究对象：连续电子波梅兰丘克冷却（continuous electronic Pomeranchuk cooling）方案，具体利用味简并平带材料中电子液体（EL）与维格纳晶体（WC）之间的熵差，在纳米电子器件中实现片上冷却。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过调控局域栅极下的载流子密度，使电子在电子液体与维格纳晶体之间循环相变，利用相变熵差实现连续冷却；在足够低的电流密度（通常低于1 nA/μm）下可实现净冷却，在4 mK浴温下栅极区域冷却功率可达8.4 aW/μm，有望将电子温度持续降至1 mK以下。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过调控局域栅极下的载流子密度，使电子在电子液体与维格纳晶体之间循环相变，利用相变熵差实现连续冷却；在足够低的电流密度（通常低于1 nA/μm）下可实现净冷却，在4 mK浴温下栅极区域冷却功率可达8.4 aW/μm，有望将电子温度持续降至1 mK以下。；创新点：首次提出利用味简并平带材料中电子液体与维格纳晶体的熵差，实现连续、片上、亚毫开尔文电子温度的冷却方案，并给出了可行性模拟与冷却功率估算。
papers.method_zh: 提出并模拟了一个片上冷却循环方案：器件包含局域栅极区域，通过调节该区域载流子密度使维格纳晶体形成；载流子从电子液体相变为维格纳晶体时熵增加并吸热，滑动的维格纳晶体将热量沿器件输运，载流子再变回电子液体时释放热量，从而建立冷热区域和稳定温度梯度。模拟分析了不同电流密度下的净冷却效果与焦耳热竞争。

papers.title: A Practical Guide for Diagnosing Imaginary Phonon Modes in Metal--Organic Frameworks: The Case of MOF-5
papers.abstract: Assessing the dynamical stability of computationally predicted metal--organic frameworks (MOFs) is essential to distinguish synthetically feasible structures from dynamically unstable ones. However, reliable first-principles phonon calculations on these systems remain challenging: their large, flexible unit cells and soft collective modes make the vibrational spectrum highly sensitive to the numerical settings. Using MOF-5 as a representative case study, we establish a finite-displacement workflow to identify and isolate the origins of imaginary phonon modes. We demonstrate how numerical force convergence thresholds, real-space grid resolutions, symmetry-standardization protocols, and alternative unit-cell representations can qualitatively and spuriously alter the predicted lattice stability. Once numerical noise is confidently excluded, the remaining imaginary modes can be analyzed through mode mapping or stochastic Monte Carlo symmetry-breaking distortions to locate lower-energy local minima. This protocol provides a robust, transferable strategy for the reliable assessment of dynamical stability and lattice vibrations in flexible porous frameworks.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles phonon calculations”、“finite-displacement workflow”、“DFT”（隐含）、“Monte Carlo symmetry-breaking distortions”。；研究对象：金属有机框架（MOFs）的动力学稳定性，具体以MOF-5为代表性案例，研究其声子谱中虚频模式的诊断与排除方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 数值计算设置（如力收敛阈值、实空间网格分辨率、对称性标准化协议及晶胞表示方式）会定性地、虚假地改变MOF-5的晶格稳定性预测；在排除数值噪声后，剩余的虚频模式可通过模式映射或蒙特卡洛对称性破缺畸变找到更低能量的局域极小值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：数值计算设置（如力收敛阈值、实空间网格分辨率、对称性标准化协议及晶胞表示方式）会定性地、虚假地改变MOF-5的晶格稳定性预测；在排除数值噪声后，剩余的虚频模式可通过模式映射或蒙特卡洛对称性破缺畸变找到更低能量的局域极小值。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 有限位移法（finite-displacement method）计算声子谱，结合力收敛阈值测试、实空间网格分辨率测试、对称性标准化协议比较、不同晶胞表示对比，以及模式映射（mode mapping）和随机蒙特卡洛对称性破缺畸变（stochastic Monte Carlo symmetry-breaking distortions）分析。

papers.title: Limits of the Non-Linear Generalized Langevin Equation: Cross-Correlations, Irreversibility and Desynchronization
papers.abstract: The generalized Langevin equation (GLE) is widely used to model complex soft-matter systems, including biomolecular dynamics, by incorporating memory effects and colored noise into coarse-grained descriptions. However, recent results suggest that combining memory with non-linear forces, ubiquitous in soft matter, introduces fundamental analytical inconsistencies. Here, using a simplified model, we investigate the practical numerical consequences of these analytical results. We show that non-linear forces generate cross-correlations with the noise, modifying the fluctuation-dissipation theorem and rendering the noise position-dependent and irreversible. This implies that the commonly assumed reversible Gaussian noise in GLE simulations fails to capture essential features of the microscopic fluctuations. For weak non-linearities, these issues can be partially resolved either by using an iterative optimization of memory or by using microscopically consistent noise, which unexpectedly synchronizes GLE trajectories with the underlying microscopic dynamics. For stronger non-linearities like high barriers or shoulders in the external potential, however, iterative reconstruction fails and we observe desynchronization, indicating that the non-linear GLE no longer correctly reproduces the microscopic dynamics. Our results show in which situations non-linear GLEs can be accurately applied and when they fail, thus providing practical guidance for their application to coarse-grain soft-matter systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有数值模拟）。判断依据：关键词包括“analytical inconsistencies”、“numerical consequences”、“simplified model”、“simulations”。；研究对象：非线性广义朗之万方程（non-linear GLE）在软物质系统（如生物分子动力学）粗粒化建模中的适用性，特别是记忆效应与非线性力结合时产生的交叉关联、不可逆性和去同步化问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 非线性力会引入与噪声的交叉关联，破坏涨落-耗散定理，使噪声具有位置依赖性和不可逆性；在强非线性（如高势垒或肩势）下，非线性GLE无法正确复现微观动力学，出现去同步化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：非线性力会引入与噪声的交叉关联，破坏涨落-耗散定理，使噪声具有位置依赖性和不可逆性；在强非线性（如高势垒或肩势）下，非线性GLE无法正确复现微观动力学，出现去同步化。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用简化模型进行数值模拟，通过迭代优化记忆函数或使用微观一致噪声来尝试修正弱非线性下的问题，并对比GLE轨迹与微观动力学轨迹的同步性。

papers.title: Valley-polarized Orbital and Spin Magnetism Induced by Femtosecond Optical Pulses in Two-Dimensional Semiconductors
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate the ultrafast generation of spin and orbital magnetism in a two-dimensional gapped Dirac system with spin-orbit coupling. This system is representative of two-dimensional hexagonal semiconductors, such as transition-metal dichalcogenides that exhibit valley-selective optical selection rules arising from the valley-contrasting magnetic texture of their band structure. Using a time-dependent density-matrix formalism, we demonstrate that circularly polarized laser pulses generate nonequilibrium magnetization under both resonant and multiphoton resonant conditions. We show that the induced spin and orbital magnetic moments can be distinctly controlled via the photon energy and polarization of the driving field. Furthermore, spin and orbital dynamics originate from fundamentally different light-matter coupling mechanisms, leading to qualitatively dissimilar temporal behaviors. The orbital magnetic moment couples directly to the external electric field, resulting in faster dynamics and pronounced Rabi-like oscillations, whereas the spin response develops gradually through spin-orbit coupling. Consequently, orbital dynamics is significantly more sensitive to electron-hole dephasing than the spin response. Our results highlight the importance of properly accounting for orbital contributions in future technologies that utilize femtosecond control of magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“time-dependent density-matrix formalism”。；研究对象：二维带隙狄拉克体系（具有自旋-轨道耦合），代表材料为过渡金属二硫属化物（TMDs）等二维六角半导体，具体物理现象为飞秒光脉冲诱导的谷极化轨道磁性和自旋磁性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 圆偏振激光脉冲可在共振及多光子共振条件下产生非平衡磁化，且自旋与轨道磁矩可通过光子能量和偏振独立调控；轨道磁矩直接耦合外电场，动力学更快并呈现拉比振荡，而自旋响应通过自旋-轨道耦合缓慢发展，对退相干的敏感性更低。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：圆偏振激光脉冲可在共振及多光子共振条件下产生非平衡磁化，且自旋与轨道磁矩可通过光子能量和偏振独立调控；轨道磁矩直接耦合外电场，动力学更快并呈现拉比振荡，而自旋响应通过自旋-轨道耦合缓慢发展，对退相干的敏感性更低。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用含时密度矩阵形式（time-dependent density-matrix formalism）进行理论计算，分析光与物质相互作用下的非平衡自旋和轨道动力学。

papers.title: Droplets sitting on thin elastic sheets: A study with the boundary element method
papers.abstract: Elasto-capillarity of a droplet wetting an elastic sheet provides an interesting system, both for fundamental and applied research. The droplet sinks into the sheet and assumes the shape of a lens. To determine the equilibrium shape in simulations, we formulate a boundary element method (BEM) extending our earlier approaches, and apply the BEM to three specific protocols for the boundary conditions of the sheet. For a clamped elastic sheet, we use various morphological metrics to demonstrate that the lens shape crucially depends on the sheet thickness. Stretching the sheet isotropically, allows for an additional control parameter to influence the droplet shape and the tension in the sheet, which we quantify by radial profiles of the azimuthal and radial elastic stresses. We further demonstrate how the focal length of a liquid lens can be tuned by varying the applied tension. Finally, stretching the sheet along one direction, elongates the droplet, and the sheet shows folds and dimples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：boundary element method (BEM)、simulations。；研究对象：液滴浸润弹性薄片时的弹性-毛细耦合现象，具体为液滴在薄片上形成的透镜状平衡形态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 液滴透镜形状关键依赖于薄片厚度；通过各向同性拉伸薄片可调控液滴形状和薄片张力，进而调节液体透镜的焦距；各向异性拉伸会使液滴拉长并在薄片上产生褶皱和凹陷。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：液滴透镜形状关键依赖于薄片厚度；通过各向同性拉伸薄片可调控液滴形状和薄片张力，进而调节液体透镜的焦距；各向异性拉伸会使液滴拉长并在薄片上产生褶皱和凹陷。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 边界元方法（BEM），基于作者先前方法进行扩展，应用于三种不同的薄片边界条件（夹持、各向同性拉伸、单向拉伸）。

papers.title: Charged Bose polarons at finite momentum
papers.abstract: Charged impurities in quantum fluids have unveiled new classes of strongly correlated many-body states across condensed matter, ultracold gases, and hybrid atom-ion platforms. While previous studies have primarily focused on their ground-state and static properties, much less is known about their finite-momentum behavior, which governs transport, dissipation, and quasiparticle stability. Here, we investigate the momentum-dependent properties of a charged Bose polaron using a diagrammatic approach within second-order perturbation theory, explicitly accounting for the finite-range nature of the ion-atom interaction. We show that the interaction range introduces a characteristic momentum scale at which many-body dressing and dissipation are maximized, leading to a non-monotonic behavior of the damping rate and quasiparticle energy. In the high-momentum regime, we uncover a scaling law $Γ_p \sim 1/p$, signaling the suppression of many-body dressing and the recovery of quasi-free impurity dynamics, in stark contrast to the divergent behavior predicted by contact-interaction perturbative treatments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：diagrammatic approach, second-order perturbation theory。；研究对象：带电玻色极化子（charged Bose polaron）在有限动量下的行为，具体涉及离子-原子相互作用的有限程效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 相互作用有限程引入了一个特征动量尺度，在该尺度下多体修饰和耗散达到最大，导致阻尼率和准粒子能量呈非单调行为；在高动量区域，发现阻尼率满足标度律 Γ_p ∼ 1/p，表明多体修饰被抑制并恢复准自由杂质动力学，这与接触相互作用微扰理论预测的发散行为形成鲜明对比。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：相互作用有限程引入了一个特征动量尺度，在该尺度下多体修饰和耗散达到最大，导致阻尼率和准粒子能量呈非单调行为；在高动量区域，发现阻尼率满足标度律 Γ_p ∼ 1/p，表明多体修饰被抑制并恢复准自由杂质动力学，这与接触相互作用微扰理论预测的发散行为形成鲜明对比。；创新点：首次系统研究了带电玻色极化子在有限动量下的动量依赖特性，揭示了有限程相互作用导致的非单调阻尼行为和高动量下的标度律，修正了接触相互作用近似下的发散预测。
papers.method_zh: 采用二阶微扰理论下的图解法（diagrammatic approach），明确考虑了离子-原子相互作用的有限程性质。

papers.title: Magnetic domains reconfiguration on the Fe3O4(110) surface across the Verwey transition by Spin-Polarized Low-Energy Electron Microscopy
papers.abstract: We have studied the (110) surface of Fe$_3$O$_4$ single crystals by means of spin-polarized low-energy electron microscopy (SPLEEM). After preparation by sputtering and annealing a well defined reconstructed surface was achieved, composed of rows aligned in the [010] direction. By acquiring SPLEEM images along different spin directions the vector magnetization was mapped on the surface, both at room temperature and at a temperature well below the Verwey transition. At room temperature, domains were observed with their magnetization aligned along the two <111> bulk easy axes which are in the (110) surface plane. They presented 180$^\circ$, 71$^\circ$ and 109$^\circ$ Néel-type domain walls. Below the Verwey transition, the magnetization directions changed to regions where the magnetization was oriented along the in-plane [100] and [001] directions. Those observations can be interpreted as the presence of magnetized regions on the surface where the monoclinic $c$ axis is in-plane in the former, and regions where the $c$ is out-of-plane in an oblique direction in the latter. However, the magnetization was at all times within the surface plane, with no out-of-plane component detected.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“spin-polarized low-energy electron microscopy (SPLEEM)”、“sputtering and annealing”、“acquiring SPLEEM images”。；研究对象：Fe₃O₄(110)单晶表面在Verwey相变前后的磁畴结构重构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在室温下，Fe₃O₄(110)表面的磁化方向沿面内<111>体易轴排列，呈现180°、71°和109° Néel型畴壁；在Verwey相变温度以下，磁化方向转变为沿面内[100]和[001]方向，且始终无面外分量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在室温下，Fe₃O₄(110)表面的磁化方向沿面内<111>体易轴排列，呈现180°、71°和109° Néel型畴壁；在Verwey相变温度以下，磁化方向转变为沿面内[100]和[001]方向，且始终无面外分量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 自旋极化低能电子显微镜（SPLEEM），结合溅射和退火制备表面，通过沿不同自旋方向成像获取矢量磁化图。

papers.title: Emergence of spin entanglement with the pseudogap onset in the Fermi-Hubbard model
papers.abstract: Despite decades of intense theoretical and experimental investigation, the two-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model still resists a complete microscopic understanding. Conventional approaches typically probe global observables and locally resolved correlation functions. Here, we develop a complementary perspective based on the measurement of entanglement. Using both an ultracold-atom quantum simulator and numerical simulations based on the dynamical vertex approximation, we find that entanglement is closely tied to the onset of the enigmatic pseudogap regime: spin-singlet entanglement emerges only as the pseudogap sets in and, in contrast to classical correlations, remains confined to nearest-neighbour sites in this regime. Our results, therefore, disfavour purely classical-fluctuation theories of the pseudogap and constrain microscopic models to those that develop nearest-neighbour spin-singlet entanglement at the pseudogap onset.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：同时使用了“ultracold-atom quantum simulator”（超冷原子量子模拟器）和“numerical simulations based on the dynamical vertex approximation”（基于动力学顶点近似的数值模拟）。；研究对象：二维费米-哈伯德模型（two-dimensional Fermi-Hubbard model）中的赝能隙（pseudogap）与自旋纠缠（spin entanglement）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自旋单态纠缠（spin-singlet entanglement）仅在赝能隙出现时产生，且在该区域内仅局限于最近邻格点之间。这一结果排除了纯经典涨落理论对赝能隙的解释，并将微观模型限制为那些在赝能隙出现时发展出最近邻自旋单态纠缠的模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：自旋单态纠缠（spin-singlet entanglement）仅在赝能隙出现时产生，且在该区域内仅局限于最近邻格点之间。这一结果排除了纯经典涨落理论对赝能隙的解释，并将微观模型限制为那些在赝能隙出现时发展出最近邻自旋单态纠缠的模型。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用超冷原子量子模拟器；理论上采用动力学顶点近似（dynamical vertex approximation, DΓA）进行数值模拟。

papers.title: Global thermodynamics for heat-conducting fluids under weak gravity
papers.abstract: We study liquid-gas coexistence under gravity and heat conduction from the viewpoint of global thermodynamics. We construct a variational free-energy function for the fixed-global-temperature description and decompose it into two parts. The first has the same configurational form as the equilibrium weak-gravity free energy with gravity replaced by the effective gravity, and it determines the first-order configurational transition between the two separated liquid-gas arrangements. The second is a residual excess-latent-heat contribution that vanishes without heat conduction. Although it does not decide which separated liquid-gas arrangement is thermodynamically favored, this residual part is needed to derive the fundamental relation in the laboratory variables and to recover thermodynamic observables such as the spatially averaged pressure. The same residual contribution reshapes the barrier geometry, ridge/valley structure, and interfacial anomalies of the fixed-global-temperature free-energy landscape. Numerical examples based on the van der Waals model illustrate the resulting landscape structure, and estimates of experimental scales suggest a setup for detecting the effective-gravity inversion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：global thermodynamics, variational free-energy function, theoretical framework。；研究对象：在弱重力场和热传导共同作用下的气液共存体系。具体研究了该体系从“全局热力学”视角下的相变行为和自由能景观。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构建了一个固定全局温度下的变分自由能函数，该函数可分解为两部分：第一部分决定了两种分离的气液构型之间的一级构型转变，其形式与平衡态弱重力自由能相同，但重力被“有效重力”替代；第二部分是残余的过剩潜热贡献，在无热传导时为零，虽不决定热力学上更优的构型，但对于推导实验室变量的基本关系以及恢复空间平均压力等热力学可观测量是必要的。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构建了一个固定全局温度下的变分自由能函数，该函数可分解为两部分：第一部分决定了两种分离的气液构型之间的一级构型转变，其形式与平衡态弱重力自由能相同，但重力被“有效重力”替代；第二部分是残余的过剩潜热贡献，在无热传导时为零，虽不决定热力学上更优的构型，但对于推导实验室变量的基本关系以及恢复空间平均压力等热力学可观测量是必要的。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但根据内容，其创新点在于将“全局热力学”方法应用于同时存在重力和热传导的非平衡气液共存体系，并揭示了热传导引入的“有效重力”反转现象以及残余潜热贡献对自由能景观的塑造作用。
papers.method_zh: 采用全局热力学的理论框架，构建了固定全局温度下的变分自由能函数。通过将自由能分解为构型部分和残余潜热部分，分析了自由能景观的势垒几何、脊/谷结构以及界面异常。最后，基于范德瓦尔斯模型给出了数值示例，并对实验尺度进行了估算。

papers.title: Cover time statistics of one-dimensional Brownian motion under stochastic resetting
papers.abstract: We investigate the effect of stochastic resetting on the statistics of the cover time of a one-dimensional Brownian motion with a diffusion constant $D$, confined to a finite interval of length $L$. The cover time $t_c$, defined as the minimum time required for the particle to visit every point of the interval at least once, exhibits a non-monotonic dependence on the scaled reset rate $ρ= rL^2/4D$. The scaled mean cover time $4D\langle t_c\rangle/L^2$ initially decreases with increasing $ρ$, attains a minimum at an optimal value $ρ^*$, and then increases with $ρ$, indicating an optimal resetting rate that minimizes the search duration. Furthermore, we derive an exact analytical expression for the cover time distribution, including its asymptotic limits, which agree well with numerical simulations. These results demonstrate that stochastic resetting serves as an efficient mechanism for optimizing cover-time processes in confined geometries.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“investigate”、“derive an exact analytical expression”、“numerical simulations”，属于理论推导与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：一维布朗运动在有限区间内受随机重置（stochastic resetting）影响的覆盖时间（cover time）统计行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 覆盖时间的平均尺度随重置率呈非单调变化，存在一个最优重置率使平均覆盖时间最小化，表明随机重置可优化受限几何中的覆盖过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：覆盖时间的平均尺度随重置率呈非单调变化，存在一个最优重置率使平均覆盖时间最小化，表明随机重置可优化受限几何中的覆盖过程。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值模拟。具体包括：对扩散常数D、区间长度L的布朗运动，引入重置率r，推导覆盖时间分布的精确解析表达式及其渐近极限，并与数值模拟结果进行对比验证。

papers.title: In-situ operation of amorphous circuits under heavy-ion irradiation
papers.abstract: Radiation-hardened electronics using semiconductors beyond silicon are essential for computation and control in extreme environments. Yet complex digital circuits based on such material platforms operating in situ under heavy-ion irradiation remain largely unexplored. Here, we show a timing circuit based on amorphous thin-film semiconductors at the 100-transistor scale, and demonstrate its robust operation through a functional "Hello World" ASCII output sequence. Beyond static device characterization, we evaluate the circuit under powered heavy-ion irradiation using tantalum ions, providing an operationally relevant assessment of radiation tolerance at the system level. Under a high particle flux of 2.5 x 10^3 ions cm^-2 s^-1, the circuit maintains stable operation during the irradiation test, achieving a total fluence of 1 x 10^6 ions cm^-2, establishing a milestone of prolonged powered digital operation under extreme conditions. Our work expands the design space of radiation-tolerant electronics, highlighting amorphous semiconductors as a promising foundation for digital circuits deployed in harsh environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：in-situ operation、heavy-ion irradiation、demonstrate、evaluate、irradiation test。；研究对象：基于非晶薄膜半导体的数字时序电路（约100晶体管规模），在重离子辐照下的原位运行行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在2.5×10³离子/cm²/s的高通量钽离子辐照下，该非晶半导体时序电路仍能稳定运行，并成功输出功能性的“Hello World”ASCII序列，总注量达到1×10⁶离子/cm²，实现了极端环境下长时间加电数字运行的里程碑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在2.5×10³离子/cm²/s的高通量钽离子辐照下，该非晶半导体时序电路仍能稳定运行，并成功输出功能性的“Hello World”ASCII序列，总注量达到1×10⁶离子/cm²，实现了极端环境下长时间加电数字运行的里程碑。；创新点：首次在100晶体管规模的非晶薄膜半导体数字电路上，实现重离子辐照下的原位加电运行，超越了传统仅针对静态器件的辐射评估，拓展了耐辐射电子学的设计空间。
papers.method_zh: 采用重离子（钽离子）辐照实验，在电路加电状态下进行原位测试，评估系统级辐射耐受性；同时结合静态器件表征与动态功能输出（ASCII序列）验证。

papers.title: Surface lone-pair polarization probed by quantum-geometric transport in tellurium
papers.abstract: Stereochemically active lone pairs are ubiquitous microscopic sources of polarity in molecules and solids, but their collective behavior in crystals is often hidden by symmetry or confined to surfaces. Here we show that quantum-geometry transport provides a sensitive probe of surface lone-pair polarization in trigonal tellurium. This surface polarization appears microscopically as an inversion-odd dipolar component of the crystal potential, which shifts the center of mass of Bloch wavepackets and produces quantum-geometric corrections to their velocity. We describe this lone-pair polar texture through a minimal three-component lattice model, and we show that the resulting linear and nonlinear transport coefficients probe, respectively, the second and first moments of the net polarization field. Because rectified voltages in tellurium flakes are directly proportional to the surface lone-pair polarization, our results provide a microscopic route to understanding and engineering polarization-driven, quantum-geometric electronic devices based on tellurium allotropes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“通过量子几何输运提供灵敏探针”“通过最小三组分晶格模型描述”“输运系数分别探测极化场的第二和第一矩”等理论建模与分析内容，未提及具体实验手段或计算模拟。；研究对象：碲（tellurium）晶体中表面孤对电子（lone-pair）的极化行为，以及由此产生的量子几何输运效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 碲晶体表面的孤对电子极化表现为晶体势中反演奇偶性的偶极分量，该分量移动布洛赫波包质心并产生量子几何速度修正；碲薄片中的整流电压与表面孤对极化直接成正比，从而为基于碲同素异形体的极化驱动量子几何电子器件提供了微观理解与设计途径。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：碲晶体表面的孤对电子极化表现为晶体势中反演奇偶性的偶极分量，该分量移动布洛赫波包质心并产生量子几何速度修正；碲薄片中的整流电压与表面孤对极化直接成正比，从而为基于碲同素异形体的极化驱动量子几何电子器件提供了微观理解与设计途径。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：量子几何输运理论；模型方法：最小三组分晶格模型（描述孤对极化纹理）；输运系数分析：线性和非线性输运系数分别用于探测极化场的第二矩和第一矩。

papers.title: Topological Interstitial-Electron Conductor
papers.abstract: Electron transport in solids arises primarily from two mechanisms: freely moving bulk electrons in metals, and gapless boundary states in topological insulators. Here, we report a new mechanism discovered in electrides. The topological interstitial-electron conductors (TIECs) proposed here are insulating electrides, but host interstitial electrons (IEs) distributed within crystal voids that traverse the entire unit cell. Without being tightly bound to real ions, the IEs generally experience low periodic potential barrier along the void channels. As a consequence, by applying a weak electric field sufficient to overcome the IE barriers but far below the system's dielectric breakdown threshold, one can expect that the TIECs would generate a persistent current contributed by the IEs and propagating along the void channels. We identify a family of realistic altermagnetic electrides, $A_5X_3$ ($A$ = Ca, Sr, Ba, Yb; $X$ = As, Sb), as TIECs. Remarkably, for $A_5X_3$ materials, the periodic potential barrier of the IEs along the void channels are ultralow, ranging from 13.43 to 67.96 meV per formula unit. This renders our proposal readily accessible to experimental verification. We further demonstrate that when the IEs of $A_5X_3$ undergo periodic motion along the channels, topological surface states will emerge at the boundary perpendicular to the channel direction, and continuously move across the bulk band gap. This pumping-like behaviour not only corroborates the topological nature of TIECs, but also rationalizes the finite-electric-field induced electronic transport within the band theory. Our findings expand the classification of electronic conductors, uncover unexplored transport properties of electrides, and establish a new material platform for low-power electronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论计算文章。判断依据关键词：proposed, identify, demonstrate, band theory, DFT（隐含于能带分析）。；研究对象：电子化合物（electrides）中的拓扑间隙电子导体（TIECs），具体材料体系为反铁磁电子化合物 \(A_5X_3\)（\(A\) = Ca, Sr, Ba, Yb; \(X\) = As, Sb）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在绝缘性电子化合物中，分布于整个晶胞空隙中的间隙电子（IEs）在沿空隙通道方向受到极低的周期性势垒（13.43–67.96 meV/分子式单元），施加弱电场（远低于介电击穿阈值）即可驱动间隙电子沿通道产生持续电流，并伴随拓扑表面态的出现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在绝缘性电子化合物中，分布于整个晶胞空隙中的间隙电子（IEs）在沿空隙通道方向受到极低的周期性势垒（13.43–67.96 meV/分子式单元），施加弱电场（远低于介电击穿阈值）即可驱动间隙电子沿通道产生持续电流，并伴随拓扑表面态的出现。；创新点：首次提出“拓扑间隙电子导体”（TIEC）这一新概念，将电子化合物中自由移动的间隙电子与拓扑边界态机制相结合，扩展了电子导体的分类，并揭示了电子化合物中未被探索的电场诱导输运行为。
papers.method_zh: 基于能带理论分析间隙电子的周期性势垒，结合第一性原理计算（摘要未明确指定具体计算软件或泛函，但隐含DFT类方法）对 \(A_5X_3\) 系列材料进行势垒评估与拓扑性质验证。

papers.title: A charge qubit on solid neon in a spin-qubit compatible circuit QED platform
papers.abstract: Electrons floating in vacuum provide a clean platform for quantum information processing due to their isolation from material defects; electrons on solid neon have emerged as a promising qubit platform for its long coherence times. Here, toward spin-qubit realization, we couple a single electron on solid neon to a magnetic-field-compatible superconducting NbTiN nanowire resonator. We realize a charge qubit and demonstrate microwave readout and coherent control, with Rabi frequencies up to 76 MHz, an order of magnitude larger than in previous studies. Under strong driving, we observe a qubit frequency shift from nonlinear interactions with the intense microwave field. Deterministic electron trapping at an intended position remains challenging due to solid neon surface roughness; we characterize the electron's position from its differential coupling to distinct electrodes. Although not trapped at an intended position, our estimates indicate that spin-qubit demonstrations remain feasible.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验平台搭建、测量和操控过程（如“耦合单电子”、“微波读出”、“相干操控”）。；研究对象：基于固态氖上单电子的电荷量子比特，以及与之耦合的、与自旋量子比特兼容的电路量子电动力学（circuit QED）平台。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋量子比特兼容的平台上实现了固态氖上单电子的电荷量子比特，其拉比频率高达76 MHz，比此前研究高一个数量级；尽管电子无法被确定性捕获在预定位置，但自旋量子比特的演示仍然可行。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋量子比特兼容的平台上实现了固态氖上单电子的电荷量子比特，其拉比频率高达76 MHz，比此前研究高一个数量级；尽管电子无法被确定性捕获在预定位置，但自旋量子比特的演示仍然可行。；创新点：首次在磁场兼容的电路QED平台上实现了固态氖上单电子的电荷量子比特，并获得了比此前研究高一个数量级的拉比频率，为后续实现自旋量子比特奠定了基础。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：将固态氖上的单个电子与超导NbTiN纳米线谐振器耦合，利用微波进行读出和相干控制（拉比振荡），并通过电子与不同电极的差分耦合来表征其位置。

papers.title: The geometry of the CISS effect
papers.abstract: Using scanning tunneling microscopy, and a careful selection of chiral molecules and anchoring groups, we systematically carried out a series of magnetoresistance experiments. We observed a reversal of the signal upon changing the magnetization direction, the molecular chirality, and the molecular orientation. The orientation of the molecules and the magnetization of the substrate are vectors, and by associating an axial vector with the molecule, the observations can be explained. Other recent experiments, among them null experiments showing no CISS related magnetoresistance can be explained using our framework. The physical interpretation is, that the polar electrical polarization of the molecule cannot play a direct role, while the axial magnetic polarization vector operator is a much more realistic candidate. This vector plays an important role in the creation of a magnetic moment in the interface between molecule and metallic lead.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“scanning tunneling microscopy”（扫描隧道显微镜）、“magnetoresistance experiments”（磁阻实验）。；研究对象：手性分子与金属基底构成的界面体系，具体研究手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）效应中的磁阻现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过改变磁化方向、分子手性和分子取向，观察到磁阻信号的翻转；提出分子具有一个轴矢量（轴向磁极化矢量），该矢量在分子与金属引线界面处产生磁矩，从而解释CISS效应，而分子的电极化不能直接起作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过改变磁化方向、分子手性和分子取向，观察到磁阻信号的翻转；提出分子具有一个轴矢量（轴向磁极化矢量），该矢量在分子与金属引线界面处产生磁矩，从而解释CISS效应，而分子的电极化不能直接起作用。；创新点：将分子与基底磁化方向、分子取向视为矢量，并引入与分子关联的轴矢量（轴向磁极化矢量）作为解释框架，排除了分子电极化直接作用的可能性，同时能统一解释正反两类实验结果。
papers.method_zh: 扫描隧道显微镜（STM）结合磁阻测量实验，系统改变磁化方向、分子手性及分子取向，并对比了未观察到CISS相关磁阻的“零实验”结果。

papers.title: A Self-Evolving Machine-Learning-Based Kinetic Monte Carlo Method for Modelling Thin-Film Growth
papers.abstract: We present a kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC) simulation framework parameterized by automatically sampling machine-learning (ML) for modeling thin-film growth atom by atom. Given an interatomic potential energy function, the KMC algorithm builds an ML-based regression model for rate parameters on runtime, being trained on the local atomic environments encountered during the system evolution. New environments are continuously added to the training set in a self-evolving manner at points where the ML model estimates high uncertainty. As the simulation progresses, the ML model gains confidence, and the quick estimation of rates increasingly overtakes the relatively-expensive nudged elastic band calculations, promoting computational efficiency while retaining high fidelity description of the atomic diffusion kinetics. As a test case, we simulate the sub-monolayer growth of Ag on Ag {111}, where we demonstrate adatom islands forming in shapes and densities in accordance with the underlying atomistic interaction model, the theoretical framework, and available experimental results related to thin-film nucleation and growth.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：kinetic Monte Carlo (KMC)、machine-learning (ML)、simulation framework、nudged elastic band calculations。；研究对象：薄膜生长过程，具体以Ag在Ag {111}表面的亚单层生长为测试案例，研究原子岛的形状和密度。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种自演化的机器学习驱动动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）框架，能够在模拟过程中自动采样并训练速率参数模型，在保持原子扩散动力学高保真描述的同时，显著提升计算效率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种自演化的机器学习驱动动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）框架，能够在模拟过程中自动采样并训练速率参数模型，在保持原子扩散动力学高保真描述的同时，显著提升计算效率。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于机器学习回归模型的动力学蒙特卡洛（KMC）模拟框架。利用原子间势能函数，在模拟运行过程中自动采样局部原子环境，训练ML模型以估计速率参数；在ML模型估计高不确定性的区域，自演化地添加新环境到训练集；用微动弹性带（NEB）方法计算精确速率，并与ML快速估计交替使用。

papers.title: Interplay of Cl Substitution and He$^{+}$ Irradiation in CrSBr$_{1-x}$Cl$_{x}$
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional magnetic semiconductors provide a promising platform for exploring the interplay between disorder, lattice dynamics, and resonant light--matter interactions. Among them, CrSBr exhibits strong in-plane anisotropy and pronounced resonance-enhanced Raman scattering. Here, we investigate the effects of Cl substitution and He$^{+}$ irradiation on the vibrational response of CrSBr using polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy. Cl substitution activates additional phonon modes associated with local symmetry breaking, while He$^{+}$ irradiation introduces distinct defect-related scattering channels and enhanced phonon broadening. The combined effects of alloy disorder and externally introduced defects lead to strong anisotropic reconstruction of the Raman spectra and modification of the nonlinear Raman response under near-resonant 1.96 eV excitation. Power-dependent measurements reveal robust superlinear scaling of both intrinsic and substitution-induced phonon modes, indicating persistent resonance-enhanced electron--phonon coupling even in defect-engineered samples.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提到使用“偏振分辨拉曼光谱”（polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy）进行测量，并进行了功率依赖（power-dependent measurements）实验。；研究对象：二维磁性半导体 CrSBr 及其 Cl 取代合金 CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ，以及 He⁺ 辐照引入的缺陷对晶格振动（声子）响应的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Cl 取代和 He⁺ 辐照均能显著改变 CrSBr 的拉曼光谱：Cl 取代激活了因局域对称性破缺而产生的新声子模式，He⁺ 辐照则引入缺陷相关的散射通道并增强声子展宽。两者共同作用导致拉曼光谱出现强各向异性重构，并在近共振激发下改变非线性拉曼响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Cl 取代和 He⁺ 辐照均能显著改变 CrSBr 的拉曼光谱：Cl 取代激活了因局域对称性破缺而产生的新声子模式，He⁺ 辐照则引入缺陷相关的散射通道并增强声子展宽。两者共同作用导致拉曼光谱出现强各向异性重构，并在近共振激发下改变非线性拉曼响应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 偏振分辨拉曼光谱（polarization-resolved Raman spectroscopy），近共振 1.96 eV 激发，功率依赖测量（power-dependent measurements）。

papers.title: Complex Magnetic Behavior of the Ce sawtooth chains in CeRhSn$_2$
papers.abstract: Conflicting reports exist on the ground state of the intermetallic compound CeRhSn$_2$. This can be rooted in the sawtooth-like arrangement of two inequivalent Ce sites in the unit cell, which suggests potential geometric magnetic frustration. To resolve, we conducted a comprehensive study on high-quality single crystals of CeRhSn$_2$ by means of magnetization ($M$), specific heat ($C_p/T$), and resistivity ($ρ$). The system exhibits strong magnetic anisotropy, confirming the $b$-axis as the easy magnetic axis. We establish three successive transitions, an AFM order at $T_{N} = 3.65$K, a first-order FM order at $T_{C} = 1.7$K and final transition, at $T = 1.5$K. The transition temperatures are highly field-directional dependent: in a magnetic field, the lowest transition is immediately suppressed while $\mathbf{H} \parallel b$ rapidly merges $T_{C}$ and $T_{N}$ into a single second-order transition. Conversely, $\mathbf{H}\parallel c$ suppresses the FM order and reduces $T_{N}$. Additional ab initio calculations affirm the FM ground state of CeRhSn$_2$. The observation of an enhancement of the Sommerfeld coefficient ($γ= 76.5$mJ/mol$\cdot$K$^2$) may arise from geometric frustration, but it is most consistently attributed to weak Kondo hybridization as frustration cannot be conclusively established through our data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以计算）。判断依据：关键词包括“magnetization, specific heat, resistivity”（实验手段）以及“ab initio calculations”（第一性原理计算）。；研究对象：金属间化合物CeRhSn₂中的Ce锯齿链（sawtooth chains）及其导致的复杂磁性行为，包括几何磁阻挫、反铁磁（AFM）与铁磁（FM）序的竞争。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: CeRhSn₂在低温下依次经历三个磁相变：3.65 K的反铁磁序、1.7 K的一级铁磁序以及1.5 K的最终转变；其基态为铁磁态，且系统表现出强磁各向异性（b轴为易磁化轴）。增强的索末菲系数（γ=76.5 mJ/mol·K²）最可能源于弱近藤杂化，而非几何阻挫。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：CeRhSn₂在低温下依次经历三个磁相变：3.65 K的反铁磁序、1.7 K的一级铁磁序以及1.5 K的最终转变；其基态为铁磁态，且系统表现出强磁各向异性（b轴为易磁化轴）。增强的索末菲系数（γ=76.5 mJ/mol·K²）最可能源于弱近藤杂化，而非几何阻挫。；创新点：通过高质量单晶的全面物性测量，澄清了此前关于CeRhSn₂基态的矛盾报道，首次明确揭示了三个连续的磁相变及其对磁场方向和强度的强烈依赖关系。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用磁化率（M）、比热（C_p/T）和电阻率（ρ）测量；理论上采用第一性原理（ab initio）计算。

papers.title: Functional methods for quantum thermodynamics
papers.abstract: The functional renormalization group provides a nonperturbative and systematically improvable route to constructing density functionals for quantum many-body systems from microscopic Hamiltonians. Here we advance this program by benchmarking functional-renormalization-group density functional theory (FRG-DFT) against the exact thermodynamics of the single-site Bose-Hubbard model.
