This model provides an ideal testing ground because it is analytically solvable, yet remains subtle in the imaginary-time coherent-state path integral, where a naive continuum treatment generates a spurious self-interaction. We show that a careful Hubbard-Stratonovich derivation identifies the self-interaction correction term that must be included in the FRG-DFT flow to recover the exact thermodynamics. We then systematically compare several closures of the resulting hierarchy of flow equations for the free energy, chemical potential, and connected density correlators over broad ranges of density, temperature, and interaction strength. The benchmark shows that the free energy is comparatively robust, whereas the chemical potential and fluctuation observables provide much sharper diagnostics of the hierarchy closure. A maximum-entropy closure gives the most accurate overall description and reproduces even the low-temperature oscillatory structure of the connected two-density correlator. These results identify two general requirements for functional approaches to quantum thermodynamics: the renormalization group flow equation must retain the equal-time contact subtraction to avoid spurious self-interactions, and any closure of the hierarchy must preserve the statistical consistency of density correlators. This work provides a controlled foundation for deriving ab initio density functionals for quantum many-body systems across condensed-matter, ultracold-atom, and nuclear physics, as well as quantum chemistry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“functional renormalization group”、“density functional theory”、“benchmarking”、“flow equations”。；研究对象：单格点Bose-Hubbard模型的热力学性质。该模型作为量子多体系统的理想测试平台，用于检验泛函重整化群密度泛函理论（FRG-DFT）的精确性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确求解单格点Bose-Hubbard模型，发现FRG-DFT必须包含等时接触减除项以避免虚假自相互作用，且最大熵截断方案能最准确地描述自由能、化学势及密度关联函数，包括低温下的振荡结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确求解单格点Bose-Hubbard模型，发现FRG-DFT必须包含等时接触减除项以避免虚假自相互作用，且最大熵截断方案能最准确地描述自由能、化学势及密度关联函数，包括低温下的振荡结构。；创新点：首次在可精确求解的模型上系统基准测试了FRG-DFT方法，明确了泛函方法用于量子热力学的两个普适要求：流方程必须保留等时接触减除项，且层次截断必须保持密度关联函数的统计自洽性。
papers.method_zh: 泛函重整化群密度泛函理论（FRG-DFT），结合Hubbard-Stratonovich变换推导自相互作用修正项，并系统比较了自由能、化学势及连通密度关联函数流方程层次的不同截断方案（如最大熵截断）。

papers.title: Clustering in atom probe tomography data: coordination number metric, percolation-based parameter scaling, and size effects
papers.abstract: The ability to identify nanometer-scale nuclei of new phases in atom probe tomography (APT) is often limited by the sensitivity of clustering algorithms to user-defined control parameters. Conventional approaches typically rely on the Euclidean distance metric and consider only solute atoms, thereby discarding the solvent atoms that contain most of the spatial information. Here, we introduce a coordination-number metric based on the composition and apply it to higher-order clustering. Using various metrics, we investigate percolation in typical APT structures. By scaling clustering properties to the corresponding percolation thresholds, we define a self-similar variable that is almost invariant with respect to metrics, clustering parameters, and structural disorder. This variable provides a relevant description of clustering and enables the formal transfer of optimal parameters between clustering methods. We also study the characteristic clustering behavior in small precipitates and quantify how the precipitate-matrix interface alters the composition spectrum and broadens the clustering curve. Finally, using simulations that incorporate finite spatial resolution, detection efficiency, and other APT reconstruction artifacts, we show that the approach based on coordination numbers effectively compensates for heterogeneous dilations and outperforms solute-density-based methods in all tested scenarios.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“引入配位数度量”、“研究逾渗”、“使用模拟”等，属于方法开发和数值模拟研究。；研究对象：原子探针断层扫描（APT）数据中纳米尺度新相核的聚类分析，具体涉及基于配位数的聚类度量、逾渗行为以及小析出相中的尺寸效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于配位数的度量方法能有效补偿APT重建中的非均匀膨胀效应，在所有测试场景中均优于基于溶质密度的传统方法；通过将聚类性质标度至对应的逾渗阈值，可定义一种几乎不依赖于度量、聚类参数和结构无序的自相似变量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于配位数的度量方法能有效补偿APT重建中的非均匀膨胀效应，在所有测试场景中均优于基于溶质密度的传统方法；通过将聚类性质标度至对应的逾渗阈值，可定义一种几乎不依赖于度量、聚类参数和结构无序的自相似变量。；创新点：提出了一种基于配位数的聚类度量，替代传统仅考虑溶质原子的欧几里得距离度量；通过逾渗标度定义了一个自相似变量，实现了不同聚类方法间最优参数的正式传递。
papers.method_zh: 引入基于成分的配位数度量，并将其应用于高阶聚类分析；使用多种度量研究典型APT结构中的逾渗行为；通过模拟引入有限空间分辨率、探测效率及其他APT重建伪影，验证配位数方法的有效性。

papers.title: Finite-inertia effects in Langevin dynamics of a lopsided elastic dumbbell using exponential-time differencing schemes
papers.abstract: Inertia effects in the Langevin dynamics of a lopsided elastic dumbbell are investigated using exponential-time-differencing (ETD) integrators for the corresponding stiff stochastic equations at small mass limit. Starting from the bead-level underdamped Langevin model, we formulate the dynamics in modal coordinates, highlighting two distinct friction scales: an additive friction $ζ_{\rm trans}=ζ_1+ζ_2$ controlling translation ($ζ_i, i=1,2$ are the friction factor on bead $i$), and an effective internal friction $1/ζ_{\rm eff}=1/ζ_1+1/ζ_2$ controlling configurational relaxation, with relaxation time $τ_R=ζ_{\rm eff}/H$ for a Hookean spring of stiffness $H$. We benchmark ETD against Euler--Maruyama and overdamped Brownian dynamics using equilibrium statistics, time-domain autocorrelations, and frequency-domain power spectra of the end-to-end vector. When time is rescaled by $τ_R$, configurational and orientational relaxation curves collapse across asymmetry ratios, showing that the dominant long-time structural dynamics remains close to the overdamped description. Inertial signatures are instead confined to short-time transients, high-frequency modifications of the configurational spectrum, and a transient coupling between translational and internal modes. This study provides a practical and accurate route for lopsided dumbbells across overdamped and weakly underdamped regimes, and clarify how mass and friction asymmetry affect the translational and internal dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Langevin dynamics、exponential-time-differencing (ETD) integrators、数值模拟与理论分析结合。；研究对象：非对称弹性哑铃（lopsided elastic dumbbell）在有限惯性效应下的朗之万动力学，具体关注质量与摩擦不对称性对平动和内禀构型动力学的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 当时间以构型弛豫时间τ_R标度后，不同不对称比下的构型与取向弛豫曲线重合，表明主导的长时结构动力学接近过阻尼描述；惯性效应仅局限于短时瞬态、构型谱的高频修正以及平动与内禀模式之间的瞬态耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：当时间以构型弛豫时间τ_R标度后，不同不对称比下的构型与取向弛豫曲线重合，表明主导的长时结构动力学接近过阻尼描述；惯性效应仅局限于短时瞬态、构型谱的高频修正以及平动与内禀模式之间的瞬态耦合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用指数时间差分（ETD）积分器求解小质量极限下的刚性随机方程；从珠子层次的欠阻尼朗之万模型出发，在模态坐标下建立动力学方程；对比ETD与Euler–Maruyama及过阻尼布朗动力学在平衡统计、时域自相关和频域功率谱上的表现。

papers.title: Spin-Spiral Enhancement of Ultrafast Light-Polarization-Robust Magnetization
papers.abstract: Ultrafast light-driven magnetization, a frontier in quantum magneto-optics, has traditionally relied on circularly polarized lasers to provide external angular momentum. While increasing efforts have aimed to achieve light-polarization-robust (LPR) magnetization that is insensitive to the form of external light excitation, the underlying mechanism remains largely unclear. Here, we establish the symmetry-constrained rule for LPR magnetization in antiferromagnetic systems. Through real-time time-dependent density functional theory calculations, we observe the strong LPR magnetization in spin-spiral magnets and its suppression in collinear antiferromagnets, confirming our theory. Strikingly, laser excitation induces real-space demagnetization, rotation, and oscillation of atomic spins in spin-spiral monolayer NiI$_2$, whereas rotation is largely suppressed in conventional collinear antiferromagnets. Our work reveals a novel microscopic pathway for ultrafast magnetization that is independent of light polarization, paving the way for advanced femtosecond spin control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：real-time time-dependent density functional theory calculations、理论计算）；研究对象：自旋螺旋磁体（spin-spiral magnets）中的超快光驱动磁化现象，具体材料为单层NiI₂，并与共线反铁磁体进行对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋螺旋磁体中实现了强光偏振鲁棒（LPR）磁化，而共线反铁磁体中的LPR磁化被抑制；激光激发在自旋螺旋单层NiI₂中诱导了实空间退磁、自旋旋转和振荡，而共线反铁磁体中自旋旋转被大幅抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋螺旋磁体中实现了强光偏振鲁棒（LPR）磁化，而共线反铁磁体中的LPR磁化被抑制；激光激发在自旋螺旋单层NiI₂中诱导了实空间退磁、自旋旋转和振荡，而共线反铁磁体中自旋旋转被大幅抑制。；创新点：建立了反铁磁体系中光偏振鲁棒磁化的对称性约束规则，揭示了自旋螺旋结构是实现偏振无关超快磁化的微观新路径。
papers.method_zh: 实时含时密度泛函理论（real-time time-dependent density functional theory, rt-TDDFT）计算，并结合对称性约束规则分析。

papers.title: Dimensionality of a strongly interacting 2D-3D Fermi-Fermi mixture from the perspective of superfluid instability and excitation properties
papers.abstract: We theoretically investigate strong-coupling properties of an attractively interacting Fermi atomic gas, where the Cooper-pair formation occurs between atoms belonging to different dimensional bands. Including pairing fluctuations within the framework of the self-consistent $T$-matrix approximation (SCTMA), we examine how the BCS-type superfluid phase transition temperature $T_\mathrm{c}$ varies as one moves from the 3D-3D to the 2D-3D system, in the wide parameter region with respect to the strength of the pairing interaction. In the 2D-3D limit, we find that, while the mean-field BCS theory predicts $T_\mathrm{c}>0$ in the strong-coupling regime, $T_\mathrm{c}$ is remarkably suppressed down to zero by pairing fluctuations that are strongly enhanced by the mixed-dimensionality of the system. As the origin of this, we clarify that the lower-dimensional (2D) component dominates the superfluid instability, so that the vanishing $T_\mathrm{c}$ is the same phenomenon as that in the 2D-2D case. We also point out that this can already be seen in the mean-field level, when one examines the propagation of the Goldstone mode. On the other hand, we find that the pseudogap phenomenon, which is known as a precursor of Cooper-pair formation, exhibits a 3D character of the 2D-3D system. These results indicate that the dimensionality of a strongly interacting Fermi gas depends on what we observe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretically investigate”、“self-consistent T-matrix approximation (SCTMA)”、“mean-field BCS theory”。；研究对象：强相互作用的吸引型费米原子气体，其中库珀对形成发生在属于不同维度能带的原子之间，具体为从3D-3D体系过渡到2D-3D混合维度费米-费米混合物。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在2D-3D极限下，强耦合区域中平均场BCS理论预测超导转变温度Tc>0，但配对涨落（由混合维度性强烈增强）会显著抑制Tc直至零。同时，赝能隙现象则表现出2D-3D体系的3D特征，表明强相互作用费米气体的维度性取决于观测对象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在2D-3D极限下，强耦合区域中平均场BCS理论预测超导转变温度Tc>0，但配对涨落（由混合维度性强烈增强）会显著抑制Tc直至零。同时，赝能隙现象则表现出2D-3D体系的3D特征，表明强相互作用费米气体的维度性取决于观测对象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用自洽T矩阵近似（SCTMA）理论框架，纳入配对涨落效应，研究超流相变温度Tc随配对相互作用强度的变化，并分析戈德斯通模的传播行为。

papers.title: Parity-induced generalized Brillouin zone without non-Hermitian skin effect
papers.abstract: Acute spectral sensitivity to boundary conditions and the formation of a generalized Brillouin zone associated with complex quasimomenta are features frequently attributed to systems with non-trivial non-Hermitian topology, showcasing the non-Hermitian skin effect. We show that, away from the thermodynamic limit, these features themselves are not uniquely tied to this phenomenon; they can similarly arise as parity-induced even-odd effects in non-Hermitian systems without skin effect. Despite an underlying generalized Brillouin zone description, wavefunctions remain delocalized. In addition, the effect can arise in skin-effect models as entirely separate distinguishable feature
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, description, effect, models。；研究对象：非厄米系统中由宇称（parity）导致的奇偶效应（even-odd effects），以及广义布里渊区（generalized Brillouin zone）与非厄米趋肤效应（non-Hermitian skin effect）的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在远离热力学极限时，广义布里渊区的出现和边界条件对谱的敏感性并非非厄米趋肤效应的独有特征；它们可以纯粹由宇称诱导的奇偶效应产生，即使波函数保持退局域化（无趋肤效应）。此外，该效应可作为独立特征出现在原本具有趋肤效应的模型中。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在远离热力学极限时，广义布里渊区的出现和边界条件对谱的敏感性并非非厄米趋肤效应的独有特征；它们可以纯粹由宇称诱导的奇偶效应产生，即使波函数保持退局域化（无趋肤效应）。此外，该效应可作为独立特征出现在原本具有趋肤效应的模型中。；创新点：揭示了广义布里渊区与非厄米趋肤效应之间的非唯一对应关系，指出在有限尺寸下宇称本身即可诱导类似特征，且该效应可与趋肤效应共存并区分。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，基于非厄米系统的广义布里渊区描述，对比有无趋肤效应的模型，并考察有限尺寸下的宇称效应。

papers.title: Competing heterogeneities shape ordering via higher-order interactions
papers.abstract: Higher-order interactions admit richer structural heterogeneity than pairwise networks. To understand how heterogeneity impacts collective phenomena we develop a framework based on the cavity method and apply it to the simplicial Ising model on heterogeneous hypergraphs. Unlike in homogeneous structures, group size and node degree play fundamentally different roles: size heterogeneity sharpens the transition via large-group unanimity, while degree heterogeneity softens it as hubs cooperatively seed ordering with non-hubs. Under either type of heterogeneity, continuous--discontinuous double transitions can arise, where the symmetry-breaking continuous transition is driven by pairs or by hubs, respectively. When both heterogeneities coexist, cross-order degree correlations further modulate the phase diagram, with anticorrelation delaying the group-driven discontinuous jump and broadening the hysteretic region. Our results reveal the intricate interplay between size and degree heterogeneities in collective phenomena beyond pairwise interactions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop a framework based on the cavity method”（基于空腔方法发展理论框架），并应用于“simplicial Ising model”（单纯复形伊辛模型），属于解析理论推导。；研究对象：高阶相互作用（higher-order interactions）下的异质超图（heterogeneous hypergraphs）上的单纯复形伊辛模型（simplicial Ising model），具体研究群体大小异质性（group size heterogeneity）和节点度异质性（node degree heterogeneity）如何影响集体有序化（ordering）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 群体大小异质性通过大群体的全体一致性（unanimity）使相变更尖锐，而节点度异质性通过枢纽节点与非枢纽节点的协同成核使相变软化；两种异质性共存时，跨阶度关联（cross-order degree correlations）会进一步调控相图，反关联会延迟群体驱动的非连续跳变并扩大滞后区。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：群体大小异质性通过大群体的全体一致性（unanimity）使相变更尖锐，而节点度异质性通过枢纽节点与非枢纽节点的协同成核使相变软化；两种异质性共存时，跨阶度关联（cross-order degree correlations）会进一步调控相图，反关联会延迟群体驱动的非连续跳变并扩大滞后区。；创新点：揭示了高阶相互作用中群体大小异质性与节点度异质性在集体现象中的根本不同作用，并首次发现两种异质性共存时跨阶度关联对相图的调制效应，超越了传统成对网络（pairwise networks）的异质性理解。
papers.method_zh: 基于空腔方法（cavity method）的理论框架，应用于异质超图上的单纯复形伊辛模型，通过解析计算分析不同异质性条件下的相变行为。

papers.title: Finite-time Scaling with Arbitrary Driving Rates: Bridging the Kibble-Zurek and De Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov Limits
papers.abstract: The pursuit of a universal description for nonequilibrium critical dynamics in quantum many-body systems stands as a central frontier in modern statistical physics. For driven critical dynamics starting far from the critical point, the well-known Kibble-Zurek (KZ) scaling holds only when the driving rate lies below an upper bound. Here we study driven dynamics restricted to the critical region, and show that robust dynamic scaling behavior exists for arbitrary driving rates. We develop a generalized finite-time scaling (FTS) framework, which provides a unified understanding on the driven dynamics for the full range of quench rates, bridging the KZ scaling in the slow-driving regime and the De~Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov (DGP) scaling in the sudden-quench limit. We verify this unified FTS form through numerical simulations in both quantum critical and tricritical points. The good agreement between theoretical predictions and numerical results confirms the generality of our theory. Our work establishes a universal theory for nonequilibrium critical dynamics spanning the full range of driving rates, with broad implications for quantum quench experiments and out-of-equilibrium statistical mechanics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：develop a generalized finite-time scaling framework, theoretical predictions, numerical simulations）；研究对象：量子多体系统中的非平衡临界动力学，特别是从远离临界点或限制在临界区域驱动的动力学过程。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作建立了一个统一的有限时间标度（FTS）理论框架，能够描述从慢速驱动（Kibble-Zurek标度）到突然淬火极限（De Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov标度）整个驱动速率范围内的非平衡临界动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作建立了一个统一的有限时间标度（FTS）理论框架，能够描述从慢速驱动（Kibble-Zurek标度）到突然淬火极限（De Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov标度）整个驱动速率范围内的非平衡临界动力学。；创新点：该工作首次建立了一个统一的标度理论，将之前被认为分属不同极限的Kibble-Zurek标度（慢速驱动）和De Grandi-Gritsev-Polkovnikov标度（突然淬火）联系起来，覆盖了全部驱动速率范围。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个广义的有限时间标度（FTS）理论框架，并通过在量子临界点和三临界点上的数值模拟进行了验证。

papers.title: Pure Spin Photocurrent in Altermagnetic Photovoltaic Battery
papers.abstract: Altermagnets, featuring momentum-dependent spin splitting without net magnetization, provide a promising platform for spintronic functionalities beyond conventional ferromagnets and antiferromagnets. Here, we propose an altermagnetic spin photovoltaic battery consisting of a nonmagnetic semiconducting layer sandwiched between two altermagnetic electrodes. Using first-principles quantum-transport simulations, we show that a V2Te2O/ZnSe/V2Te2O junction supports a pure spin photocurrent for opposite Néel vectors in the two altermagnetic electrodes, with spin-up and spin-down photocurrents equal in magnitude and opposite in sign. The effect persists under both linearly and circularly polarized light and remains tunable with photon energy and polarization angle. Our results establish a realistic route toward light-driven pure spin-current generation in altermagnetic junctions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles quantum-transport simulations”（第一性原理量子输运模拟）。；研究对象：一种由非磁性半导体层（ZnSe）夹在两个交变磁电极（V₂Te₂O）之间构成的“交变磁自旋光伏电池”异质结，以及其中产生的纯自旋光电流现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在V₂Te₂O/ZnSe/V₂Te₂O结中，当两个交变磁电极的奈尔矢量相反时，可产生纯自旋光电流（自旋向上和自旋向下的光电流大小相等、符号相反），且该效应在线偏振光和圆偏振光下均存在，并可通过光子能量和偏振角进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在V₂Te₂O/ZnSe/V₂Te₂O结中，当两个交变磁电极的奈尔矢量相反时，可产生纯自旋光电流（自旋向上和自旋向下的光电流大小相等、符号相反），且该效应在线偏振光和圆偏振光下均存在，并可通过光子能量和偏振角进行调控。；创新点：首次提出利用交变磁体（altermagnet）构建光伏电池结构，实现光驱动的纯自旋电流产生，为超越传统铁磁和反铁磁的自旋电子学功能提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理量子输运模拟（first-principles quantum-transport simulations）进行计算研究。

papers.title: Activity-Enhanced Ordering in Fluctuation-Induced First-Order Transitions
papers.abstract: Fluctuations can drive otherwise continuous phase transitions to first order through the Brazovskii mechanism. We study how these fluctuation-induced transitions are modified in active systems by introducing nonequilibrium spatiotemporally correlated noise. We show that, while the transition remains fluctuation-induced first order, activity systematically suppresses these fluctuation effects, shifting the transition to higher temperatures and rendering it increasingly weakly first order. As a result, ordering is enhanced without inducing a spinodal instability of the isotropic phase, as confirmed by direct numerical simulations. In the strong-activity limit, fluctuation effects disappear and mean-field behavior is recovered. Our results identify activity as a generic control parameter for tuning the strength of fluctuation-induced first-order transitions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：Brazovskii mechanism、nonequilibrium spatiotemporally correlated noise、mean-field behavior、direct numerical simulations）；研究对象：活性系统中由涨落诱导的一级相变（fluctuation-induced first-order transitions in active systems），具体关注非平衡时空关联噪声对Brazovskii机制的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 活性（activity）会系统性地抑制涨落效应，使相变温度升高、相变强度减弱（变得更弱一级），从而增强有序化；在强活性极限下，涨落效应消失，恢复平均场行为。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：活性（activity）会系统性地抑制涨落效应，使相变温度升高、相变强度减弱（变得更弱一级），从而增强有序化；在强活性极限下，涨落效应消失，恢复平均场行为。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析结合直接数值模拟（direct numerical simulations），引入非平衡时空关联噪声来建模活性，并基于Brazovskii机制研究相变行为。

papers.title: Spin Hall effect in two-dimensional materials with inverted bands and Mexican-hat dispersion
papers.abstract: We study the spin Hall effect in two-dimensional topological insulators with "Mexican hat" dispersion and a ring-shaped Fermi surface which are formed due to the band inversion. Electron transitions between different isoenergetic contours and the quantum metric of band states play an important role in the transport properties of such materials, since they largely determine the spatial distribution of the electron charges screening the impurity potential and the scattering probability [Phys.B, 719, 417942 (2025)]. Here we study a spin-dependent skew scattering, which is enabled by the second-order scattering processes, and show that the extrinsic spin-Hall current (SHC) can significantly exceed the intrinsic SHC arising from the Berry curvature. Furthermore, due to Mexican-hat dispersion, the SHC exhibits a very unusual dependence on the Fermi energy ($E_F$). The extrinsic SHC reaches a maximum at some $E_F$, then decreases with increasing $E_F$ and can even change a sign. This complicated behavior reflects an interplay of energy dependencies of such important factors as probabilities of inter- and intra-contour transitions, as well as different electron velocities in two contours.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：study、show、extrinsic spin-Hall current、theoretical analysis。；研究对象：具有“墨西哥帽”色散和环形费米面的二维拓扑绝缘体中的自旋霍尔效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在具有倒带和墨西哥帽色散的二维材料中，由二阶散射过程引起的外禀自旋霍尔电流可显著超过由贝里曲率引起的内禀自旋霍尔电流，且该外禀自旋霍尔电流随费米能级的变化表现出非常规的依赖关系，包括达到最大值后下降甚至改变符号。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在具有倒带和墨西哥帽色散的二维材料中，由二阶散射过程引起的外禀自旋霍尔电流可显著超过由贝里曲率引起的内禀自旋霍尔电流，且该外禀自旋霍尔电流随费米能级的变化表现出非常规的依赖关系，包括达到最大值后下降甚至改变符号。；创新点：揭示了在墨西哥帽色散体系中，外禀自旋霍尔电流可主导内禀贡献，并展现出随费米能级非单调变化甚至变号的复杂行为，这归因于不同等能轮廓间/内跃迁概率与电子速度的能量依赖性的相互竞争。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体涉及基于二阶散射过程的自旋相关斜散射机制，以及考虑等能轮廓间/内跃迁概率和电子速度等能量依赖性的输运计算。

papers.title: Living Helices in Fluctuating Polymer Chains: Cooperative Nucleation, Dynamics, and Lifetime
papers.abstract: Helical segments in polymer chains are often transient, finite, and dynamically evolving, yet their origin and stability remain incompletely understood. Here we develop a minimal coarse-grained statistical-mechanical theory that explains how such living helices emerge in fluctuating polymer systems. Using a three-state model with cooperative interactions, we show that helix formation proceeds through a multistep nucleation mechanism. An initial constrained pre-nucleus forms first, followed by cooperative stabilization that promotes the growth of finite helical segments. The resulting free-energy landscape naturally favors marginally stable helices whose size is determined by a competition between cooperative gains and nonlinear penalties arising from stiffness, torsional strain, and solvent fluctuations. By formulating the dynamics as a stochastic process in segment size, we derive analytical expressions for both formation times and lifetimes within a mean first-passage framework. For representative parameters relevant to flexible polymers and peptide segments, the theory predicts characteristic timescales in the nanosecond to sub-microsecond range. The present analysis supports a view of living helices as finite, mobile excitations whose stability is controlled by cooperativity, boundary motion, and solvent-induced fluctuations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：coarse-grained statistical-mechanical theory、three-state model、stochastic process、mean first-passage framework。；研究对象：聚合物链中瞬态、有限且动态演化的螺旋片段（living helices），以及其成核、动力学和寿命。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 螺旋片段的形成通过多步成核机制实现：先形成受约束的前核，再通过协同稳定化促进有限螺旋生长。自由能景观中，协同增益与刚度、扭转应变及溶剂涨落导致的非线性惩罚之间的竞争，决定了螺旋的尺寸和亚稳态特性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：螺旋片段的形成通过多步成核机制实现：先形成受约束的前核，再通过协同稳定化促进有限螺旋生长。自由能景观中，协同增益与刚度、扭转应变及溶剂涨落导致的非线性惩罚之间的竞争，决定了螺旋的尺寸和亚稳态特性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于粗粒化统计力学理论，构建三态模型（含协同相互作用），将螺旋段尺寸演化建模为随机过程，利用平均首通时间框架解析推导形成时间与寿命。

papers.title: Terahertz Electrodynamics and Kinetic Inductance of Disordered Titanium-Vanadium Alloy Thin Films
papers.abstract: Disordered superconductors represent an important area in modern condensed matter physics, where superconductivity survives even in the presence of strong electron scattering and localization effects. Understanding how disorder modifies the high-frequency electrodynamic response is not only important from physics point of view, but is also essential for developing next-generation quantum detectors and superconducting devices. In this work, we investigate the terahertz electrodynamics of disordered Ti40V60 alloy thin films using terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) to understand the relationship between disorder, quasiparticle dynamics, and kinetic inductance. By analysing the complex conductivity, penetration depth and superfluid response, we show that structural disorder can be systematically used to tune the inductive response while maintaining a robust superconducting phase. Unlike conventional nitride superconductors that require tightly controlled reactive growth conditions, Ti40V60 alloys provide a simpler and more adaptable route for tuning the superconducting energy scales directly through the deposition conditions. These findings establish Ti40V60 alloys as a promising material for kinetic inductance detectors and provide useful insights into the electrodynamics of strongly disordered superconductors.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确提及使用太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS）进行实验测量，并分析复电导率、穿透深度等实验数据。；研究对象：无序Ti40V60合金薄膜的超导太赫兹电动力学响应，特别是无序对准粒子动力学和动感电感的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过系统调控结构无序，可以在保持超导相稳定的前提下有效调节薄膜的动感电感响应；Ti40V60合金薄膜为动感电感探测器提供了一种比传统氮化物超导体更简单、更灵活的材料方案。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过系统调控结构无序，可以在保持超导相稳定的前提下有效调节薄膜的动感电感响应；Ti40V60合金薄膜为动感电感探测器提供了一种比传统氮化物超导体更简单、更灵活的材料方案。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与传统无序超导体研究相比的具体创新点，但明确指出Ti40V60合金薄膜相比传统氮化物超导体（需严格控制反应生长条件）具有更简单的制备工艺和更灵活的超导能标调控途径。
papers.method_zh: 太赫兹时域光谱（THz-TDS），通过分析复电导率、穿透深度和超流体响应来研究电动力学性质。

papers.title: Using graph neural networks to predict many-body interactions in amorphous materials
papers.abstract: Many-body interactions govern the complex behavior of many amorphous materials, from metallic glasses to biological tissues, yet are often replaced by pairwise additive frameworks for computational efficiency. Here, we use classical density functional theory (DFT) to study a model soft glass of solvent-free polymer-grafted nanoparticles (PGNs), where the absence of solvent forces grafted chains to uniformly fill the interstitial space, generating strong angular-dependent many-body interactions between the cores. We show that NequIP, an equivariant message-passing graph neural network (GNN), learns the high-dimensional, rugged potential energy landscape of the system and reproduces classical DFT energies across a range of PGN design parameters at four orders of magnitude lower cost. Systematic analysis of GNN hyperparameters offers physical insights into the range, anisotropy, and effective body order of interactions. GNN-driven Monte Carlo simulations reveal locally favored icosahedral-like structures at equilibrium, and strikingly, recover equilibrium structures in agreement with experiments, despite the network being trained only on high-energy, out-of-equilibrium configurations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：classical density functional theory (DFT)、graph neural network (GNN)、Monte Carlo simulations。；研究对象：无溶剂聚合物接枝纳米颗粒（PGNs）形成的软玻璃模型体系，其中核心间存在强角度依赖的多体相互作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 等变消息传递图神经网络（NequIP）能以四个数量级更低的计算成本，准确学习该体系的高维粗糙势能面，并复现经典DFT能量；GNN驱动的蒙特卡洛模拟成功恢复了与实验一致的平衡态结构，尽管网络仅基于高能非平衡构型训练。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：等变消息传递图神经网络（NequIP）能以四个数量级更低的计算成本，准确学习该体系的高维粗糙势能面，并复现经典DFT能量；GNN驱动的蒙特卡洛模拟成功恢复了与实验一致的平衡态结构，尽管网络仅基于高能非平衡构型训练。；创新点：首次将等变图神经网络应用于无溶剂聚合物接枝纳米颗粒体系，以极低成本准确预测其多体相互作用势能面，并仅从非平衡构型训练数据中成功恢复实验一致的平衡结构。
papers.method_zh: 经典密度泛函理论（DFT）建模；等变图神经网络（NequIP）进行势能面学习；系统分析GNN超参数以获取相互作用范围、各向异性和有效体阶的物理洞察；GNN驱动的蒙特卡洛模拟进行平衡结构预测。

papers.title: Saturated and Anisotropic Magnetostriction in an Altermagnet
papers.abstract: Magnetostriction, a fundamental phenomenon bridging magnetism and mechanics, has enabled a broad spectrum of applications. For almost two centuries, it has been mainly investigated for ferromagnets. Regarding the magnetostriction of antiferromagnets (AFMs), limitedly known examples for both conventional collinear AFMs and noncollinear AFMs predominantly exhibit non-saturating magnetic-field dependence. Herein, we report an easily saturated magnetostriction effect in a prototypical altermagnet - MnTe, which is an emerging class of collinear AFMs with special crystal symmetries. For high-quality MnTe single crystals, the magnetostriction saturates under a moderate field of ~0.7 T with an intriguing two-fold-symmetry anisotropy. First-principles calculations reveal that the saturated and anisotropic magnetostriction originates from symmetry-allowed coupling between elastic strain and its Néel order parameter. These findings break the traditional wisdom on antiferromagnetic magnetostriction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与计算混合类型。判断依据：摘要中提及“高质量MnTe单晶”的实验测量，以及“第一性原理计算”的理论分析。；研究对象：反铁磁材料中的磁致伸缩效应，具体材料为一种典型交变磁体（altermagnet）——MnTe单晶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在交变磁体MnTe中发现了易饱和的磁致伸缩效应，在约0.7 T的适中磁场下即可饱和，并表现出奇特的两重对称性各向异性，打破了传统对反铁磁磁致伸缩“难以饱和”的认知。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在交变磁体MnTe中发现了易饱和的磁致伸缩效应，在约0.7 T的适中磁场下即可饱和，并表现出奇特的两重对称性各向异性，打破了传统对反铁磁磁致伸缩“难以饱和”的认知。；创新点：首次在交变磁体（而非传统共线或非共线反铁磁体）中报道了易饱和且具有两重对称各向异性的磁致伸缩效应，揭示了弹性应变与奈尔序参量之间对称性允许的耦合机制，颠覆了反铁磁磁致伸缩的传统认知。
papers.method_zh: 实验上使用高质量MnTe单晶进行磁致伸缩测量；理论上采用第一性原理计算（具体方法如DFT等，摘要未明确说明更细的泛函类型）。

papers.title: Crystal Dislocations as Atomic Scale Ratchets
papers.abstract: The symmetry of a system's response to external stimuli is a fundamental concept in physics and materials science. At the microscopic scale, breaking this symmetry to achieve a rectified response is exceptionally difficult to engineer and remains rare in nature. Conventional micromechanics models of crystalline solids assume a symmetric response to applied stress, where reversing the load simply inverts the direction of defect velocity without altering its magnitude. In this work, we report an atomic-scale, geometry-rooted mechanism that breaks this symmetry. Molecular dynamics simulations of face-centered cubic nickel reveal that dislocations containing atomic-scale jogs exhibit asymmetric mobility under opposite applied stresses, reversing the loading direction triggers significantly higher drag. This asymmetry arises from an unconventional coupling between an atomic displacement vector and the second-order tensorial eigenstrain of the jog motion mechanism. Because jogs are ubiquitous structures in plastic deformation, this discovery challenges classical descriptions of plastic deformation mechanisms, with direct implications to cyclic creep, and opens new pathways for defect engineering to enhance fatigue resistance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：Molecular dynamics simulations）；研究对象：面心立方（FCC）镍晶体中，含有原子尺度割阶（jogs）的位错在反向应力下的非对称运动行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一种基于几何结构的原子尺度机制，该机制打破了位错运动对应力的对称响应：在反向加载时，含有割阶的位错会表现出显著更高的拖曳阻力，即运动具有非对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一种基于几何结构的原子尺度机制，该机制打破了位错运动对应力的对称响应：在反向加载时，含有割阶的位错会表现出显著更高的拖曳阻力，即运动具有非对称性。；创新点：揭示了位错上普遍存在的原子尺度割阶（jogs）与二阶张量本征应变（eigenstrain）之间的非传统耦合，这是导致位错运动非对称性的根源。该发现挑战了经典塑性力学中关于位错运动对称响应的基本假设，并为通过缺陷工程提高材料抗疲劳性能提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 分子动力学模拟（Molecular dynamics simulations）

papers.title: Bending-like stress induced by solder joint under uniaxial tensile testing in 2G-HTS tapes: Impact and optimization approach
papers.abstract: The reversible stress limit (\mathit{R}_{rev}) of second-generation high-temperature superconducting (2G-HTS) tapes is a critical performance indicator, typically characterized through uniaxial tensile testing. In practice, the accuracy of the measured Rrev value is often compromised by stress concentration induced by the voltage tap solder joint. The present study investigates the underlying interference mechanism using integrated experimental and numerical methods. Mechanistic analysis reveals that under uniaxial tensile loading, the local geometric inhomogeneity introduced by the solder joint induces an external, bending-like stress in the vicinity of the solder joint, transitioning from additional tensile stress in the zone adjacent to the joint to additional compressive stress in the zone remote from it. When the solder joint is attached to the front surface of the tape (the side closer to the superconducting layer), the superconducting layer experiences localized additional tensile stress, triggering premature damage and early \mathit{I}_{c} degradation. Consequently, an optimized back-surface soldering approach is proposed, which positions the superconducting layer in a localized compressive zone. Experimental validation demonstrates that the proposed approach effectively mitigates testing errors for various tape configurations. Notably, for the tape with a copper layer thickness of 5 μm, the measured \mathit{R}_{rev} increased from 546 MPa to 734 MPa, corresponding to a 42% increase, and moved closer to the actual value. The findings provide essential insights for the precision characterization of the electromechanical performances (EMPs) of 2G-HTS tapes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与数值模拟结合）。关键词：integrated experimental and numerical methods、experimental validation。；研究对象：第二代高温超导（2G-HTS）带材在单轴拉伸测试中，由电压引线焊点引起的应力集中及其对可逆应力极限（Rrev）测量精度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 焊点引入的局部几何不均匀性会在超导层附近产生类似弯曲的附加应力（邻近区为附加拉应力，远离区为附加压应力），导致超导层提前损伤和临界电流退化；采用背面焊接方案可将超导层置于局部压应力区，有效提升Rrev测量值（如铜层厚度5 μm的带材中Rrev从546 MPa提升至734 MPa，提高42%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：焊点引入的局部几何不均匀性会在超导层附近产生类似弯曲的附加应力（邻近区为附加拉应力，远离区为附加压应力），导致超导层提前损伤和临界电流退化；采用背面焊接方案可将超导层置于局部压应力区，有效提升Rrev测量值（如铜层厚度5 μm的带材中Rrev从546 MPa提升至734 MPa，提高42%）。；创新点：揭示了焊点引起的弯曲类应力干扰机制，并提出了将焊点置于带材背面（远离超导层一侧）的优化方案，以消除附加拉应力对Rrev测量的影响。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：单轴拉伸测试；数值方法：有限元模拟（mechanistic analysis）；优化方案：背面焊接（back-surface soldering approach）。

papers.title: Ni-O hybridization-driven electronic reconstruction across the superconducting dome in an infinite-layer nickelate
papers.abstract: Superconductivity in infinite-layer nickelates has drawn wide interest as a cuprate analogue, yet how the electronic structure evolves with hole doping remains unsettled. Here we map the doping- and temperature-dependent unoccupied states of the La-based infinite-layer nickelate La1-xCaxNiO2 using O K-edge and Ni L-edge x-ray absorption spectroscopy. Superconductivity occurs for 0.18<=x<=0.27. Near x~0.20-0.23, low-energy spectral weight redistributes: Ni3d-dominated states decrease while O2p-hybridized states increase, indicating an orbital-selective crossover in Ni-O covalency. This crossover coincides with a sign reversal of the Hall coefficient and precedes the reduction of the superconducting critical temperature at higher doping. By directly linking transport anomalies and the superconducting dome to a measurable Ni-O orbital reorganization, our results provide a key step toward a unified, orbital-resolved phase diagram for infinite-layer nickelates and a practical route to engineer superconductivity via hybridization control.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：x-ray absorption spectroscopy（X射线吸收谱）、mapping doping- and temperature-dependent unoccupied states。；研究对象：无限层镍氧化物超导体La₁₋ₓCaₓNiO₂，具体研究其电子结构随空穴掺杂（x）的演化，以及超导穹顶与电子重构的关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在掺杂区间x~0.20-0.23附近，Ni-O杂化发生轨道选择性交叉：Ni 3d主导的未占据态减少，而O 2p杂化态增加。这一电子重构与霍尔系数符号反转同时发生，并先于更高掺杂下超导临界温度的下降，表明Ni-O轨道重组直接关联超导穹顶和输运异常。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在掺杂区间x~0.20-0.23附近，Ni-O杂化发生轨道选择性交叉：Ni 3d主导的未占据态减少，而O 2p杂化态增加。这一电子重构与霍尔系数符号反转同时发生，并先于更高掺杂下超导临界温度的下降，表明Ni-O轨道重组直接关联超导穹顶和输运异常。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用O K边和Ni L边X射线吸收谱（XAS），测量不同掺杂浓度（x=0.18-0.27）和温度下的未占据态电子结构。

papers.title: Defect-engineered scaling of lead-free ferroelectrics with ultralow-voltage switching
papers.abstract: Scaling ferroelectrics to nanometer thicknesses remains a central challenge for low-power, nonvolatile electronics, as leakage currents increasingly dominate with reduced dimensions. Alkali-based, lead-free ferroelectrics offer an environmentally sustainable alternative to lead-based systems, yet their scaling is severely limited by leakage arising from volatile alkali constituents. Here, we show that this intrinsic limitation can be transformed into an advantageous degree of freedom through defect engineering. By precisely modulating alkali deficiency during thin-film synthesis, we engineer clustered defect complexes that function as deep trap states, strongly suppressing leakage and enabling robust ferroelectric operation in ultrathin films down to the sub-10 nm regime at voltages below 100 mV. Our results establish defect-enabled scaling as a viable pathway for advancing environmentally benign ferroelectrics toward ultra-low-power, non-volatile electronic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“thin-film synthesis”（薄膜合成）、“modulating alkali deficiency”（调控碱金属缺失）、“suppressing leakage”（抑制漏电流）。；研究对象：基于碱金属的无铅铁电薄膜，具体研究其厚度缩减至亚10纳米（sub-10 nm regime）时的铁电开关特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过缺陷工程（defect engineering），在无铅铁电薄膜中精确调控碱金属缺失，形成深能级陷阱态的缺陷团簇，从而有效抑制漏电流，实现了在低于100毫伏电压下、厚度小于10纳米的超薄铁电薄膜的稳健开关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过缺陷工程（defect engineering），在无铅铁电薄膜中精确调控碱金属缺失，形成深能级陷阱态的缺陷团簇，从而有效抑制漏电流，实现了在低于100毫伏电压下、厚度小于10纳米的超薄铁电薄膜的稳健开关。；创新点：将传统上限制无铅铁电薄膜缩放的碱金属挥发导致的漏电问题，通过缺陷工程转化为一种有利的自由度，从而实现了无铅铁电材料在超薄尺度（亚10纳米）和超低电压（<100 mV）下的铁电开关。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：通过精确调控薄膜合成过程中的碱金属缺失（alkali deficiency），构建缺陷团簇（clustered defect complexes）。具体表征手段摘要未明确说明，但涉及对漏电流和铁电开关行为的电学测量。

papers.title: Superconductor-"Metal" Transition of One-dimensional Interacting Bosons with Ohmic Quantum Dissipation
papers.abstract: The phase diagram of a system of interacting bosons (Cooper pairs) hoping on a one-dimensional (1D) lattice with onsite phase dissipation describing the Josephson tunneling to a nearby diffusive normal-metal electrode is studied. Starting from the system at commensurate lattice filling, it is shown by a combination of analytical techniques that the phase diagram contains two quantum phases: A dissipative Bose-Einstein condensate (D-BEC) or superconductor with long-range phase coherence, and a dissipative Mott insulator (D-Mott) or "metal" with exponentially decaying phase correlations in space and local imaginary-time correlations decaying as the local pairing correlations of the electrode. The D-Mott/metal phase can be described as a 1D array of dissipative boson puddles, weakly coupled by Josephson tunneling. The puddle size roughly corresponds to the length scale beyond which phase slips suppress phase coherence. The dissipative time-dependent Ginsburg-Landau theory phenomenologically used by Sachdev, Werner, and Troyer [Phys. Rev. Lett. {\bf 92} 237003 (2004)] for the superconductor-metal transition in quasi-1D wires is derived from this microscopic puddle picture. Thus, the criticality of the D-Mott/D-BEC transition is shown to belong to the Wilson-Fisher universality class with dynamical exponent $z\approx 2$. At small doping, the D-Mott/metal phase remains stable due to its finite compressibility, which is computed to leading order in a perturbation expansion of the dissipation strength and the inter-puddle Josephson coupling. At larger doping, using a mapping to a pseudospin chain combined with bosonization, the D-BEC/superconductor phase is the ground state for non-vanishing but arbitrarily small dissipation. Similarities and differences with deconfinement transition of an array 1D bosonic Mott insulators in anisotropic optical lattices are also discussed.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“analytical techniques”“bosonization”“mapping to a pseudospin chain”等理论分析工具，未提及实验或数值计算手段。；研究对象：一维相互作用玻色子（库珀对）系统在存在欧姆型量子耗散（通过约瑟夫森隧穿耦合到邻近扩散性正常金属电极）时的超导体-“金属”相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该系统的相图包含两个量子相：具有长程相位相干的耗散玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（D-BEC）/超导体相，以及具有指数衰减空间相位关联和局域虚时关联的耗散莫特绝缘体（D-Mott）/“金属”相。D-Mott/D-BEC相变属于Wilson-Fisher普适类，动力学指数z≈2。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该系统的相图包含两个量子相：具有长程相位相干的耗散玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（D-BEC）/超导体相，以及具有指数衰减空间相位关联和局域虚时关联的耗散莫特绝缘体（D-Mott）/“金属”相。D-Mott/D-BEC相变属于Wilson-Fisher普适类，动力学指数z≈2。；创新点：从微观“耗散玻色子团簇”图像出发，推导了Sachdev等人用于准一维线超导体-金属相变的唯象耗散含时金兹堡-朗道理论，并明确了该相变的临界行为属于Wilson-Fisher普适类。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的其他具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 结合多种解析技术：从耗散强度与团簇间约瑟夫森耦合的微扰展开计算压缩率；通过映射到赝自旋链并结合玻色化方法分析掺杂效应；从微观“耗散玻色子团簇”图像推导出唯象的耗散含时金兹堡-朗道理论。

papers.title: A Padding Method for Enhanced Encoding of Inorganic Structures with Varying Chemical Compositions
papers.abstract: Designing novel inorganic materials through generative models remains an important challenge for material science, driven by the complexity and diversity of inorganic structures across expansive chemical compositions and structural landscape. The vast combinatorial space of inorganic compounds demands innovative, AI-driven approaches to overcome limitations in generative accuracy and efficiency. To address this, we introduce a novel method that redefines the encoding and generation of inorganic materials by utilizing domain-specific symmetry-aware representation. Our approach not only refines the representation of intricate inorganic structures but also contributes to the field of material discovery by enhancing the precision and stability of generated candidates. Central to our methodology is a novel padding technique that exploits crystal symmetry information to enhance the encoding process. By integrating Wyckoff position length-aware padding into an encoder architecture, we achieve a more robust informed representation of inorganic materials. This symmetry-driven enhancement improves deep learning models to generate stable, previously unexplored inorganic structures with superior accuracy and computational efficiency. Furthermore, we introduce an end-to-end system that leverages the machine learning potential models to seamlessly generate novel, even those unseen in the training data, and stable inorganic materials from initial data to validated output. This pipeline integrates advanced generative models with stability analysis, marking a significant leap forward in the automated exploration and design of next-generation inorganic materials. Our method improved reconstruction accuracy 5.3% in proton conductor data, and generated 63.5% more novel stable inorganic material to baseline model on the perov-5 dataset.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：generative models, encoding, machine learning potential models, deep learning models。；研究对象：无机晶体材料，特别是具有不同化学成分的无机结构（如质子导体、钙钛矿材料）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于晶体对称性（Wyckoff位置长度感知填充）的编码方法，显著提升了生成模型对无机材料结构的重建精度（提升5.3%）和新型稳定材料的生成数量（比基线模型多63.5%）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于晶体对称性（Wyckoff位置长度感知填充）的编码方法，显著提升了生成模型对无机材料结构的重建精度（提升5.3%）和新型稳定材料的生成数量（比基线模型多63.5%）。；创新点：首次将Wyckoff位置长度感知填充技术引入编码器，利用晶体对称性信息增强对复杂无机结构的表示能力，并构建了结合生成模型与稳定性分析的端到端自动化材料设计流程。
papers.method_zh: 采用基于对称性感知的编码器架构，结合Wyckoff位置长度感知填充技术，并集成机器学习势模型（machine learning potential models）构建端到端生成系统，用于从初始数据到验证输出的全流程材料生成与稳定性分析。

papers.title: Tensor gradient flow for rod-like liquid crystals from molecular model with closure approximation by quasi-entropy
papers.abstract: In tensor dynamics for liquid crystals derived from molecular models, a common problem is closure approximation. For rod-like molecules, the Bingham closure has proved to outperform other methods because it inherits the gradient flow structure of the molecular model, but is difficult to achieve efficient computations maintaining the gradient flow structure. We propose a closure approximation by the quasi-entropy that has been successfully applied to the free energy, based on which we construct the tensor gradient flow. The quasi-entropy closure has the same symmetry properties as the Bingham closure. The resulting tensor gradient flow is able to constrain the eigenvalues of the tensor within the physical range, guaranteeing the positive definiteness of the dissipation operator given by the higher-order tensors. The quasi-entropy closure is easy to implement since it can be reduced to minimizing an elementary function of three variables. As a result, we construct a numerical scheme preserving the eigenvalue constraints and energy dissipation, with the closure approximation decoupled from solving the scheme. Numerical simulations are carried out for the interface between the isotropic and the uniaxial nematic phase, as well as the defect evolutions, where the higher-order tensors indeed make a difference.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：tensor gradient flow、closure approximation、numerical scheme、numerical simulations。；研究对象：棒状液晶（rod-like liquid crystals）的分子模型，具体涉及从分子模型推导的张量动力学中的闭合近似问题，以及各向同性-单轴向列相界面和缺陷演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出基于准熵（quasi-entropy）的闭合近似方法，能够构建保持物理约束（张量本征值在物理范围内）和能量耗散结构的张量梯度流，且该闭合近似易于数值实现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出基于准熵（quasi-entropy）的闭合近似方法，能够构建保持物理约束（张量本征值在物理范围内）和能量耗散结构的张量梯度流，且该闭合近似易于数值实现。；创新点：提出准熵闭合近似，兼具Bingham闭合的对称性（继承分子模型的梯度流结构）和更高的计算效率，同时能保证耗散算子的正定性，且数值实现简单。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架：从分子模型出发，利用准熵构造闭合近似，建立张量梯度流方程。数值方法：设计保持本征值约束和能量耗散的数值格式，将闭合近似与求解格式解耦，并通过最小化三元初等函数实现高效计算。模拟对象：各向同性-单轴向列相界面及缺陷演化。

papers.title: A Convenient Sealing Method Using Boron Nitride Capping for Reactive Reactions
papers.abstract: While quartz (SiO2) ampule sealing is commonly used in laboratories to prevent sample oxidation during synthesis, its application is limited for reactions involving highly reactive elements such as alkali, alkaline-earth, and rare-earth metals. These elements can react with SiO2 at elevated temperatures, causing compositional loss, tube failure, and experimental inconsistencies. Here, we introduce an inexpensive boron nitride (BN) cap sealing technique. This approach is readily adaptable to centrifugal separation and flux transport growth and yields superior sample quality. We demonstrate its efficacy by growing KFe2As2 and CsCr6Sb6 single crystals, the former exhibiting record-high quality, with a residual resistivity ratio (RRR) exceeding 2500, and the latter achieving significantly larger crystal dimensions than other methods. This accessible and economical method promises to accelerate the discovery of novel materials that contain reactive elements.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验操作（石英管密封、BN盖密封）、样品生长（KFe2As2和CsCr6Sb6单晶）以及性能表征（残余电阻率RRR、晶体尺寸）。；研究对象：针对含有碱金属、碱土金属、稀土金属等高活性元素的材料合成，提出一种新的密封方法。具体演示体系为KFe2As2和CsCr6Sb6单晶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种廉价且简便的氮化硼（BN）盖密封技术，可替代传统石英管密封，用于高活性元素反应。利用该方法生长的KFe2As2单晶残余电阻率（RRR）超过2500，达到创纪录的高质量；CsCr6Sb6单晶尺寸显著大于其他方法所得。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种廉价且简便的氮化硼（BN）盖密封技术，可替代传统石英管密封，用于高活性元素反应。利用该方法生长的KFe2As2单晶残余电阻率（RRR）超过2500，达到创纪录的高质量；CsCr6Sb6单晶尺寸显著大于其他方法所得。；创新点：提出一种低成本、易操作的BN盖密封方法，解决了传统石英管密封在高活性元素反应中易发生反应、导致组分损失和实验失败的问题，并兼容离心分离和助熔剂生长工艺。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：采用BN盖密封技术替代传统石英管密封，并结合离心分离和助熔剂输运生长法，用于单晶生长。表征手段：通过残余电阻率（RRR）评估KFe2As2晶体质量，通过晶体尺寸比较CsCr6Sb6生长效果。

papers.title: Non-Perturbative Renormalization Group for Ising-Nematic Criticality: A Closed-Form Nonlocal Ansatz
papers.abstract: The two-dimensional metallic quantum critical problem is a long-standing puzzle that is widely believed to hold the key to resolving ubiquitous non-Fermi liquid behavior in strongly correlated electronic systems. In this study, we present a non-perturbative renormalization group (RG) analysis of the metallic Ising-nematic quantum critical point in two dimensions, formulated directly around an intrinsically nonlocal infrared (IR) boson propagator. Rather than treating the anomalous dynamical critical exponent $a$ as a fixed phenomenological parameter, we regard it as an intrinsic component of the fixed-point data to be determined from the internal consistency of the low-energy patch field theory under highly anisotropic scaling dimensions ($[k_0]=a+1$, $[k_x]=2$, $[k_y]=1$). While the leading two-loop diagrammatics vanish identically due to kinematic pole configurations, our three-loop evaluation reveals a profound structural asymmetry between the sectors: the fermion self-energy and Yukawa vertex receive non-vanishing logarithmic corrections, whereas the corresponding bosonic counter-term remains strictly zero. Consequently, we find that no self-consistent, intersecting fixed-point solution for the exponent $a$ exists within the three-loop truncation, failing to reproduce the physical value of $a \approx 1.85$ observed in quantum Monte Carlo simulations. We conjecture that the cross-linked topology of the four-loop boson self-energy diagrams is exactly marginal and yields the minimal, mandatory bosonic counter-term required to restore multi-sector self-consistency. Our framework establishes a rigid multi-loop matching scheme necessary to uniquely pin down the critical exponent, and uncovers a stable phase space for field anomalous dimensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：非微扰重整化群、场论分析、多圈图计算。；研究对象：二维金属中Ising-nematic量子临界点，即电子向列序的量子相变问题，以及与之相关的非费米液体行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在三圈图截断下，无法找到自洽的临界动力学指数a的解，无法复现量子蒙特卡洛模拟给出的物理值a≈1.85；推测四圈图玻色子自能中的交叉拓扑结构是严格边缘的，是恢复多扇区自洽性所必需的最小玻色子抵消项。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在三圈图截断下，无法找到自洽的临界动力学指数a的解，无法复现量子蒙特卡洛模拟给出的物理值a≈1.85；推测四圈图玻色子自能中的交叉拓扑结构是严格边缘的，是恢复多扇区自洽性所必需的最小玻色子抵消项。；创新点：将反常动力学临界指数a视为固定点数据的内在组成部分而非唯象参数，通过多圈匹配方案自洽确定；揭示了三圈图下费米子自能和Yukawa顶点与玻色子抵消项之间的结构性不对称。
papers.method_zh: 非微扰重整化群（RG）分析，基于非局域红外玻色子传播子构建低能patch场论，采用高度各向异性的标度维度（[k₀]=a+1, [kₓ]=2, [k_y]=1），并进行了两圈和三圈图计算。

papers.title: Nonlinear Schrodinger Equations for Dense Bose Fluid and He4 Film at Low Temperatures
papers.abstract: We have derived the nonlinear Schrodinger equation generalizing the Gross-Pitaevskii (GP) equa tion for dilute Bose gas. The derivation is based on the Hartree-Fock time-dependent mean-field theory with an arbitrary intermolecular interaction potential. It is shown that obtained nonlinear Schrodinger equation with appropriate redefinition of coefficients can be used for description of dense Bose fluid at low temperatures. We also present the Schrodinger type equation describing the superfluid component of helium in two fluid hydrodynamics. This approach leads to quantum correction for superfluid component of velocity in two fluid hydrodynamics. We also have derived the nonlinear Schrodinger equation for superfluid He4 film at low temperatures. It is shown that this Schrodinger type equation for superfluid He4 film leads to phonon-roton dispersion relation for elementary excitation at low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：derived、mean-field theory、nonlinear Schrodinger equation。；研究对象：稠密玻色流体（dense Bose fluid）和低温下He⁴薄膜（superfluid He4 film）的超流性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导了适用于稠密玻色流体的非线性薛定谔方程，并给出了描述He⁴薄膜超流组分的薛定谔型方程，该方程在低温下可得到声子-旋子（phonon-roton）色散关系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导了适用于稠密玻色流体的非线性薛定谔方程，并给出了描述He⁴薄膜超流组分的薛定谔型方程，该方程在低温下可得到声子-旋子（phonon-roton）色散关系。；创新点：将非线性薛定谔方程从稀薄玻色气体推广到稠密玻色流体，并推导了He⁴薄膜超流组分的薛定谔型方程，引入双流体流体力学中超流速度的量子修正。
papers.method_zh: 基于含时哈特里-福克平均场理论（Hartree-Fock time-dependent mean-field theory），采用任意分子间相互作用势，推广了稀薄玻色气体的Gross-Pitaevskii方程。

papers.title: Simulations of dislocation dynamics on an atomic lattice: the effect of collision rules
papers.abstract: The stochastic dynamics of dislocations on a one-dimensional periodic lattice domain are considered. Two models are studied: one without a collision rule, and one which annihilates colliding dislocations if they have opposite orientation. The behaviour of both models is investigated by means of a series of numerical simulations exploring the asymptotic behaviour of these models as the number of dislocations increases. From these simulations, evidence is obtained that the discrete model with annihilation tends to a PDE for the dislocation density that accounts for annihilation. However, the discrete model without a collision rule does not appear to exhibit consistent convergence behaviour; instead, it appears that the expected PDE with conserved dislocation density appears in the limit for some parameters, but that for other parameters the density appears to follow to the evolution of the PDE with annihilation. These findings provide evidence that a careful treatment of dislocation collisions is important in discrete dislocation dynamics models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：数值模拟、离散模型、随机动力学。；研究对象：一维周期晶格上的位错随机动力学，具体研究两种模型：一种无碰撞规则，另一种使相反取向的碰撞位错湮灭。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 带湮灭的离散模型趋于描述位错密度演化的偏微分方程（PDE）；而无碰撞规则的模型收敛行为不一致，在某些参数下趋于位错密度守恒的PDE，在其他参数下却趋于带湮灭的PDE，表明碰撞规则的处理对离散位错动力学模型至关重要。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：带湮灭的离散模型趋于描述位错密度演化的偏微分方程（PDE）；而无碰撞规则的模型收敛行为不一致，在某些参数下趋于位错密度守恒的PDE，在其他参数下却趋于带湮灭的PDE，表明碰撞规则的处理对离散位错动力学模型至关重要。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 通过一系列数值模拟，研究位错数量增加时两种模型的渐近行为，并对比离散模型与相应PDE的演化。

papers.title: Wetting as an emergent property of water: reformulating Young equation on molecular grounds
papers.abstract: Young equation provides a remarkably successful macroscopic description of wetting, yet its molecular origin (particularly for water) has remained elusive for over two centuries. Here we make the molecular basis of aqueous wetting explicit by reformulating it in terms of a molecular wetting coefficient, omega m, which quantifies how an interface compensates the intrinsic energetic cost of hydrogen-bond defects relative to bulk water. Across a broad and continuous spectrum of hydrophilicities, spanning chemically diverse experimental and model surfaces, macroscopic contact angles collapse onto a single universal master curve when expressed through omega m. This molecular reformulation closes Young and Young-Dupre relations on energetic grounds, establishing a unified and predictive physical link between wetting, adhesion, cavitation, and nanoconfined filling. By anchoring interfacial behavior to waters intrinsic hydrogen-bond energetic scales, our results reveal wetting as an emergent property of water itself, rather than a surface-specific attribute and provide a transferable molecular framework that recalibrates energetic intuition and guides the rational design of aqueous interfaces. (This document is the unedited Author version of a Submitted Manuscript subsequently accepted for publication in J. Am. Chem. Soc. For the published version, which includes a more complete molecular-thermodynamics grounding of the method see the published version)
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：reformulating、molecular grounds、energetic scales、molecular-thermodynamics grounding）；研究对象：水在固体表面的润湿现象，具体涉及水分子氢键缺陷的界面补偿行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过定义分子润湿系数ωm，发现不同化学性质表面的宏观接触角可统一为一条普适主曲线，表明润湿是水本身的涌现性质而非表面特异性属性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过定义分子润湿系数ωm，发现不同化学性质表面的宏观接触角可统一为一条普适主曲线，表明润湿是水本身的涌现性质而非表面特异性属性。；创新点：首次从水分子氢键本征能量尺度出发，建立了润湿、粘附、空化和纳米限域填充之间的统一预测性物理联系，将杨氏方程和杨-杜普雷方程在能量基础上闭合，为理性设计水界面提供了可迁移的分子框架。
papers.method_zh: 基于分子热力学框架，将杨氏方程重新表述为分子润湿系数ωm，该系数量化界面如何补偿水分子氢键缺陷相对于体相水的本征能量成本。研究覆盖了连续亲水性谱上的多种实验与模型表面。

papers.title: Deterministic fabrication of large-area, high-crystallinity oxide moire superlattices
papers.abstract: Oxide twistronics extends moire engineering beyond van der Waals materials, offering a promising platform for accessing emergent interfacial phenomena arising from the strong coupling of lattice, charge, and orbital degrees of freedom in complex oxides. However, deterministic fabrication of high-crystallinity oxide moire superlattices over large lateral dimensions remains challenging due to the three-dimensional bonding network of oxides. Here, we demonstrate a scalable, generalized fabrication strategy that enables the formation of high-crystallinity oxide moire superlattices with clean, chemically bonded interfaces and precisely controlled twist angles down to nominal values of 0.1 degree, achieving sub-degree twist-angle accuracy across large contiguous lateral dimensions approaching the millimeter scale. Using NaNbO3 as a model system, we show that the resulting interlayer coupling drives pronounced structural reconstruction that modifies both the phase structure and ferroelectric domain configuration. Synchrotron-based X-ray 3D reciprocal space mapping reveals the emergence of a single-phase state in twisted bilayers, in contrast to the mixed-phase structure observed in single-layer membranes prior to twist assembly. The structural signatures are further consistent with gradual lattice rotation distributed along the thickness direction that may accommodate interfacial shear strain, distinct from reconstruction observed in van der Waals moire systems, which primarily occurs through in-plane stacking rearrangement. This collective lattice response is correlated with twist-dependent nanoscale electromechanical modulations observed by piezoresponse force microscopy. These results establish a scalable materials platform for oxide twistronics and open new pathways towards integrating twist-engineered complex oxides into practical, macroscale device architectures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据关键词：demonstrate、fabrication、X-ray 3D reciprocal space mapping、piezoresponse force microscopy。；研究对象：氧化物莫尔超晶格，具体以 NaNbO₃ 为模型体系，研究其通过扭转工程实现的高结晶度、大面积的制备及其层间耦合导致的相结构和铁电畴重构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种可规模化、普适的制备策略，实现了大面积、高结晶度、亚度扭转角精度的氧化物莫尔超晶格，并发现其层间耦合导致显著的结构重构，形成单相态和沿厚度方向的晶格旋转，区别于范德华莫尔体系的面内堆垛重构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种可规模化、普适的制备策略，实现了大面积、高结晶度、亚度扭转角精度的氧化物莫尔超晶格，并发现其层间耦合导致显著的结构重构，形成单相态和沿厚度方向的晶格旋转，区别于范德华莫尔体系的面内堆垛重构。；创新点：实现了氧化物莫尔超晶格在毫米级大面积上的确定性制备，并精确控制扭转角至0.1度精度，揭示了氧化物体系中独特的沿厚度方向晶格旋转的集体响应机制，为氧化物扭转电子学提供了可规模化的材料平台。
papers.method_zh: 采用可扩展的普适制备方法（摘要未明确具体工艺名称），结合同步辐射X射线三维倒易空间映射（3D reciprocal space mapping）和压电力显微镜（piezoresponse force microscopy）进行结构表征与电机械调制测量。

papers.title: Symmetry-Resolved Second Harmonic Generation in Quantum and Functional Materials
papers.abstract: Second harmonic generation (SHG) has evolved from a probe of noncentrosymmetric crystals into a symmetry-resolved optical method for identifying order parameters in quantum and functional materials. In particular, polarization-resolved rotational anisotropy (RA) measurements of SHG can connect nonlinear susceptibility tensors to the crystallographic and magnetic point groups of the underlying materials. This capability is especially powerful when the ordered state is weak, spatially confined, multipolar, magnetic, or hidden from conventional linear probe techniques. In this review article, we provide a comprehensive overview of RA-SHG studies across a broad range of condensed matter systems. We begin with basic theoretical background for the multipole origins of SHG radiation, the construction of nonlinear susceptibility tensors, and group-theoretical framework connecting tensor components to order parameters. We then review the applications of RA-SHG to polar materials, magnetic orders, and other hidden electronic materials. Finally, we outline challenges and future research directions for using SHG to reveal, image, and control hidden, intertwined, and nonequilibrium phases in quantum and functional materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：综述文章。关键词：review article, comprehensive overview。；研究对象：量子材料与功能材料中的二次谐波产生（SHG）现象，特别是其作为对称性分辨光学探针的应用。具体涵盖极性材料、磁有序体系以及隐藏电子态材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 偏振分辨的旋转各向异性二次谐波产生（RA-SHG）测量能够将非线性磁化率张量与材料的晶体和磁点群联系起来，从而有效探测那些微弱、空间受限、多极、磁性或对传统线性探针“隐藏”的有序态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：偏振分辨的旋转各向异性二次谐波产生（RA-SHG）测量能够将非线性磁化率张量与材料的晶体和磁点群联系起来，从而有效探测那些微弱、空间受限、多极、磁性或对传统线性探针“隐藏”的有序态。；创新点：本文是一篇全面的综述，系统总结了RA-SHG在广泛凝聚态体系中的应用，并特别强调了其在揭示、成像和控制量子与功能材料中隐藏、交织及非平衡相方面的潜力与未来方向。摘要未突出说明与单篇研究论文相比的具体单一创新点。
papers.method_zh: 主要综述了偏振分辨的旋转各向异性二次谐波产生（RA-SHG）实验技术。理论框架包括：SHG辐射的多极起源、非线性磁化率张量的构建、以及将张量分量与序参量联系起来的群论方法。

papers.title: Observation and Control of the Magnetic Photogalvanic Effect from Strongly Bound Excitons
papers.abstract: Photogalvanic effects arising from the quantum geometry of noncentrosymmetric materials are promising for next-generation light-harvesting devices that do not require a built-in electric field. Recent theories predict photogalvanic currents generated in magnetic systems with spin-dependent symmetry breaking as well as by bound exciton states, allowing for potential magnetic field control of the photoresponse and enhanced detection of deep sub-gap signals, respectively. We demonstrate the magnetic photogalvanic effect in a bilayer CrI3 tunnel junction with both magnetic field switching and electric field tuning of interlayer symmetry. By controlling for the polarization and energy of light illumination, we disentangle the shift and injection current contributions and find that the peak response occurs under resonant excitation of strongly bound excitons in CrI3. Our results can be captured within a many-body framework of the photogalvanic effect, while our devices function as tunable, multispectral helicity- and polarization-sensitive detectors that highlight the potential of 2D magnets for future optoelectronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（判断依据：demonstrate、tunnel junction、control、disentangle、devices function等实验操作与器件表征关键词）；研究对象：双层CrI₃隧道结中的磁光电流效应（magnetic photogalvanic effect），具体涉及强束缚激子（strongly bound excitons）的光激发与电流响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在双层CrI₃隧道结中实现了磁光电流效应，并发现其峰值响应来源于强束缚激子的共振激发；通过磁场开关和电场调控可改变层间对称性，从而控制光电流。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在双层CrI₃隧道结中实现了磁光电流效应，并发现其峰值响应来源于强束缚激子的共振激发；通过磁场开关和电场调控可改变层间对称性，从而控制光电流。；创新点：首次在实验上观测并调控了磁性体系中的光电流效应（磁光电流效应），并明确将其归因于强束缚激子的共振激发，同时实现了磁场和电场对层间对称性的双重调控。
papers.method_zh: 实验上构建双层CrI₃隧道结，通过控制光照的偏振和能量，区分了位移电流（shift current）和注入电流（injection current）的贡献；理论分析采用多体光电流效应框架（many-body framework of the photogalvanic effect）。

papers.title: Entanglement entropy of an acoustic black hole
papers.abstract: We introduce a method to numerically compute the entanglement entropy of an acoustic black hole. It is shown that the entanglement entropy of sufficiently large subregions scales linearly with size and thus shows a volume law instead of an area law. The origin of this scaling can be traced back to the non-separable long-distance correlations due to the production of phonon pairs at the horizon. The system is shown to be locally thermal, such that the part of the entanglement entropy scaling with volume is well approximated by the thermal entropy of the outgoing Hawking radiation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：numerically compute、entanglement entropy、acoustic black hole）；研究对象：声学黑洞（acoustic black hole）中的纠缠熵（entanglement entropy）
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于足够大的子区域，声学黑洞的纠缠熵随尺寸线性增长，呈现体积律而非面积律；该体积律源于视界处声子对产生导致的不可分离的长程关联，且系统局部热化，体积律部分可近似由出射霍金辐射的热熵描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于足够大的子区域，声学黑洞的纠缠熵随尺寸线性增长，呈现体积律而非面积律；该体积律源于视界处声子对产生导致的不可分离的长程关联，且系统局部热化，体积律部分可近似由出射霍金辐射的热熵描述。；创新点：摘要未突出说明
papers.method_zh: 数值计算纠缠熵的方法（method to numerically compute the entanglement entropy）

papers.title: Kinetic phase transition modeling for metals
papers.abstract: We present a new phenomenological model for phase transformation (PT) kinetics in metals, the "Fermi Kinetic Phase Transition (KPT) Model". It is designed such that it captures the main macroscopic features of our previously developed micro-structure dependent model, but at a fraction of the computational cost of the latter. Using four model parameters, the Fermi KPT model performs better than other phenomenological PT kinetics models in the literature, as shown by our present comparisons to experimental data for iron and tin.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：phenomenological model、modeling、computational cost）；研究对象：金属中的相变动力学（phase transformation kinetics），具体以铁和锡为例进行实验对比。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一个名为“Fermi Kinetic Phase Transition (KPT) Model”的新唯象模型，该模型能以远低于微观结构依赖模型的计算成本，捕捉其主要宏观特征，并在与铁和锡的实验数据对比中优于文献中其他唯象相变动力学模型。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一个名为“Fermi Kinetic Phase Transition (KPT) Model”的新唯象模型，该模型能以远低于微观结构依赖模型的计算成本，捕捉其主要宏观特征，并在与铁和锡的实验数据对比中优于文献中其他唯象相变动力学模型。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于唯象建模（phenomenological modeling），使用四个模型参数构建Fermi KPT模型，并通过与已有实验数据（铁和锡）的对比来验证模型性能。

papers.title: Harnessing diamond surface features for dense and aligned NV ensembles
papers.abstract: Controlling nitrogen doping in diamond is key to advancing nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center devices. We harness the hillock, a typically undesirable surface feature, to incorporate high densities of grown-in, aligned NV-centers on a (001)-oriented substrate. Enhanced cathodoluminescence at hillock sidewalls is correlated via nanoSIMS to up to 1000x greater nitrogen incorporation compared to the planar film. We find that these hillocks are associated with stacking faults and edge-type dislocations, consistent with an origin in surface preparation rather than substrate screw dislocations. Yet, the growth is orderly enough that each of the four hillock sidewalls hosts a distinct NV orientation. A 1.7-2% grown-in NV/substitutional nitrogen (P1) ratio, 4x higher than typical (001)-oriented growth, is measured via NV decoherence analysis. By revealing that spontaneously formed hillocks act as natural laboratories for dense, aligned NV formation, this work motivates systematic investigation of facet-dependent nitrogen incorporation and preferential NV alignment in (001) diamond.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了具体的实验观测（增强的阴极发光）、表征手段（nanoSIMS）和样品制备（生长）。；研究对象：金刚石（001）衬底上生长的氮空位（NV）中心，特别是利用金刚石表面自发形成的“hillock”（小丘）结构来制备高密度、取向一致的NV中心。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现金刚石（001）表面通常不受欢迎的hillock结构，其侧壁的氮掺入量比平坦薄膜区域高出1000倍，并且每个侧壁只包含一种特定的NV取向，从而实现了高密度、取向一致的NV中心阵列。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现金刚石（001）表面通常不受欢迎的hillock结构，其侧壁的氮掺入量比平坦薄膜区域高出1000倍，并且每个侧壁只包含一种特定的NV取向，从而实现了高密度、取向一致的NV中心阵列。；创新点：揭示了通常被视为缺陷的hillock结构，实际上可以作为天然“实验室”，用于自发形成高密度且取向一致的NV中心。这一发现为在（001）金刚石中通过控制晶面依赖的氮掺入和NV择优取向来制备高质量NV中心阵列提供了新思路。
papers.method_zh: 主要采用化学气相沉积（CVD）方法在（001）取向金刚石衬底上生长NV中心；使用阴极发光（CL）和纳米二次离子质谱（nanoSIMS）进行表征和关联分析；通过NV退相干分析测量了生长态NV与替代氮（P1中心）的比例。

papers.title: Mean-squared displacements of rough particles in polydisperse granular gases
papers.abstract: We investigate the diffusion coefficients and mean-squared displacements in a polydisperse granular gas in a homogeneous cooling state by considering the roughness of the particles. We study their dependence on the normal and tangential restitution coefficients. We show that the motility of particles is strongly affected by their mechanical properties and surface characteristics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：investigate、show（理论推导与数值分析）。；研究对象：多分散颗粒气体中粗糙颗粒的扩散系数与均方位移，具体关注颗粒在均匀冷却态下的运动行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 颗粒的迁移率（扩散系数与均方位移）强烈依赖于其力学性质（法向恢复系数）和表面特性（切向恢复系数）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：颗粒的迁移率（扩散系数与均方位移）强烈依赖于其力学性质（法向恢复系数）和表面特性（切向恢复系数）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于颗粒气体动理论，通过考虑颗粒粗糙度引入法向与切向恢复系数，对多分散颗粒气体在均匀冷却态下的扩散系数和均方位移进行解析或数值计算。

papers.title: Topological Phenomena Protected by Diabolical Textures
papers.abstract: We present a new class of topological phenomena in inhomogeneous systems arising from the adiabatic spatial embedding of parametrized families of quantum states such as charge pumps and their generalizations. We demonstrate that each topologically distinct class of these "diabolical textures" gives rise to distinct gapped states that are separated by "trap-scaling" critical points. When the texture varies sufficiently rapidly in space, the critical line terminates abruptly, producing an "unnecessary critical" surface. We demonstrate our results using a microscopic model of non-interacting fermions with a spatially embedded Thouless pump. We study its phase diagram comprehensively and establish its stability to arbitrary perturbations, including interactions, in the vicinity of the critical regions. For systems in arbitrary spatial dimensions and global symmetries, we present a framework to systematically classify diabolical textures using Kitaev's $Ω$ spectrum conjecture.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“present a framework”“Kitaev’s Ω spectrum conjecture”等理论分类与构造方法，未涉及实验或数值计算细节。；研究对象：非均匀系统中的拓扑现象，具体为通过绝热空间嵌入参数化量子态族（如电荷泵及其推广）形成的“diabolical textures”（魔鬼纹理）所保护的拓扑态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 每一类拓扑不同的“diabolical textures”对应不同的有能隙态，这些态被“阱标度”临界点分隔；当纹理空间变化足够快时，临界线突然终止，形成“非必要临界”表面。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：每一类拓扑不同的“diabolical textures”对应不同的有能隙态，这些态被“阱标度”临界点分隔；当纹理空间变化足够快时，临界线突然终止，形成“非必要临界”表面。；创新点：提出了一类由“diabolical textures”保护的全新拓扑现象，并建立了其分类框架与临界行为特征，特别是发现了“非必要临界”表面这一新现象。
papers.method_zh: 采用非相互作用费米子的微观模型，其中空间嵌入Thouless泵，通过全面研究其相图，并在临界区域附近论证其对任意微扰（包括相互作用）的稳定性；同时利用Kitaev的Ω谱猜想构建了任意空间维度和全局对称性下系统的分类框架。

papers.title: Richardson-Gaudin states of non-zero seniority III: The Perfect-Pairing limit
papers.abstract: Strongly correlated electrons can be treated with a configuration interaction of Slater determinants grouped by number of unpaired electrons with exponential cost. The first two papers in this series demonstrated that single reference methods built from Richardson-Gaudin states gave results of similar quality at polynomial cost. In this contribution, the states are simplified substantially yielding the perfect-pairing state as a reference along with its low-lying excitations. The states are much simpler, the computational cost is substantially reduced, and there is no sacrifice in numerical accuracy. Second-order Epstein-Nesbet perturbative corrections for the valence electrons are similar in quality to the complete active space self-consistent field.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：configuration interaction、Richardson-Gaudin states、perturbative corrections、complete active space self-consistent field。；研究对象：强关联电子体系，具体关注基于Richardson-Gaudin态构建的完美配对（Perfect-Pairing）极限下的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在完美配对极限下，Richardson-Gaudin态可大幅简化为完美配对参考态及其低激发态，计算成本显著降低且数值精度不损失；其二阶Epstein-Nesbet微扰修正对价电子的描述质量与完全活性空间自洽场（CASSCF）相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在完美配对极限下，Richardson-Gaudin态可大幅简化为完美配对参考态及其低激发态，计算成本显著降低且数值精度不损失；其二阶Epstein-Nesbet微扰修正对价电子的描述质量与完全活性空间自洽场（CASSCF）相当。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与数值计算：采用Richardson-Gaudin态构建单参考方法，在完美配对极限下简化态结构，并应用二阶Epstein-Nesbet微扰理论进行价电子修正。

papers.title: Can dents and gouges compromise the structural integrity of hydrogen transport pipelines?
papers.abstract: Repurposing natural gas pipelines for hydrogen transport requires understanding how external defects, like dents and gouges, affect structural integrity under H$_2$ exposure. To address this, we combine experiments with a new hydrogen embrittlement model aimed at large plastic straining scenarios, which integrates: (i) multi-trap hydrogen transport, (ii) finite-strain plasticity, and (iii) a hydrogen- and triaxiality-dependent damage law. Each constituent of the model is validated with experiments on X65 pipeline steel: (i) hydrogen permeation, (ii) full-scale pipe-indentation, and (iii) mechanical testing at different hydrogen and triaxiality levels. The validated model is used to study \textit{passive} (indent before H$_2$ exposure) and \textit{active} (indent with H$_2$) dents and gouges. Results reveal that hydrogen does not significantly increase the damage severity of those defects, unless hydrogen egress is completely precluded at the outer surface of a pipeline that is being pressurised internally and contains a pre-existing \textit{passive} dent with a gouge.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算/理论）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combine experiments with a new hydrogen embrittlement model”，并分别对模型各组成部分进行了实验验证。；研究对象：X65管线钢在氢气环境下的结构完整性，具体研究外部缺陷（dent凹痕和gouge沟槽）对氢气输送管道的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 氢气暴露并不会显著增加凹痕和沟槽缺陷的损伤严重程度，除非在内部加压且外表面完全阻止氢气逸出的情况下，预先存在的被动凹痕（含沟槽）才会因氢气而加剧损伤。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：氢气暴露并不会显著增加凹痕和沟槽缺陷的损伤严重程度，除非在内部加压且外表面完全阻止氢气逸出的情况下，预先存在的被动凹痕（含沟槽）才会因氢气而加剧损伤。；创新点：提出了一个专门针对大塑性应变场景的氢脆模型，并首次将被动（先压痕后暴露于氢）与主动（在氢环境中压痕）两种缺陷形成方式下的管道结构完整性进行系统对比研究。
papers.method_zh: 实验方面：氢渗透实验、全尺寸管道压痕实验、不同氢浓度和应力三轴度下的力学测试。理论/计算方面：针对大塑性应变场景开发的新型氢脆模型，该模型整合了（i）多陷阱氢输运、（ii）有限应变塑性、（iii）氢与应力三轴度相关的损伤判据。

papers.title: (Non-)Traversable Quantum Phase Transitions
papers.abstract: Quantum phase transitions manifest as an abrupt change in the ground state of a many-body system; yet it is an open question whether this sudden change necessarily precludes a continuous dynamical connection between the two phases. We introduce a classification of quantum phase transitions based on this geometric aspect of the ground-state manifold, that differs from known classifications. By leveraging the framework of counterdiabatic driving, we explicitly construct schedules that dynamically connect one phase to another. This strategy allows us to uncover a large class of quantum phase transitions, where the states on both sides are separated only by a finite geometric distance in the thermodynamic limit. We term such transitions traversable, since exact counterdiabatic driving links the two phases via a finite dynamical protocol in the thermodynamic limit. We show that multiple known transitions fall into this class -- e.g., symmetry-breaking transitions obeying hyperscaling and discontinuous transitions with an enhanced continuous symmetry. We further show the existence of quantum phase transitions that cannot be crossed dynamically even with the help of nonlocal counterdiabatic driving, as they would require divergent amplitudes and frequencies. Geometrically, these nontraversable transitions correspond to an infinite distance separating the two phases of matter; we show that the class comprises continuous transitions exhibiting mean-field universality, and discontinuous transitions arising from the competition between metastable minima. Our geometric classification goes beyond the known taxonomy, is independent of local order parameters and renormalization group fixed points, and has direct implications for the complexity of state preparation and adiabatic quantum computation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“引入分类”、“利用框架”、“构造协议”、“展示存在”等理论推导与分类方法，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：量子相变（Quantum Phase Transitions），特别是从基态流形的几何角度对量子相变进行分类，研究其是否可被动态穿越。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现量子相变可根据基态流形在热力学极限下的几何距离分为“可穿越”与“不可穿越”两类：可穿越相变可通过精确的反向绝热驱动在有限动力学协议下连接两相；不可穿越相变即使借助非局域反向绝热驱动也无法动态跨越，因为需要发散振幅和频率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现量子相变可根据基态流形在热力学极限下的几何距离分为“可穿越”与“不可穿越”两类：可穿越相变可通过精确的反向绝热驱动在有限动力学协议下连接两相；不可穿越相变即使借助非局域反向绝热驱动也无法动态跨越，因为需要发散振幅和频率。；创新点：提出一种独立于局域序参量和重整化群不动点的几何分类方法，超越了已知的量子相变分类体系，并直接关联到态制备复杂度与绝热量子计算。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 利用反向绝热驱动（counterdiabatic driving）框架，显式构造连接不同相的动力学协议，并基于基态流形的几何距离（有限或无限）对量子相变进行分类。

papers.title: Multi-point functions of a full-plane two-state fuzzy $4$-Potts model
papers.abstract: We study the full-plane two-state fuzzy $4$-Potts model, obtained by assigning independent balanced $\{\pm1\}$ spins to the open clusters of a critical $q=4$ random-cluster configuration. This model corresponds exactly to the single-spin projection of the isotropic Ashkin-Teller model at its Potts point. We prove that, after proper normalization, all even multi-point spin correlation functions converge to explicit conformally covariant Coulomb-gas type neutral charge sums. As a consequence, we prove convergence in law of the rescaled magnetization field and identify the moments of the limiting field. The proof combines the Baxter-Kelland-Wu coupling, convergence of the six-vertex height function to the Gaussian free field, and a charge-completion mechanism: an enlarged discrete sum over charge assignments with total charge in $4\mathbb Z$ produces a combinatorial cancellation of connection patterns, while only the neutral charge sector survives in the scaling limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：prove（证明）、convergence（收敛）、Coulomb-gas type（库仑气体类型）、scaling limit（标度极限）。；研究对象：全平面两态模糊4-态Potts模型（full-plane two-state fuzzy 4-Potts model），该模型通过给临界q=4随机团簇构型的开放团簇分配独立平衡的{±1}自旋得到，等价于各向同性Ashkin-Teller模型在Potts点的单自旋投影。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经过适当归一化后，所有偶数点自旋关联函数收敛到显式的共形协变库仑气体型中性电荷和；由此证明了重整化磁化场在分布意义下的收敛性，并识别了极限场的矩。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经过适当归一化后，所有偶数点自旋关联函数收敛到显式的共形协变库仑气体型中性电荷和；由此证明了重整化磁化场在分布意义下的收敛性，并识别了极限场的矩。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 结合Baxter-Kelland-Wu耦合、六顶点高度函数到高斯自由场的收敛性，以及一种“电荷完备机制”：对总电荷为4ℤ的电荷分配进行扩大的离散求和，产生连接模式的组合对消，而只有中性电荷扇区在标度极限下存活。

papers.title: Optimisation and Precision Tuning of Localised Surface Plasmon Resonance in AuFON Systems
papers.abstract: Metal film on nanosphere (MFON) plasmonic systems have emerged as nanostructures with useful properties for molecular detection. This work presents the optimisation and discussion of the characterisation results of Au-film on nanosphere (AuFON) systems. Through experiments and numerical simulations, the resonance energies of localised surface plasmon modes and the spatial distribution of light on the nanostructured surface were identified. The results highlight the dependence of these modes on changes in nanostructure dimensions and the optical conditions of the incident radiation, thereby optimising the amplification of optical signals for applications in molecular detection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与数值模拟结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“通过实验和数值模拟”（experiments and numerical simulations）。；研究对象：Au膜覆盖纳米球（AuFON）系统中的局域表面等离激元共振（LSPR）特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: AuFON系统的局域表面等离激元共振能量和光场空间分布强烈依赖于纳米结构尺寸和入射光光学条件，通过优化这些参数可增强分子检测中的光学信号放大。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：AuFON系统的局域表面等离激元共振能量和光场空间分布强烈依赖于纳米结构尺寸和入射光光学条件，通过优化这些参数可增强分子检测中的光学信号放大。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验制备Au膜覆盖纳米球（AuFON）系统并进行表征；同时采用数值模拟计算局域表面等离激元模式的共振能量和光场分布。

papers.title: $q$-Exponential Random Graphs: higher-order networks from simple constraints
papers.abstract: Exponential Random Graphs (ERGs) are among the most widely used network models, derived as principled least-bias graph ensembles that maximize Shannon entropy under constraints on the expected values of given structural properties. However, it has been recently (re)discovered that, in the absence of additional information privileging Shannon entropy, the most agnostic inferential construction should maximize the broader class of Uffink entropies. The resulting entropy-maximizing distribution changes from the exponential (Boltzmann-Gibbs) to the so-called q-exponential one. Since maximizing Shannon entropy may produce an unjustified independence between degrees of freedom, here we investigate how the most popular ERGs with independent edges (namely, the Erdos-Renyi and configuration models) generalize to higher-order q-Exponential Random Graphs with dependent edges in the non-Shannon case, while keeping their defining constraints (number of links and degree sequence, respectively) unchanged. We find features, such as a phase transition between sparse and dense regimes, that are absent in the original ERGs but typical of higher-order networks, plus novel phenomena such as richer assortativity and clustering profiles, which allow for the coexistence of link sparsity and triadic closure. These results show that higher-order networks do not necessarily require higher-order constraints, as they naturally arise from simpler ones in a framework that is even more agnostic than Shannon's.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：entropy-maximizing distribution、inferential construction、phase transition。；研究对象：网络模型，具体为q-指数随机图（q-Exponential Random Graphs），属于高阶网络（higher-order networks）的统计物理模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非香农熵（Uffink熵）最大化框架下，仅通过保持与经典ERGs相同的简单约束（如链接数、度序列），即可自然产生高阶网络特征，包括稀疏-密集相变、更丰富的同配性和聚类特性，以及链接稀疏性与三角闭合的共存。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非香农熵（Uffink熵）最大化框架下，仅通过保持与经典ERGs相同的简单约束（如链接数、度序列），即可自然产生高阶网络特征，包括稀疏-密集相变、更丰富的同配性和聚类特性，以及链接稀疏性与三角闭合的共存。；创新点：揭示了高阶网络特征（如相变、聚类）并不必然需要高阶约束（如三角形计数），而是可以从更简单的约束在比香农熵更无偏的框架下自然涌现。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导与模型分析。基于Uffink熵最大化原则，将经典的指数型（Boltzmann-Gibbs）随机图推广为q-指数型随机图，并分析其在保持Erdos-Renyi模型和配置模型约束下的统计性质。

papers.title: Rigorous extension of semilocal collinear functionals to noncollinear DFT using $SU(2)$ rotations
papers.abstract: In the presence of spin-orbit coupling and in geometrically frustrated materials, a noncollinear treatment the magnetization density is essential. However, in density functional theory most exchange--correlation functional approximations were originally developed for locally collinear magnetization. Many practical approaches to noncollinear DFT have emerged over the past decade. However, a first-principles connection between widely used semilocal collinear functionals and their noncollinear generalizations remains lacking. In this work, a locally exact relation between collinear and noncollinear exchange--correlation functionals is derived at the level of gradient expansions within a $u(2)$ matrix representation of the energy functional. Within this framework, collinear semilocal variables naturally acquire distinct dependencies on transverse and longitudinal magnetization gradient components. The widely used Scalmani--Frisch scheme emerges as a first-order approximation. The transformation of collinear functional derivatives to noncollinear space is implemented through numerically robust $SU(2)$ rotations. A consistent description of local magnetic torques is demonstrated for the prototypical spin-frustrated Cr$_3$ cluster. The approach further extends to fully nonlocal functionals and provides a direct route towards numerically stable relativistic response calculations.
