The influence on magnetic properties in presence of spin-orbit coupling is illustrated through calculations of hyperfine couplings in the high-spin ground states of uranium and the uranium ion.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：density functional theory（密度泛函理论）、$SU(2)$ rotations（$SU(2)$旋转）、gradient expansions（梯度展开）。；研究对象：非共线磁化密度体系，包括存在自旋-轨道耦合的材料和几何阻挫材料，具体以自旋阻挫Cr₃团簇、铀及铀离子的高自旋基态为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出半局域共线交换关联泛函到非共线泛函的局域精确关系，证明广泛使用的Scalmani-Frisch方案是该关系的一阶近似，并通过$SU(2)$旋转实现了共线泛函导数到非共线空间的数值稳定变换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出半局域共线交换关联泛函到非共线泛函的局域精确关系，证明广泛使用的Scalmani-Frisch方案是该关系的一阶近似，并通过$SU(2)$旋转实现了共线泛函导数到非共线空间的数值稳定变换。；创新点：首次在梯度展开层次上建立了半局域共线泛函与其非共线推广之间的第一性原理精确关系，并提供了数值稳定的$SU(2)$旋转实现方案。
papers.method_zh: 基于$u(2)$矩阵表示的能量泛函梯度展开框架，利用$SU(2)$旋转实现共线泛函导数的非共线空间变换，并通过Cr₃团簇的局域磁矩计算和铀/铀离子的超精细耦合计算验证方法。

papers.title: Explicit Turn Resolution with Anisotropic Homogenisation for Efficient 3D Magneto-Thermal Finite-Element Simulation of Large-Scale No-Insulation HTS Magnets
papers.abstract: No-insulation (NI) and metal-insulation (MI) high-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets require three-dimensional (3D) models to describe the current distribution around critical current defects. In this work, we design and validate the EXTRA homogenisation method, standing for explicit turn resolution with anisotropic homogenisation method. It allows 3D magneto-thermal finite-element (FE) simulations of large-scale magnets to be performed with high accuracy at a reasonable computational cost. The method combines the anisotropic homogenisation of turn-to-turn contact layers (T2TCLs) and their neighbouring winding turns with the explicit resolution of specific T2TCLs. In particular, the inner- and outermost winding turns and adjacent contact layers are explicitly resolved to properly describe the current distribution near current leads. In addition, the method is able to simulate local $J_{\textrm{c}}$ defects for a broad range of turn-to-turn contact resistances, provided the winding turns and T2TCLs next to the defect are explicitly resolved. For efficiency, the resolved T2TCLs are modelled using the surface contact approximation. The consistency of the proposed method is first verified on a 50-turn single pancake benchmark. It is shown to reproduce AC losses and temperature distributions obtained with a turn-resolved FE reference model, for both nominal operation and during thermal runaway. The computational efficiency of the EXTRA method is demonstrated with the simulation of a stack of three 150-turn pancake coils, for which computation time is reduced by a factor of up to 13 with respect to a turn-resolved FE reference model. Finally, the results of a large-scale 3D FE simulation, currently out of reach of turn-resolved models, are provided for an insert HTS magnet with 10,000 turns. The EXTRA method is open-source and input files to reproduce all results are made available.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：finite-element simulation、homogenisation method、computational cost。；研究对象：无绝缘（NI）和金属绝缘（MI）高温超导（HTS）磁体中的三维磁热有限元模拟。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出并验证了EXTRA均匀化方法，能够在合理计算成本下对大规模（如10,000匝）HTS磁体进行高精度三维磁热有限元模拟，计算速度相比匝解析模型最高提升13倍。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出并验证了EXTRA均匀化方法，能够在合理计算成本下对大规模（如10,000匝）HTS磁体进行高精度三维磁热有限元模拟，计算速度相比匝解析模型最高提升13倍。；创新点：首次将各向异性均匀化与局部显式匝解析相结合，在保持高精度的同时大幅降低大规模HTS磁体三维模拟的计算成本，并开源了所有代码和输入文件。
papers.method_zh: 采用显式匝解析与各向异性均匀化相结合的有限元方法（EXTRA方法）。具体包括：对匝间接触层（T2TCLs）及其相邻绕组匝进行各向异性均匀化，同时对特定匝间接触层（如最内/外层绕组匝及邻近接触层、局部Jc缺陷附近匝层）进行显式解析，并使用表面接触近似建模解析的匝间接触层。

papers.title: Eigenstate chaos in the presence of non-Abelian symmetries
papers.abstract: The eigenstate thermalization hypothesis (ETH) posits that energy eigenstates encode local properties of the microcanonical ensemble. Motivated by recent interest in the physics of non-commuting conserved charges and the non-Abelian ETH, we study chaotic eigenstates in the presence of symmetries described by general compact Lie groups, such as SU(2). By applying non-Abelian symmetry resolution, we develop a non-Abelian microcanonical entropy and relate this entropy to the entanglement entropy of chaotic eigenstates. We find that microcanonical entropy is closely related to the symmetry-resolved entanglement entropy, which differs from conventional entanglement entropy by a universal logarithmic correction. Our results depend on the global Casimir charge, e.g. total spin. At finite charge density, we find a logarithmic enhancement to conventional entanglement entropy. At zero density, we find no such correction to entanglement entropy, but a logarithmic reduction to microcanonical entropy and symmetry-resolved entanglement entropy. We discuss the implications of our approach for non-Abelian eigenstate thermalization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：posits、develop、relate、discuss（理论推导与概念构建）。；研究对象：具有非阿贝尔对称性（如SU(2)群）的混沌量子本征态，具体涉及非对易守恒荷（如总自旋）下的本征态热化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在非阿贝尔对称性存在时，微正则熵与对称性分辨的纠缠熵密切相关，且两者相对于传统纠缠熵存在普适的对数修正：有限电荷密度下传统纠缠熵出现对数增强，零电荷密度下微正则熵和对称性分辨纠缠熵出现对数减少。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在非阿贝尔对称性存在时，微正则熵与对称性分辨的纠缠熵密切相关，且两者相对于传统纠缠熵存在普适的对数修正：有限电荷密度下传统纠缠熵出现对数增强，零电荷密度下微正则熵和对称性分辨纠缠熵出现对数减少。；创新点：首次将非阿贝尔对称性分辨方法系统应用于混沌本征态热化问题，揭示了微正则熵与对称性分辨纠缠熵之间的普适对数修正关系，并区分了有限与零电荷密度下的不同行为。
papers.method_zh: 通过非阿贝尔对称性分辨技术，将微正则系综推广到非阿贝尔情形，定义非阿贝尔微正则熵，并将其与混沌本征态的纠缠熵建立解析联系，分析全局卡西米尔荷（如总自旋）的影响。

papers.title: Geometric dependence of critical-current variation in Al/AlO${\rm _x}$/Al Josephson junctions: a model-based analysis
papers.abstract: Achieving uniform critical current across Josephson junctions is essential for the large-scale integration of superconducting quantum circuits. In this work, we statistically analyzed the variation of the critical current of Al/AlO${\rm _x}$/Al junctions using room-temperature tunnel resistance statistics, and identified the dominant contribution among the modeled sources of the variation based on their dependence on geometry and deposition conditions of junctions. Our model-based analysis reveals that fluctuations in the Al film thickness play the dominant role among the modeled contributing factors. Based on this analysis, we found that, in Dolan-bridge double-angle deposition, adopting a deposition angle of 30-degree for bilayer junctions significantly improves uniformity, yielding a relative standard deviation of 1.2% (0.5%) across a 9.75 mm (1.5 mm) square region.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：statistically analyzed、room-temperature tunnel resistance statistics、model-based analysis）；研究对象：Al/AlOₓ/Al 约瑟夫森结中临界电流的几何依赖性变化
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 Al/AlOₓ/Al 约瑟夫森结中，铝膜厚度波动是导致临界电流变化的主导因素；采用 30 度沉积角的 Dolan-bridge 双层沉积工艺可显著提高临界电流均匀性，在 9.75 mm 和 1.5 mm 方形区域内相对标准偏差分别降至 1.2% 和 0.5%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 Al/AlOₓ/Al 约瑟夫森结中，铝膜厚度波动是导致临界电流变化的主导因素；采用 30 度沉积角的 Dolan-bridge 双层沉积工艺可显著提高临界电流均匀性，在 9.75 mm 和 1.5 mm 方形区域内相对标准偏差分别降至 1.2% 和 0.5%。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于室温隧道电阻统计数据进行统计分析，并结合模型分析，研究临界电流变化对结几何形状和沉积条件的依赖关系。

papers.title: A mathematical framework for dynamic emergent constraints in climate science
papers.abstract: Emergent constraints in climate science are empirical relations that link the response to a forcing of a physical observable to the properties of other observables, with the aim of reducing climate change projection uncertainties. Here we use recent results in linear response theory to develop a mathematical framework for dynamic emergent constraints, a class of emergent constraints linking the response of different observables to the same forcing. We show how traditional dynamic emergent constraints are a special case of more general relations, that we call integral dynamic emergent constraints. These relations allow to compute the response of a predictand as the convolution of the response of a predictor and the proxy Green's function of the predictand-predictor pair. The conditions for the existence of integral emergent constraints are related to the causality of the proxy Green's function and the time scales at which the system is observed. We apply this framework to global warming simulations with the MPI-ESM climate model, to study dynamic emergent constraints between different observables. These results allow to put the theory of dynamic emergent constraints on firm mathematical ground, and suggest a protocol to identify necessary conditions for the existence of such relations in climate data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：mathematical framework, linear response theory, theoretical framework）；研究对象：气候科学中的动态涌现约束（Dynamic Emergent Constraints），具体应用于全球变暖模拟（MPI-ESM气候模型）中不同可观测物理量之间的响应关系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 传统动态涌现约束是更一般的“积分动态涌现约束”的特例。后者允许通过预测因子的响应与预测因子-预测对象对的代理格林函数进行卷积，来计算预测对象的响应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：传统动态涌现约束是更一般的“积分动态涌现约束”的特例。后者允许通过预测因子的响应与预测因子-预测对象对的代理格林函数进行卷积，来计算预测对象的响应。；创新点：将动态涌现约束理论置于坚实的数学基础之上，提出了更普适的“积分动态涌现约束”概念，并给出了识别气候数据中存在此类关系的必要条件的协议。
papers.method_zh: 基于线性响应理论（linear response theory）构建数学框架，推导出积分动态涌现约束的数学形式，并将其应用于MPI-ESM气候模型的全球变暖模拟数据中，以验证该框架。

papers.title: Search at bounded speed with immigration
papers.abstract: Many biophysical search processes employ searchers which enter or "immigrate" into the domain progressively over time. Existing search time estimates can become unphysical for fast immigration since they imply that searchers move at infinite speed. In this paper, we investigate search times of immigrating searchers that move at bounded speed. In the fast immigration limit, we determine the full probability distribution and all the moments of the $k$th search time in terms of the early time probability distribution of a single searcher. We apply these rigorous mathematical results to several canonical models of stochastic search. We further analyze different models of "diffusion" and use these results to investigate when and how the minutiae of searcher dynamics affect search times. We compare our theory to numerical simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：investigate、determine、apply rigorous mathematical results、compare to numerical simulations）；研究对象：生物物理搜索过程中，以有限速度移动且随时间逐步进入（“移民”）搜索域的搜索者，其搜索时间问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在快速移民极限下，第k次搜索时间的完整概率分布及其所有矩可由单个搜索者的早期时间概率分布完全确定；不同“扩散”模型对搜索时间的影响取决于搜索者动力学的细节。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在快速移民极限下，第k次搜索时间的完整概率分布及其所有矩可由单个搜索者的早期时间概率分布完全确定；不同“扩散”模型对搜索时间的影响取决于搜索者动力学的细节。；创新点：首次在搜索者以有限速度移动（而非无限速度）的条件下，系统研究了移民过程对搜索时间的影响，并给出了快速移民极限下的精确解析结果。
papers.method_zh: 采用严格数学推导（概率分布与矩的解析求解），并结合数值模拟进行验证；应用于多个随机搜索的经典模型，并分析不同扩散模型。

papers.title: Dually tunable YBCO coplanar waveguide resonators based on helium-ion-generated Josephson inductances
papers.abstract: Superconducting microwave circuits with and without Josephson inductances are the Swiss Army knife for many experiments and technologies from quantum information science to astrophysical particle detectors. Despite a large variety of existing circuit types, thin film materials and Josephson junction technologies, a flexible and reliable platform for high-magnetic-field and high-temperature applications is yet to be found. In this manuscript, we investigate coplanar waveguide cavities made of the high-temperature cuprate superconductor YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_7$ (YBCO), integrated with Josephson inductances and quantum interferometers that are generated by the controlled local irradiation of the YBCO with a focused helium ion beam. We obtain strongly flux-tunable microwave resonators, which not only display periodic interferometer oscillations of resonance frequency and decay rate, but also a superimposed Fraunhofer-like modulation pattern. The latter originates from the magnetic field tuning of the individual Josephson junction critical currents due to the out-of-plane junction barriers. It allows adjusting resonance frequency and flux responsivity independently of each other, potentially enabling tunable microwave circuits with low sensitivity to external magnetic-field noise over a broad range of frequencies. Finally, we investigate the temperature dependence of the cavities, show that they have promising characteristics up to 14$\,$K, and present a model for the junction-induced cavity losses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的器件制备（聚焦氦离子束辐照YBCO）、测量（微波谐振、磁场调谐、温度依赖）和建模（结诱导损耗模型）。；研究对象：基于高温铜氧化物超导体YBa₂Cu₃O₇（YBCO）的共面波导谐振腔，集成了由聚焦氦离子束辐照产生的约瑟夫森电感和量子干涉仪。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实现了强磁通可调的微波谐振器，不仅观察到谐振频率和衰减率的周期性干涉仪振荡，还发现了叠加的类夫琅禾费调制图案，该图案源于面外结势垒对单个约瑟夫森结临界电流的磁场调谐，从而允许独立调节谐振频率和磁通响应度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实现了强磁通可调的微波谐振器，不仅观察到谐振频率和衰减率的周期性干涉仪振荡，还发现了叠加的类夫琅禾费调制图案，该图案源于面外结势垒对单个约瑟夫森结临界电流的磁场调谐，从而允许独立调节谐振频率和磁通响应度。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：聚焦氦离子束局部辐照YBCO薄膜以生成约瑟夫森结；低温微波测量（温度最高至14 K）；磁场调谐实验。理论框架：建立了结诱导腔损耗的模型。

papers.title: Experiments on Settling of Granular and Cohesive Material in Low Gravity
papers.abstract: The regolith of rocky bodies, such as planets or asteroids, generally settles under gravity conditions different from those of Earth. The behavior of granular material is not easily scalable for different gravities. To predict these highly complex systems where cohesive inter particle forces can be comparable to gravitational forces, we need simulations and experiments. We did experiments on settling of three different granular samples in varying reduced gravities and examined their packing densities. We used a high precision linear stage to artificially induce reduced gravities inside the zero $g$ environment provided by the ZARM drop tower and observe the settling of our samples. The three samples were fine basalt with particle diameters of $1\text{-}200\,μ$m, coarse basalt with $2\text{-}5\,$mm and glass beads with $750\text{-}1000\,μ$m. The artificial gravities were $150,\,250,\,500,\,750$ and $1000\,$mm/s$^2$ and therefore ranged from large asteroid gravity to almost moon gravity. We saw the granular samples have higher volumes in lower gravities and therefore lower packing densities, we also saw the fine basalt be the most sensitive to changes in gravity, up to $+19.6\,\%$ in volume for $250\,$mm/s$^2$, followed by the coarse basalt particles, up to $+12.2\,\%$ for $150\,$mm/s$^2$ and the glass beads packing density being the least sensitive to changes in gravity, up to $+4.25\,\%$ for $250\,$mm/s$^2$. With these experiments we show change in volume is not solely dependent of particle size but also roughness and uniformity, we provide real life experimental data to validate theoretical works and highlight the role of cohesive forces in low gravity environments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要明确描述“We did experiments on settling of three different granular samples”，并详细说明实验装置（ZARM drop tower、高精度线性平台）和测量结果（packing densities）。；研究对象：颗粒物质（granular material）和粘性材料（cohesive material）在低重力环境下的沉降行为。具体样品包括：细玄武岩（1–200 μm）、粗玄武岩（2–5 mm）和玻璃珠（750–1000 μm）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在低重力下，颗粒样品的体积增大、堆积密度降低；细玄武岩对重力变化最敏感（在250 mm/s²下体积增加+19.6%），玻璃珠最不敏感（在250 mm/s²下体积增加+4.25%）。体积变化不仅取决于颗粒大小，还与粗糙度和均匀性有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在低重力下，颗粒样品的体积增大、堆积密度降低；细玄武岩对重力变化最敏感（在250 mm/s²下体积增加+19.6%），玻璃珠最不敏感（在250 mm/s²下体积增加+4.25%）。体积变化不仅取决于颗粒大小，还与粗糙度和均匀性有关。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用ZARM落塔提供的零重力环境，结合高精度线性平台人工诱导不同减重力（150、250、500、750、1000 mm/s²），观测三种颗粒样品的沉降过程并测量其堆积密度。

papers.title: Emerging Trends in Intelligent Sensing
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of artificial intelligence, connected devices, and high speed mobile networks is driving unprecedented computational demands that challenge traditional sensor architectures. This article explores the shift toward edge computing, where computation is performed directly at the data source, and highlights the key architectures and performance metrics that may define the next generation of intelligent sensor systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述/展望文章）。判断依据：摘要中使用了“explores”、“highlights”等词汇，旨在探讨趋势和架构，而非报告具体的实验或计算结果。；研究对象：智能传感器系统，特别是面向边缘计算的新一代传感器架构。摘要未明确说明具体的材料或物理体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现。文章主要指出，人工智能、互联设备及高速移动网络的快速发展对传统传感器架构提出了挑战，并探讨了向边缘计算（即在数据源处直接进行计算）转变的趋势。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体的物理结论或发现。文章主要指出，人工智能、互联设备及高速移动网络的快速发展对传统传感器架构提出了挑战，并探讨了向边缘计算（即在数据源处直接进行计算）转变的趋势。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。文章的主要贡献可能在于系统性地梳理了智能传感领域向边缘计算发展的关键架构与性能指标。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的研究方法。文章可能采用了文献综述、架构分析与性能指标对比等宏观分析方法。

papers.title: Visualizing orbital magnetism in electron doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene
papers.abstract: Electron doped rhombohedral multilayer graphene at high displacement field features an exceptionally flat band minimum with near-ideal quantum geometry. Experiments in this regime observe the formation of a 'quarter metal,' in which the electron liquid condenses into a single spin- and valley flavor. Remarkably, recent experiments have found a zero resistance state in the same region of the density- and displacement-field-tuned parameter space, attributed to the formation of a chiral superconductor characterized by a finite-momentum Cooper pair condensate. Here, we use nanoSQUID-on-tip magnetometry to map the orbital magnetization of electron-doped rhombohedral graphene devices ranging in thickness between 3 and 13 layers. Magnetization within the quarter metal phases peaks at finite density, consistent with concentration of the Berry curvature in a finite-momentum 'ring of fire'. Correlating transport and local magnetometry data in a tetralayer sample reveals that the superconducting state has a finite orbital magnetic moment, providing direct evidence of its chiral nature. We further show that widely observed stochastic switching of the resistivity in the metallic regime arises from a density-tuned sign change in the valley-resolved total magnetic moment. This leads to the formation of metastable magnetic domains under typical gate control sequences and can also be harnessed for electric-field controlled switching of orbital moment across the entire device. Unexpectedly, we find magnetic inhomogeneity specific to the apparent normal state of the chiral superconductor, suggestive of a strain-tuned competition between magnetic and non-magnetic ground states. Our results point to a subtle energetic competition underlying the observation of chiral superconductivity in a narrow range of layer numbers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了 nanoSQUID-on-tip magnetometry（纳米SQUID针尖磁力测量）等实验手段，并进行了输运与局域磁测量数据的关联分析。；研究对象：电子掺杂的菱面体多层石墨烯（rhombohedral multilayer graphene），层数在3到13层之间。具体研究了该体系在强位移场下的轨道磁性（orbital magnetism）、四分之一金属态（quarter metal）以及手性超导态（chiral superconductor）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过直接测量，证实了四分之一金属态中的轨道磁化强度在有限密度处达到峰值，并首次提供了超导态具有有限轨道磁矩的直接实验证据，证明了其手性本质。此外，揭示了金属态中电阻随机开关现象源于密度调控的谷分辨总磁矩符号变化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过直接测量，证实了四分之一金属态中的轨道磁化强度在有限密度处达到峰值，并首次提供了超导态具有有限轨道磁矩的直接实验证据，证明了其手性本质。此外，揭示了金属态中电阻随机开关现象源于密度调控的谷分辨总磁矩符号变化。；创新点：1. 首次直接观测并成像了菱面体多层石墨烯中四分之一金属态的轨道磁化分布，验证了其与有限动量“火环”（ring of fire）贝里曲率分布的关联。2. 通过直接测量超导态的轨道磁矩，为手性超导的存在提供了最直接的实验证据。3. 揭示了电阻随机开关现象与谷磁矩符号变化及亚稳态磁畴形成之间的物理联系。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段为纳米SQUID针尖磁力测量（nanoSQUID-on-tip magnetometry），用于直接映射样品的轨道磁化。同时，结合了输运测量（transport）和局域磁测量数据（local magnetometry data）进行关联分析。

papers.title: Electron Doping of $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ Thin Films: Candidate Metal Dopants and Their Potential Impact on Superconductivity
papers.abstract: The bilayer Ruddlesden-Popper nickelate $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ has emerged as a promising platform for exploring and understanding high-temperature superconductivities. While most prior doping studies have focused on hole doping via strontium (Sr) substitution or by tuning oxygen content, electron doping remains largely unexplored. In this work,we systematically investigate electron doping in $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ thin films through tetravalent element substitution, employing first-principles density functional theory calculations. Our results reveal that, unlike in cuprates, $\mathrm{cerium}$ (Ce) doping is difficult to effectively introduce electron carriers into the low-energy bands. In contrast, zirconium (Zr), hafnium (Hf), and thorium (Th) can act as efficient electron dopants. These element substitutions can significantly increase the interlayer hopping $t_{\perp}$ between $d_{z^2}$ orbitals, which may lead to enhanced superexchange coupling $J_{\perp}$ , and thereby potentially elevated superconducting $T_c$. We evaluate the interaction parameters using constrained random phase approximation. Our results identify candidate dopants for achieving electron-doped $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$, offering a route to clarify the ongoing debate on pairing mechanisms in this system.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles density functional theory calculations”（第一性原理密度泛函理论计算）和“constrained random phase approximation”（约束随机相位近似）。；研究对象：电子掺杂的双层Ruddlesden-Popper镍氧化物薄膜 $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$。具体研究通过四价元素（如Ce、Zr、Hf、Th）替代进行电子掺杂的可能性及其对超导电性的潜在影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ 中，铈（Ce）掺杂难以有效引入电子载流子，而锆（Zr）、铪（Hf）和钍（Th）是高效的电子掺杂剂。这些掺杂能显著增强 $d_{z^2}$ 轨道间的层间跳跃 $t_{\perp}$，可能提升超交换耦合 $J_{\perp}$，从而有望提高超导转变温度 $T_c$。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ 中，铈（Ce）掺杂难以有效引入电子载流子，而锆（Zr）、铪（Hf）和钍（Th）是高效的电子掺杂剂。这些掺杂能显著增强 $d_{z^2}$ 轨道间的层间跳跃 $t_{\perp}$，可能提升超交换耦合 $J_{\perp}$，从而有望提高超导转变温度 $T_c$。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但相对于以往主要关注空穴掺杂（如Sr替代或调控氧含量）的研究，本工作首次系统探索了 $\mathrm{La_3Ni_2O_7}$ 薄膜中的电子掺杂，并识别出有效的电子掺杂候选元素。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，并结合约束随机相位近似（cRPA）评估相互作用参数。

papers.title: Spectroscopic evidence for a molecular orbital Kondo insulator
papers.abstract: A Kondo insulator (KI) is a prototypical example of a highly entangled phase of matter, where many-body interactions between local moments and delocalized electrons engender the non-magnetic insulating ground state. Conventionally, the local moments arise from atomic multiplet states with a narrow bandwidth, limiting Kondo coherence to low temperatures. Here, we realize a new paradigm for constructing the KI state with hybridized molecular orbitals in FeSb2. Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS) at the Fe L-edge reveals distinct signatures of band-like continuum states and localized states. Comparisons with first-principles calculations establish a mixed-configuration ground state with hybridized Fe d-Sb p molecular orbitals as basis states. By systematically investigating the RIXS momentum, temperature, and doping dependences, we find propagating collective modes commensurate with many-body charge and spin excitations. Our results pave the way for understanding the emerging class of unconventional d electron insulators and engineering high temperature Kondo many-body states.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Resonant inelastic X-ray scattering (RIXS)、spectroscopic evidence、momentum/temperature/doping dependences）；研究对象：FeSb₂ 中由杂化分子轨道构建的 Kondo 绝缘体（Kondo insulator）态，以及其中的多体电荷与自旋激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 FeSb₂ 中，通过 Fe d 与 Sb p 杂化分子轨道作为基态，实现了新型 Kondo 绝缘体态；RIXS 观测到与多体电荷和自旋激发相称的传播性集体模式。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 FeSb₂ 中，通过 Fe d 与 Sb p 杂化分子轨道作为基态，实现了新型 Kondo 绝缘体态；RIXS 观测到与多体电荷和自旋激发相称的传播性集体模式。；创新点：首次在实验上实现并证实了以杂化分子轨道（而非传统原子多重态）为基态的 Kondo 绝缘体新范式，为理解非常规 d 电子绝缘体及工程化高温 Kondo 多体态提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: Fe L 边共振非弹性 X 射线散射（RIXS），结合第一性原理计算（first-principles calculations），并系统研究了 RIXS 信号随动量、温度和掺杂的变化。

papers.title: Exploring the Origins of Anti-Ambipolarity in BBL Polymer: Links to Redox Chemistry, Electronic Structure, and Structural Dynamics
papers.abstract: We examine the intrinsic physical-chemical properties of the conjugated ladder-type polymer poly(benzimidazobenzophenanthroline) (BBL) in response to electron transfer. We aim at explaining the origin of the anti-ambipolar behavior behind the observed BBL nonlinear response associated with specific device architectures. To elucidate this point, we use theory and computation based on first principles, including density functional theory optimizations, ab initio molecular dynamics, time-dependent DFT, and Marcus-theory analysis. Our results reveal that this redox response is not simply monotonic but follows an alternating odd/even pattern in which gap narrowing and reopening occur sequentially before near-gapless behavior emerges at high charging. Converging theoretical evidence in this work demonstrates that bell shaped conductivity in BBL originates in its fundamental electronic structure and supramolecular organization.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算与理论混合型文章。关键词：first principles、density functional theory、ab initio molecular dynamics、time-dependent DFT、Marcus-theory analysis。；研究对象：共轭梯形聚合物聚苯并咪唑苯并菲咯啉（BBL）在电子转移过程中的本征物理化学性质，特别是其反双极性（anti-ambipolar）非线性响应的起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BBL的氧化还原响应并非单调，而是呈现交替奇偶模式：能隙先变窄后重新打开，最终在高电荷态下出现近无能隙行为。钟形电导率源于其基本电子结构和超分子组织。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BBL的氧化还原响应并非单调，而是呈现交替奇偶模式：能隙先变窄后重新打开，最终在高电荷态下出现近无能隙行为。钟形电导率源于其基本电子结构和超分子组织。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于第一性原理的理论与计算，包括密度泛函理论（DFT）优化、从头算分子动力学（AIMD）、含时密度泛函理论（TD-DFT）以及Marcus理论分析。

papers.title: Electronic correlations driving Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity
papers.abstract: We explicitly account for electron-electron interactions when modeling low-dimensional helical organic molecules. We show that competition between various hopping channels, together with interaction-induced double- and superexchange mechanisms, can stabilize non-collinear helical magnetic order. The resulting single-electron bands exhibit partial spin polarization, a manifestation of $p$-wave magnetism. Using density-matrix renormalization group, cluster perturbation theory, and Monte Carlo methods, we find that even vanishingly small spin-orbit coupling triggers strong spin selectivity at temperatures significantly above the spin-orbit scale. While strong correlations are essential for this mechanism, long-range spin ordering is not required. We thus propose non-collinear spin correlations driven by Coulomb interactions as an explanation of chirality-induced spin selectivity and discuss connections to experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：explicitly account for electron-electron interactions, modeling, density-matrix renormalization group, cluster perturbation theory, Monte Carlo methods）；研究对象：低维螺旋有机分子中的手性诱导自旋选择性（Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity, CISS）现象，具体关注电子关联（电子-电子相互作用）在该现象中的作用。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 电子-电子相互作用驱动的非共线螺旋磁序可以解释手性诱导自旋选择性，即使自旋-轨道耦合非常微弱，也能在远高于自旋-轨道能标的温度下产生强自旋选择性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：电子-电子相互作用驱动的非共线螺旋磁序可以解释手性诱导自旋选择性，即使自旋-轨道耦合非常微弱，也能在远高于自旋-轨道能标的温度下产生强自旋选择性。；创新点：首次明确将电子关联（特别是相互作用诱导的双交换和超交换机制）作为手性诱导自旋选择性的核心驱动力，提出非共线自旋关联（而非长程自旋序）是产生自旋选择性的关键，并指出该机制在极弱自旋-轨道耦合下仍有效。
papers.method_zh: 理论建模与数值计算：明确考虑电子-电子相互作用，利用密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG）、团簇微扰理论（Cluster Perturbation Theory）和蒙特卡洛方法（Monte Carlo）进行模拟分析。

papers.title: Induced nonlinear phase shift of forward volume spin waves in magnetic films and one-dimensional magnonic crystals
papers.abstract: A differential phase shift of a low-power spin wave (SW) induced by a high-power pumping wave co-propagating at different frequencies in perpendicularly magnetized magnetic films has been studied. We find that this effect for forward volume SWs propagating in yttrium iron garnet (YIG) films is stronger than that for surface SWs propagating in tangentially magnetized films. The results show that the induced nonlinear phase shift up to 180° takes place for pumping wave power of a few milliwatts. The phenomenon paves the way for fast and energy-efficient control of one-dimensional magnon transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/实验混合类型。判断依据：摘要中同时包含“studied”（理论研究）和实验材料“yttrium iron garnet (YIG) films”及具体功率参数（实验特征）。；研究对象：垂直磁化磁性薄膜（钇铁石榴石YIG薄膜）及一维磁子晶体中前向体自旋波的诱导非线性相移现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低功率自旋波可由共传播的高功率泵浦波诱导产生高达180°的差分相移，且该效应在垂直磁化薄膜的前向体自旋波中比切向磁化薄膜的表面自旋波更强。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低功率自旋波可由共传播的高功率泵浦波诱导产生高达180°的差分相移，且该效应在垂直磁化薄膜的前向体自旋波中比切向磁化薄膜的表面自旋波更强。；创新点：首次发现垂直磁化薄膜中前向体自旋波的非线性相移效应显著强于切向磁化薄膜中的表面自旋波，并实现了毫瓦级功率下180°的大幅相移，为快速低能耗的一维磁子输运控制提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 通过不同频率的低功率自旋波与高功率泵浦波共传播实验，测量并比较了前向体自旋波与表面自旋波的诱导非线性相移，泵浦波功率为毫瓦量级。

papers.title: Electron momentum densities from QSGW and $G^0W^0$: Revealing the role of many-body effects within the reduced density matrix
papers.abstract: The ground-state many-body electron momentum density, which can be probed by x-ray Compton scattering, holds insights into the electronic structure of materials. Comparisons between the measured so-called Compton profiles and the theoretical ones are invaluable in assessing the successes and failures of the methodology used to generate the theoretical ground-state electronic structure. Here, we present calculations of the Compton profiles of Li, Si, Cr, and Ni using the state-of-the-art QSGW method within the Questaal package compared with density functional theory (DFT), one-shot $GW$ ($G^0W^0$) predictions and with experiment. This comparison reveals significant differences between the QSGW and $G^0W^0$ methods which we attribute to the distinction between the single particle density provided by the QSGW method and the many-body density that we construct from the $G^0W^0$ theory; although in general the QSGW description of the electronic structure is superior to that of $G^0W^0$, we find the use of the many-body reduced density matrix is key to improving the agreement of the Compton profile with experiment.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：calculations、QSGW、DFT、\(G^0W^0\)、Compton profiles。；研究对象：Li、Si、Cr、Ni 四种材料的电子动量密度（通过X射线康普顿散射探测的基态多体电子动量密度）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: QSGW方法与\(G^0W^0\)方法计算的康普顿轮廓存在显著差异，这种差异源于两者对单粒子密度与多体密度的不同处理；尽管QSGW对电子结构的描述通常优于\(G^0W^0\)，但使用多体约化密度矩阵（来自\(G^0W^0\)理论）是改善康普顿轮廓与实验吻合的关键。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：QSGW方法与\(G^0W^0\)方法计算的康普顿轮廓存在显著差异，这种差异源于两者对单粒子密度与多体密度的不同处理；尽管QSGW对电子结构的描述通常优于\(G^0W^0\)，但使用多体约化密度矩阵（来自\(G^0W^0\)理论）是改善康普顿轮廓与实验吻合的关键。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用Questaal软件包中的QSGW（自洽准粒子自洽GW）方法，并与密度泛函理论（DFT）、单次\(GW\)（\(G^0W^0\)）方法的计算结果进行对比，同时与实验数据比较。

papers.title: Role of structure and charge trapping on the bipolaron formation and magnetic-field response of gated conjugated polymers
papers.abstract: Conjugated polymers exhibit unique spin-dependent phenomena arising from weak yet critical hyperfine interactions. Understanding these spin effects, particularly the spin-dependent formation and decay of correlated spin pairs, is important for advancing both organic electronics and polymer-based spintronics. Intrinsic magnetic-field responses such as magnetoresistance have primarily been investigated in diode architectures, where electrons and holes coexist. However, such systems are less suitable for probing bipolaron formation in unipolar transport, and the relationship between polymer structure and bipolaron formation in lightly doped polymers remains unclear. Here, we systematically investigate intrinsic magnetoresistance in representative conjugated polymers using field-effect transistors and observe a generally positive magnetoresistance. First-principles simulations reveal that bipolarons preferentially form on short conjugated segments associated with amorphous regions. Moreover, comparisons across these polymers show that enhanced charge trapping correlates with stronger magnetoresistance, implying promoted bipolaron formation. Bipolaron-incorporated energylevel-alignment modeling near metal/polymer interfaces suggests that charge traps can increase the bipolaron density.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据：摘要中明确提到使用“field-effect transistors”（场效应晶体管）进行实验测量，以及“First-principles simulations”（第一性原理模拟）进行理论计算。；研究对象：门控共轭聚合物中的双极化子形成及其对磁场的响应。具体涉及聚合物结构（特别是短共轭链段）和电荷陷阱对双极化子形成的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在共轭聚合物场效应晶体管中观察到普遍的正磁电阻效应。第一性原理模拟表明，双极化子优先在非晶区的短共轭链段上形成；增强的电荷陷阱与更强的磁电阻效应相关，表明电荷陷阱促进了双极化子的形成。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在共轭聚合物场效应晶体管中观察到普遍的正磁电阻效应。第一性原理模拟表明，双极化子优先在非晶区的短共轭链段上形成；增强的电荷陷阱与更强的磁电阻效应相关，表明电荷陷阱促进了双极化子的形成。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。但可推断其创新点在于：1）利用场效应晶体管（而非传统二极管结构）在单极性输运条件下系统研究了共轭聚合物的本征磁电阻与双极化子形成的关系；2）通过实验与计算结合，揭示了聚合物结构（短共轭链段）和电荷陷阱对双极化子形成的具体作用机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验上采用场效应晶体管（FET）器件测量本征磁电阻；理论上采用第一性原理模拟（First-principles simulations）研究双极化子形成的偏好位置，并构建了包含双极化子的金属/聚合物界面能级对齐模型。

papers.title: What drives performance in molecular MPNNs? An operator-level factorial benchmark
papers.abstract: Message-passing neural networks (MPNNs) are widely used for molecular property prediction, but their deployment as monolithic architectures makes it difficult to identify how specific message-passing operators affect performance. We present an operator-level factorial benchmark that decomposes 2D molecular MPNNs into the three families of message-seed initialization, node-edge fusion, and node update operators. The resulting 84 configurations are benchmarked on ten MoleculeNet datasets under a shared experimental setup and statistical analysis protocol. Across this controlled design, performance variation is associated primarily with message construction rather than update complexity. Message-seed initialization shows significant family-level effects for both regression and classification, node-edge fusion shows a significant family-level effect for regression with descriptive advantages for concatenation-based mixing, and the update family shows no statistically supported effect for either endpoint family. A representation probe into the Quinethazone molecule further demonstrates that concatenation-based mixing can better differentiate chemically distinct heteroatoms and withstand oversmoothing than Hadamard gating. Representative configurations selected separately for classification and regression recover competitive performance relative to established molecular graph neural network (GNN) baselines, ranking numerically best on eight of ten benchmark datasets. These empirical results are interpreted through concise mechanistic analyses of representative node-edge fusion and update operators. Our findings provide empirical design heuristics for molecular MPNNs by turning model design from a search over monolithic architectures into a targeted assessment of where and how chemical information enters the message-passing pipeline.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：benchmark（基准测试）、message-passing neural networks（消息传递神经网络）、operator-level factorial benchmark（算子级析因基准）。；研究对象：分子性质预测中的二维分子图神经网络（2D molecular MPNNs），具体分解为消息种子初始化、节点-边融合、节点更新三类算子，并在MoleculeNet数据集上测试。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 分子MPNN的性能差异主要来源于消息构建（message construction）而非更新复杂度；基于拼接（concatenation）的节点-边融合方式在区分化学上不同的杂原子和抵抗过平滑方面优于Hadamard门控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：分子MPNN的性能差异主要来源于消息构建（message construction）而非更新复杂度；基于拼接（concatenation）的节点-边融合方式在区分化学上不同的杂原子和抵抗过平滑方面优于Hadamard门控。；创新点：将分子MPNN的设计从搜索整体架构转变为对化学信息进入消息传递管道的具体位置和方式进行针对性评估，提供了经验性设计启发式规则。
papers.method_zh: 采用算子级析因基准方法，将2D分子MPNN分解为三类算子（消息种子初始化、节点-边融合、节点更新），构建84种配置，在10个MoleculeNet数据集上统一实验设置和统计分析协议，并进行表征探针（representation probe）分析。

papers.title: Theory of distribution skewness effect on polydisperse random close packing
papers.abstract: We investigate the random close packing density, $φ_\textrm{RCP}$, of polydisperse hard sphere systems using a theoretical framework based on the equilibrium model of crowding. We derive a closed-form solution for $φ_\textrm{RCP}$ in terms of the moments of the diameter distribution, enabling an analytical exploration of the effects of polydispersity ($δ$) and skewness ($S$) on packing density. For a binary mixture, it is possible to explore a broader range of dependence of $φ_\textrm{RCP}$ on $δ$ for a given $S$ or on $S$ for a given $δ$. We show that the dependencies of $φ_\textrm{RCP}$ on skewness for a variety of continuous distributions collapse onto a theoretical master curve obtained for the binary mixture case. By correcting the theory so that it obeys known exact limiting behaviours for extreme size asymmetry, our analytical predictions not only agree with previously obtained numerical results, but also predict previously unexplored regions of the $φ_\textrm{RCP}$ parameter space.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：theoretical framework、derive a closed-form solution、analytical predictions。；研究对象：多分散硬球系统的随机密堆积（Random Close Packing, RCP）密度，重点研究粒径分布偏度（skewness）对堆积密度的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 推导出多分散硬球随机密堆积密度关于粒径分布矩的解析解，发现不同连续分布下堆积密度对偏度的依赖关系可塌缩到二元混合情形的主曲线上；通过修正理论使其满足极端尺寸不对称的已知极限行为，理论预测与已有数值结果一致，并预测了参数空间中此前未探索的区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：推导出多分散硬球随机密堆积密度关于粒径分布矩的解析解，发现不同连续分布下堆积密度对偏度的依赖关系可塌缩到二元混合情形的主曲线上；通过修正理论使其满足极端尺寸不对称的已知极限行为，理论预测与已有数值结果一致，并预测了参数空间中此前未探索的区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于拥挤平衡模型（equilibrium model of crowding）的理论框架，推导出随机密堆积密度关于粒径分布矩的闭式解析解，并通过修正理论使其满足极端尺寸不对称的精确极限行为。

papers.title: Coherent and Dissipative Spin Torques in Quantum Dots: A Unified Framework for Quantum Spin Dynamics
papers.abstract: The manipulation of single spins through spin-polarized tunneling opens new routes for quantum control at the atomic scale. We present a theoretical framework describing spin-transfer, spin torques and spin resonance in molecular quantum dots weakly coupled to magnetic electrodes. By deriving a Lindblad master equation from microscopic tunneling processes, we capture both coherent exchange interactions and dissipative spin torque effects within a unified approach. We analyze how charge transport through localized orbitals influences spin dynamics and show that modulating the tunneling rates in time can induce electron spin resonance. This framework is further extended to coupled spin systems, revealing how spin coherence and entanglement respond to local spin torques and highlighting sources of transport-driven decoherence. Our results provide a general model to interpret spin-resolved tunneling experiments and extend classical spin torque concepts into the quantum regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“theoretical framework”、“Lindblad master equation”、“unified approach”。；研究对象：弱耦合到磁性电极的分子量子点中的自旋转移、自旋扭矩和自旋共振现象，以及耦合自旋系统中的自旋相干性与纠缠。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过从微观隧穿过程推导出Lindblad主方程，统一描述了量子点中的相干交换相互作用和耗散性自旋扭矩效应，并证明通过时间调制隧穿率可以诱导电子自旋共振。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过从微观隧穿过程推导出Lindblad主方程，统一描述了量子点中的相干交换相互作用和耗散性自旋扭矩效应，并证明通过时间调制隧穿率可以诱导电子自旋共振。；创新点：将经典的自旋扭矩概念扩展到量子体系，并提供了一个统一的理论模型来解释自旋分辨隧穿实验，同时揭示了输运驱动的退相干来源。
papers.method_zh: 采用微观隧穿过程推导的Lindblad主方程理论框架，分析电荷输运对自旋动力学的影响，并扩展至耦合自旋系统以研究自旋相干性与纠缠对局域自旋扭矩的响应。

papers.title: Composition-dependent Thin-film Synthesis of Layered Ternary Iron Nitrides FeMN2 (M = W, Mo)
papers.abstract: Ternary transition-metal nitrides with layered crystal structures host anisotropic bonding and reduced dimensionality that may enable unconventional electronic and magnetic behavior. Yet, synthesis of such nitride thin films remains challenging because reactive sputtering often favors metastable rocksalt-derived structures. We report the composition-dependent synthesis, structure, and properties of layered FeMN2 (M = W, Mo) thin films with triangular Fe sublattices, prepared by reactive sputtering and post-deposition NH3 annealing. Using synchrotron grazing-incidence wide-angle X-ray scattering (GIWAXS) and X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS), we investigate the evolution of phase formation, crystallographic texture, and local Fe coordination across composition. Both layered phase form over broad composition ranges. FeWN2 maintains high phase purity across compositions, consistent with cation substitution, whereas FeMoN2 only exhibits good phase purity at Fe-poor compositions. Azimuthal GIWAXS analysis shows that Fe-rich films in both systems exhibit out-of-plane fiber texture, which progressively evolves toward predominantly in-plane orientation near stoichiometry in FeWN2, while FeMoN2 develops a more randomly oriented polycrystalline microstructure. Electrical measurements reveal relatively low and composition-insensitive resistivity in FeWN2 (~1 mΩ.cm), whereas FeMoN2 exhibits a pronounced resistivity maximum near nominal stoichiometry. Preliminary room-temperature magnetization measurements on FeWN2 further reveal weak ferromagnetic-like behavior in Fe-poor films, while stoichiometric compositions remain predominantly paramagnetic. These results demonstrate fundamentally different structural accommodation mechanisms in FeWN2 and FeMoN2, and highlight the strong coupling between composition, microstructure, and electronic/magnetic properties in layered nitride thin films.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了薄膜制备（reactive sputtering, post-deposition NH3 annealing）、结构表征（GIWAXS, XAS）和物性测量（电输运、磁化测量）等实验手段。；研究对象：层状三元氮化物薄膜 FeMN₂（M = W, Mo），具体研究其成分依赖的合成、结构、电学和磁学性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: FeWN₂ 和 FeMoN₂ 在成分变化时表现出根本不同的结构容纳机制：FeWN₂ 在宽成分范围内保持高相纯度且电阻率低且对成分不敏感，而 FeMoN₂ 仅在贫铁成分下相纯度好，且在名义化学计量比附近出现电阻率极大值；此外，FeWN₂ 的贫铁薄膜表现出弱铁磁性，而化学计量比薄膜主要为顺磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：FeWN₂ 和 FeMoN₂ 在成分变化时表现出根本不同的结构容纳机制：FeWN₂ 在宽成分范围内保持高相纯度且电阻率低且对成分不敏感，而 FeMoN₂ 仅在贫铁成分下相纯度好，且在名义化学计量比附近出现电阻率极大值；此外，FeWN₂ 的贫铁薄膜表现出弱铁磁性，而化学计量比薄膜主要为顺磁性。；创新点：首次系统揭示了层状三元氮化物 FeWN₂ 和 FeMoN₂ 薄膜中成分对相纯度、织构、电学和磁学性质的显著影响，并发现两者在结构容纳机制上的本质差异。摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 反应磁控溅射（reactive sputtering）结合后退火（NH3 annealing）制备薄膜；同步辐射掠入射广角X射线散射（GIWAXS）分析相形成和织构；X射线吸收谱（XAS）分析局域Fe配位；电输运测量（电阻率）；室温磁化测量。

papers.title: Carrier-coupled ultrafast structural dynamics and interlayer energy transport of supported transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures
papers.abstract: Understanding the electronic coupling and energy flow across layered two-dimensional heterostructures (HSs) is crucial to the exploitation of carrier and phonon transports as well as thermal management in next-generation optoelectronic devices. By using reflection ultrafast electron diffraction, we directly examine photoinduced out-of-plane structural dynamics of supported MoS2/WS2 bilayer HSs and their individual monolayers. Experimental evidence reveals the launch of ultrafast carrier-coupled intralayer atomic motions due to interlayer charge transfer across the van der Waals (vdW) heterojunctions that is absent for individual monolayers. Such a notable carrier-lattice correlation is in addition to the electronic coupling manifested in the enhanced optical absorption for HSs. Also, different pathways of energy flow as a result of carrier-phonon coupling and phonon scattering are reported with the corresponding characteristic times. On longer timescales, relaxation of thermalized atomic motions can be sufficiently described by a thermal transport model. A higher thermal boundary conductance (TBC) across MoS2/WS2 HSs is obtained compared to those at the monolayer-substrate interfaces; however, the similar TBC values suggest comparable couplings of phonons across vdW contacts. These results further shed light on the optical, phonon, and interfacial thermal properties of vertically-stacked vdW HSs.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：使用了“reflection ultrafast electron diffraction”（反射式超快电子衍射）作为主要实验手段，并提供了直接的实验证据。；研究对象：支撑在基底上的MoS₂/WS₂双层异质结及其单层薄膜，具体研究光致面外结构动力学和层间能量输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验发现，由于层间电荷转移，MoS₂/WS₂异质结中出现了单层膜所没有的超快载流子耦合的层内原子运动；此外，MoS₂/WS₂异质结的界面热导高于单层与基底之间的界面热导，但数值相近，表明范德华接触中声子耦合强度相当。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验发现，由于层间电荷转移，MoS₂/WS₂异质结中出现了单层膜所没有的超快载流子耦合的层内原子运动；此外，MoS₂/WS₂异质结的界面热导高于单层与基底之间的界面热导，但数值相近，表明范德华接触中声子耦合强度相当。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 反射式超快电子衍射（reflection ultrafast electron diffraction），结合光学吸收测量和热输运模型分析。

papers.title: Engineering Quantum Criticality in the Integer Quantum Hall Regime through a Screening Layer
papers.abstract: Disorder-induced localization of electrons and electron-electron interaction are among the most fundamental problems in condensed matter physics. In two-dimensional electron systems, extensive studies have led to the emergence of a scaling picture, characterized by a set of universal critical exponents that govern the transitions between the integer quantum Hall plateaus. From the temperature dependence of the plateau-to-plateau transitions, experiments primarily report k ~ 0.42, implying a dynamic exponent z = 1, consistent with a theoretical picture where electrons have a long-range (1/r) interaction. Theory also predicts that z = 2 for short-range electron interaction, but an experimental verification has remained elusive. Here, we directly probe the influence of Coulomb interaction on these transitions using a bilayer electron system confined to a GaAs double quantum well device. The two layers are in close proximity, with an interlayer distance approximately equal to the magnetic length at the relevant magnetic fields. By tuning the electron density in the top layer, we access both insulating and metallic phases of the electrons in this layer as a function of magnetic field, allowing in-situ control of the unscreened and screened interaction strengths in the bottom layer as it goes through its plateau-to-plateau transitions. In the unscreened case, we measure k ~ 0.42 consistent with the widely reported value. More importantly, when screening is introduced, k is reduced to ~ 0.22, implying z = 2. Our results provide direct experimental evidence for the role of electron-electron interaction in determining critical behavior in the quantum Hall regime, and demonstrate screening as a powerful tuning parameter for engineering quantum criticality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“experiments primarily report”、“we directly probe”、“we measure”等实验操作和测量结果。；研究对象：GaAs双量子阱器件中的二维电子系统，具体研究整数量子霍尔效应中平台-平台相变的临界行为，以及电子-电子相互作用（库仑相互作用）对临界指数的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过引入屏蔽层原位调控电子-电子相互作用强度，实验观察到在未屏蔽时临界指数k≈0.42（对应动力学指数z=1），在屏蔽后k降至约0.22（对应z=2），直接证明了电子-电子相互作用决定量子霍尔区临界行为，并展示了屏蔽作为调控量子临界性的有效手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过引入屏蔽层原位调控电子-电子相互作用强度，实验观察到在未屏蔽时临界指数k≈0.42（对应动力学指数z=1），在屏蔽后k降至约0.22（对应z=2），直接证明了电子-电子相互作用决定量子霍尔区临界行为，并展示了屏蔽作为调控量子临界性的有效手段。；创新点：首次通过实验直接验证了短程电子相互作用下动力学指数z=2的理论预言，并展示了利用屏蔽层原位调控量子临界行为的新方法。
papers.method_zh: 使用GaAs双量子阱器件构建双层电子系统，通过调节顶层电子密度使其在磁场下进入绝缘或金属相，从而原位控制底层电子在经历平台-平台相变时受到的库仑相互作用是否被屏蔽；测量不同屏蔽条件下的温度依赖关系，提取临界指数k。

papers.title: Towards exascale fully relativistic pseudopotential density functional theory calculations enabled by mixed-precision computation and compressed-communication using residual based subspace iteration
papers.abstract: Noncollinear (NC) magnetism and spin-orbit coupling (SOC) are indispensable for predictive ab initio materials simulations with pronounced relativistic effects and magnetic frustration, yet they significantly increase the cost of cubic-scaling density functional theory (DFT) by introducing complex 2-component wavefunctions per electron and consequently much larger eigenproblems. We present a GPU-centric high-performance framework for NC-SOC DFT that combines: (i) algorithmic advances for solving finite-element (FE) discretized DFT equations; (ii) residual-based Chebyshev filtered subspace iteration (R-ChFSI), tolerant to inexact matrix-vector products, for the resulting sparse generalized eigenproblem; (iii) a matrix-free strategy for accelerating FE Poisson solver; (iv) R-ChFSI-enabled mixed-precision computation with block floating-point compressed MPI communication at compression ratios over 4x, preserving double-precision robustness while reducing compute and data movement costs; and (v) a communication efficient band-partitioning algorithm to improve scalability. Numerical results demonstrate improved time-to-solution and excellent scaling on exascale architectures, enabling fully relativistic pseudopotential DFT simulations of up to 100,000 electrons.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：density functional theory (DFT) calculations、high-performance framework、exascale architectures。；研究对象：摘要未明确说明具体材料或体系，研究对象为一般性的非共线磁性和自旋轨道耦合（NC-SOC）的密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，适用于具有显著相对论效应和磁阻挫的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过结合残差基切比雪夫滤波子空间迭代（R-ChFSI）、混合精度计算和压缩通信等算法，实现了在百亿亿次（exascale）架构上高效的全相对论赝势DFT模拟，可处理多达10万个电子的体系。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过结合残差基切比雪夫滤波子空间迭代（R-ChFSI）、混合精度计算和压缩通信等算法，实现了在百亿亿次（exascale）架构上高效的全相对论赝势DFT模拟，可处理多达10万个电子的体系。；创新点：将R-ChFSI算法（可容忍不精确矩阵-向量乘积）与混合精度计算及压缩通信（压缩比超过4倍）相结合，在保持双精度鲁棒性的同时显著降低计算和数据移动成本，并首次在exascale架构上实现了全相对论赝势DFT的大规模模拟。
papers.method_zh: 基于有限元（FE）离散化的DFT方程求解框架；采用残差基切比雪夫滤波子空间迭代（R-ChFSI）方法求解稀疏广义本征问题；无矩阵策略加速有限元泊松求解器；混合精度计算与块浮点压缩MPI通信；通信高效的能带划分算法。

papers.title: Quantum Spin-5/2 Blume-Capel Model in a Random Transverse-Crystalline Field Anisotropy
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the thermodynamic properties of the quantum Blume-Capel model with spin \( S = 5/2 \) in the presence of transverse and random crystalline fields. The system is described by a Hamiltonian that includes ferromagnetic exchange interactions between nearest neighbors, a longitudinal single-ion anisotropy, and a transverse single-ion anisotropy. Using a mean-field approach based on Bogoliubov's inequality for the Gibbs free energy, we derive the fundamental thermodynamic potential and the equation of state for the magnetization. The influence of the longitudinal and transverse anisotropy parameters on the magnetic ordering and phase transitions is analyzed in detail. We present magnetization versus temperature diagrams for various combinations of the anisotropies, exploring both positive and negative values. Our results reveal that the system exhibits standard second-order phase transitions for most parameter ranges, with no evidence of tricritical behavior. However, for certain positive values of the anisotropies, the model displays a first-order phase transition within the ordered phase, characterized by a jump from a higher-spin ordered state to a lower-spin ordered state. The critical temperatures are shown to be sensitive to the magnitude and sign of the anisotropy parameters. In particular, negative transverse anisotropies favor magnetic order, raising the critical temperature, while positive anisotropies promote disorder, lowering the critical temperature. This study provides a comprehensive analysis of the phase diagram of the \( S = 5/2 \) quantum Blume-Capel model and highlights the role of transverse fields in modifying the critical behavior.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：mean-field approach、Bogoliubov's inequality、thermodynamic potential、equation of state。；研究对象：自旋 S=5/2 的量子 Blume-Capel 模型，在随机横向晶场各向异性下的热力学性质与相变行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统在大多数参数范围内呈现标准二级相变，未发现三临界点；但在某些正各向异性参数下，有序相内部会出现从高自旋有序态到低自旋有序态的一级相变。负横向各向异性有利于磁有序（提高临界温度），正横向各向异性则促进无序（降低临界温度）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统在大多数参数范围内呈现标准二级相变，未发现三临界点；但在某些正各向异性参数下，有序相内部会出现从高自旋有序态到低自旋有序态的一级相变。负横向各向异性有利于磁有序（提高临界温度），正横向各向异性则促进无序（降低临界温度）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于 Bogoliubov 不等式对吉布斯自由能进行平均场近似，推导出基本热力学势和磁化状态方程，并通过数值计算分析磁化随温度的变化图。

papers.title: Supercooling of liquids, as described by the Enskog-Vlasov kinetic equation
papers.abstract: A model combining Enskog's collision integral for dense fluids with a Vlasov-style description of the van der Waals force is applied to supercooling. First, the spinodal temperature $T_{s}$ is calculated, at which a liquid becomes unstable to small perturbations and transitions to solid. In particular, it turns out that isochoric cooling allows one to reach a lower temperature than isobaric cooling. Second, the surface tension of a supercooled liquid-vapor interface is shown to diverge at $T_{s}$. The singularity is caused by an oscillatory region emerging on the liquid side of the interface as $T\rightarrow T_{s}$; it develops because the liquid approaches instability, and the interface starts radiating (so far, evanescent) waves. At $T=T_{s}$, the waves cease to be evanescent and the oscillatory region extends to infinity -- hence, the singularity of the surface tension. Since this effect has a clear physical interpretation, it should occur regardless of the model and approximations under which it was obtained. This and the other results of the paper are illustrated using argon and several other fluids.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“kinetic equation”“model”“calculated”等关键词，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：过冷液体（supercooled liquids），具体以氩（argon）及其他几种流体为例，研究其从液态向固态转变的失稳行为及液-气界面性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 等容冷却比等压冷却能达到更低的温度；过冷液体-蒸气界面的表面张力在旋节线温度 \(T_s\) 处发散，该发散源于液体侧在接近 \(T_s\) 时出现振荡区域，并在 \(T_s\) 处振荡波从倏逝波变为传播波，使振荡区域延伸至无穷远。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：等容冷却比等压冷却能达到更低的温度；过冷液体-蒸气界面的表面张力在旋节线温度 \(T_s\) 处发散，该发散源于液体侧在接近 \(T_s\) 时出现振荡区域，并在 \(T_s\) 处振荡波从倏逝波变为传播波，使振荡区域延伸至无穷远。；创新点：首次在Enskog-Vlasov框架下系统研究过冷液体的旋节线失稳及表面张力发散行为，并指出该发散具有清晰的物理图像（界面辐射倏逝波），因此应独立于具体模型和近似而普遍存在。
papers.method_zh: 采用Enskog-Vlasov动力学方程，其中Enskog碰撞积分描述稠密流体的短程碰撞，Vlasov项描述范德瓦尔斯力的长程作用。通过该模型计算旋节线温度 \(T_s\) 及界面性质。

papers.title: Electronic Origin of Ferromagnetic Excitations in the Candidate Spin-Triplet Superconductor CeSb2
papers.abstract: The origin of quasi-one-dimensional (q1D) ferromagnetic (FM) excitations in the candidate spin-triplet superconductor CeSb$_2$ has remained unclear. Here we report an electronic mechanism for emergent q1D magnetism in the quasi-two-dimensional lattice of CeSb$_2$, revealed by angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). High-resolution ARPES resolves no spin-density-wave gap on the dispersive Fermi pockets, disfavoring a nesting-driven mechanism for the q1D FM excitations. Instead, resonant ARPES reveals a pronounced selective enhancement of Ce 4$f$ spectral weight on the $C_2$-distributed Fermi pockets aligned with the Ce ladder. This observation signifies band-selective Kondo coupling that generates strongly anisotropic magnetic exchange interactions, which can naturally account for both the q1D ferromagnetic excitations and the competing magnetic orders. Our results identify a band-selective Kondo coupling mechanism for emergent low-dimensional magnetism in correlated $f$-electron systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：关键词“angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES)”、“resonant ARPES”以及“high-resolution ARPES resolves”表明主要基于角分辨光电子能谱实验。；研究对象：候选自旋三重态超导体CeSb₂中准一维铁磁激发的电子起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过ARPES实验发现，CeSb₂中准一维铁磁激发并非源于费米面嵌套，而是由能带选择性的近藤耦合机制导致，该机制产生强各向异性磁交换作用，从而解释了准一维铁磁激发和竞争磁有序。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过ARPES实验发现，CeSb₂中准一维铁磁激发并非源于费米面嵌套，而是由能带选择性的近藤耦合机制导致，该机制产生强各向异性磁交换作用，从而解释了准一维铁磁激发和竞争磁有序。；创新点：首次通过实验揭示CeSb₂中准一维铁磁激发的电子机制，即能带选择性的近藤耦合，而非传统的费米面嵌套驱动机制。摘要未突出说明其他创新点。
papers.method_zh: 高分辨角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）和共振角分辨光电子能谱（resonant ARPES）。

papers.title: Slave-rotor theory of correlated altermagnets on the Lieb lattice
papers.abstract: We investigate the metal-insulator transition driven by the onsite repulsive interaction $U$ in an altermagnetic Hubbard model defined on a Lieb lattice. Using the slave-rotor approach at half filling, we find that the system exhibits a cascade of interaction-driven phase transitions. As $U$ increases, the system evolves from a normal metal to an altermagnetic metal, then to an altermagnetic insulator, and eventually to an altermagnetic Mott insulator characterized by the complete suppression of the quasiparticle weight. These phases are supported by the calculation of the electronic spectral function, which features spin-split bands in both the metallic and insulating regimes. However, the spin splitting becomes substantially suppressed in the Mott insulating phase. Our results suggest that the observation of spin splitting in the spectral function of $d$-wave altermagnets with a Lieb-lattice-like structure may be limited to the weak-to-moderate correlation regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“Slave-rotor approach”（奴隶转子方法）、“theoretical investigation”（理论研究）。；研究对象：Lieb晶格上定义的交错磁Hubbard模型，具体研究由在位库仑相互作用U驱动的金属-绝缘体相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统随相互作用U增大经历一系列相变：从正常金属到交错磁金属，再到交错磁绝缘体，最终进入准粒子权重完全被抑制的交错磁Mott绝缘体。在Mott绝缘相中，能带的自旋劈裂被显著压制，表明在Lieb晶格类d波交错磁体中，谱函数自旋劈裂的观测可能仅限于弱到中等关联区域。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统随相互作用U增大经历一系列相变：从正常金属到交错磁金属，再到交错磁绝缘体，最终进入准粒子权重完全被抑制的交错磁Mott绝缘体。在Mott绝缘相中，能带的自旋劈裂被显著压制，表明在Lieb晶格类d波交错磁体中，谱函数自旋劈裂的观测可能仅限于弱到中等关联区域。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用奴隶转子（slave-rotor）方法，在半满填充下进行计算分析，并通过电子谱函数计算来表征各相。

papers.title: Surface Originated Cross-Field Anomalous Transport in Magnetoelectric Multilayers
papers.abstract: In material systems with slab geometry, the surface contribution to physical responses is commonly expected to diminish rapidly with increasing thickness, giving way to the bulk response. Here, we show that this conventional wisdom is violated in a class of gate-induced responses, including gate-induced orbital and spin magnetization as well as cross-field anomalous thermoelectric transport. We develop a general framework for these effects, which naturally decomposes the total response into surface- and bulk-contributions treated on equal footing. Remarkably, the volume-averaged surface contribution remains finite in the thick-slab limit and exhibits the same thickness scaling as the bulk term. Furthermore, the surface response originates from band geometric quantities distinct from those in the bulk, being constrained solely by surface symmetries. As a result, it can dominate the overall response when the bulk contribution is symmetry-forbidden. Taking MnBi$_2$Te$_4$ multilayers as an example, we predict a strong surface-dominated cross-field anomalous Nernst effect arising from surface Berry curvature, which is readily accessible to experimental detection. These findings reveal a previously overlooked significance of surface response and open a new direction in the study of surface quantum geometry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a general framework、predict、theoretical framework。；研究对象：磁电多层膜（magnetoelectric multilayers）中的表面起源交叉场反常输运现象，具体以MnBi₂Te₄多层膜为例，研究门诱导的轨道磁化、自旋磁化以及交叉场反常热电输运。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在厚板极限下，表面贡献的体积平均值并不随厚度增加而衰减，而是与体贡献具有相同的厚度标度行为；当体贡献因对称性被禁止时，表面贡献可主导整体响应，例如在MnBi₂Te₄多层膜中预测了由表面贝里曲率主导的强交叉场反常能斯特效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在厚板极限下，表面贡献的体积平均值并不随厚度增加而衰减，而是与体贡献具有相同的厚度标度行为；当体贡献因对称性被禁止时，表面贡献可主导整体响应，例如在MnBi₂Te₄多层膜中预测了由表面贝里曲率主导的强交叉场反常能斯特效应。；创新点：揭示了传统认知中表面贡献随厚度增加而迅速衰减这一观念的违反，指出在门诱导响应中表面贡献在厚板极限下仍保持有限，并可能主导整体响应，开辟了表面量子几何研究的新方向。
papers.method_zh: 发展了一个将总响应自然分解为表面贡献和体贡献的通用理论框架，两者被平等处理；表面响应仅受表面对称性约束，并基于与体不同的能带几何量（如表面贝里曲率）进行分析。

papers.title: Hysteretic Acoustic Band Structures in Shape-Memory Composite Thin Rods
papers.abstract: We investigate the propagation of longitudinal elastic waves in one-dimensional periodic composite rods composed of alternating segments of a shape-memory alloy (NiTiCu) and a polymer spacer (Parylene C). In the thin-rod regime, the longitudinal phase velocity reduces to $c=\sqrt{E/ρ}$, which coincides with the regime in which the elastic modulus of NiTiCu has been measured directly through its acoustic response across the martensitic transformation. Using the standard transfer-matrix method along the heating and cooling branches of the transformation separately, we compute the Bloch band structure of the infinite periodic system and the transmission spectrum of finite composite rods. Because the elastic modulus of NiTiCu follows different paths upon heating and cooling, the same external temperature within the transformation interval corresponds to two different phase fractions and, consequently, to two different phononic spectra. The resulting hysteresis of the underlying material is thus transferred to the collective acoustic response of the periodic structure: stop-band edges trace closed loops in the temperature--frequency plane, and the transmission coefficient of a finite rod at a fixed temperature depends on the previous thermal history. We further show that the geometric filling fraction of the active segment provides a complementary tuning mechanism, modifying the width of the spectral hysteresis loops and the position of specific gap closures independently of temperature. These results illustrate how a first-order structural phase transition with intrinsic thermal hysteresis manifests itself in the dispersion relation of a periodic elastic medium.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：transfer-matrix method、compute、Bloch band structure、transmission spectrum）；研究对象：由形状记忆合金（NiTiCu）与聚合物间隔层（Parylene C）交替组成的一维周期性复合细棒中的纵向弹性波传播。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 由于NiTiCu在相变区间内加热与冷却时弹性模量路径不同，同一温度对应不同相分数，导致周期性结构的声子谱出现热滞回线：带隙边缘在温度-频率平面上形成闭合回路，有限长复合棒的透射系数依赖于热历史。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：由于NiTiCu在相变区间内加热与冷却时弹性模量路径不同，同一温度对应不同相分数，导致周期性结构的声子谱出现热滞回线：带隙边缘在温度-频率平面上形成闭合回路，有限长复合棒的透射系数依赖于热历史。；创新点：将形状记忆合金本征的热滞行为（一级结构相变）传递到周期性弹性介质的集体声学响应中，并展示了活性段几何填充比可作为独立于温度的额外调控机制来改变谱滞回线的宽度和特定带隙闭合位置。
papers.method_zh: 采用标准传递矩阵法，分别沿马氏体相变的加热支和冷却支计算无限周期系统的布洛赫能带结构以及有限长复合棒的透射谱。

papers.title: Magnetic precession induced spin accumulation in collinear antiferromagnets
papers.abstract: Generating and characterizing uniform and staggered spin polarization in antiferromagnets is one of the key challenges for antiferromagnetic spintronic technology. Here, we perform perturbative theory, group-theoretical symmetry analysis, low energy and ab initio simulations to propose that the magnetic precession near the equilibrium magnetic axis could generate finite uniform and staggered spin polarization at the opposite magnetic sublattices (referring to total magnetic and Néel vector generation) in a single AFM semiconductors. This response does not require the heterojunction setup and could eliminate the lattice mismatch issues at the junction. Through scrutinizing all symmetrically-protected vanishing magnetic moment groups and especially focusing on parity-time (PT ) invariant groups, we identify the symmetry constraints that describe the staggered spin accumulation responses, and disclose their fieldlike and dampinglike characters. This unravels a hidden spin accumulation mode in AFM semiconductors. Furthermore, we simulate such an effect using a perturbative approach and suggest that electric gate field and Floquet light-dressing can effectively manipulate these responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词包括“perturbative theory”（微扰理论）、“group-theoretical symmetry analysis”（群论对称性分析）、“low energy and ab initio simulations”（低能及第一性原理模拟）。；研究对象：共线反铁磁体（collinear antiferromagnets）中由磁进动（magnetic precession）诱导的自旋积累现象，具体涉及均匀和交错自旋极化（uniform and staggered spin polarization）的产生。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在单一反铁磁半导体中，平衡磁轴附近的磁进动可以在相反磁子格点上产生有限的均匀和交错自旋极化（即总磁矩和奈尔矢量的生成），且该响应无需异质结结构，可避免晶格失配问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在单一反铁磁半导体中，平衡磁轴附近的磁进动可以在相反磁子格点上产生有限的均匀和交错自旋极化（即总磁矩和奈尔矢量的生成），且该响应无需异质结结构，可避免晶格失配问题。；创新点：揭示了一种在反铁磁半导体中隐藏的自旋积累模式，并阐明了其场致类（fieldlike）和阻尼类（dampinglike）特性。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 微扰理论、群论对称性分析、低能模型模拟以及第一性原理（ab initio）模拟。特别关注了宇称-时间（PT）不变群，并分析了对称性保护的消失磁矩群。

papers.title: Charting the thermodynamic stability of hybrid perovskite alloys with machine learning
papers.abstract: Alloy-based perovskite solar cells offer tunable properties and improved stability, but their complexity has impeded accurate modeling, hindering development. We present a machine-learning (ML) accelerated atomistic modeling approach for the phase stability of (Cs/FA)Pb(Br/I)3 and (Cs/FA)Sn(Br/I)3 perovskites, with FA being formamidinium. To make such quaternary alloys tractable, we adopt a two-level ML strategy, combining 1) graph neural network interatomic potentials trained on density functional theory data for efficient structure relaxations with 2) secondary ML models for direct energy prediction from unrelaxed structures. These models enable computations of free energy landscapes across compositions and phases, capturing alloy disorder and FA molecular orientations. Our results reveal narrower stable composition regions for the Sn-based system compared to its Pb-based counterpart, limiting options for compositional engineering. Maximum stability occurs at high I content, and no stabilization is observed near the center of the composition space. Our results guide the design of stable perovskites.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine-learning (ML) accelerated atomistic modeling、graph neural network interatomic potentials、density functional theory (DFT) data。；研究对象：混合钙钛矿合金 (Cs/FA)Pb(Br/I)₃ 和 (Cs/FA)Sn(Br/I)₃ 的相稳定性，其中 FA 为甲脒。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 锡基混合钙钛矿合金的稳定组分区间比铅基体系更窄，限制了组分工程的选择；最大稳定性出现在高碘含量区域，而组分空间中心附近未观察到稳定化效应。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：锡基混合钙钛矿合金的稳定组分区间比铅基体系更窄，限制了组分工程的选择；最大稳定性出现在高碘含量区域，而组分空间中心附近未观察到稳定化效应。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用两级机器学习加速原子建模策略：1）基于密度泛函理论数据训练图神经网络原子间势，用于高效结构弛豫；2）训练二级机器学习模型，直接从未弛豫结构预测能量。进而计算不同组分和相的自由能景观，捕捉合金无序和FA分子取向。

papers.title: Hidden Ising models from the generalized Yang-Baxter equation
papers.abstract: We introduce a one dimensional spin $\frac{1}{2}$ Hamiltonian with multi-site interactions, but still local. The algebra of its Hamiltonian densities resembles that of the transverse field Ising model. Using this fact we show that its spectrum is free-fermionic but with a huge degeneracy for each level. The source of the degeneracy is a set of local conserved quantities that act like a classical background field for the quantum system. The thermodynamics of this system is contrasted with the standard Ising model. At the gapless points in the energy spectrum, we show that this system can be derived from the quantum inverse scattering method adapted to a multi-site generalization of the Yang-Baxter equation as introduced by E. Rowell and Z. Wang. The $R$-matrix is constructed using generators of extraspecial 2-groups. This helps us extract all the conserved charges and lay the framework for a general mechanism to generate such multi-site interaction spin systems that are transverse field Ising models under the hood. A remark on how to obtain P. Fendley's free-fermion in disguise models in this formalism is also included.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Hamiltonian、Yang-Baxter equation、量子逆散射方法、R-matrix。；研究对象：一维自旋1/2系统，具有多体相互作用但仍是局域的哈密顿量，其代数结构与横场Ising模型类似。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该系统的能谱是自由费米子型的，但每个能级具有巨大的简并度，简并来源于一组局域守恒量，这些守恒量对量子系统起到经典背景场的作用。在能谱的无能隙点，该系统可通过推广的Yang-Baxter方程（E. Rowell和Z. Wang引入的多位点推广）从量子逆散射方法导出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该系统的能谱是自由费米子型的，但每个能级具有巨大的简并度，简并来源于一组局域守恒量，这些守恒量对量子系统起到经典背景场的作用。在能谱的无能隙点，该系统可通过推广的Yang-Baxter方程（E. Rowell和Z. Wang引入的多位点推广）从量子逆散射方法导出。；创新点：提出了一个一般性机制，用于生成“表面上是多体相互作用自旋系统、实质上是横场Ising模型”的哈密顿量，并指出该框架可推广得到P. Fendley的“伪装自由费米子”模型。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导：利用哈密顿量密度代数与横场Ising模型的相似性证明自由费米子谱；使用量子逆散射方法，构造基于超特殊2-群生成元的R-矩阵，提取所有守恒荷；对比标准Ising模型的热力学性质。

papers.title: Thermodynamic and magnetocaloric properties of a triangular spin-1/2 cluster with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction
papers.abstract: We present a theoretical investigation of the magnetic and thermodynamic properties of the triangular spin-1/2 cluster with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction, described by a spin-1/2 Heisenberg Hamiltonian with antisymmetric exchange interactions. The energy spectrum and ground-state phase diagram reveal the presence of ferromagnetic (FM), ferrimagnetic (FI), and frustrated (FR) phases, strongly influenced by the total spin and the DM interaction. We analyze magnetization and susceptibility, showing that at low temperatures the system exhibits a characteristic 1/3 magnetization plateau, while thermal fluctuations suppress magnetic order at higher temperatures. The entropy and specific heat display residual entropies due to ground-state degeneracies, Schottky-type anomalies at intermediate temperatures, and additional low-temperature features related to phase transitions. Particular attention is given to the magnetocaloric effect (MCE), characterized by both direct and inverse regimes depending on the magnetic field variation. We find that the DM interaction enhances the complexity of the MCE, leading to nontrivial entropy variations as a function of the magnetic field. These results provide insights into the role of frustration and anisotropy in tuning the MCE of properties triangular spin clusters, with relevance to \mathrm{Cu}_{3}-based molecular magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用“theoretical investigation”“described by a Hamiltonian”“analyze”等关键词，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：具有Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya（DM）相互作用的三角自旋-1/2团簇，具体为自旋-1/2海森堡哈密顿量描述的反铁磁交换体系，与Cu₃基分子磁体相关。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 系统存在铁磁（FM）、亚铁磁（FI）和阻挫（FR）三种基态相，受总自旋和DM相互作用强烈调控；低温下出现1/3磁化平台，磁热效应呈现直接与逆两种模式，DM相互作用显著增强了磁热效应的复杂性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：系统存在铁磁（FM）、亚铁磁（FI）和阻挫（FR）三种基态相，受总自旋和DM相互作用强烈调控；低温下出现1/3磁化平台，磁热效应呈现直接与逆两种模式，DM相互作用显著增强了磁热效应的复杂性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：通过求解自旋-1/2海森堡哈密顿量（含反对称交换相互作用）得到能谱和基态相图，计算磁化率、熵、比热等热力学量，并分析磁热效应（MCE）的熵变行为。

papers.title: Stability Analysis of Superconductivity in $\textit{P6/mmm}$-LaSc$_2$H$_{24}$ and its Experimental Reproducibility from La-Sc Alloys
papers.abstract: In this work, we analyze the feasibility of room-temperature superconductivity in the lanthanum-scandium hydride $\textit{P6/mmm}$-LaSc$_2$H$_{24}$. We demonstrate that the electron-phonon coupling calculations performed using the $σ$-broadening of the double $δ$-function at the Fermi surface lead to a very strong dependence of $\textit{T$_c$}(σ)$ on the arbitrary $σ$, whereas the tetrahedral method for the electron-phonon interaction is free from this drawback and leads to $\textit{T$_c$}$ > 300 K at 300 GPa in agreement with previous predictions. By analyzing the stability of the metallic state of LaSc$_2$H$_{24}$ at 250-300 GPa, we show that this compound is at the edge of the stability region ($ξ$ = 0.54), similar to $\textit{fcc}$ LaH$_{10}$ at 140-150 GPa. Experimental attempts to synthesize LaSc$_2$H$_{24}$ at 250-280 GPa starting from the (La,Sc$_2$) alloy are unsuccessful and indicate the absence of even traces of superconductivity at 245-300 K in all the resulting La-Sc-H hydrides. The method for preparing the precursor by simultaneous deposition of La and Sc metals may be a key factor for the successful synthesis of LaSc$_2$H$_{24}$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（计算分析 + 实验尝试）。判断依据：摘要中同时包含电子-声子耦合计算（σ展宽法与四面体法）和高压合成实验（从La-Sc合金前驱体合成氢化物）。；研究对象：镧-钪氢化物 LaSc₂H₂₄（空间群 P6/mmm）在250-300 GPa高压下的超导电性及其实验可重复性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 采用四面体法计算电子-声子相互作用时，LaSc₂H₂₄在300 GPa下的超导临界温度 T_c > 300 K，与先前预测一致；但该化合物在250-300 GPa下处于稳定性边缘（ξ = 0.54），且实验尝试在250-280 GPa下从(La,Sc₂)合金合成该材料均未成功，未观察到245-300 K温度范围内的超导迹象。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：采用四面体法计算电子-声子相互作用时，LaSc₂H₂₄在300 GPa下的超导临界温度 T_c > 300 K，与先前预测一致；但该化合物在250-300 GPa下处于稳定性边缘（ξ = 0.54），且实验尝试在250-280 GPa下从(La,Sc₂)合金合成该材料均未成功，未观察到245-300 K温度范围内的超导迹象。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 1）电子-声子耦合计算：对比了σ展宽的双δ函数方法与四面体法对T_c(σ)的影响；2）稳定性分析：通过金属态稳定性参数ξ评估化合物在高压下的稳定性；3）高压合成实验：以La和Sc共沉积制备前驱体合金，在250-280 GPa下尝试合成LaSc₂H₂₄并检测超导信号。

papers.title: Prototype-Guided Latent Alignment for Data-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Molecular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have transformed materials discovery by leveraging graph neural networks (GNNs) to predict material properties with near density functional theory (DFT) accuracy. While large-scale pretrained foundation models offer transferable baseline representations, they frequently struggle to generalise to out-of-distribution (OOD) target systems -- a common challenge in modelling complex or chemically diverse materials. Fine-tuning is the standard remedy, but the high cost of generating DFT-labelled configurations confines adaptation to data-scarce regimes, where over-parameterised GNNs amplify overfitting and degrade target-domain performance. To address this, we propose a prototype-based alignment approach for data-efficient fine-tuning of MLIPs. Our method identifies local structural similarities between the source and target domains by grouping atoms with analogous chemical environments based on their latent representations. Each target-domain atom's energy contribution is aligned to its source-domain prototype, introducing an inductive bias that anchors fine-tuned representations to the pretrained structure, encouraging effective reuse of learned interactions and improving generalisation without restrictive assumptions on the target chemistry. We evaluate our method on the rMD17 benchmark using equivariant MACE and invariant SchNet across varying data budgets, and extend evaluation to the MACE-OFF foundation models on the SPICE dataset. Our approach consistently improves predictive accuracy in the low-data regime, reducing energy MAE by up to 18% over standard fine-tuning baselines.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs)、graph neural networks (GNNs)、fine-tuning、benchmark evaluation。；研究对象：分子体系，具体包括rMD17基准数据集和SPICE数据集中的分子，涉及化学环境多样、可能偏离训练分布（out-of-distribution）的复杂或化学多样性材料。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种基于原型（prototype）的潜在空间对齐方法，可在数据稀缺条件下有效微调分子基础模型，相比标准微调基线，能量平均绝对误差（MAE）最多降低18%。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种基于原型（prototype）的潜在空间对齐方法，可在数据稀缺条件下有效微调分子基础模型，相比标准微调基线，能量平均绝对误差（MAE）最多降低18%。；创新点：提出通过识别源域与目标域之间局部结构相似性（基于原子潜在表示分组为原型），将目标域原子的能量贡献对齐到源域原型，引入归纳偏置以锚定微调表示，从而在数据稀缺时有效复用预训练知识并提升泛化能力。
papers.method_zh: 采用图神经网络（GNN）构建的等变MACE和不变SchNet模型，结合原型引导的潜在对齐方法进行微调。在rMD17和SPICE数据集上，使用不同数据预算进行性能评估。

papers.title: Synergistic approach to probing the dynamics and mechanics of patchy soft matter
papers.abstract: Tailoring microscopic details to tune bulk rheology is a key paradigm in soft matter physics, yet the vast parameter space associated with constituent interactions precludes a fully systematic approach. To address this, we have designed a synergistic strategy to explore the parameter space that comprises simulations, experimental rheology, and machine learning. As a case study, we choose DNA-based self-assembled fluids whose viscoelastic response can be fine-tuned by manipulating the base sequencing of the constituent nucleic acid nanostars. We use coarse-grained simulations, benchmarked against experimental data, to obtain the rheology of the DNA fluids, which feeds forward to a framework of Gaussian Process Regression and active learning. The latter is then used to explore the rheological design space with high predictive precision. The pipeline is designed to be deployed iteratively for the rational design and accelerated discovery of generic soft matter suspensions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（模拟+实验+机器学习）。关键词：simulations, experimental rheology, machine learning。；研究对象：基于DNA自组装的可调粘弹性软物质流体（DNA纳米星流体），属于补丁软物质体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过协同使用粗粒化模拟、实验流变学和机器学习（高斯过程回归+主动学习），能够高效探索DNA流体流变学设计空间，实现高预测精度的理性设计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过协同使用粗粒化模拟、实验流变学和机器学习（高斯过程回归+主动学习），能够高效探索DNA流体流变学设计空间，实现高预测精度的理性设计。；创新点：提出了一种可迭代部署的协同策略，将模拟、实验与机器学习结合，用于加速发现和理性设计通用软物质悬浮液的流变特性，而非依赖传统试错法。
papers.method_zh: 粗粒化模拟（coarse-grained simulations，经实验数据标定）、实验流变学（experimental rheology）、高斯过程回归（Gaussian Process Regression）与主动学习（active learning）框架。

papers.title: Universal thermokinetic decomposition of short-time information fluctuations
papers.abstract: Biological, artificial, and physical systems dissipate energy to accurately transmit information. While tools of information theory have been used to characterize information-processing capabilities, how reliably this information is acquired along individual trajectories, and which aspects require a thermodynamic cost, is an open question. In this work, we focus on the stochastic predictability of an arbitrary Langevin dynamics, defined as the pointwise mutual information between the current and future states of a system. We show that the fluctuations of predictability obey a universal thermokinetic decomposition at short times, which reveals that information fluctuations are suppressed by energy dissipation and become stronger with increased dynamical activity. Remarkably, we find that the average predictability, i.e., the short-time mutual information, does not carry any dependence on the underlying thermodynamic and kinetic features. Thus, the role of dissipation at short times is not to enhance information, but to reduce its fluctuations. Such dissipative control is effective only when instantiated by nonlinear operations. Moreover, energy consumption governs short- and long-time precision in stochastic oscillators through structurally different mechanisms that can be independently tuned. Our decomposition offers a fundamental thermodynamic basis for understanding the reliability of information transmission in nonequilibrium systems, the constraints on precision in biological systems, and the design of energy-limited control strategies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Langevin dynamics、thermodynamic basis、decomposition、theoretical framework。；研究对象：任意朗之万动力学系统中，当前状态与未来状态之间的点互信息（pointwise mutual information）所定义的随机可预测性（stochastic predictability）及其涨落。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 短时间尺度下，信息涨落服从普适的热动力学分解：能量耗散抑制信息涨落，而动力学活性增强信息涨落；但平均可预测性（即短时互信息）本身不依赖于热力学与动力学特征，因此耗散的作用并非增强信息量，而是降低其涨落。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：短时间尺度下，信息涨落服从普适的热动力学分解：能量耗散抑制信息涨落，而动力学活性增强信息涨落；但平均可预测性（即短时互信息）本身不依赖于热力学与动力学特征，因此耗散的作用并非增强信息量，而是降低其涨落。；创新点：首次揭示短时信息涨落与能量耗散、动力学活性之间的普适定量关系，并指出耗散在短时间尺度下不提升信息量而仅抑制其涨落，且该抑制效果仅当通过非线性操作实现时才有效。摘要未突出说明与已有信息论热力学工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 基于朗之万动力学的随机过程理论，对点互信息的短时涨落进行解析分解，推导出普适的热动力学表达式，并分析非线性操作、能量消耗对短时与长时精度的影响机制。

papers.title: Entropy of Liquids and Glasses from Recurring Structural Patterns
papers.abstract: We compute the low-temperature configurational entropy of a two-dimensional supercooled liquid. Our method, based on a higher-dimensional version of the Grassberger--Procaccia algorithm, can be implemented in a manner that is entirely agnostic with respect to both the dynamics and the theoretical framework, as any genuine notion of order should be. In this construction, entropy is obtained as the decay rate of recurrent structural patterns with increasing patch size, directly linking entropy reduction to the growing persistence of amorphous order. Because the method requires only particle positions, without any knowledge of the interaction potential or even of the particle sizes, it can be applied directly to both equilibrium and nonequilibrium aging configurations. The resulting configurational entropy, together with the higher-order Rényi complexities, agree quantitatively with values obtained from conventional definitions. Remarkably, the entropies measured during aging coincide with their equilibrium counterparts when compared at the same inherent-structure energy.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：compute（计算）、algorithm（算法）、configurational entropy（构型熵）、method（方法）。；研究对象：二维过冷液体和玻璃的低温构型熵，以及非平衡老化过程中的构型熵。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 基于重复结构模式（recurrent structural patterns）的熵计算方法，在平衡态和非平衡老化态中得到的构型熵与常规定义定量一致；老化过程中的熵与相同本征结构能量下的平衡态熵相等。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：基于重复结构模式（recurrent structural patterns）的熵计算方法，在平衡态和非平衡老化态中得到的构型熵与常规定义定量一致；老化过程中的熵与相同本征结构能量下的平衡态熵相等。；创新点：该方法完全独立于动力学和理论框架，是一种对“序”的纯粹几何定义，且无需任何关于相互作用势或粒子尺寸的先验知识，可直接用于非平衡老化过程。
papers.method_zh: 基于Grassberger-Procaccia算法的高维版本，仅需粒子位置信息，无需相互作用势或粒子尺寸，可直接应用于平衡和非平衡老化构型。通过重复结构模式随补丁尺寸增大而衰减的速率提取熵。

papers.title: Carrier Localization in Pnictogen-Based Chalcohalides from Defect-Bound Hot Polarons
papers.abstract: Pnictogen-based solar absorbers have gained prominence as promising nontoxic and stable alternatives to lead-halide perovskites (LHPs), but are severely limited by carrier localization, preventing their performance from approaching those of LHPs. Recent efforts have uncovered routes to overcome carrier localization, but these early efforts only considered intrinsic factors. Herein, we push beyond these limited early efforts, examining the role of defects, not only on cold carriers but also hot carriers. Focusing on the structurally one-dimensional pnictogen chalcohalide BiSBr, we find that whilst this material intrinsically does not exhibit carrier localization, vacancies introduced during synthesis or post-treatment lead to pronounced extrinsic self-trapping via the formation of defect-bound hot polarons-excited charge-carriers strongly coupled to local defect-induced vibrational modes. These above-gap defect states divert hot carriers from cooling to the band edge, thus depleting the mobile carrier population. Our findings establish the key role of defect-bound hot polarons in mediating extrinsic localization and offer new mechanistic insights into the interplay between defects, lattice coupling, and excited-state charge-carrier transport, which are critical to designing efficient perovskite-inspired solar absorbers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章（关键词：examining the role of defects, formation of defect-bound hot polarons, mechanistic insights）；研究对象：基于光族元素的硫卤化物太阳能吸收材料，具体为结构准一维的BiSBr，以及其中由缺陷导致的载流子局域化现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现BiSBr在完美晶体中本征上不表现出载流子局域化，但合成或后处理过程中引入的空位缺陷会通过形成“缺陷束缚热极化子”导致显著的非本征自陷，从而消耗移动载流子。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现BiSBr在完美晶体中本征上不表现出载流子局域化，但合成或后处理过程中引入的空位缺陷会通过形成“缺陷束缚热极化子”导致显著的非本征自陷，从而消耗移动载流子。；创新点：该工作超越了以往仅关注本征因素（如晶格畸变）对载流子局域化影响的研究，首次揭示了缺陷在热载流子（而非仅冷载流子）动力学中的关键作用，提出了“缺陷束缚热极化子”这一新机制来解释非本征的载流子局域化。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析与计算模拟（摘要未明确说明具体计算方法，如DFT等，但基于“形成缺陷束缚热极化子”和“激发态电荷载流子输运”等描述，可推断采用了第一性原理计算或相关理论模型）。
