papers.title: Field-induced multipolar character in the dipolar ground state of the honeycomb rare-earth chalcohalide NdOF
papers.abstract: Field-tunable reconstruction of crystalline electric field (CEF) doublets offers a promising avenue for inducing multipolar character, while its observation in real materials has been little explored so far. Here we establish the honeycomb rare-earth chalcohalide NdOF as such a platform. Raman spectroscopy identifies four CEF excitations at 1.7, 15.6, 19.2, and 80.9~meV, and a Zeeman--CEF analysis reproduces their nonlinear field splitting into seven branches. Magnetization and susceptibility over 0.1--9~T are well described by a CEF model for the total angular momentum $J = 9/2$ manifold, confirming the robustness of the extracted CEF scheme. These results demonstrate a field-driven continuous evolution of the ground-state doublet from dipolar to dipolar-multipolar character, with pressure providing a complementary tuning knob, establishing NdOF as a model system for exploring the controlled induction of multipolar components in rare-earth magnets.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：Raman spectroscopy、Magnetization、susceptibility）；研究对象：蜂窝状稀土硫卤化物NdOF，具体研究其晶体电场（CEF）双重态在磁场下的多极特性演化。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过拉曼光谱和磁化率测量，证实NdOF的基态双重态在磁场下可从纯偶极特性连续演变为偶极-多极混合特性，且压力可作为额外调控手段。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过拉曼光谱和磁化率测量，证实NdOF的基态双重态在磁场下可从纯偶极特性连续演变为偶极-多极混合特性，且压力可作为额外调控手段。；创新点：首次在真实材料中观察到磁场可调谐的CEF双重态重构，并实现从偶极到偶极-多极特性的连续演化，为稀土磁体中多极组分的可控诱导提供了模型体系。
papers.method_zh: 拉曼光谱（识别CEF激发能级）、Zeeman-CEF分析（拟合非线性场分裂）、磁化率和磁化强度测量（0.1–9 T范围，基于总角动量J=9/2的CEF模型）。

papers.title: Topological spin-texture transitions in van der Waals magnets revealed by X-ray Fourier transform holography
papers.abstract: Nontrivial topological spin-textures, such as skyrmions, merons, bimerons, and skyrmioniums, are envisioned as robust building blocks for future memory and logic devices. Controllable transformations between these states require a quantum-mechanical description of electronic degrees of freedom and atomic-scale insight beyond existing phenomenological models. Here, we report an atomic-scale investigation of topological phase transitions and their protection in the two-dimensional van der Waals ferromagnet Fe$_3$GeTe$_2$ (FGT) using a combined experimental-theoretical approach. Synchrotron-based Fourier transform holography directly images labyrinth domains, isolated skyrmions, mixed labyrinth-skyrmion phases, and skyrmion bags with high spatial resolution. We compare these observations to simulations based on an electronic lattice Hamiltonian that captures both metallicity and relativistic spin-orbit coupling in FGT. By systematically exploring a broad range of temperatures and magnetic fields, we map the mechanisms governing topological transitions and their stability. This sequential-integrated experimental-theoretical framework advances understanding of spin-texture interactions and enables precise control of external tuning parameters. Our results establish a platform for creating, stabilizing, and manipulating topological states, paving the way for engineered spin-texture transitions in next-generation spintronic technologies.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论/计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“combined experimental-theoretical approach”，实验部分使用同步辐射傅里叶变换全息术，理论部分基于电子晶格哈密顿量进行模拟。；研究对象：二维范德瓦尔斯铁磁体Fe₃GeTe₂（FGT）中的拓扑自旋纹理（如斯格明子、meron、bimeron、skyrmionium）及其拓扑相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过原子尺度的实验与理论结合，揭示了FGT中从迷宫畴到孤立斯格明子、混合迷宫-斯格明子相以及斯格明子袋的拓扑相变及其稳定性机制，并建立了通过温度和磁场精确调控这些拓扑态的平台。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过原子尺度的实验与理论结合，揭示了FGT中从迷宫畴到孤立斯格明子、混合迷宫-斯格明子相以及斯格明子袋的拓扑相变及其稳定性机制，并建立了通过温度和磁场精确调控这些拓扑态的平台。；创新点：实现了对二维范德瓦尔斯磁体中拓扑自旋纹理相变的原子尺度直接成像，并建立了将金属性与自旋-轨道耦合纳入统一描述的电子晶格哈密顿量模拟框架，从而系统性地揭示了拓扑转变的机制及其稳定性，超越了现有唯象模型。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段：基于同步辐射的X射线傅里叶变换全息术（Fourier transform holography），直接成像高空间分辨率的自旋纹理。理论方法：基于电子晶格哈密顿量的模拟，该哈密顿量同时捕捉了FGT的金属性和相对论性自旋-轨道耦合。

papers.title: Charged Abelian Higgs phase transitions in three-dimensional compact lattice U(1) gauge models with multicharge scalar matter
papers.abstract: We consider three-dimensional (3D) lattice Abelian Higgs models, with compact U(1) gauge variables coupled to a doubly-charged $N$-component complex scalar field (CLAH). We focus on their phase transitions between the disordered-confined (DC) and ordered-deconfined (OD) phases. When they are continuous they belong to the 3D Abelian Higgs (AH) universality class associated with the stable charged fixed point (CFP) of the renormalization-group flow of the 3D AH field theory, or scalar electrodynamics, describing $N$-component complex scalar fields minimally coupled to a U(1) gauge field. This CFP exists only for a sufficiently large number of components, i.e., $N \ge N_d^*$, where the integer $N_d^*$ depends on the spatial dimension $d$ (for example $N_4^*=183$). To estimate $N_3^*$, we look for the minimum number $N_{\rm cL}$ of scalar components of 3D doubly-charged CLAH models developing continuous transitions along their DC-OD transition line. For this purpose, we present finite-size scaling analyses of Monte Carlo simulations for $N\in[4,10]$, up to lattice sizes $L\approx 100$. The results provide evidence of continuous DC-OD transitions for $N=10$, and weak first-order transitions for $N\le 7$. They are not conclusive for $N=8,\,9$. Therefore, we estimate $N_{\rm cL}=9(1)$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：Monte Carlo simulations、finite-size scaling、renormalization-group flow。；研究对象：三维紧致U(1)格点规范模型与双电荷N分量复标量场耦合体系（CLAH模型）中从无序-禁闭相（DC）到有序-退禁闭相（OD）的相变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于N=10的CLAH模型，DC-OD相变为连续相变，属于三维阿贝尔-希格斯（AH）普适类；对于N≤7，相变为弱一级相变；N=8、9的结果不明确。由此估计出三维双电荷CLAH模型出现连续相变的最小标量分量数N_cL = 9(1)。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于N=10的CLAH模型，DC-OD相变为连续相变，属于三维阿贝尔-希格斯（AH）普适类；对于N≤7，相变为弱一级相变；N=8、9的结果不明确。由此估计出三维双电荷CLAH模型出现连续相变的最小标量分量数N_cL = 9(1)。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用蒙特卡洛模拟，对N=4至10的体系进行有限尺寸标度分析，最大格点尺寸L≈100。

papers.title: Macroscopic evidence of spatial modulation of conductivity in a microtextured ferromagnetic film
papers.abstract: A 75 nm-thick Fe0.5Pt0.5 film is a ferromagnetic metal showing striped magnetic domains in remanence at room temperature. The magnetoresistance is characterized by varying the external temperature and the in-plane magnetic field intensity, thereby affecting its magnetic structure. Qualitatively, the resistivity is well described by using the generalized Ohm's law. High-field magnetotransport properties are successfully explained by considering the competition between the expected metallic behavior and the electron-magnon interaction. In the low-field condition, we size the contribution of the magnetic texture to the macroscopic magnetotransport response by introducing a new quantity. Consistent with the microscopic modulation of the lateral conduction, low-field measurements reveal inhomogeneities attributed to the spatial distribution of ferromagnetic domains and domain walls. By carefully analyzing the macroscopic response near the coercive field, the additional contribution to the resistivity is attributed to the domain walls themselves. In fact, this term could surpass the anisotropic term at low temperatures. In summary, this study demonstrates that spatial magnetic inhomogeneities are not only macroscopically measurable but also comparable in magnitude to other regularly considered terms, mainly at low temperatures.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中描述了薄膜的制备（75 nm-thick Fe0.5Pt0.5 film）、磁电阻测量（magnetoresistance is characterized）以及通过改变温度和磁场进行实验。；研究对象：研究对象是厚度为75纳米的铁磁性Fe₀.₅Pt₀.₅薄膜，具体关注其室温下呈现的条纹状磁畴结构（striped magnetic domains）以及由此引起的空间电导率调制（spatial modulation of conductivity）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该工作通过宏观磁电阻测量，证明了微结构铁磁薄膜中由磁畴和畴壁引起的空间电导率不均匀性不仅是宏观可测的，而且其贡献在低温下可与各向异性磁电阻等其他常规项相比拟。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该工作通过宏观磁电阻测量，证明了微结构铁磁薄膜中由磁畴和畴壁引起的空间电导率不均匀性不仅是宏观可测的，而且其贡献在低温下可与各向异性磁电阻等其他常规项相比拟。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体区别，但核心创新在于：通过分析低场和矫顽场附近的宏观输运响应，将电阻率的额外贡献明确归因于畴壁本身（domain walls themselves），并指出该贡献在低温下可能超过各向异性磁电阻项。这为宏观测量微观磁结构对电输运的影响提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 主要实验手段是变温、变面内磁场的磁电阻测量（magnetoresistance characterization）。理论分析上，定性使用广义欧姆定律（generalized Ohm's law）描述电阻率；在高场下，通过考虑金属行为与电子-磁子相互作用（electron-magnon interaction）的竞争来解释输运性质；在低场下，引入了一个新的物理量来量化磁织构（magnetic texture）对宏观磁电阻的贡献。

papers.title: Estimates of ground state energies for the quantum SK and 2D-EA model, using deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo mean-field annealing dynamics
papers.abstract: We perform a large scale simulation of quantum annealing in the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) spin glass up to a system size $N=40000$ to estimate its ground state energy using the deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo mean-field Ising dynamics, extending the earlier results (reported in Eur. Phys. J. B {\bf 98}, 226 (2025)). Here we numerically solve the deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo annealing dynamics to obtain the spin configurations and subsequently the ground state energy for a given system size at the end of the annealing (to the desired quantum system at the corresponding values of the transverse field), starting from a quantum paramagnetic state. The method shows high efficiency, with an overall algorithmic cost of $O(N^3)$ in estimating the energy of the ground state. We later extend this method to study the ground state energy of the Edwards-Anderson (EA) spin glass on a square lattice.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：large scale simulation、numerically solve、algorithmic cost。；研究对象：量子 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick (SK) 自旋玻璃和二维 Edwards-Anderson (EA) 自旋玻璃的基态能量。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用 deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo 平均场退火动力学，对 SK 模型（系统尺寸达 N=40000）和二维 EA 模型进行了大规模模拟，成功估计了其基态能量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用 deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo 平均场退火动力学，对 SK 模型（系统尺寸达 N=40000）和二维 EA 模型进行了大规模模拟，成功估计了其基态能量。；创新点：将 deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo 平均场退火动力学方法扩展到更大系统尺寸（N=40000）的 SK 模型，并首次将该方法应用于二维 EA 模型的基态能量研究。
papers.method_zh: 数值求解 deGennes-Suzuki-Kubo 平均场 Ising 动力学方程，从量子顺磁态开始退火，最终获得自旋构型并计算基态能量。算法整体计算复杂度为 O(N³)。

papers.title: Enhanced Density Fluctuations Near a Disordered Chiral Topological Transition
papers.abstract: The universal statistics of density fluctuations of localized quantum states may offer unprecedented opportunities to probe and understand quantum transport in connection with dimensionality, coherence, symmetry and disorder. To date, the possible role of topological phase transitions in the fluctuation statistics is not studied yet. Using a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger chain subject to off-diagonal disorder (so that chiral symmetry is preserved), this work investigates how a disorder driven topological phase transition impacts on the spatial fluctuations of the logarithmic wave-packet density $\ln P(r)$ at distance $r$ from the initial excitation. Away from the transition, in both topological and trivial localized phases, the standard deviation follows the conventional one-dimensional scaling $σ[\ln P(r)]\sim r^θ$ with $θ\simeq 1/2$. Near the transition, however, the fluctuation growth is enhanced: the fitted exponent $θ$ increases above $1/2$ in a nonmonotonic manner before returning close to $1/2$ at criticality. We interpret this behavior from the energy-resolved density of states and localization length. Near the transition, several energy sectors carry appreciable spectral weight and exhibit competitive decay rates, preventing a single localization scale from dominating the accessible wave-packet tail and thereby enhancing the fluctuations of $\ln P(r)$. Our results establish wave-packet fluctuation statistics as a dynamical diagnostic of disordered chiral topological transitions and motivate broader studies of fluctuation phenomena in disordered topological quantum systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：使用Su-Schrieffer-Heeger链模型进行数值模拟，分析波包密度涨落统计，未提及实验手段。；研究对象：无序手性拓扑相变附近的密度涨落现象，具体体系为具有非对角无序的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）链（保持手性对称性）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在无序驱动的手性拓扑相变附近，对数波包密度涨落的标准差增长指数θ从常规一维标度值1/2增大至超过1/2，呈现非单调行为，而在临界点附近又恢复至约1/2。该增强源于多个能量区间同时贡献显著谱权重并具有竞争性衰减率，导致单一局域化尺度无法主导波包尾部。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在无序驱动的手性拓扑相变附近，对数波包密度涨落的标准差增长指数θ从常规一维标度值1/2增大至超过1/2，呈现非单调行为，而在临界点附近又恢复至约1/2。该增强源于多个能量区间同时贡献显著谱权重并具有竞争性衰减率，导致单一局域化尺度无法主导波包尾部。；创新点：首次研究了拓扑相变对局域量子态密度涨落统计的影响，建立了波包涨落统计作为无序手性拓扑相变动力学诊断工具的新方法。
papers.method_zh: 采用具有非对角无序的Su-Schrieffer-Heeger链模型（保持手性对称性），通过数值计算分析对数波包密度ln P(r)的空间涨落，并利用能量分辨态密度和局域化长度进行解释。

papers.title: The flow deep within granular piles
papers.abstract: Grain piles embody the complex mechanics and kinematics of disordered granular materials, including solid-like and fluid-like behaviours, complex kinematics, and preparation history-dependent stress variation. It is widely believed that the bulk of a growing pile is static and flow is confined to a thin layer at the surface, but very few studies have investigated the subsurface kinematics. Here we study the flow within conical grain piles by flow imaging experiments and particle dynamics simulations. We provide direct evidence of continuous plastic flow deep within piles as grains are poured from above, and show that the direction of flow varies smoothly from vertical at the symmetry axis to parallel to the surface at the periphery. Our findings provide new insight into the kinematics and rheology of granular media, including the nature of creep in seemingly solid-like regions, and have important implications for geophysical phenomena such as landslides and industrial processes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验与计算结合）。判断依据关键词：flow imaging experiments, particle dynamics simulations。；研究对象：颗粒堆积体（granular piles）内部的流动行为，特别是锥形堆积体在顶部持续倾倒颗粒时的次表层运动学。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提供了颗粒堆积体内部存在持续塑性流动的直接证据，并揭示流动方向从对称轴处的垂直方向平滑过渡到边缘处的平行于表面方向。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提供了颗粒堆积体内部存在持续塑性流动的直接证据，并揭示流动方向从对称轴处的垂直方向平滑过渡到边缘处的平行于表面方向。；创新点：首次通过直接实验观测和模拟，证明在看似静止的颗粒堆积体内部深处存在连续塑性流动，突破了以往认为流动仅局限于表面薄层的传统认知。
papers.method_zh: 流动成像实验（flow imaging experiments）与颗粒动力学模拟（particle dynamics simulations）。

papers.title: Optical Cooling of Nuclear Spins in a CdTe/CdZnTe Quantum Well: The Impact of Kinetic Local Fields on Cooling Efficiency
papers.abstract: The efficiency of optical cooling of nuclear spins in a CdTe/CdZnTe quantum well is investigated as a function of an external magnetic field. Our results confirm that there is indeed an optimal external magnetic field for optical cooling. We associate it with the kinetic local field $B_{KL}$ defined by the heating rate of the spin-spin reservoir due to the fluctuations of the hyperfine interaction. We also propose an experimental technique for measuring $B_{KL}$. For our sample we find that $B_{KL}=1.0\pm0.4$ G and it is independent of the electron polarization and pump power. The measured values of the kinetic local fields are in good agreement with a theoretical calculation $B_{KL} = 0.7$ G, taking into account indirect spin-spin interactions of Cd and Te nuclear spins and their considerably different hyperfine constants. The hyperfine constants of the magnetic isotopes of Cd and Te in CdTe are estimated.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：investigated, experimental technique, measured values, our sample）；研究对象：CdTe/CdZnTe量子阱中核自旋的光学冷却效率，以及动力学局域场对冷却效率的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证实了光学冷却核自旋存在最优外磁场，该最优场与动力学局域场 \( B_{KL} \) 相关；实验测得 \( B_{KL} = 1.0 \pm 0.4 \) G，与理论计算值 0.7 G 吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证实了光学冷却核自旋存在最优外磁场，该最优场与动力学局域场 \( B_{KL} \) 相关；实验测得 \( B_{KL} = 1.0 \pm 0.4 \) G，与理论计算值 0.7 G 吻合。；创新点：将光学冷却的最优外磁场与动力学局域场 \( B_{KL} \) 关联起来，并提出了测量该局域场的实验方法；同时估算了CdTe中磁性同位素Cd和Te的超精细常数。
papers.method_zh: 通过改变外磁场测量核自旋光学冷却效率，提出了一种测量动力学局域场 \( B_{KL} \) 的实验技术，并基于Cd和Te核自旋的间接自旋-自旋相互作用及超精细常数差异进行了理论计算。

papers.title: Microfluidic Oscillatory Rheology of Transported Soft Particles
papers.abstract: Microfluidic channels have emerged as useful tools to control dynamic forcing on transported microscale objects, as encountered in emulsions, biological flows, and other soft matter systems. Tailored channel designs enable precise interfacial and bulk rheological measurements of complex materials over a wide range of forcing timescales. After a brief overview of recent experiments illustrating these techniques, we discuss perspectives for future research in this direction, including the study of lubrication films in highly confined droplets, the measurement of fast relaxation dynamics of complex interfaces, and the high-throughput rheological characterization of microscopic soft matter systems ranging from single macromolecules to cells.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（综述与展望）。关键词：overview（概述）、perspectives（展望）、discuss（讨论）。；研究对象：微流控通道中输运的软颗粒（如乳液、生物流体中的液滴、细胞、大分子等）的振荡流变学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体物理结论，主要指出微流控通道可用于对输运中的微观软物质施加动态力，并实现宽时间尺度下的界面与体相流变测量。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体物理结论，主要指出微流控通道可用于对输运中的微观软物质施加动态力，并实现宽时间尺度下的界面与体相流变测量。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但指出该方向未来可研究高度受限液滴中的润滑膜、复杂界面的快速弛豫动力学，以及从单分子到细胞的高通量流变表征。
papers.method_zh: 微流控振荡流变学（Microfluidic Oscillatory Rheology），利用定制设计的微通道对输运中的软颗粒施加动态力，进行界面与体相流变测量。

papers.title: Accelerated Discovery of Nitrogen-Coordinated Dual-Atom Hydrogen Evolution Reaction Electrocatalysts via Machine Learning Potentials
papers.abstract: The hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) is central to sustainable hydrogen production, and nitrogen coordinated dual atom catalysts (DACs) offer a promising route to noble metal activity at low cost. Yet their vast compositional and coordination design space remains underexplored, as density functional theory (DFT) screening at scale is prohibitive. Here, we map the HER landscape of graphene supported TM2@Nx-Gr DACs, screening 23 transition metals across 20 nitrogen coordination motifs using a machine learning potential (MLP) benchmarked against DFT. Intermediate coordination (2N to 4N) consistently yields near-optimal ΔGH*, with Ti2@2Na, Mn2@2Na, Fe2@2Na, Cu2@2Na, Rh2@2Na, Zr2@2Na, Zr2@2Nb, Zr2@2Nc, Nb2@2Nc, Zr2@2Nd, Mn2@2Ne, Mn2@2Nf, Ti2@3Na, Au2@3Na, Fe2@3Na, Pd2@3Nb, Rh2@3Nc, Rh2@3Nd, Au2@3Nd, V2@4Na, Ti2@4Nb, Pd2@4Nb, Ti2@4Nc, Cr2@4Nd, Ni2@4Nd, Cu2@4Nd emerging as standout, synthesizable candidates, most exhibiting metallic or narrow gap (<0.25 eV) character. The MLP reaches near-DFT accuracy, with a mean absolute error of 80 meV for Gibbs binding free energies at orders of magnitude lower computational cost, establishing MLP driven screening as a practical engine for next-generation catalyst discovery.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：machine learning potential (MLP)、density functional theory (DFT) screening、Gibbs binding free energies。；研究对象：石墨烯负载的氮配位双原子催化剂（TM2@Nx-Gr DACs），用于析氢反应（HER）。具体涉及23种过渡金属和20种氮配位构型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中等配位数（2N至4N）的氮配位双原子催化剂普遍具有接近最优的氢吸附吉布斯自由能（ΔGH*），并筛选出26种性能突出且可合成的候选催化剂，多数具有金属性或窄带隙（<0.25 eV）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中等配位数（2N至4N）的氮配位双原子催化剂普遍具有接近最优的氢吸附吉布斯自由能（ΔGH*），并筛选出26种性能突出且可合成的候选催化剂，多数具有金属性或窄带隙（<0.25 eV）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用机器学习势（MLP）进行高通量筛选，并以密度泛函理论（DFT）作为基准验证。MLP计算吉布斯结合自由能的平均绝对误差为80 meV，计算成本比DFT低数个数量级。

papers.title: Breaking Bipartite and Time Reversal Symmetries by Fusing Porphine Unit in-between two Zigzag-edge Graphene Nanoribbons
papers.abstract: Hybrid structure of two zigzag-edge graphene nanoribbons with a fused porphine ring in between, results in two distinct nearly degenerate ground states: a semiconducting antiferromagnetic state and a conducting ferromagnetic state with unequal and opposite Fermi velocities of majority and minority spins, the former having slightly higher stability. Such ground states result from the broken bipartite symmetry induced by the porphine ring. The incorporation of different transition metal atoms in the porphine cavity reduces their energy difference but keeps their electronic properties mostly unchanged. The splitting of the $d$-orbitals in the distorted square-planar ligand field of porphine produces a high spin ground state that breaks the global time reversal symmetry ($\mathcal{T}$). The opposite Fermi velocities of the majority and minority spins in the ferromagnetic ground state and lower sensitivity of the conducting majority spin channel to the edge disorder, make this class of quasi-one-dimensional hybrid structures promising for dual spin-filtering device applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中未提及实验手段，主要基于电子结构计算和对称性分析（如“broken bipartite symmetry”“splitting of the d-orbitals”）。；研究对象：由两个锯齿型石墨烯纳米带（zigzag-edge graphene nanoribbons）中间融合一个卟啉环（porphine ring）构成的准一维杂化结构，以及在该卟啉空腔中嵌入不同过渡金属原子后的体系。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该杂化结构存在两个近简并的基态：一个半导体反铁磁态和一个导电铁磁态（后者中多数自旋与少数自旋具有大小相等、符号相反的费米速度），且前者稳定性略高。卟啉环破坏了二分对称性，而过渡金属d轨道在畸变四方平面配位场中的分裂产生高自旋基态，从而打破全局时间反演对称性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该杂化结构存在两个近简并的基态：一个半导体反铁磁态和一个导电铁磁态（后者中多数自旋与少数自旋具有大小相等、符号相反的费米速度），且前者稳定性略高。卟啉环破坏了二分对称性，而过渡金属d轨道在畸变四方平面配位场中的分裂产生高自旋基态，从而打破全局时间反演对称性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的电子结构计算，具体涉及对称性分析（二分对称性、时间反演对称性）、配位场理论（d轨道分裂）以及边缘无序对输运影响的评估。

papers.title: Criticality in the disordered $N$-color Ashkin-Teller model
papers.abstract: The $N$-color Ashkin-Teller model corresponds to $N$ Ising models coupled by four-spin interactions. We consider the two-dimensional case in presence of quenched disorder and use scale invariant scattering theory to determine all the solutions of the exact renormalization group fixed points equations. The weak disorder sector is characterized by a solution that, for any fixed $N$ larger than 1, is a line of fixed points with Ising thermal exponents and continuously varying magnetic exponents. The number of fixed point solutions allowed by the symmetries of the model increases at strong disorder illustrating the growing dependence on the distributions of the two random couplings. The presence of some critical exponents which do not depend on the symmetry parameter $N$ confirms this type of superuniversality as a peculiar feature of random criticality.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：scale invariant scattering theory、renormalization group fixed points equations。；研究对象：二维无序N色Ashkin-Teller模型（由N个伊辛模型通过四自旋相互作用耦合而成），研究其临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱无序区域，对于任意N>1，存在一条固定点线，具有伊辛热力学指数和连续变化的磁指数；在强无序区域，固定点解的数量增加，且部分临界指数不依赖于对称性参数N，体现了随机临界性中的超普适性特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱无序区域，对于任意N>1，存在一条固定点线，具有伊辛热力学指数和连续变化的磁指数；在强无序区域，固定点解的数量增加，且部分临界指数不依赖于对称性参数N，体现了随机临界性中的超普适性特征。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 利用标度不变散射理论，求解精确重整化群不动点方程，分析无序对临界行为的影响。

papers.title: A trick of the tail: how electrostatics helps a DNA repair enzyme to localize on nucleosomes
papers.abstract: Electrostatic interactions are key to the recognition processes of proteins and DNA and have been previously documented for the action of repair enzymes. Uracil-DNA glycosylase (UDG) is the first in a sequence of enzymes that act in the base-excision repair process (BER) and whose task is the extraction of uracil bases from nuclear DNA. The question of how the molecule targets uracil bases in chromatin, in particular in the condensed protein-DNA complexes of nucleosomes, has only recently become a subject of detailed studies. Here we show that the presence of an arginine anchor motif on the N-terminal tail of UDG can favor its localization on nucleosomes by binding to their acidic patches on their top and bottom surfaces via electrostatic interactions. We argue that this mechanism can play a key role in the detection of uracil defects in nucleosomal DNA.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中使用了“show”、“argue”等动词，描述了通过计算或理论模型（如静电相互作用分析）得出的结论，未提及具体实验操作。；研究对象：DNA修复酶（尿嘧啶-DNA糖基化酶，UDG）在核小体上的定位机制。具体物理现象是：静电相互作用如何帮助UDG酶在染色质（特别是核小体）上识别并定位到尿嘧啶缺陷位点。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: UDG酶N端尾巴上的精氨酸锚定基序，可以通过静电相互作用与核小体顶部和底部的酸性斑块结合，从而促进该酶在核小体上的定位。这一机制可能在核小体DNA中尿嘧啶缺陷的检测中起关键作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：UDG酶N端尾巴上的精氨酸锚定基序，可以通过静电相互作用与核小体顶部和底部的酸性斑块结合，从而促进该酶在核小体上的定位。这一机制可能在核小体DNA中尿嘧啶缺陷的检测中起关键作用。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。该工作将UDG酶在染色质环境（特别是核小体）中的定位机制，归因于其N端尾巴与核小体酸性斑块之间的静电相互作用，这为理解修复酶如何在高度压缩的染色质中寻找靶点提供了新的视角。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体的研究方法（如分子动力学模拟、蒙特卡洛模拟、泊松-玻尔兹曼方程求解等）。仅提及基于“静电相互作用”的分析和论证。

papers.title: Zeeman Pumping of Higgs Bosons in the Balian--Werthamer State
papers.abstract: Based on equations of motion of an SO(5) pseudo-spin, we demonstrate a quantum quench protocol using the magnetic pulse to excite an $\textit{undamped}$ heavy Higgs boson in the Balian--Werthamer superfluid (or superconductor). To achieve that, it is essential to include the dipolar interaction in the effective Hamiltonian and to calculate the ground state self-consistently. The pumped heavy Higgs mode has the twisted angular momentum $J=2$ with the projection $J^{\,}_z=0$ and couples to a well-known light Higgs mode ($J=1$, $J^{\,}_z=0$). The numerical method of 26-point Lebedev quadrature is implemented concretely so as to observe the real-time coupled oscillation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：基于SO(5)赝自旋的运动方程，提出量子淬火协议，并使用数值方法进行模拟。；研究对象：Balian-Werthamer态（超流或超导态）中的希格斯玻色子激发。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过特定的磁脉冲量子淬火协议，可以在Balian-Werthamer态中激发一个无阻尼的重希格斯玻色子。该重希格斯模式具有扭曲的角动量（J=2，J_z=0），并与已知的轻希格斯模式（J=1，J_z=0）耦合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过特定的磁脉冲量子淬火协议，可以在Balian-Werthamer态中激发一个无阻尼的重希格斯玻色子。该重希格斯模式具有扭曲的角动量（J=2，J_z=0），并与已知的轻希格斯模式（J=1，J_z=0）耦合。；创新点：提出了一种利用磁脉冲激发无阻尼重希格斯玻色子的具体协议，并揭示了该重模式与轻模式之间的耦合关系。摘要未突出说明与以往工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 基于SO(5)赝自旋的运动方程进行理论推导；在有效哈密顿量中引入偶极相互作用，并自洽地计算基态；采用26点Lebedev求积法进行数值模拟，以观察实时的耦合振荡。

papers.title: Geometry and localization: Probing Localization Landscape Theory on the Bethe Lattice
papers.abstract: The Localization Landscape Theory (LLT) offers a classical analogy for understanding Anderson localization through an effective confining potential, whose percolation threshold has been proposed to mark the mobility edge. While this correspondence shows striking numerical agreement in three dimensions, its theoretical foundations remain an open question. In this work, we extend the analysis of the LLT on the Bethe lattice presented in~\cite{Tonetti2026}. In this setting in both the Anderson localization transition and the LLT percolation problem admit exact solutions. Our analysis reveals that the two transitions are distinct, with markedly different critical behaviors. Notably, the LLT percolation transition falls into the standard mean-field universality class, in sharp contrast with the unconventional critical behavior of the Anderson transition on the Bethe lattice. Nonetheless, the LLT framework reproduces several exact results, capturing nontrivial features of the very low-disorder regime: it predicts the position of the isolated eigenvalue, the minimal disorder at which both the LLT percolation curve and the mobility edge first appear, and the Aizenman--Warzel lower bound for localization. We also study the dependence of the LLT percolation threshold on the energy shift, evaluate the LLT prediction for the Density of States, and derive several results on the statistical properties of the variables controlling the problem. Finally, we develop an extreme-value analysis showing that the LLT prediction for the Density of States overestimates the amplitude of the tails close to the boundary of the continuous spectrum. These findings provide an exact analytical benchmark showing that, despite its geometric appeal, the LLT does not generally reproduce the quantum critical properties of Anderson localization, while still offering a powerful tool to understand its very low-disorder regime.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“extend the analysis”“admit exact solutions”“develop an extreme-value analysis”等理论推导与解析分析关键词。；研究对象：Bethe格点上的Anderson局域化与局域化景观理论（LLT）的渗透问题，重点比较两种相变（Anderson局域化转变与LLT渗透转变）的临界行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Bethe格点上，LLT渗透转变与Anderson局域化转变是两种不同的相变，具有截然不同的临界行为：LLT渗透转变属于标准平均场普适类，而Anderson转变则表现出非常规临界行为。尽管如此，LLT框架仍能准确再现极低无序区间的若干精确结果，包括孤立本征值位置、最小无序阈值以及Aizenman–Warzel下界。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Bethe格点上，LLT渗透转变与Anderson局域化转变是两种不同的相变，具有截然不同的临界行为：LLT渗透转变属于标准平均场普适类，而Anderson转变则表现出非常规临界行为。尽管如此，LLT框架仍能准确再现极低无序区间的若干精确结果，包括孤立本征值位置、最小无序阈值以及Aizenman–Warzel下界。；创新点：在Bethe格点上首次严格证明LLT渗透转变与Anderson局域化转变属于不同普适类，并系统评估了LLT在极低无序区间的预测能力与局限性，为理解LLT的适用范围提供了精确解析基准。
papers.method_zh: 基于Bethe格点上的解析求解，包括：LLT渗透问题的精确解、Anderson局域化转变的精确解、极值统计分析、态密度（Density of States）的LLT预测及其与精确结果的对比。

papers.title: Exact Solution of the Discrete Wormlike Chain Model
papers.abstract: We present an exact solution of the discrete wormlike chain (DWLC) model describing a single semiflexible polymer under arbitrary external force. Through exact closure relations between pair angular correlations and single-site angular densities, we derive complete self-consistent equations determining the free energy functional and all thermodynamic properties without additional approximations. The key innovation is an exact closure relation connecting the pair angular distribution function to the single-site angular density, enabling the exact integration of the entropy functional. We validate the theoretical framework against known limits (rigid rod and random coil regimes), compare with continuum wormlike chain predictions, and demonstrate excellent agreement with recent theoretical results (Marantan \& Mahadevan, 2018). The approach naturally extends to multiple-chain systems and phase transitions, positioning it as a versatile framework for understanding polymer mechanics from the nanoscale to the macroscopic limit.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“exact solution”（精确解）、“derive complete self-consistent equations”（推导完整的自洽方程）、“theoretical framework”（理论框架），未提及任何实验或数值模拟计算。；研究对象：离散蠕虫状链（DWLC）模型，该模型用于描述单根半柔性聚合物在任意外力作用下的行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过推导出对关联函数与单点角密度之间的精确闭合关系，实现了对离散蠕虫状链模型的精确求解，从而无需额外近似即可获得自由能泛函和所有热力学性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过推导出对关联函数与单点角密度之间的精确闭合关系，实现了对离散蠕虫状链模型的精确求解，从而无需额外近似即可获得自由能泛函和所有热力学性质。；创新点：提出了一个连接对角度分布函数与单点角密度的精确闭合关系，这是实现熵泛函精确积分的关键，使得该模型能够在不引入额外近似的情况下被精确求解。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。具体为：利用对关联函数与单点角密度之间的精确闭合关系，建立并求解描述自由能泛函的自洽方程组，从而精确积分熵泛函。

papers.title: Spin-Orbit Coupling Effects on the Structural and Electronic Properties of Planar Pentagonal p-MS$_{2}$ (M = Si, Ge, and Pb)
papers.abstract: Spin-orbit coupling (SOC) plays an important role in determining the structural and electronic properties of recently proposed two-dimensional planar pentagonal materials. In this work, density functional theory calculations are employed to investigate SOC effects in p-MS$_{2}$ systems (M = Si, Ge, and Pb). Our results indicate that the p-SiS$_{2}$ structure is likely unstable, except for p-GeS$_{2}$ and p-PbS$_{2}$. A detailed j-resolved (total angular momentum) orbital analysis reveals that SOC enhances electronic localization, leading to a slight structural contraction and a reconstruction of electronic states near the Fermi level, this effect becoming stronger for heavier M atoms. While p-GeS$_{2}$ remains metallic, SOC drives a metal-semiconductor transition in p-PbS$_{2}$ and opening a quasi-direct band gap of about 0.475 eV. In addition, the conduction band minimum state of p-PbS$_{2}$ exhibits pronounced anisotropy along the S-S bonds. These findings provide insight into SOC-driven structural and electronic reconstruction in planar pentagonal chalcogenides p-MS$_{2}$ and suggest that p-PbS$_{2}$ may be a promising candidate for gas-sensing applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词“density functional theory calculations”（密度泛函理论计算）。；研究对象：二维平面五边形材料p-MS₂（M = Si, Ge, Pb）中自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）对其结构和电子性质的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: SOC导致p-PbS₂发生金属-半导体转变，打开约0.475 eV的准直接带隙；而p-GeS₂保持金属性，p-SiS₂结构不稳定。SOC还增强了电子局域化，引起轻微结构收缩和费米能级附近电子态重构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：SOC导致p-PbS₂发生金属-半导体转变，打开约0.475 eV的准直接带隙；而p-GeS₂保持金属性，p-SiS₂结构不稳定。SOC还增强了电子局域化，引起轻微结构收缩和费米能级附近电子态重构。；创新点：首次系统研究了SOC对平面五边形硫族化物p-MS₂体系结构和电子性质的重构作用，并发现p-PbS₂在SOC下转变为半导体，具有潜在的气敏应用前景。
papers.method_zh: 密度泛函理论（DFT）计算，并进行了j分辨（总角动量）轨道分析。

papers.title: Transition metal (group V) doping induced spin and valley polarization in MoS$_2$ monolayer
papers.abstract: Doping in two-dimensional materials has emerged as an effective tool for modulating their electronic properties and thereby enabling their multifunctional applications. In this work, we present a first-principles study on induced effective magnetic moment and metallicity in MoS$_2$ monolayer by substitutional doping of group-5 transition metal (TM) elements -- V, Nb and Ta. From our study, we observe that the V doping induces half-metallicity, whereas metallic characteristics are observed in the case of Nb and Ta doping. Moreover, V and Ta-doped MoS$_2$ monolayers are observed to show total induced magnetic moments of 0.922 and 0.624 $μ_{\rm B}$, respectively. Importantly, the combined effects of strong spin-orbit coupling (SOC), broken inversion symmetry, and structural asymmetry is observed to lead to a permanent valley polarization in the V- and Ta-MoS$_2$ systems. In particular, we observed a valley polarization of 121 and 21 meVs for V and Ta-doped MoS$_2$, respectively. Furthermore, an enhanced piezoelectric coefficient for the doped systems is observed compared to pristine MoS$_2$. Notably, the simultaneous presence of half-metallicity, substantial valley polarization, and enhanced piezoelectricity in V-doped MoS$_2$ establishes this system as a promising multifunctional platform for next-generation spintronic, valleytronic, and piezoelectric nanodevices. Overall, our findings provide fundamental insights into engineering coupled spin-valley-mechanical degrees of freedom in two-dimensional materials for advanced quantum and nanoelectronic applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据：关键词为“first-principles study”（第一性原理研究）。；研究对象：论文研究的具体材料是过渡金属（V、Nb、Ta）替代掺杂的单层MoS₂，以及由此诱导的自旋极化、谷极化和压电特性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: V掺杂使MoS₂单层呈现半金属性，而Nb和Ta掺杂使其呈现金属性；V和Ta掺杂的MoS₂分别产生0.922 μ_B和0.624 μ_B的磁矩，并由于强自旋-轨道耦合、反演对称性破缺和结构不对称性，实现了永久性的谷极化（V掺杂：121 meV；Ta掺杂：21 meV）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：V掺杂使MoS₂单层呈现半金属性，而Nb和Ta掺杂使其呈现金属性；V和Ta掺杂的MoS₂分别产生0.922 μ_B和0.624 μ_B的磁矩，并由于强自旋-轨道耦合、反演对称性破缺和结构不对称性，实现了永久性的谷极化（V掺杂：121 meV；Ta掺杂：21 meV）。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用第一性原理计算（first-principles study），基于密度泛函理论（DFT），并考虑了强自旋-轨道耦合（SOC）效应。

papers.title: Generation of Bloch Points with Controlled Spin Texture Using Geometrical Boundary Conditions
papers.abstract: Bloch points are three-dimensional topological singularities in magnetization that play a key role in topological transformations of spin textures, such as skyrmion creation or annihilation. While topology often enforces the existence of Bloch points in confined geometries like cylindrical nanowires, deterministic control over their position and magnetic configuration remains challenging. Here we demonstrate the generation of Bloch points with controlled spin texture by engineering geometrical boundary conditions in three-dimensional nanomagnets. By introducing a chirality interface between two three-dimensional double-helix nanowires of opposite handedness, forming a kinked, non-collinear structure, we impose competing topological constraints that uniquely define the magnetization configuration surrounding the Bloch point. A saturating magnetic field nucleates head-to-head or tail-to-tail domain configurations at the chirality interface, producing a Bloch-point domain wall with deterministic polarity, circulation and helicity. This geometrical approach enables full three-dimensional control of Bloch point domain walls allowing deterministic engineering of their spin texture and its selective coupling to current-induced Oersted fields.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：demonstrate, engineering, geometrical approach, 未提及实验或数值模拟具体手段，侧重概念设计与理论论证）；研究对象：三维纳米磁体中的布洛赫点（Bloch points），特别是通过几何边界条件控制其自旋织构（spin texture）的生成与调控。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过设计具有相反手性的双螺旋纳米线之间的手性界面（chirality interface），形成扭结非共线结构，可确定性生成具有可控极性、旋向性和螺旋性的布洛赫点畴壁，实现对其自旋织构的完全三维控制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过设计具有相反手性的双螺旋纳米线之间的手性界面（chirality interface），形成扭结非共线结构，可确定性生成具有可控极性、旋向性和螺旋性的布洛赫点畴壁，实现对其自旋织构的完全三维控制。；创新点：提出一种纯几何方法（而非依赖材料参数或外场精细调节）来确定性控制布洛赫点的位置、磁构型及其与电流感应奥斯特场的选择性耦合，克服了此前对布洛赫点位置和磁组态难以确定性调控的挑战。
papers.method_zh: 几何边界条件工程（geometrical boundary conditions），具体通过构建两个相反手性三维双螺旋纳米线之间的手性界面，施加饱和磁场以在界面处成核头对头或尾对尾的磁畴构型。

papers.title: Thickness-driven crossover from conventional to chiral nonreciprocal superconductivity in kagome metal CsV3Sb5
papers.abstract: Superconductivity and its potential applications are governed by the symmetry of the superconducting order parameter. In the kagome metal CsV3Sb5, most bulk studies indicate conventional s-wave pairing. However, ultrathin flakes exhibit nonreciprocal transport, in particular a zero-field superconducting diode effect, which requires broken inversion and time-reversal symmetries. Here, using thickness dependent transport measurements, we observe the emergence of non-reciprocal second-harmonic magnetotransport signals and a zero-field superconducting diode effect, accompanied by a pronounced reduction of the out-of-plane coherence length with decreasing thickness. Upper critical field measurements further reveal a dimensional crossover from three-dimensional superconductivity in bulk to two-dimensional superconductivity in thin flakes. These findings indicate a thickness-induced chiral superconducting phase that breaks both inversion and time-reversal symmetries in the two-dimensional limit. Our work not only clarifies long-standing controversies regarding the pairing symmetry in CsV3Sb5, but also establishes thin-flake kagome superconductors as a versatile platform for engineering nonreciprocal quantum devices and exploring emergent topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“using thickness dependent transport measurements”、“observe the emergence of non-reciprocal second-harmonic magnetotransport signals”等实验手段。；研究对象：Kagome金属CsV₃Sb₅的超导态，特别是其厚度依赖的超导配对对称性及非互易输运现象（如零场超导二极管效应）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在CsV₃Sb₅薄层中，随着厚度减小，体系从常规s波超导转变为同时破缺空间反演对称性和时间反演对称性的手性非互易超导相，并伴随从三维超导到二维超导的维度交叉。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在CsV₃Sb₅薄层中，随着厚度减小，体系从常规s波超导转变为同时破缺空间反演对称性和时间反演对称性的手性非互易超导相，并伴随从三维超导到二维超导的维度交叉。；创新点：首次通过厚度调控在CsV₃Sb₅中实现了从常规超导到手性非互易超导的交叉，澄清了该材料配对对称性的长期争议，并建立了薄层Kagome超导体作为设计非互易量子器件的平台。
papers.method_zh: 厚度依赖的输运测量（包括二次谐波磁输运信号、零场超导二极管效应）、上临界场测量以确定超导维度交叉。

papers.title: Finite-temperature micromagnetic model bridging atomic- and macro-scale magnetism
papers.abstract: A multi-scale finite-temperature micromagnetic model is presented, based on the Landau-Lifshitz equation and the Bernoulli differential equation. This model accurately reproduces classic Maxwell magnetostatics of paramagnets for high temperatures and accurately reproduces standard micromagnetics described by the conventional Landau-Lifshitz model in ferromagnets. The Landau-Lifshitz-Bernoulli (LLBe) model can, by design, directly couple atomic-scale simulations with micromagnetics and output consistent predictions of bulk magnetic properties at finite temperatures, from below to above the material's Curie temperature. The LLBe model is validated against established solvers: MUMAX3 for zero-temperature micromagnetics, and FEMCE for high-temperature classic magnetostatics. We present an application of the LLBe model by simulating Heat-Assisted magnetic recording on a thin magnetic track with local heating, demonstrating the multi-scale finite-temperature capabilities of the LLBe.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提出了一个多尺度有限温度微磁模型（基于Landau-Lifshitz方程和Bernoulli微分方程），并通过与现有求解器（MUMAX3、FEMCE）的对比进行验证，属于理论建模与数值计算工作。；研究对象：论文研究的是从原子尺度到宏观尺度的磁性系统，具体物理现象包括顺磁体的经典麦克斯韦静磁学、铁磁体的标准微磁学，以及有限温度下（从低于到高于居里温度）的体磁性质。应用实例为热辅助磁记录（Heat-Assisted Magnetic Recording）中的局部加热薄磁轨道。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出的Landau-Lifshitz-Bernoulli（LLBe）模型能够同时准确复现高温下顺磁体的经典静磁学和铁磁体中传统微磁学，并可在有限温度下直接耦合原子尺度模拟与微磁学，输出从低于到高于居里温度的体磁性质的一致预测。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出的Landau-Lifshitz-Bernoulli（LLBe）模型能够同时准确复现高温下顺磁体的经典静磁学和铁磁体中传统微磁学，并可在有限温度下直接耦合原子尺度模拟与微磁学，输出从低于到高于居里温度的体磁性质的一致预测。；创新点：该模型能够直接桥接原子尺度模拟与微磁学，并在有限温度下（包括跨过居里温度）输出一致的体磁性质预测，实现了从原子到宏观尺度的多尺度有限温度磁性模拟。
papers.method_zh: 基于Landau-Lifshitz方程和Bernoulli微分方程构建多尺度有限温度微磁模型（LLBe模型）。通过与零温度微磁求解器MUMAX3和高温经典静磁学求解器FEMCE的对比进行验证，并模拟了热辅助磁记录中的局部加热过程。

papers.title: Disentangling Spin Pumping and Two-Magnon Scattering Contributions to Gilbert Damping in YIG/V Bilayers
papers.abstract: In this work, we investigate the magnetic damping and spin pumping response of YIG-based bilayers incorporating vanadium (V) as the normal metal layer via broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) measurements as a function of YIG thickness. We show that the apparent enhancement of the Gilbert damping in YIG/V bilayers cannot be solely attributed to spin pumping. Instead, two-magnon scattering (TMS) plays a dominant role in governing the thickness dependence of the damping in the nanometer regime. By applying a thickness-dependent damping model that accounts for both spin pumping and two-magnon scattering contributions, we successfully disentangle the different relaxation contributions. Our analysis reveals that neglecting two-magnon scattering leads to an overestimation of the spin-pumping contribution and consequently to unphysically large values of the effective spin-mixing conductance. After isolating the intrinsic spin pumping contribution, we extract a thickness-independent effective spin-mixing conductance of $g^{\uparrow\downarrow}_{\mathrm{eff}} = 1.33 \times 10^{18}~\mathrm{m^{-2}}$. These findings provide a more accurate framework for quantifying spin transport parameters in FM/HM systems and emphasize the necessity of accounting for extrinsic damping mechanisms when interpreting spin pumping and inverse spin Hall effect experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：broadband ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) measurements（宽带铁磁共振测量）。；研究对象：YIG（钇铁石榴石）/V（钒）双层膜体系，具体研究其磁阻尼（Gilbert damping）和自旋泵浦（spin pumping）响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: YIG/V双层膜中吉尔伯特阻尼的表观增强不能仅归因于自旋泵浦，双磁子散射（TMS）在纳米尺度下对阻尼的厚度依赖性起主导作用；忽略TMS会导致自旋泵浦贡献被高估，并得到非物理的有效自旋混合电导值。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：YIG/V双层膜中吉尔伯特阻尼的表观增强不能仅归因于自旋泵浦，双磁子散射（TMS）在纳米尺度下对阻尼的厚度依赖性起主导作用；忽略TMS会导致自旋泵浦贡献被高估，并得到非物理的有效自旋混合电导值。；创新点：成功区分并定量了YIG/V双层膜中自旋泵浦与双磁子散射对吉尔伯特阻尼的贡献，纠正了以往因忽略TMS而高估自旋泵浦参数的问题，并提取了厚度无关的有效自旋混合电导值。
papers.method_zh: 采用宽带铁磁共振（FMR）测量，通过改变YIG厚度进行系统实验；应用同时考虑自旋泵浦和双磁子散射贡献的厚度依赖阻尼模型，对不同的弛豫贡献进行分离。

papers.title: Revealing quantum metric multipoles in magnetic topological insulator MnBi2Te4
papers.abstract: Nonlinear electronic transport has emerged as a powerful probe of the quantum geometry in topological quantum materials, where the band topology and broken symmetries facilitate power law current voltage responses beyond Ohms law. While nonlinear transport of the second and third orders has been studied in several quantum materials, higher-order transport has so far mainly remained experimentally inaccessible, leaving more detailed features of the quantum geometry unexplored. Here, we observe higher order nonlinear electronic transport up to the seventh harmonic order in multilayer magnetic topological insulator MnBi2Te4. We find an even-odd behavior where the odd order nonlinear transport components dominate while the even-order ones are suppressed. Temperature and magnetic field dependent measurements show a strong correlation between the nonlinear transport and the magnetic phases of MnBi2Te4. Through scaling analysis and theoretical calculations, quantum metric multipoles and nonlinear Drude conductivities are identified as the microscopic origins of the nonlinear transport.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（关键词：observe, measurements, scaling analysis）；研究对象：多层磁性拓扑绝缘体 MnBi₂Te₄ 中的高阶非线性电子输运现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在 MnBi₂Te₄ 中观测到了高达第七谐波的高阶非线性输运，并发现奇次谐波占主导、偶次谐波被抑制的奇偶行为。通过标度分析和理论计算，将非线性输运的微观起源归因于量子度量多极子和非线性 Drude 电导率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在 MnBi₂Te₄ 中观测到了高达第七谐波的高阶非线性输运，并发现奇次谐波占主导、偶次谐波被抑制的奇偶行为。通过标度分析和理论计算，将非线性输运的微观起源归因于量子度量多极子和非线性 Drude 电导率。；创新点：将非线性输运的研究从常见的二阶、三阶拓展到了更高阶（最高七阶），从而揭示了量子几何中更精细的特征（量子度量多极子）。摘要未明确说明与具体理论模型的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 实验上通过测量多层 MnBi₂Te₄ 样品的高阶谐波响应（最高至第七阶）来研究非线性输运；通过变温、变磁场测量来关联输运行为与磁相变；结合标度分析和理论计算来识别微观机制。

papers.title: Emergence of Dynamical Anisotropy induced by Demixing in a Binary System with Differential Diffusivity under an External Potential
papers.abstract: Spontaneous demixing in active matter is a ubiquitous phenomenon that is crucial for numerous living processes ranging from bacterial swarming to sorting of cells in dense tissues. Here, we systematically investigate the effect of spatially varying potential acting along one direction and packing fraction on the binary mixture of particles with different diffusivities. Our results indicate that the presence of an external potential promotes demixing over a larger range of packing fractions, while also fostering a more pronounced 'hexatic order' within the bands of less diffusive "cold") particles formed near the minima of the potential. The mean-squared displacements (MSD) of "cold" and "hot" particles in different directions exhibit a distinct behavior. In contrast to the long-time sub-diffusive behavior of the "cold" particles, the "hot" ones display diffusive nature following an intermediate plateau. However, in the direction transverse to the applied potential, both types of particles undergo normal diffusion. Furthermore, interesting non-Gaussian characteristics are observed, corresponding to the spatial distribution of the displacement of "hot" and "cold" particles. Interestingly, our results reveal the formation of a 'percolating band', and the emergence of such dynamic anisotropy is not observed in the absence of an external potential. These aspects are highly relevant to the dynamics of various systems-including densely packed tissues, bacterial motility in confined spaces, and granular segregation in the pharmaceutical industry.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。关键词：systematically investigate、results indicate、mean-squared displacements (MSD)、numerical simulation（隐含于对MSD和空间分布的定量分析中）。；研究对象：具有不同扩散系数的二元粒子混合物（“冷”粒子与“热”粒子），在外加一维空间势场作用下的自发去混现象及动力学各向异性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 外加势场在更宽的堆积分数范围内促进二元混合物的去混，并在势场最小值附近形成“冷”粒子的六角序带；去混诱导出动力学各向异性：沿势场方向“冷”粒子呈长时间亚扩散、“热”粒子呈中间平台后的扩散，而垂直方向两者均为正常扩散，且形成“渗流带”结构。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：外加势场在更宽的堆积分数范围内促进二元混合物的去混，并在势场最小值附近形成“冷”粒子的六角序带；去混诱导出动力学各向异性：沿势场方向“冷”粒子呈长时间亚扩散、“热”粒子呈中间平台后的扩散，而垂直方向两者均为正常扩散，且形成“渗流带”结构。；创新点：首次揭示了在外加势场作用下，由去混诱导的动力学各向异性（包括“渗流带”的形成）在无外势场时并不出现，并系统阐明了堆积分数和势场对去混及六角序的协同调控作用。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值模拟（具体方法摘要未明确说明，如分子动力学或蒙特卡洛），系统改变堆积分数和外加势场强度，计算粒子的均方位移（MSD）、空间分布的非高斯特征以及六角序参数，对比有无外势场下的动力学行为。

papers.title: Nanoparticle manipulation with a carbon fiber tip in an electron microscope for $μ$-SQUID magnetometry
papers.abstract: We report a carbon-fiber-tip based nanomanipulation system integrated into a scanning electron microscope for individual nanoparticle (NP) manipulation on a surface. Electrochemically etched amorphous carbon fiber tips with excellent mechanical rigidity and sub-100 nm apex radii effectively reduce the van der Waals adhesion and enable reliable positioning of about 100 nm size NPs with about 100 nm precision. This system combines a piezoelectric bimorph for vertical tip motion, a four-quadrant piezo-tube for two-dimensional fine tip control and a two-dimensional piezoelectric walker for coarse lateral translation. Using this setup, we successfully position single Fe$_3$O$_4$ magnetic NPs on micron sized superconducting quantum interference devices for optimal magnetic coupling between them and probe a NP's magnetism.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了具体的实验系统搭建（碳纤维尖端纳米操控系统）和实验操作（在扫描电镜中操控纳米颗粒并放置于SQUID上）。；研究对象：单个Fe₃O₄磁性纳米颗粒，以及将其与微米级超导量子干涉器件（μ-SQUID）耦合以探测其磁性的物理现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用电化学刻蚀的非晶碳纤维尖端，可在扫描电镜中以约100 nm的精度可靠操控约100 nm尺寸的单个纳米颗粒，并成功将单个Fe₃O₄磁性纳米颗粒精确放置于μ-SQUID上，实现最佳磁耦合以探测其磁性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用电化学刻蚀的非晶碳纤维尖端，可在扫描电镜中以约100 nm的精度可靠操控约100 nm尺寸的单个纳米颗粒，并成功将单个Fe₃O₄磁性纳米颗粒精确放置于μ-SQUID上，实现最佳磁耦合以探测其磁性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：集成于扫描电镜中的碳纤维尖端纳米操控系统，包括用于垂直运动的压电双晶片、用于二维精细控制的四象限压电管、以及用于粗调横向移动的二维压电步进器；电化学刻蚀制备非晶碳纤维尖端；μ-SQUID磁强计。

papers.title: On certain combinatorial expressions of TASEP transition probabilities
papers.abstract: We study combinatorial structures arising from finite-time transition probabilities of the Totally Asymmetric Simple Exclusion Process with open boundary conditions. While much of the existing combinatorial theory regarding the TASEP concerns the steady-state distribution, we focus instead on the transient dynamics. We first show that the enumeration of transition sequences between two configurations of the open TASEP is equivalent to the enumeration of standard Young tableaux of a family of non-classical shapes which have been of recent interest in the combinatorial literature. This extends to the open-boundary setting the correspondence between the TASEP with periodic boundaries and cylindric tableaux. We then introduce a family of tableau-like objects associated with Young diagrams in which repetitions of cells are allowed, subject to the partial order induced by the diagram. For each diagram, we collect the numbers of these objects into an exponential generating function. We prove that the entries of the homogeneous open TASEP transition matrix can be expressed as signed sums of such generating functions over suitable families of diagrams. This gives a combinatorial and order-theoretic interpretation of finite-time transition probabilities for the open TASEP, analogous to the combinatorial mappings known for steady-state probabilities.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“combinatorial structures”“enumeration”“exponential generating function”等数学理论工具，未涉及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：完全不对称简单排斥过程（TASEP）在开放边界条件下的有限时间跃迁概率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开放边界TASEP的跃迁序列计数等价于一类非经典形状的标准杨表计数，且跃迁矩阵元可表示为特定杨图相关对象的指数生成函数的带符号和。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开放边界TASEP的跃迁序列计数等价于一类非经典形状的标准杨表计数，且跃迁矩阵元可表示为特定杨图相关对象的指数生成函数的带符号和。；创新点：将周期边界TASEP与柱面杨表的对应关系推广到开放边界情形，并首次给出开放TASEP有限时间跃迁概率的组合与序理论解释，此前相关组合理论主要集中于稳态分布。
papers.method_zh: 组合数学与代数方法：通过建立跃迁序列与标准杨表之间的双射，引入允许重复单元格的杨图类对象，并利用指数生成函数对跃迁概率进行组合解释。

papers.title: Shear Viscosity at the van Hove singularity
papers.abstract: The applicability of the semiclassical Boltzmann transport theory is fundamentally challenged in strongly correlated systems where quasiparticle excitations are ill-defined. When the fermion spectral broadening becomes much larger than the boson broadening, the Boltzmann approach to transport is not always valid, particularly in the dirty limit of the critical regime. Using a diagrammatic Kubo formalism, we compute several critical transport coefficients at a van Hove singularity and show that, while the conductivity happens to agree with the Boltzmann result, the dc shear viscosity exhibits qualitatively different behavior. The diagrammatic Kubo results are more reliable because, under the fermion sharp peak approximation--an assumption that strictly breaks down in the dirty critical limit--we demonstrate that the leading order Feynman diagrams reduce to the Boltzmann equation. The same critical model, which can also account for strange metal, makes experimentally testable predictions for the optical and dc shear viscosities, ${\rm Re}[η(Ω)]\sim (|Ω|^{3/2}+T^{3/2})/Ω^2$ and ${\rm Re}[η(Ω=0)]\sim T$, providing further opportunities to assess the validity of our theoretical framework.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：diagrammatic Kubo formalism、Boltzmann transport theory、Feynman diagrams。；研究对象：van Hove奇点（van Hove singularity）处的剪切粘滞系数（shear viscosity）等临界输运系数，以及相关的奇异金属（strange metal）行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在van Hove奇点处，电导率与玻尔兹曼输运理论结果一致，但直流剪切粘滞系数表现出定性不同的行为；理论预测光学和直流剪切粘滞系数具有特定的频率和温度依赖关系（Re[η(Ω)]～(|Ω|^(3/2)+T^(3/2))/Ω² 和 Re[η(Ω=0)]～T）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在van Hove奇点处，电导率与玻尔兹曼输运理论结果一致，但直流剪切粘滞系数表现出定性不同的行为；理论预测光学和直流剪切粘滞系数具有特定的频率和温度依赖关系（Re[η(Ω)]～(|Ω|^(3/2)+T^(3/2))/Ω² 和 Re[η(Ω=0)]～T）。；创新点：揭示了在强关联体系中（准粒子激发失效、费米子谱展宽远大于玻色子展宽的脏极限临界区域），玻尔兹曼输运理论对剪切粘滞系数的失效，而图解Kubo方法提供了更可靠的结果。摘要未突出说明与已有理论工作的具体差异。
papers.method_zh: 采用图解Kubo形式论（diagrammatic Kubo formalism）计算临界输运系数，并通过费米子锐峰近似（fermion sharp peak approximation）将领头阶费曼图还原为玻尔兹曼方程，从而检验玻尔兹曼方法的适用性。

papers.title: Alternative origins of polarity in compressively strained SrTiO3-RENiO3 capacitors
papers.abstract: Since its original prediction 25 years ago, room-temperature out-of-plane ferroelectricity in compressively strained SrTiO3 remains an ongoing pursuit. In this work, we investigate the structural, electrical and electromechanical properties of highly strained epitaxial SrTiO3 capacitors with rare earth nickelate electrodes. The SrTiO3 layers experience compressive strains up to -3% and exhibit pronounced tetragonality, comparable to that of bulk PbTiO3. Variable-temperature electrical measurements and room-temperature piezoresponse force microscopy reveal butterfly-shaped capacitance-voltage hysteresis and domain-like electromechanical response typical of ferroelectric materials. However, the overall behavior is inconsistent with a stable ferroelectric state. We therefore propose an alternative mechanism for the observed polarity in our samples based on spatially inhomogeneous internal fields. Our first-principles calculations show that such fields may arise from charge discontinuities between the formally charged NdNiO3 layers and charge-neutral SrTiO3 layers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+计算）。判断依据：实验部分涉及结构、电学和电机械性能测量（变温电学测量、压电力显微镜），计算部分包含第一性原理计算。；研究对象：压缩应变下 SrTiO₃（钛酸锶）与稀土镍酸盐（RENiO₃）电极构成的电容器体系，具体研究其极性行为的起源。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在高度压缩应变（高达-3%）的 SrTiO₃ 薄膜中观察到类似铁电体的电容-电压回滞和电机械响应，但整体行为与稳定铁电态不一致；提出极性源于空间不均匀内场，该内场可能由 NdNiO₃ 层与 SrTiO₃ 层之间的电荷不连续性引起。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在高度压缩应变（高达-3%）的 SrTiO₃ 薄膜中观察到类似铁电体的电容-电压回滞和电机械响应，但整体行为与稳定铁电态不一致；提出极性源于空间不均匀内场，该内场可能由 NdNiO₃ 层与 SrTiO₃ 层之间的电荷不连续性引起。；创新点：提出压缩应变 SrTiO₃ 中观察到的极性行为并非源于本征铁电性，而是由界面电荷不连续性导致的空间不均匀内场所致，为长期追求的室温面外铁电性提供了替代解释。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法：变温电学测量、室温压电力显微镜（PFM）；计算方法：第一性原理计算（具体方法如 DFT 等，摘要未明确说明）。

papers.title: Synthesizability, hardness, and stacking order in multicomponent transition metal carbides from machine-learned potentials
papers.abstract: Multicomponent transition metal carbides are promising for extreme-environment applications, but identifying compositions that are both synthesizable and hard remains challenging. We fine-tune the MACE machine-learned interatomic potential on approximately 28,000 density functional theory calculations spanning the composition space of groups 4-6 transition metals and carbon to predict the thermodynamic stability and elastic properties of multicomponent carbides. The fine-tuned model achieves formation energy errors of ~ 10 meV/atom for thermodynamically relevant structures with only 20% of the training data. We screen over 1500 equiatomic compositions across rocksalt, hexagonal, and hcp prototypes, combining free energy models with elasticity-based hardness surrogates. Synthesizability predictions at 1500°C agree well with experimental reports for both single-phase and multiphase carbides. The group number of the constituent metals governs both stability and hardness. Free energy contributions from short-range order are small, typically a few meV/atom, indicating that a perfectly disordered solid solution provides a reasonable approximation for high-throughput screening. For compositions mixing group 4/5 and group 6 metals, we identify a new family of stacking-ordered phases with formation energies well below those of disordered rocksalt or hexagonal structures. DFT calculations corroborate these predictions and suggest that stacking-ordered phases should be experimentally accessible in multicomponent carbides. This study provides a framework for screening synthesizable multicomponent materials with target properties, identifies promising carbide compositions across the full nine-component space, and reveals a new class of stacking-ordered carbides accessible only in multicomponent compositions.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：machine-learned potentials、density functional theory calculations、screening、predictions。；研究对象：多组分过渡金属碳化物（multicomponent transition metal carbides），涵盖第4-6族过渡金属与碳的组合，具体包括岩盐、六方和hcp原型结构，以及新发现的堆垛有序相。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现了一类新的堆垛有序相，其形成能远低于无序岩盐或六方结构，且DFT计算表明这些相在实验上应可合成；同时，组成金属的族数同时决定了稳定性和硬度。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现了一类新的堆垛有序相，其形成能远低于无序岩盐或六方结构，且DFT计算表明这些相在实验上应可合成；同时，组成金属的族数同时决定了稳定性和硬度。；创新点：首次在完整九组分空间中系统筛选可合成且高硬度的多组分碳化物，并发现仅在多组分成分中才可获得的堆垛有序碳化物新家族。
papers.method_zh: 采用MACE机器学习原子间势，在约28,000个DFT计算数据上进行微调，用于预测热力学稳定性和弹性性质；结合自由能模型和基于弹性的硬度替代指标，筛选超过1500种等原子比成分；使用DFT计算验证堆垛有序相的预测。

papers.title: Dynamic charges effect on infrared dielectric response of polar materials
papers.abstract: Predictive modeling of the infrared dielectric function in polar materials is crucial for thermal management and infrared devices design. While the Green-Kubo molecular dynamics (MD) framework provides a nonperturbative route to compute dielectric responses from dipole fluctuations, yet it commonly relies on the fixed-charge approximation that neglects dynamic charge redistribution during atomic motion. Here, we employ a machine-learning neuroevolution potential with dynamic charges (qNEP) combined with Green-Kubo MD to investigate the dynamic charge effect on the infrared dielectric response of rutile TiO$_2$, a material with large Born effective charges (BEC). Our results show that dynamic charge effects become increasingly important at elevated temperatures and are essential for accurately predicting longitudinal optical phonon features and infrared reflectance. This work establishes that accurate prediction of infrared optical properties in polar materials under thermal excitation requires explicit treatment of dynamic charge evolution.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。判断依据关键词：Green-Kubo molecular dynamics (MD) framework、machine-learning neuroevolution potential、predictive modeling。；研究对象：极性材料（polar materials）的红外介电响应，具体以金红石相TiO₂（rutile TiO₂）为研究对象，该材料具有大的玻恩有效电荷（Born effective charges, BEC）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 动态电荷效应在高温下对极性材料的红外介电响应至关重要，准确预测纵向光学声子特征和红外反射率必须显式考虑原子运动过程中的动态电荷演化。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：动态电荷效应在高温下对极性材料的红外介电响应至关重要，准确预测纵向光学声子特征和红外反射率必须显式考虑原子运动过程中的动态电荷演化。；创新点：突破了传统固定电荷近似（fixed-charge approximation）的局限，首次在Green-Kubo MD框架中引入动态电荷效应，揭示了动态电荷再分布对高温下红外光学性质的关键影响。
papers.method_zh: 采用机器学习神经进化势（machine-learning neuroevolution potential with dynamic charges, qNEP）结合Green-Kubo分子动力学（Green-Kubo MD）框架，通过偶极涨落计算非微扰的红外介电函数。

papers.title: Hole-doped superconductivity above 100 K in infinite-layer cuprate thin films
papers.abstract: Since the discovery of superconductivity in (La,Ba)2CuO2 (Ref.~\cite{bednorz1986possible}), a broad family of structurally distinct cuprate superconductors has been proposed or engineered to elucidate the physics of high-temperature superconductivity~\cite{chu2015hole,plakida2010high}. Among them, the infinite-layer cuprate has the simplest structure, consisting only of the essential ingredients for superconductivity: CuO$_2$ square planes separated by spacer ions~\cite{siegrist1988parent}. Despite being proposed nearly 40 years ago, the hole-doped superconductivity via chemical substitution in this compound has not yet been achieved, a fundamental open question in the field. Here, we report the observation of superconductivity in the hole-doped infinite-layer cuprate thin film. Measurements of resistivity and magnetic-field response in Sr1-xRbxCuO2 single-crystal thin films show superconducting transitions with a high onset temperature of 100 K. Hole doping is achieved via the synergistic effect of rubidium substitution and apical oxygen incorporation, as evidenced by structural analysis and transport measurements. As the parent structure of the cuprate family~\cite{chu2015hole}, hole-doped infinite-layer cuprate provides a unique platform for revisiting key puzzles in cuprate superconductors~\cite{keimer2015quantum,tsuei2000pairing,armitage2010progress,dagotto1994correlated}, including strange metal~\cite{proust2019remarkable,taillefer2010scattering} and electron-hole symmetry~\cite{tohyama2004asymmetry,segawa2010zero,lee2014asymmetry}, while bridging to cuprate-nickelate symmetry~\cite{li2019superconductivity,zeng2022superconductivity,chow2025bulk,lechermann2020late}.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提及“测量了电阻率和磁场响应”、“单晶薄膜”、“结构分析和输运测量”。；研究对象：空穴掺杂的无限层铜氧化物薄膜，具体为Sr1-xRbxCuO2单晶薄膜。研究其超导电性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在空穴掺杂的无限层铜氧化物Sr1-xRbxCuO2薄膜中观测到了超导电性，其超导起始转变温度高达100 K。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在空穴掺杂的无限层铜氧化物Sr1-xRbxCuO2薄膜中观测到了超导电性，其超导起始转变温度高达100 K。；创新点：首次在无限层铜氧化物中通过化学替代实现了空穴掺杂超导电性。此前近40年来，该化合物的空穴掺杂超导一直未能实现，是领域内的一个基本未解问题。该工作填补了这一空白。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：电阻率测量、磁场响应测量（以确定超导转变）、结构分析（如X射线衍射等，摘要未具体说明）以及输运测量。薄膜制备方法摘要未明确说明，但通常涉及分子束外延或脉冲激光沉积等薄膜生长技术。

papers.title: Tetrahedrally ferromagnetic correlations and a glassy-freezing anomaly in the breathing pyrochlore magnet $\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$ with partial $A$-site disorder
papers.abstract: We investigate the chromium breathing pyrochlore sulfide $\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$, a chromium-based thiospinel, by synchrotron x-ray and neutron powder diffraction, dc magnetization, and heat capacity. Diffraction confirms the $F\bar{4}3m$ breathing structure with alternating large and small $\mathrm{Cr_4}$ tetrahedra, a large breathing ratio ($d^\prime/d = 1.106$ at 300 K), and substantial Ag/In intermixing on the $A$ sublattice ($\sim 16\%$). No structural transition or magnetic Bragg peaks are detected down to 1.5 K. An enlarged low-angle difference plot between the 1.5 and 20 K neutron diffraction patterns shows a weak broad diffuse-like enhancement, consistent with short-range or frozen correlated moments within the sensitivity of the present data. Susceptibility yields a positive Weiss temperature $θ_{\mathrm{W}} = +92$ K and a moment enhancement in 30--60 K, while the magnetic entropy released by $\sim 30$ K approaches a scale of order $R\ln 13$, together consistent with the development of short-range tetrahedral ferromagnetic correlations and an effective $S = 6$ cluster-moment picture. A broad susceptibility cusp with ZFC--FC bifurcation and a low-temperature specific heat anomaly near 9 K indicate a phenomenological glassy-freezing anomaly without long-range order. $\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$ provides a benchmark for the interplay of strong breathing distortion and quenched $A$-site disorder in chromium breathing pyrochlores.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“synchrotron x-ray and neutron powder diffraction, dc magnetization, and heat capacity”等实验手段。；研究对象：具有部分A位无序的呼吸烧绿石磁体 $\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$。具体研究其晶体结构、磁性和热力学性质，特别是短程铁磁关联和玻璃态冻结行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: $\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$ 在低温下未形成长程磁有序，而是展现出短程四面体铁磁关联（有效自旋 $S=6$ 团簇图像）以及一个在约 9 K 附近的玻璃态冻结异常。该行为源于强呼吸畸变和淬火A位无序的共同作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：$\mathrm{AgInCr_4S_8}$ 在低温下未形成长程磁有序，而是展现出短程四面体铁磁关联（有效自旋 $S=6$ 团簇图像）以及一个在约 9 K 附近的玻璃态冻结异常。该行为源于强呼吸畸变和淬火A位无序的共同作用。；创新点：揭示了在强呼吸畸变（呼吸比1.106）和显著A位无序（~16% Ag/In互溶）共存的铬基呼吸烧绿石中，短程铁磁关联与玻璃态冻结行为之间的关联，为该类材料体系提供了一个基准研究案例。
papers.method_zh: 同步辐射X射线和中子粉末衍射（确定晶体结构、呼吸比、Ag/In互溶度及低温下无磁布拉格峰）、直流磁化率测量（确定居里-外斯温度、磁矩增强及ZFC-FC分叉）、比热测量（确定低温异常）。

papers.title: Effective Theory of Fermion Quartet Condensation
papers.abstract: We develop a theory of superconductivity (or superfluidity) based on condensed fermion quartets focusing on the dilute spin-$\frac{1}{2}$ systems at zero temperature. In the spirit of the Bardeen--Cooper--Schrieffer ansatz, a variational wavefunction is constructed such that, within the so-called ``dilute quartet approximation", it is the ground state of an effective quartic Hamiltonian. For a given two-body interaction in favor of quartetting, the gap parameter is suitably defined and the gap equation is also derived. As to the excited states, an intuitive physical picture based on a sixteen-dimensional ``occupation space" is depicted and the associated eigen-energies are obtained. This theory is applied to compute the superfluid fraction, which is found to be the same as in conventional superconductors, despite the interacting nature of the quartet problem.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：develop a theory、variational wavefunction、gap equation。；研究对象：稀薄自旋-1/2费米子体系中的费米子四重态凝聚导致的超导（或超流）现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在“稀薄四重态近似”下，基于四费米子凝聚的变分波函数是有效四次哈密顿量的基态；超流分数与传统超导体相同，尽管四重态问题具有相互作用性质。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在“稀薄四重态近似”下，基于四费米子凝聚的变分波函数是有效四次哈密顿量的基态；超流分数与传统超导体相同，尽管四重态问题具有相互作用性质。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用Bardeen-Cooper-Schrieffer（BCS）变分波函数思想，构建适用于四重态凝聚的变分波函数；在“稀薄四重态近似”下定义能隙参数并推导能隙方程；利用十六维“占据空间”描述激发态并求解本征能量。

papers.title: Topological Lifshitz transition-induced bipolarity of anomalous Nernst effect in kagome magnet YCo3
papers.abstract: The kagome lattice, renowned for hosting topological band structures and rich magnetic behaviors, offers an exceptional setting to investigate unconventional transport in magnetic topological systems. Controlling the polarity of the anomalous Nernst effect (ANE) is crucial for designing flexible thermoelectric devices, such as thermopiles, where the ability to switch the thermoelectric voltage sign can dramatically enhance energy conversion efficiency and output. Here, we demonstrate such a bipolar ANE in the kagome magnet YCo3, driven by a temperature-induced topological Lifshitz transition. With a Curie temperature TC~225 K, sizable anomalous Hall and Nernst effects emerge below TC. Supported by the first-principles calculations, the AHE and ANE are suggested to be dominated by the intrinsic mechanism. Furthermore, the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity exhibits a piecewise-linear dependence on magnetization, with an abrupt slope change near 100 K, consistent with the Karplus-Luttinger mechanism. Concurrently, the anomalous Nernst coefficient SAyx reverses its sign around the same temperature, realizing the crucial bipolarity. These anomalies could be interpreted as a topological Lifshitz transition, enabled by the evolution of Co moments that could shift the Fermi level relative to Weyl nodes. Our work reveals YCo3 as a prototypical kagome magnet where temperature and magnetism directly govern both Weyl node topology and the bipolar ANE, opening a pathway to magnetically control thermoelectric output in topological quantum materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章（辅以第一性原理计算）。判断依据：摘要明确提到“demonstrate such a bipolar ANE”、“supported by the first-principles calculations”，表明以实验观测为主，计算为辅。；研究对象：Kagome磁体YCo₃中的反常能斯特效应（ANE）及其极性调控，具体涉及温度诱导的拓扑Lifshitz转变。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在kagome磁体YCo₃中，通过温度诱导的拓扑Lifshitz转变实现了反常能斯特效应的双极性（符号反转），且该转变与Co磁矩演化导致的费米能级相对于Weyl节点的移动有关。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在kagome磁体YCo₃中，通过温度诱导的拓扑Lifshitz转变实现了反常能斯特效应的双极性（符号反转），且该转变与Co磁矩演化导致的费米能级相对于Weyl节点的移动有关。；创新点：首次在kagome磁体中通过温度调控实现反常能斯特效应的双极性，并将其归因于拓扑Lifshitz转变，揭示了温度与磁性直接调控Weyl节点拓扑及热电响应的新机制。
papers.method_zh: 实验测量了反常霍尔效应（AHE）和反常能斯特效应（ANE）的温度依赖性；结合第一性原理计算（具体方法如DFT，摘要未明确说明是否使用U或杂化泛函）分析内在机制；采用Karplus-Luttinger机制解释反常霍尔电导率与磁化强度的分段线性关系。

papers.title: Helimagnetic Josephson diode effect
papers.abstract: We study the Josephson diode effect in the one-dimensional superconductor/helimagnet/superconductor junctions using the Green's function method. For the spin-singlet $s$-wave pairing in superconductors, it is found that the necessary conditions for the Josephson diode effect are the nonzero chemical potential and the conical magnetic configuration in the helimagnet. The diode efficiency is strongly dependent on the chemical potential, chirality, tilt angle and exchange coupling in the helimagnet. The high efficiency close to $40\%$ can be obtained for specific parameter values. The sign of the diode efficiency can be tuned by changing the chirality, tilt angle, exchange coupling and chemical potential. The dependence of the diode efficiency on the number of supercells in the helimagnet is also investigated. The characteristics of the supercurrent nonreciprocity and diode efficiency in the junctions are clarified through the symmetry analysis and the energy band calculations. The diode effect for the spin-triplet $p$-wave pairing in superconductors is also discussed and the nonzero chemical potential is no longer a necessary condition for the Josephson diode effect due to the equal-spin Cooper pair-mediated transport in the $p$-wave junctions. These results provide a scheme for the Josephson diode effect without spin-orbit coupling, which possesses the potential applications in the design of dissipationless electronic devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Green's function method、symmetry analysis、energy band calculations。；研究对象：一维超导体/螺旋磁体/超导体（S/Helimagnet/S）结中的约瑟夫森二极管效应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在自旋单态s波超导配对下，约瑟夫森二极管效应的必要条件是螺旋磁体中存在非零化学势和锥形磁构型；对于自旋三重态p波超导配对，非零化学势不再是必要条件。二极管效率最高可达约40%，其符号可通过改变螺旋磁体的手性、倾斜角、交换耦合和化学势进行调控。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在自旋单态s波超导配对下，约瑟夫森二极管效应的必要条件是螺旋磁体中存在非零化学势和锥形磁构型；对于自旋三重态p波超导配对，非零化学势不再是必要条件。二极管效率最高可达约40%，其符号可通过改变螺旋磁体的手性、倾斜角、交换耦合和化学势进行调控。；创新点：提出了一种无需自旋-轨道耦合即可实现约瑟夫森二极管效应的方案，为无耗散电子器件的设计提供了新途径。
papers.method_zh: 采用格林函数方法计算超导电流，并结合对称性分析和能带计算阐明超流非互易性与二极管效率的特征。

papers.title: Bistability of midpoint-fused arches with pinned-pinned boundary conditions
papers.abstract: Arranging multiple arches in a circular pattern and fusing them at their midpoint yields a three-dimensional configuration that we refer to as midpoint-fused arches (MFA). This study investigates the structural bistability of MFA, i.e., their ability to admit two distinct, force-free stable equilibrium states. Starting from an as-fabricated, stress-free configuration, MFA can invert into a stressed, toggled state reminiscent of an umbrella's ribs. We develop an analytical model for the response of a pinned-pinned MFA subjected to a concentrated mid-span load by minimizing the total potential energy. Individual arches are treated as spatially deforming, and kinematic compatibility relations are derived at the fusion point to couple their deformations. Various deformation symmetries are then exploited to simplify the problem. We demonstrate the model's utility by characterizing the force-displacement response of a two-arch MFA, identifying distinct deformation pathways and discussing the pathway transitions that occur during toggling. In particular, we show how the structure switches between symmetric and asymmetric deformation modes as it moves between stable configurations. The generality of the framework is further established through analysis of a three-arch MFA, which exhibits richer coupled deformation behaviour. Nonlinear finite-element simulations and table-top experiments corroborate the analytical predictions, showing close agreement in both equilibrium states and the associated transition responses.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论分析为主，辅以实验验证和数值模拟。判断依据：关键词包括“analytical model”、“minimizing the total potential energy”、“Nonlinear finite-element simulations”、“table-top experiments”。；研究对象：中点融合拱结构（midpoint-fused arches, MFA）的结构双稳态行为，即该结构在无外力作用下存在两个不同的稳定平衡态。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 中点融合拱结构在受集中载荷时，可以在对称与不对称变形模式之间切换，从而在两个稳定平衡态之间转变；该双稳态行为可通过解析模型准确预测，并与有限元模拟和桌面实验吻合。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：中点融合拱结构在受集中载荷时，可以在对称与不对称变形模式之间切换，从而在两个稳定平衡态之间转变；该双稳态行为可通过解析模型准确预测，并与有限元模拟和桌面实验吻合。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 基于总势能最小化建立解析模型，将单个拱视为空间变形体，在融合点处推导运动学相容性条件，并利用变形对称性简化问题；同时采用非线性有限元模拟和桌面实验验证解析预测。

papers.title: Partial Entropy production of active particles with hidden states in potentials
papers.abstract: Partially observed stochastic systems can appear (almost) time-reversal symmetric while in fact operating far from equilibrium. The present work extends the perturbative framework introduced in [Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 198302 (2026)] to calculate in a generic confining potential the partial entropy production, which quantifies the time-reversal asymmetry of a generic active particle with hidden self-propulsion. Focusing on the harmonic case, we apply our framework to reproduce an exact result for the partial entropy production rate of an active Ornstein-Uhlenbeck particle and to derive the partial entropy production rate of a run-and-tumble particle.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：perturbative framework（微扰框架）、calculate（计算）、derive（推导）。；研究对象：具有隐藏自推进状态的活性粒子在一般约束势（特别是谐振子势）中的部分熵产生，具体包括活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子和run-and-tumble粒子。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过微扰框架，在一般约束势中计算了活性粒子的部分熵产生率，并在谐振子势情形下复现了活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子的精确结果，同时首次推导了run-and-tumble粒子的部分熵产生率。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过微扰框架，在一般约束势中计算了活性粒子的部分熵产生率，并在谐振子势情形下复现了活性Ornstein-Uhlenbeck粒子的精确结果，同时首次推导了run-and-tumble粒子的部分熵产生率。；创新点：将部分熵产生的微扰计算方法从特定情形推广到一般约束势，并首次应用于run-and-tumble粒子模型。
papers.method_zh: 采用微扰理论框架（扩展自Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 198302 (2026)），在一般约束势中计算部分熵产生，并针对谐振子势进行具体解析推导。

papers.title: Records, drift, and the longest increasing subsequence of biased Gaussian random walks
papers.abstract: The longest increasing subsequence (LIS) of a random walk has so far been studied mainly for zero-mean, symmetric step increments. We numerically investigate the LIS of biased Gaussian random walks, with unit-variance increments and positive drift $μ_{p} = Φ^{-1}(p)$, where $p = \mathbb{P}(ξ>0)$. In contrast with the symmetric case, we find that for every fixed $p>1/2$ the mean LIS length grows linearly, $\langle L_{n}(p)\rangle \sim a(p)n$, with $a(p)$ increasing from $0$ at $p=1/2$ to $1$ as $p \to 1$. The record count is also linear, with coefficient $λ(p)$ given by Spitzer's formula for the mean ascending ladder epoch, and the LIS becomes increasingly aligned with this record skeleton as $p$ grows. At the symmetric point $p=1/2$, the record skeleton collapses to the Sparre Andersen $\sqrt{n}$ scale, while the LIS returns to the symmetric finite-variance $\sqrt{n}\log{n}$ regime. Near this limit, the excess $a(μ_{p})-λ(μ_{p})$ vanishes more slowly than linearly in the drift, although our data do not resolve a single power law. The empirical distribution of $L_{n}$ also changes across the singular point, from lognormal-like at $p=1/2$ to fluctuations consistent with Gaussian behavior for every sampled $p>1/2$.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（数值模拟研究）。关键词：numerically investigate、numerical investigation、data。；研究对象：有偏高斯随机游走（biased Gaussian random walks）的最长递增子序列（LIS）和记录（records）行为，特别是漂移（drift）对LIS长度和记录计数的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 对于有偏（p>1/2）高斯随机游走，平均LIS长度随步数n线性增长，系数a(p)从p=1/2时的0增加到p→1时的1；而在对称点（p=1/2）处，LIS长度恢复为√n log n标度。记录计数也呈线性增长，系数由Spitzer公式给出。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：对于有偏（p>1/2）高斯随机游走，平均LIS长度随步数n线性增长，系数a(p)从p=1/2时的0增加到p→1时的1；而在对称点（p=1/2）处，LIS长度恢复为√n log n标度。记录计数也呈线性增长，系数由Spitzer公式给出。；创新点：此前对随机游走LIS的研究主要集中于零均值、对称步长增量，本文首次系统研究了有偏（非对称）高斯随机游走的LIS行为，发现了从对称点的√n log n标度到有偏情况下的线性标度的转变，并揭示了LIS与记录骨架（record skeleton）在强偏置下的对齐现象。
papers.method_zh: 通过数值模拟研究具有单位方差和正漂移μ_p = Φ^{-1}(p)（其中p = ℙ(ξ>0)）的有偏高斯随机游走，计算并分析LIS长度和记录计数的统计性质。

papers.title: Sustainable Metal-Organic Framework Water Harvesters in the Artificial Intelligence Era
papers.abstract: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) are excellent candidates for water harvesting due to their tunable pore environments, which can be precisely engineered to capture and release water in arid conditions. Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into MOF discovery can further accelerate the design of high-performance sorbents by identifying structural features that enhance atmospheric water harvesting (AWH), stability, and cycling efficiency. In this Perspective, we examine key MOF design principles, including cooperative adsorption, operational relative humidity (RH), uptake capacity, hysteresis, and scalability. We highlight recent design advancements such as multivariate strategies and long-arm linker extension, and examine how these principles tune pore capacity and hydrophilicity, while preserving stability and crystallinity. Furthermore, we discuss how AI, large language models (LLMs), and data mining can accelerate the discovery process through predictive synthesis, inverse design, and elucidating synthesis-structure-property relationships for the next generation of MOF water harvesters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（Perspective/综述性观点文章）。判断依据：摘要中提及“examine key design principles”“highlight recent design advancements”“discuss how AI...can accelerate”，属于对已有研究进展的评述与未来展望，而非单一实验或计算工作。；研究对象：金属有机框架（MOFs）用于大气水收集（Atmospheric Water Harvesting, AWH）的材料设计，重点关注其孔道环境、吸附性能、稳定性及循环效率。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过精确调控MOF的孔道结构（如多元策略、长臂连接体延伸）可优化其吸水容量、亲水性和稳定性；人工智能（AI）和大语言模型（LLMs）有望通过预测合成、逆向设计及解析合成-结构-性能关系，加速下一代MOF水收集材料的发现。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过精确调控MOF的孔道结构（如多元策略、长臂连接体延伸）可优化其吸水容量、亲水性和稳定性；人工智能（AI）和大语言模型（LLMs）有望通过预测合成、逆向设计及解析合成-结构-性能关系，加速下一代MOF水收集材料的发现。；创新点：摘要未突出说明具体创新点，但整体视角在于将AI与MOF水收集材料设计相结合，强调通过数据驱动方法加速传统试错型材料开发流程。
papers.method_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体实验或计算方法，但提及了“cooperative adsorption”“operational RH”“uptake capacity”“hysteresis”“scalability”等设计原则，以及“multivariate strategies”“long-arm linker extension”等合成策略；在AI部分提到“predictive synthesis”“inverse design”“data mining”等计算/数据驱动方法。

papers.title: Passive memory reshapes active persistence
papers.abstract: Many active systems move in complex environments whose mechanical response is slow and history dependent. To address this regime, we study the collective dynamics of self-sustained active particles in non-Markovian media within a generalized Langevin framework with memory. We focus on the competition between the timescales of active persistence and viscoelastic relaxation in the environment. Using a minimal interacting model with an exponential memory kernel, we show that environmental memory qualitatively reshapes motility-induced phase separation of self-propelled active particles. When the memory timescale becomes comparable to the active persistence time, delayed viscoelastic stresses generate an effective anti-persistence that suppresses clustering and produces a broad metastable regime with slow nucleation dynamics. By contrast, for long memory timescales, reduced friction at short times enhances the effective propulsion velocity and restores phase separation. Our results demonstrate that the surrounding medium is not merely a passive background for active motion, but can actively regulate the emergence, stability, and dynamics of collective organization in active matter.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“generalized Langevin framework with memory”、“minimal interacting model with an exponential memory kernel”，属于理论建模与数值模拟研究。；研究对象：自驱动活性粒子在具有记忆效应的非马尔可夫介质中的集体动力学，特别是活性持续性与环境粘弹性弛豫之间的竞争对运动诱导相分离的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 环境记忆效应可以定性改变活性粒子的运动诱导相分离行为：当记忆时间尺度与活性持续性时间相当时，延迟的粘弹性应力产生有效的反持续性，抑制团簇形成并导致缓慢成核的亚稳态；而当记忆时间尺度很长时，短时摩擦减小增强了有效推进速度，从而恢复相分离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：环境记忆效应可以定性改变活性粒子的运动诱导相分离行为：当记忆时间尺度与活性持续性时间相当时，延迟的粘弹性应力产生有效的反持续性，抑制团簇形成并导致缓慢成核的亚稳态；而当记忆时间尺度很长时，短时摩擦减小增强了有效推进速度，从而恢复相分离。；创新点：揭示了环境介质并非活性运动的被动背景，而是能够主动调控活性物质集体组织的涌现、稳定性和动力学。摘要未突出说明与具体已有工作的对比细节。
papers.method_zh: 采用带有指数记忆核的广义朗之万框架，构建最小相互作用模型，分析非马尔可夫介质中自驱动活性粒子的集体动力学。

papers.title: Field-Driven Hybrid Filament Formation Governs Switching in Ta-HfO$_2$-Pt Memristors
papers.abstract: Memristive devices have gained significant attention for their potential in next-generation non-volatile memory and neuromorphic computing architectures. Among emerging candidates, transition metal oxides have proven particularly promising. While the switching mechanism in Ta/HfO$_2$/Pt devices was long attributed solely to oxygen vacancy based filaments, recent experimental evidence suggests a more complex dual-regime: the diffusion of metal cations also contributes to the formation of a conductive bridge. However, the precise atomistic mechanisms governing this metal cation migration remain poorly understood. Additionally, the role of defects such as oxygen vacancies present in the transition metal oxide in determining the final filament size and shape is also not well understood. Here, we employ molecular dynamics (MD) simulations with dynamic charge transfer to provide a detailed analysis of the atomistic mechanisms governing the co-formation of Ta-cation and oxygen-deficient filaments. We clearly show how varying the initial oxygen vacancy concentrations and spatial configurations within the HfO$_2$ matrix influences the final morphology and dimensions of the conductive filament. The switching is governed by field-driven formation and rupture of a hybrid Ta-cation-rich, oxygen-deficient filament in HfO$_2$. Our simulations closely match experiment, validating the model as a robust framework for understanding switching in oxide memristors and guiding designs that reduce cycle-to-cycle and device-to-device variability -- key barriers to high-performance devices.
