papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章（关键词：molecular dynamics simulations, dynamic charge transfer）；研究对象：Ta/HfO₂/Pt 忆阻器中的混合细丝（hybrid filament）形成与开关机制，具体涉及 Ta 阳离子与氧空位共同构成的导电细丝。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 开关行为由电场驱动的混合细丝（富 Ta 阳离子且缺氧）在 HfO₂ 中的形成与断裂所主导；初始氧空位浓度和空间分布显著影响最终细丝的形貌与尺寸。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：开关行为由电场驱动的混合细丝（富 Ta 阳离子且缺氧）在 HfO₂ 中的形成与断裂所主导；初始氧空位浓度和空间分布显著影响最终细丝的形貌与尺寸。；创新点：首次通过原子尺度模拟揭示了 Ta 阳离子与氧空位共同形成混合细丝的协同机制，并阐明了氧空位初始配置对细丝形态的调控作用，为解释实验中的双区制开关行为提供了微观模型。
papers.method_zh: 采用动态电荷转移的分子动力学（MD）模拟，分析原子尺度机制。

papers.title: Strongly-coupled hybrid lattice-plasmons in layered cuprates
papers.abstract: Metallic systems with delocalized valence electrons host collective charge density oscillations known as plasmons. On the other hand, conventional insulators do not have free electrons and the low energy charge degrees of freedom are pinned to the ions. The fate of the collective charge excitations in the intermediate regime is an outstanding question. This problem is especially important for strongly correlated systems such as the layered cuprates, where unconventional superconductivity and other emergent phenomena arise from valence electrons on the border between Mott localization and itinerancy. Using resonant inelastic X-ray scattering, we track this evolution in the prototypical electron-doped cuprate Nd2-xCexCuO4. We find a continuous transformation of the low-energy charge response: from an acoustic plasmon in the metallic regime, to a gapped hybrid mode at intermediate doping, and finally to a nearly dispersionless 139 meV excitation at half filling. Remarkably, the 139 meV excitation has approximately twice the energy of the oxygen breathing phonon responsible for the dispersion kink observed in angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, and is consistent with a putative 2-phonon excitation observed in Raman spectroscopy. These results establish a unified picture of collective charge excitations across the phase diagram of electron-doped cuprates, showing that such modes persist across the Mott transition via strong coupling to lattice degrees of freedom and revealing a missing link in the charge dynamics of carrier doped Mott insulators.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：resonant inelastic X-ray scattering（共振非弹性X射线散射）。；研究对象：电子掺杂的铜氧化物超导体 Nd₂₋ₓCeₓCuO₄ 中的集体电荷激发，特别是从金属态到Mott绝缘体转变过程中的等离激元与晶格振动耦合行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在电子掺杂铜氧化物中，低能电荷响应从金属态的声学等离激元连续演变为中间掺杂的有能隙杂化模式，最终在半填充时变为能量约139 meV的近无色散激发。该激发能量约为氧呼吸声子能量的两倍，表明集体电荷模式通过强耦合到晶格自由度而跨越Mott转变持续存在。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在电子掺杂铜氧化物中，低能电荷响应从金属态的声学等离激元连续演变为中间掺杂的有能隙杂化模式，最终在半填充时变为能量约139 meV的近无色散激发。该激发能量约为氧呼吸声子能量的两倍，表明集体电荷模式通过强耦合到晶格自由度而跨越Mott转变持续存在。；创新点：首次通过实验追踪了电子掺杂铜氧化物相图中从金属到Mott绝缘体全过程的集体电荷激发演化，揭示了等离激元与晶格振动强耦合形成的杂化模式，并建立了跨越Mott转变的统一图像，填补了载流子掺杂Mott绝缘体中电荷动力学缺失的一环。
papers.method_zh: 共振非弹性X射线散射（RIXS）。

papers.title: Long-Range Fermi-Polaron Blockade in Monolayer MoSe$_2$
papers.abstract: Strong optical nonlinearities at the few-photon level are a central goal for quantum photonics, yet they remain difficult to realize in solid-state systems. In doped two-dimensional semiconductors, coupling between excitons and a degenerate Fermi sea gives rise to exciton-Fermi polarons, many-body quasiparticles whose optical response is governed by fermionic correlations. Here, using femtosecond pump-probe transient absorption microscopy, we directly image the spatially resolved nonlinear optical response of exciton-Fermi polarons in monolayer MoSe$_2$. We observe a pronounced spatial suppression of resonant absorption associated with the attractive Fermi polaron, from which we extract an optical blockade radius that is more than ten times larger than that of the neutral exciton. Microscopic analysis indicates that this extended nonlinearity arises primarily from fermion-mediated interactions between exciton-Fermi polarons. Our results establish exciton-Fermi polarons in two-dimensional semiconductors as electrically tunable, strongly interacting optical quasiparticles, and identify them as a promising platform for ultralow-power nonlinear optical devices.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用了“femtosecond pump-probe transient absorption microscopy”（飞秒泵浦-探测瞬态吸收显微镜）这一具体实验技术，并描述了直接成像（directly image）和提取（extract）物理量的过程。；研究对象：单层MoSe₂（二硒化钼）中的激子-费米极化子（exciton-Fermi polarons）。具体物理现象是掺杂二维半导体中激子与简并费米海耦合形成的多体准粒子的非线性光学响应。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 实验观测到与吸引型费米极化子相关的共振吸收存在显著的空间抑制，并从中提取出比中性激子大十倍以上的光学阻塞半径（optical blockade radius）。微观分析表明，这种长程非线性主要源于费米子介导的激子-费米极化子之间的相互作用。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：实验观测到与吸引型费米极化子相关的共振吸收存在显著的空间抑制，并从中提取出比中性激子大十倍以上的光学阻塞半径（optical blockade radius）。微观分析表明，这种长程非线性主要源于费米子介导的激子-费米极化子之间的相互作用。；创新点：首次直接空间成像并量化了二维半导体中激子-费米极化子的非线性光学响应，发现了其远超中性激子的长程光学阻塞效应，并将其归因于费米子介导的相互作用。这为将激子-费米极化子确立为电学可调、强相互作用的准粒子平台提供了关键实验证据。
papers.method_zh: 飞秒泵浦-探测瞬态吸收显微镜（femtosecond pump-probe transient absorption microscopy）。这是一种空间分辨的非线性光学测量技术，用于直接成像样品的非线性光学响应。

papers.title: Multifractal Complexity of the Chandler Wobble and Its Anomalous Disappearance (2015--2020): A MFDFA Study
papers.abstract: The Chandler wobble (CW) -- the $\sim$433-day free nutation of Earth's rotation pole -- experienced an anomalous near-disappearance between 2015 and 2020, followed by a re-excitation with an approximately $180^{\circ}$ phase reversal. Using Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MFDFA) applied to more than six decades (1962--2024) of daily IERS EOP C04 polar motion data, this study provides the first multifractal characterisation of the CW and its recent anomaly. Global MFDFA shows that the residual polar motion components and the CW amplitude are genuine multifractal processes with strongly $q$-dependent generalised Hurst exponents and broad singularity spectra. Surrogate-data tests with shuffled and phase-randomised ensembles demonstrate that this multifractality originates from the combined action of long-range temporal correlations and heavy-tailed excitation statistics. A sliding-window analysis reveals a pronounced collapse in long-range persistence and multifractal spectral width of the geometric polar motion signal several years before and during the 2015--2020 amplitude minimum, indicating a genuine dynamical regime change rather than a simple suppression of oscillation amplitude. In contrast, the amplitude- and phase-related variables retain broad multifractal spectra and stable scaling exponents across all epochs, revealing a dynamical decoupling between the geometry of the CW and the multiscale structure of its amplitude and phase fluctuations. These findings highlight the CW amplitude as an exceptionally multifractal integrator of geophysical excitation and suggest that multifractal metrics may provide early-warning indicators of major transitions in Earth rotation dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/数据分析文章。判断依据：使用MFDFA方法对长期观测数据进行统计分析，属于数据驱动的计算研究。；研究对象：地球自转极点的钱德勒摆动（Chandler wobble, CW），即约433天周期的自由章动现象，及其在2015–2020年间出现的异常近消失与相位反转。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 钱德勒摆动振幅是一个真正的多重分形过程，其多重分形性源于长程时间相关性与重尾激发统计的共同作用；在2015–2020年振幅极小期前后，极移几何信号的长程持久性和多重分形谱宽度出现显著坍缩，表明发生了动力学机制转变，而非简单的振幅抑制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：钱德勒摆动振幅是一个真正的多重分形过程，其多重分形性源于长程时间相关性与重尾激发统计的共同作用；在2015–2020年振幅极小期前后，极移几何信号的长程持久性和多重分形谱宽度出现显著坍缩，表明发生了动力学机制转变，而非简单的振幅抑制。；创新点：首次对钱德勒摆动进行多重分形表征，并揭示了其振幅与相位涨落的多尺度结构在异常事件中的动力学解耦现象，提出多重分形指标可作为地球自转动力学重大转变的早期预警信号。
papers.method_zh: 多重分形去趋势波动分析（MFDFA），应用于1962–2024年每日IERS EOP C04极移数据；采用全局MFDFA、滑动窗口分析以及基于打乱和相位随机化的替代数据检验。

papers.title: Self-Assembly of Lipid-Biopolymer Periodic Nanostructures on Photonic Length Scales
papers.abstract: The self-assembly of photonic nanostructures in insects involves chitin, proteins, and lipids. While synthetic photonic systems have been extensively studied, current lipid-based self-assembly systems are limited in periodicity to $68\,\text{nm}$ compared to photonic length scales ($\approx 450\,\text{nm}$) observed in biological organisms. We hypothesise that lipids facilitate how structural colour arises in vivo by acting as templates for the self-assembly of biopolymers via lipidic lyotropic liquid crystal mesophases. Here, we aim to understand and identify how structural colour is produced in insects by the co-assembly of lipids and biopolymers. We study the effect of biopolymers, pH, temperature, surface charge, and stability on lipid vesicles using dynamic light scattering, X-ray scattering, and zeta potential analysis. Using cryo-electron microscopy, we demonstrate that these vesicles interact with the biopolymers and generate periodic nanostructures with periodicities ranging from $700\,\text{nm}$ to $1.2\,μ\text{m}$ (more than ten times larger than for purely lipidic systems) and dimensionalities ranging from 1D to 3D. Our results establish that lipid mesophases and biopolymers can induce reorganisation into ordered nanostructures, overcoming key limitations of periodicities achieved by lipid-only systems, and providing a methodology for recreating the physicochemical mechanisms underlying biophotonic structural colour.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：dynamic light scattering, X-ray scattering, zeta potential analysis, cryo-electron microscopy。；研究对象：脂质与生物聚合物（如几丁质、蛋白质）共组装形成的周期性纳米结构，以及其在光子长度尺度上产生结构色的物理机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 脂质与生物聚合物共组装可形成周期从700 nm到1.2 μm的周期性纳米结构（比纯脂质体系大十倍以上），并实现从一维到三维的维度调控，克服了纯脂质体系在周期性上的关键限制。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：脂质与生物聚合物共组装可形成周期从700 nm到1.2 μm的周期性纳米结构（比纯脂质体系大十倍以上），并实现从一维到三维的维度调控，克服了纯脂质体系在周期性上的关键限制。；创新点：首次证明脂质液晶中间相与生物聚合物共组装能够诱导形成光子长度尺度（>450 nm）的周期性有序纳米结构，为复现生物体内结构色的物理化学机制提供了新方法。
papers.method_zh: 动态光散射、X射线散射、Zeta电位分析、冷冻电子显微镜。

papers.title: Topological superconductivity from Abelian fractional Chern insulators
papers.abstract: Can a Laughlin anyon fluid become a topological superconductor? We answer this question for a $ν=1/3$ fractional Chern insulator (FCI) using a $U(3)$ infrared parton theory. Three charge-$e/3$ constituents form the electron, while three constituent pairs form a gauge-invariant charge-$2e$ Cooper pair. The resulting superconductors share an ordinary charge-$2e$ sector but differ in their neutral color response, giving an SC$^\ast$ with the parent Laughlin $U(1)_3$ order, a chiral topological superconductor with $c_-=3/2$, and a strong-pairing anyon superconductor with $c_-=3$. The same framework organizes a nearby $σ_{xy}=0$ charge density wave (CDW) state. At commensurate filling, the normal state and the $c_-=3$ and $c_-=3/2$ superconducting descendants are naturally tied to a period-three density order background, while the SC$^\ast$ branch can preserve microscopic translations. Away from commensuration, a chargon metal can pair into the same $c_-=3/2$ topological superconductor. The FCI, reentrant CDW, and chiral superconductivity are unified in the $U(3)$ parton theory.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：使用“parton theory”（部分子理论）进行理论分析，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：从阿贝尔分数量子霍尔态（Laughlin任意子流体）出发，研究其转变为拓扑超导体的可能性，具体体系为ν=1/3的分数量子陈绝缘体（FCI）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Laughlin任意子流体可以转变为拓扑超导体，且存在三种不同的超导相：继承母体Laughlin U(1)_3序的SC*相、手性拓扑超导体（c_-=3/2）和强配对任意子超导体（c_-=3）。这些超导相与电荷密度波（CDW）态在U(3)部分子理论框架下统一描述。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Laughlin任意子流体可以转变为拓扑超导体，且存在三种不同的超导相：继承母体Laughlin U(1)_3序的SC*相、手性拓扑超导体（c_-=3/2）和强配对任意子超导体（c_-=3）。这些超导相与电荷密度波（CDW）态在U(3)部分子理论框架下统一描述。；创新点：首次在理论上证明阿贝尔分数量子霍尔态（Laughlin任意子流体）可以转变为拓扑超导体，并系统分类了三种不同的超导相及其与CDW态的关联。摘要未突出说明与已有工作的具体对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用U(3)红外部分子理论（infrared parton theory）进行分析。将电子分解为三个电荷e/3的组分，三个组分对形成规范不变的电荷2e库珀对，通过分析不同配对通道的规范响应来区分超导相。

papers.title: Geometry-based Discovery of Calcium Battery Cathodes Accelerated by Foundational Machine-Learned Models
papers.abstract: Calcium batteries (CBs) are an attractive post-Li-ion technology, offering the appeal of Ca's natural abundance and high volumetric energy density. However, practical realization of CBs remains limited by the scarcity of positive electrode (cathode) materials that support reversible Ca$^{2+}$ (de)intercalation under electrochemical conditions. To address this challenge, we screen the materials project (MP) database for novel host structures that can intercalate Ca using geometry- and chemistry-based design principles. Specifically, we employ the Voronoi polyhedral volume as a descriptor of site compatibility for hosting Ca in potential frameworks. Further, we down-select candidate structures progressively through criteria including charge neutrality, absence of non-Ca mobile cations, thermodynamic (meta)stability, average voltage, and Ca migration barriers ($E_m$) using foundational machine-learning (ML) models. Subsequently, we validate the ensemble-ML-predicted $E_m$ in a subset of the final candidates using density functional theory based nudged elastic band calculations. Overall, from an initial pool of 52,945 MP structures, our workflow identifies 37 promising Ca cathode candidates, several of which exhibit favorable combinations of thermodynamic (meta)stability, voltage, and Ca-mobility, marking them as strong candidates for synthesis and electrochemical characterization. Particularly, we identify two Ca cathode candidates with markedly low Ca$^{2+}~E_m$ (CaSc$_2$V$_2$O$_8$ and CaVSO$_4$F$_3$), and four cathode candidates with thermodynamically stable charged states (Ca$_3$(CoO$_2$)$_4$, Ca$_3$Mn$_4$(TeO$_6$)$_2$, CaVF$_5$, and CaVSO$_4$F$_3$). Beyond identifying Ca-cathodes, our work establishes geometry-based descriptors and ML-based workflows as transferable methods for high-throughput screening, enabling the rapid discovery of novel materials for battery and other applications.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算文章。关键词：screening、machine-learning models、density functional theory、nudged elastic band calculations。；研究对象：钙电池正极（阴极）材料。具体筛选了Materials Project数据库中52,945种结构，寻找能够支持Ca²⁺可逆脱嵌的宿主结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过几何与化学设计原则及机器学习工作流，从5万余种结构中筛选出37种有前景的钙电池正极候选材料，其中CaSc₂V₂O₈和CaVSO₄F₃具有极低的Ca²⁺迁移势垒，Ca₃(CoO₂)₄、Ca₃Mn₄(TeO₆)₂、CaVF₅和CaVSO₄F₃具有热力学稳定的充电态。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过几何与化学设计原则及机器学习工作流，从5万余种结构中筛选出37种有前景的钙电池正极候选材料，其中CaSc₂V₂O₈和CaVSO₄F₃具有极低的Ca²⁺迁移势垒，Ca₃(CoO₂)₄、Ca₃Mn₄(TeO₆)₂、CaVF₅和CaVSO₄F₃具有热力学稳定的充电态。；创新点：建立了基于几何描述符（Voronoi多面体体积）和机器学习工作流的高通量筛选方法，并将其作为可迁移的方法学框架，不仅用于钙电池正极发现，还可推广至其他电池材料及应用的快速筛选。
papers.method_zh: 1）使用Voronoi多面体体积作为描述符评估Ca在潜在框架中的位点兼容性；2）通过电荷中性、无非Ca移动阳离子、热力学（亚）稳定性、平均电压和Ca迁移势垒（E_m）等标准逐步筛选，其中E_m预测采用基础机器学习模型（ensemble-ML）；3）对最终候选子集使用基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的微动弹性带（NEB）方法验证E_m。

papers.title: Critical states and anomalous wave transport in an aperiodic polariton monotile
papers.abstract: Recently "the Hat" monotile was introduced into the family of aperiodic tilings and quasicrystals boasting physical properties lying at the boundary of ordered and disordered systems. Here we study the two-dimensional wave transport, transverse localization and scaling properties of the quantum modes in a Monotile quasilattice. Our system is based on reconfigurable optical lattices for cavity-polaritons which provide flexible means to study wavepacket dynamics, strong nonlinear phenomena, and power-driven condensation in this new type of an aperiodic tiling. We confirm the existence of localized and critical states in the Monotile through direct diagonalization of the Schrödinger equation. Scaling analysis on the moments of the wavefunction distribution reveals anomalous transport regimes of super-diffusive and near sub-diffusive polariton transport associated with the fractal structure of the Monotile Hilbert space. We propose a strategy using resonantly excited polariton fluids to verify our findings.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章（关键词：direct diagonalization of the Schrödinger equation, scaling analysis, 未提及实验数据采集）；研究对象：基于“Monotile”（单铺砌块）准晶格的非周期光学晶格中的腔极化子（cavity-polaritons）波包输运、横向局域化及量子模式标度性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Monotile准晶格中确认存在局域态和临界态；波函数分布矩的标度分析揭示了与Monotile希尔伯特空间分形结构相关的反常输运行为（超扩散和近亚扩散）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Monotile准晶格中确认存在局域态和临界态；波函数分布矩的标度分析揭示了与Monotile希尔伯特空间分形结构相关的反常输运行为（超扩散和近亚扩散）。；创新点：首次将“The Hat”单铺砌块引入极化子系统，研究其二维波输运和临界态，并揭示了与分形希尔伯特空间相关的反常扩散机制。
papers.method_zh: 通过直接对角化薛定谔方程计算本征模式；对波函数分布矩进行标度分析以确定输运行为；提出利用共振激发极化子流体的实验验证策略。

papers.title: Interaction mechanics of acoustic cavitation with fibrin networks
papers.abstract: Stiff and dense fibrin networks in chronic blood clots impede drug penetration and distribution into the clot core, limiting the efficacy of thrombolytic therapies. Acoustic cavitation of microbubbles is a promising strategy to enhance drug delivery in soft tissues. However, the interaction of these bubbles with stiff fibrin networks has yet to be investigated. Here, we show that ultrasound-driven bubbles undergoing stable periodic oscillations can penetrate and alter dense fibrin networks. The penetrated bubbles create three-dimensional paths that enable nanobeads (matrix transport markers) to infiltrate up to 200 $μ$m m deep into the mesh. Radial bubble oscillation is found to be the dominant forcing mechanism on fibrin fibers. Combining mechanical measurements with these observations reveals that the bubble radial stress is insufficient to break the fibrin fibers in a single cycle. Instead, repeated sub-fracture loading from bubble oscillations induce plastic deformation and damage accumulation with each cycle. This is evident from drastic dissipation losses and softening of the network seen over thousands of cycles. We further explored the softening of fibrin networks at a range of peak applied forces. At low force, the fibrin networks undergo a shakedown effect with initial softening, which is resistant to further damage after hundreds of cycles. At higher force, networks continue to soften without reaching a stable state, indicating progressive damage accumulation. These results show that cavitation can enhance matrix transport in dense fiber networks. The underlying physics is governed by the viscoplastic mechanics of bubble-fibrin interactions. These findings establish a mechanistic framework to design comprehensive treatment strategies for fibrotic aged clots.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要中明确描述了实验观察（“we show that...”）、机械测量（“mechanical measurements”）以及循环加载实验（“over thousands of cycles”）。；研究对象：声空化气泡与致密纤维蛋白网络（fibrin networks）的相互作用力学，具体涉及慢性血凝块中气泡振荡对纤维网络结构及力学性能的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 超声驱动的稳定周期性振荡气泡能够穿透并改变致密纤维蛋白网络，通过反复亚断裂载荷诱导网络塑性变形和损伤累积，从而增强基质输运能力。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：超声驱动的稳定周期性振荡气泡能够穿透并改变致密纤维蛋白网络，通过反复亚断裂载荷诱导网络塑性变形和损伤累积，从而增强基质输运能力。；创新点：首次研究了刚性致密纤维蛋白网络中声空化气泡的相互作用机制，揭示了气泡径向振荡通过反复亚断裂加载导致网络塑性变形和损伤累积的粘塑性力学过程，为设计纤维化陈旧血凝块的治疗策略提供了机理框架。
papers.method_zh: 实验手段包括：超声驱动气泡实现稳定周期性振荡、光学观测气泡穿透路径、纳米珠示踪基质输运深度（达200 μm）、机械力学测量结合循环加载实验（数千周期），以及不同峰值力下的网络软化测试。

papers.title: Measuring anyon dispersion with tunneling probes
papers.abstract: Anyons are usually characterized by their topological data and their fractional quantum numbers under global symmetries. In lattice systems such as fractional Chern insulators (FCI), they are also mobile quasiparticles. Their motion controls the possible ground states of the dilute anyon gas obtained by doping an FCI, including possible superconducting states. We show how tunneling probes can measure this motion. In scanning tunneling spectroscopy, weak disorder produces spatially oscillating quasiparticle-interference patterns whose branches reveal the dispersion of fractionalized constituents. In quantum twisting microscopy, planar momentum-conserving tunneling selects the total momentum of the injected electron, so the continuum thresholds of fractionalized electron spectra encode the dispersion of the constituent anyons. The resulting spectra distinguish compact electron-like excitations, bound anyon molecules, and unbound anyon continuum.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show how、we show、tunneling probes measure、the resulting spectra distinguish。；研究对象：分数陈绝缘体（FCI）中任意子的色散关系，以及通过隧穿探针（扫描隧道谱和量子扭转显微镜）测量该色散的方法。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 隧穿探针（扫描隧道谱和量子扭转显微镜）可以测量分数陈绝缘体中任意子的运动色散，其谱特征能够区分紧致类电子激发、束缚任意子分子和未束缚任意子连续谱。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：隧穿探针（扫描隧道谱和量子扭转显微镜）可以测量分数陈绝缘体中任意子的运动色散，其谱特征能够区分紧致类电子激发、束缚任意子分子和未束缚任意子连续谱。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于扫描隧道谱中弱无序产生的准粒子干涉图案分支，以及量子扭转显微镜中平面动量守恒隧穿导致的连续谱阈值，推导任意子色散信息。

papers.title: Reinterpreting Memory Effects in Nonequilibrium Systems: From Temporal Dynamics to Steady-State Signatures via NEGF
papers.abstract: We investigate memory effects and quantum transport in two-dimensional lattice systems within the framework of non-equilibrium Green's functions and Schwinger-Keldysh non-equilibrium quantum field theory. Starting from a 2D tight-binding Hamiltonian, we employ the Dyson expansion on the Keldysh contour and the second-order Born and self-consistent Born Approximation to derive the electronic self-energies associated with elastic and inelastic scattering mechanisms.Static disorder produces a local self-energy and a rapidly decaying memory kernel, characteristic of Markovian dynamics, whereas electron-phonon coupling generates temporally nonlocal self-energies and genuine Non-Markovian behavior. We demonstrate that these distinct memory signatures are directly reflected in the spectral function, which we propose as a diagnostic probe of non-equilibrium memory effects. Further we explore 1PI and 2PI effective actions to see their memory perspectives studying their coarse-graining behavior. Building on this theoretical framework, we further apply the conventional NEGF formalism to two paradigmatic two-dimensional models-the Hofstadter and an RKKY-coupled system to explore how different microscopic Hamiltonians influence Markovian and Non-Markovian nature. Our results provide a unified connection between scattering mechanisms, memory effects, and quantum transport in low-dimensional systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要明确使用非平衡格林函数（NEGF）、Schwinger-Keldysh场论、Dyson展开、Born近似、有效作用量等理论工具，无实验或计算模拟关键词。；研究对象：二维晶格系统中的记忆效应与量子输运，具体包括Hofstadter模型和RKKY耦合系统两种典型二维模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 静态无序产生局域自能和快速衰减的记忆核，表现为马尔可夫动力学；而电子-声子耦合产生时间非局域自能和真正的非马尔可夫行为。这些不同的记忆特征可直接反映在谱函数中，因此谱函数可作为非平衡记忆效应的诊断探针。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：静态无序产生局域自能和快速衰减的记忆核，表现为马尔可夫动力学；而电子-声子耦合产生时间非局域自能和真正的非马尔可夫行为。这些不同的记忆特征可直接反映在谱函数中，因此谱函数可作为非平衡记忆效应的诊断探针。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 非平衡格林函数（NEGF）框架下的Schwinger-Keldysh量子场论，具体采用Keldysh轮廓上的Dyson展开、二阶Born近似和自洽Born近似推导电子自能，并分析了1PI和2PI有效作用量的粗粒化行为。

papers.title: Quantum Light Nano-Imaging
papers.abstract: Entanglement and quantum correlations are central to the physics of quantum materials, yet they have remained notoriously difficult to probe experimentally. Probing these phenomena in solids requires quantum optical probes that operate at the native length and time scales of material excitations, below the diffraction limit of light. Developing the requisite tools has previously been infeasible due to the extremely weak intensities of state-of-the-art quantum light sources and extreme inefficiency of near-field light-matter interactions. In this work, we circumvent these challenges and develop a quantum light scattering-type scanning near-field optical microscope (q-SNOM) that can explore the broad domain of solid-state quantum effects at length scales below the diffraction limit. In its first application, we image in real space the self-interference of single hybrid light-matter quasiparticles in a van der Waals semiconductor, providing a direct nanoscale visualization of the wave-particle duality. We also introduce a polaritonic time-of-flight metrology that exploits the temporal correlations among entangled photons to observe the quasiparticle propagation dynamics with femtosecond resolution. This work sets the stage for nanoscale exploration and control of quantum effects in materials.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。判断依据：摘要描述了开发新型显微镜（q-SNOM）并进行成像实验，关键词包括“develop”、“image in real space”、“introduce a polaritonic time-of-flight metrology”。；研究对象：量子材料中的量子光-物质相互作用，具体为范德瓦尔斯半导体中的混合光-物质准粒子（极化激元）及其波粒二象性。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 成功开发了一种量子光散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（q-SNOM），能够在衍射极限以下的空间尺度上，对固体中的量子效应进行实空间成像和超快动力学探测。首次在实空间直接可视化了单个混合光-物质准粒子的自干涉，即波粒二象性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：成功开发了一种量子光散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（q-SNOM），能够在衍射极限以下的空间尺度上，对固体中的量子效应进行实空间成像和超快动力学探测。首次在实空间直接可视化了单个混合光-物质准粒子的自干涉，即波粒二象性。；创新点：该工作克服了此前量子光源强度极弱和近场光-物质相互作用效率极低的双重挑战，首次将量子光学探针与近场纳米成像技术结合，实现了在材料本征长度尺度（亚衍射极限）上对量子效应的实空间成像和飞秒时间分辨的动力学探测。
papers.method_zh: 实验方法为量子光散射型扫描近场光学显微镜（q-SNOM）。具体技术包括：利用量子光源（纠缠光子）与近场光学显微镜结合，并引入了一种基于纠缠光子时间关联的极化激元飞行时间测量技术。

papers.title: Symmetry and integrability in the anyon-Hubbard model
papers.abstract: Recent cold atom experiments have realized one-dimensional anyons and enabled the tuning of 1D~statistics between bosons and fermions. Here, we analyze the symmetries, integrability, and resulting degeneracies of the underlying anyon-Hubbard model of finite length. Our results reveal a switching between symmetry classes AI, BDI, and CI in dependence on system size, particle number, and boundary conditions, and show that two anyons with periodic boundaries are integrable, while two anyons with open boundary conditions are not. We include a comprehensive analysis of all model limits, especially of interacting bosons and pseudofermions and resolve spectral signatures. We additionally reveal an exactly solvable doublon state that hides in the continuum of scattering states and the exact solution of the nullspace of two noninteracting anyons. The uncovered symmetries shape the fundamental properties of the one-dimensional anyons at hand, and the predicted states are accessible in state-of-the-art experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“分析对称性、可积性及简并”，并涉及“精确解”、“零空间精确解”等理论分析关键词，未提及实验数据或计算模拟。；研究对象：任意子-哈伯德模型（anyon-Hubbard model），具体研究有限长度一维任意子系统的对称性、可积性及其导致的能谱简并。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 揭示了任意子-哈伯德模型在有限系统中对称性类（AI、BDI、CI）随系统尺寸、粒子数和边界条件的切换；发现周期性边界条件下两个任意子是可积的，而开放边界条件下不可积；并发现一个隐藏在散射态连续谱中的精确可解双占据态（doublon state）。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：揭示了任意子-哈伯德模型在有限系统中对称性类（AI、BDI、CI）随系统尺寸、粒子数和边界条件的切换；发现周期性边界条件下两个任意子是可积的，而开放边界条件下不可积；并发现一个隐藏在散射态连续谱中的精确可解双占据态（doublon state）。；创新点：首次系统揭示了任意子-哈伯德模型中对称性类随系统参数（尺寸、粒子数、边界条件）的动态切换，并发现开放边界条件下两个任意子不可积这一反直觉结果，以及隐藏在连续谱中的精确可解双占据态。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：对称性分类（基于随机矩阵理论的对称性类AI、BDI、CI）、可积性分析、模型极限（相互作用玻色子、赝费米子）的全面分析、零空间精确求解。

papers.title: Order-disorder trade-off in dirty quantum systems
papers.abstract: We prove a trade-off theorem for order and disorder parameters in one-dimensional quantum spin systems with quenched disorder. For a disordered ensemble with exact Ising symmetry and average translation symmetry, any gapped ensemble must have one and only one of the following: an $O(1)$ order parameter or an $O(1)$ disorder parameter with even parity, both of the Edwards-Anderson type. The result extends to nearly gapped ensembles that accommodate Griffiths-type rare-region effects. These results offer a powerful and rigorous framework to understand the disorder effects beyond perturbative approaches. As applications, we (1) establish the existence of string order parameters for SPT phases; (2) derive a Lieb-Schultz-Mattis-type constraint for disordered ensembles, which requires a nearly gapped ensemble to spontaneously break the symmetry; and (3) discuss similar trade-off relations for disordered fermion chains, leading to an improved understanding of certain "intrinsically disordered" topological phases.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“prove a trade-off theorem”（证明一个权衡定理）、“rigorous framework”（严格框架）、“beyond perturbative approaches”（超越微扰方法），属于严格数学物理理论推导。；研究对象：具有淬火无序的一维量子自旋系统，具体涉及伊辛对称性和平均平移对称性下的无序系综，以及无序费米子链。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 证明了一维量子自旋系统中序参量与无序参量之间存在严格的权衡定理：任何有能隙的无序系综必须且只能具有以下两者之一——一个O(1)的序参量，或一个具有偶宇称的O(1)无序参量（均为Edwards-Anderson类型）。该结果可推广至包含Griffiths型稀罕区效应的近能隙系综。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：证明了一维量子自旋系统中序参量与无序参量之间存在严格的权衡定理：任何有能隙的无序系综必须且只能具有以下两者之一——一个O(1)的序参量，或一个具有偶宇称的O(1)无序参量（均为Edwards-Anderson类型）。该结果可推广至包含Griffiths型稀罕区效应的近能隙系综。；创新点：提供了一个超越微扰方法的严格理论框架来理解无序效应，并首次建立了无序系统中序参量与无序参量之间的严格权衡定理。摘要未突出说明与具体数值方法或实验的对比。
papers.method_zh: 采用严格的数学证明框架，基于对称性分析（伊辛对称性、平均平移对称性）和能隙条件，推导出序参量与无序参量的权衡关系。应用部分涉及SPT相的弦序参量存在性证明、Lieb-Schultz-Mattis型约束的推导，以及对无序费米子链的类似权衡关系讨论。

papers.title: Graph-based emulation of $d$-dimensional curved spaces with superconducting arrays
papers.abstract: We introduce a framework for emulating graphs and, through them, curved spaces of arbitrary dimension, using arrays of superconducting wires. The array consists of two stacked layers of wires, horizontal and vertical, such that wires are parallel within each layer and perpendicular between layers. By discretizing a space into a graph, assigning a superconducting wire with a rigid phase to each vertex, and coupling pairs of wires through Josephson junctions along the graph edges, arbitrary geometries and topologies can be engineered in a controlled setting. The superconducting phases then realize scalar field theories on the emergent geometry. We establish experimentally realistic conditions for implementing these architectures and develop a dictionary relating measurable circuit observables to quantities in the emulated field theory. As an application, we develop the implementation of hyperbolic (Anti-de Sitter) spaces of constant negative curvature and use them as an experimentally accessible platform to explore holographic duality in arbitrary dimensions. We investigate the effects of disorder in the Josephson couplings, which translate into metric variations in the bulk-boundary correspondence, and analyze their impact on boundary scaling exponents both analytically and numerically, finding that holographic duality remains robust even in the presence of strong disorder. Beyond holography, the framework opens a broad range of architectural possibilities, including the exploration of physics on highly nontrivial graphs and toy models of dynamical spacetimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：framework, emulating, develop a dictionary, analytically and numerically）；研究对象：基于超导阵列的图模拟框架，用于模拟任意维度的弯曲空间（特别是双曲/反德西特空间），并探索全息对偶。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过超导阵列构建的图模拟平台，即使在强无序（约瑟夫森耦合无序）下，全息对偶的边界标度指数仍保持鲁棒性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过超导阵列构建的图模拟平台，即使在强无序（约瑟夫森耦合无序）下，全息对偶的边界标度指数仍保持鲁棒性。；创新点：提出了一个可实验实现的超导阵列架构，用于模拟任意维度的弯曲空间（包括常负曲率的双曲空间），并首次在该平台上系统研究了无序对全息对偶边界标度指数的影响，发现其鲁棒性。
papers.method_zh: 理论框架设计：将空间离散化为图，每个顶点对应一根具有刚性相位的超导线，边通过约瑟夫森结耦合；通过电路可观测量与场论量的对应字典，实现标量场理论在模拟几何上的实现；对无序效应进行解析与数值分析。

papers.title: Controlled Loop Expansion for Strained Twisted Bilayer Graphene
papers.abstract: We develop a controlled diagrammatic framework for periodic Anderson models,and apply it to heterostrained magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG) at charge neutrality using the topological heavy-fermion formulation. Building on arXiv:2604.14278, we organize self-energy insertions and perform a Dyson resummation to any order in the small parameter $s^2$ -- the fraction of the moiré Brillouin zone with nontrivial quantum geometry. For strained MATBG, the expansion remains controlled down to arbitrarily low temperatures as long as the strain induced energy scale is not too small. In the flat-chiral limit, an emergent approximate $\rm{U}(1)$ symmetry forbids the leading scattering channel and leaves the Mott bands sharp at order $s^2$. This is in stark contrast to the unstrained case, where the linewidth is of order $N_f s^2 U$ with $U$ the on-site $f$-$f$ Hubbard interaction and $N_f$ the number of $f$ states per site. Away from the chiral limit, the linewidth is non-zero at order $s^2$ but more than an order of magnitude smaller than in the unstrained case. The strain-induced energy scale also imprints itself directly on the spectrum: as an electron-phonon-like kink in the dispersion, and as an additional flat ``trion'' band -- a single-particle excitation bound to a local $f$ particle-hole pair. We use the framework to predict the Quantum Twisting Microscope spectrum at one-loop order for both strained and unstrained MATBG, and compare with recent experiments.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“develop a controlled diagrammatic framework”（发展受控图论框架）、“perform a Dyson resummation”（进行戴森重求和）、“predict the spectrum”（预测谱）。；研究对象：异质应变魔角扭曲双层石墨烯（heterostrained magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene, MATBG）在电荷中性点（charge neutrality）的电子结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在应变作用下，魔角扭曲双层石墨烯的准粒子线宽（linewidth）在平坦-手征极限下被强烈抑制，远小于无应变情况；应变引入的能量尺度会在能谱中产生类似电子-声子耦合的扭结（kink）和一个额外的平坦“三子”（trion）能带。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在应变作用下，魔角扭曲双层石墨烯的准粒子线宽（linewidth）在平坦-手征极限下被强烈抑制，远小于无应变情况；应变引入的能量尺度会在能谱中产生类似电子-声子耦合的扭结（kink）和一个额外的平坦“三子”（trion）能带。；创新点：1. 将受控图论展开方法应用于有应变的魔角扭曲双层石墨烯，并证明在应变能标度不太小的情况下，该展开在任意低温下都保持受控。2. 揭示了应变导致的近似U(1)对称性对手征平坦极限下散射通道的禁止作用，从而解释了线宽被强烈抑制的物理机制。3. 预测了应变诱导的“三子”能带这一新的单粒子激发模式。
papers.method_zh: 基于拓扑重费米子（topological heavy-fermion）表述，发展了一个针对周期性安德森模型（periodic Anderson model）的受控图论框架。该框架通过组织自能插入并进行戴森重求和，在小参数$s^2$（莫尔布里渊区中具有非平庸量子几何的分数）的任意阶展开中保持受控。

papers.title: Improving CFT Operators Using Machine Learning
papers.abstract: Finite-size effects limit the accuracy with which conformal data can be extracted from lattice simulations of critical systems. While action improvement suppresses some corrections to scaling, it does not address operator-dependent effects arising from imperfect lattice representations of continuum conformal fields. In this work, we propose a data-driven method for improving lattice operators themselves, constructing estimators with enhanced overlap with the corresponding primary operators of the continuum conformal field theory. We identify improved lattice representations of leading spin and energy operators in three two-dimensional critical systems: the Ising model, the q = 3 Potts model, and the dilute q = 3 Potts model. In all cases, the resulting operators exhibit reduced corrections to scaling and yield more accurate estimates of scaling dimensions compared to conventional lattice choices. The code and analysis workflows used to produce these results are made available in an accompanying GitHub repository.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论混合类型。判断依据：提出数据驱动方法（data-driven method）、机器学习（Machine Learning）、数值模拟（lattice simulations）。；研究对象：二维临界系统中的共形场论（CFT）算符。具体体系包括：Ising模型、q=3 Potts模型、稀化q=3 Potts模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 通过机器学习方法改进格点算符的表示，可以显著增强算符与连续共形场论中初级算符的重叠，从而减小有限尺寸标度修正，获得比传统格点选择更精确的标度维度估计。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：通过机器学习方法改进格点算符的表示，可以显著增强算符与连续共形场论中初级算符的重叠，从而减小有限尺寸标度修正，获得比传统格点选择更精确的标度维度估计。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 数据驱动的算符改进方法（data-driven method for improving lattice operators），通过构造具有增强重叠的估计量（estimators）来优化格点算符。具体针对三个二维临界系统，识别了领头自旋算符和能量算符的改进格点表示。代码和分析流程已公开在GitHub仓库。

papers.title: Comment on "Spin-1/2 Kagome Heisenberg Antiferromagnet: Machine Learning Discovery of the Spinon Pair-Density-Wave Ground State"
papers.abstract: A recent article [Phys. Rev. X 15, 011047 (2025)] utilizes group-equivariant convolutional neural networks to study the ground state of the kagome Heisenberg antiferromagnet. On the largest finite-size cluster studied to date ($N=108$), the authors report variational energies significantly lower than other numerical methods, including state-of-the-art density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations. In contrast to previous results suggesting a possible spin-liquid ground state, the authors observe a spinon pair-density-wave ground state. We find that: (i) the reported low energies are artifacts of broken ergodicity in the Metropolis--Hastings sampling, since the single-spin-flip update rule utilized by the authors effectively freezes the Markov chains; and (ii) when ergodic sampling is enforced via spin-exchange updates, the neural network converges to energies significantly higher than existing DMRG results, calling the paper's claims into question.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：利用神经网络、变分能量、DMRG计算、马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样。；研究对象：Kagome晶格上的自旋-1/2海森堡反铁磁体，具体研究其基态性质。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 该文指出，原论文声称的极低变分能量是Metropolis-Hastings采样中单自旋翻转更新规则导致遍历性破缺的伪影；当采用自旋交换更新恢复遍历性后，神经网络给出的能量显著高于现有DMRG结果，因此原论文关于自旋子对密度波基态的结论存疑。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：该文指出，原论文声称的极低变分能量是Metropolis-Hastings采样中单自旋翻转更新规则导致遍历性破缺的伪影；当采用自旋交换更新恢复遍历性后，神经网络给出的能量显著高于现有DMRG结果，因此原论文关于自旋子对密度波基态的结论存疑。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 使用群等变卷积神经网络进行变分基态计算，结合马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛采样（分别采用单自旋翻转更新和自旋交换更新），并与密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）结果进行能量对比。

papers.title: Quantum Desynchronization of Limit Cycles
papers.abstract: It is well known from classical physics that weakly coupled self-sustained oscillators may spontaneously lock their phases. Just like classical synchronization is known to break down due to noise induced phase slips, we show here how the synchronization of continuous variable quantum systems breaks down by proliferation of quantum phase slips. Within a Keldysh path integral formulation of limit cycles, we analyze the phase dynamics and show how, in spite of strong phase correlations, quantum phase slips degrade the actual phase locking. This approach also allows us to address non-Markovian effects on the synchronization of limit cycles, which we illustrate explicitly for superconducting resonators coupled via a voltage biased double quantum dot.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：Keldysh path integral formulation（Keldysh路径积分）、phase dynamics analysis（相位动力学分析）。；研究对象：连续变量量子系统中极限环的同步与去同步化现象，具体以通过电压偏置双量子点耦合的超导谐振器为例。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 经典弱耦合自持振荡器的相位锁定会因噪声诱导的相位滑移而破坏；类似地，连续变量量子系统的同步会因量子相位滑移的增殖而退化，即使存在强相位关联，实际相位锁定仍被破坏。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：经典弱耦合自持振荡器的相位锁定会因噪声诱导的相位滑移而破坏；类似地，连续变量量子系统的同步会因量子相位滑移的增殖而退化，即使存在强相位关联，实际相位锁定仍被破坏。；创新点：首次在连续变量量子系统中揭示量子相位滑移如何导致同步失效，并建立了非马尔可夫效应下极限环同步的理论框架。
papers.method_zh: 采用Keldysh路径积分形式化描述极限环，分析相位动力学；并利用该方法处理非马尔可夫效应对极限环同步的影响。

papers.title: Quantum Synchronization of Fock States
papers.abstract: Synchronization, a ubiquitous phenomenon in classical systems, has recently been extended to the quantum domain. Here, we show quantum synchronization of a bosonic mode exhibiting a Fock state-like limit cycle, manifesting as a steady state with a negative Wigner function. We demonstrate that this non-classical state can be phase-locked to an external drive, achieving synchronization within an Arnold tongue regime. We argue that synchronization is a dynamical property and fundamentally tied to the suppression of phase slips, which we show to occur with exponentially decreasing probability. We introduce a novel method to extract the phase slip rate from the Lindblad time evolution of the system. This work opens new avenues for understanding and manipulating non-classical synchronization dynamics.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show、demonstrate、argue、introduce a novel method（理论推导与数值分析）。；研究对象：玻色子模的量子同步现象，具体表现为具有负Wigner函数的Fock态极限环。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Fock态极限环可被外部驱动锁相，在Arnold舌区域内实现量子同步，且相位滑移概率呈指数衰减。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Fock态极限环可被外部驱动锁相，在Arnold舌区域内实现量子同步，且相位滑移概率呈指数衰减。；创新点：首次展示了非经典Fock态（负Wigner函数）的量子同步，并建立了同步与相位滑移抑制之间的指数关联。
papers.method_zh: 基于Lindblad主方程的时间演化，提出从系统动力学中提取相位滑移率的新方法。

papers.title: Heralded ultrafast generation of macroscopic quantum states in matter with bright squeezed vacuum light
papers.abstract: We show that bright squeezed vacuum light, combined with a single-shot quadrature measurement of the post-interaction light, enables the ultrafast generation of macroscopic quantum states in matter. Although in the weak-coupling regime multiphoton quantum light leaves the unconditional matter state as a classical mixture due to light--matter entanglement, quadrature-based heralding prepares the matter in a Gaussian-weighted quantum superposition. For an ensemble of resonantly electric-dipole-coupled two-level systems, this heralding dynamics acts as a Gaussian filter with respect to the electric polarization, with brighter squeezed-vacuum light accelerating the preparation of the zero-eigenvalue Dicke state. Counter-rotating terms further drive a stroboscopic transition from this Dicke state to a cat-like state. Our results open a route to ultrafast engineering of macroscopic quantum matter with strong-field quantum light.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：show, enables, acts as, drive, open a route（均为理论推导与预测性表述）。；研究对象：宏观量子态在物质中的超快制备，具体体系为共振电偶极耦合的二能级系统（two-level systems）的系综。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用明亮压缩真空光（bright squeezed vacuum light）并结合单次正交测量（single-shot quadrature measurement），可在弱耦合条件下通过“预示”（heralding）机制在物质中制备高斯权重量子叠加态，并进一步通过反旋转项（counter-rotating terms）驱动从Dicke态到类猫态（cat-like state）的跃迁。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用明亮压缩真空光（bright squeezed vacuum light）并结合单次正交测量（single-shot quadrature measurement），可在弱耦合条件下通过“预示”（heralding）机制在物质中制备高斯权重量子叠加态，并进一步通过反旋转项（counter-rotating terms）驱动从Dicke态到类猫态（cat-like state）的跃迁。；创新点：首次提出利用明亮压缩真空光（而非传统弱相干光或单光子源）结合单次正交测量，在弱耦合条件下实现宏观量子态的超快制备，并揭示了反旋转项在从Dicke态向类猫态转变中的关键作用。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：基于光-物质纠缠的量子光学模型，采用正交测量作为预示手段，分析弱耦合下多光子量子光与二能级系综的相互作用动力学，并引入反旋转项研究态的非绝热演化。

papers.title: Ridge Regression from Poisson Resetting: A Renewal Perspective on Spectral Regularization
papers.abstract: We connect stochastic resetting from non-equilibrium statistical physics with ridge regularization in statistical learning. For linear gradient flow, resetting to the origin at rate $r$ produces stationary mean $(X^\top X+rI)^{-1}X^\top y$, exactly the ridge estimator with penalty $λ=r$. This uses the known Laplace-transform relationship between ridge regression and exponential-time averaging of gradient flow, with the exponential time now interpreted as the stationary age associated with Poisson resetting. We then extend this identity to general renewal reset laws: the exponential reset time distribution is the unique renewal law whose stationary mean reproduces scalar ridge in every eigendirection as an exact filter identity for every positive curvature, while non-exponential renewal laws generate alternative spectral filters. At the fluctuation level, we study a separate additive Ornstein-Uhlenbeck extension with constant diffusion, interpreted as a stylized SGD approximation. In this setting, the equality holds only at the level of the mean, since the reset process has a nonzero stationary covariance from accumulated OU noise and reset-timing variance, whereas deterministic ridge is a fixed estimator with the same center. Stylized experiments compare the deterministic renewal-induced filters directly and illustrate when filters induced by non-exponential reset-time laws can differ predictively from ridge. The results for the stationary mean and the induced spectral filters are established for continuous-time gradient flow with isotropic resetting on quadratic objectives; the covariance and risk formulas additionally assume additive noise with state-independent covariance.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：连接（connect）、理论框架（renewal perspective）、推导（establish）、公式（formulas）。；研究对象：统计学习中的岭回归（ridge regression）与非平衡统计物理中的随机重置（stochastic resetting）之间的理论联系，具体研究线性梯度流在二次目标函数上的动力学行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 发现泊松重置（指数重置时间分布）下的梯度流稳态均值恰好等于岭回归估计量，且指数重置是唯一能在每个本征方向上精确实现标量岭回归滤波的重置律；非指数重置律则产生替代的谱滤波器。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：发现泊松重置（指数重置时间分布）下的梯度流稳态均值恰好等于岭回归估计量，且指数重置是唯一能在每个本征方向上精确实现标量岭回归滤波的重置律；非指数重置律则产生替代的谱滤波器。；创新点：首次从非平衡统计物理的随机重置视角重新诠释岭回归的谱正则化机制，并推广到一般更新重置律，揭示了指数重置律在谱滤波中的唯一性。
papers.method_zh: 采用解析理论推导，包括：拉普拉斯变换关系、更新过程（renewal process）理论、奥恩斯坦-乌伦贝克（Ornstein-Uhlenbeck）过程扩展，以及数值实验对比不同重置律诱导的滤波器。

papers.title: Critical exponents for planar random-cluster model with cluster-weight $q=4$
papers.abstract: Using the Baxter-Kelland-Wu coupling and the convergence of the height function of the six-vertex model to the Gaussian Free Field, we extract critical exponents for the planar critical random-cluster model at $q=4$, and the planar four-state Potts model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：关键词“提取临界指数”、“耦合”、“收敛性”。；研究对象：平面随机团簇模型（cluster-weight $q=4$）和平面四态Potts模型。具体物理现象为这些模型在临界点处的临界指数。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 利用Baxter-Kelland-Wu耦合以及六顶点模型高度函数收敛到高斯自由场这一结果，成功提取了$q=4$时平面临界随机团簇模型和平面四态Potts模型的临界指数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：利用Baxter-Kelland-Wu耦合以及六顶点模型高度函数收敛到高斯自由场这一结果，成功提取了$q=4$时平面临界随机团簇模型和平面四态Potts模型的临界指数。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 理论推导。具体框架为：1. 利用Baxter-Kelland-Wu耦合将随机团簇模型与六顶点模型联系起来；2. 利用六顶点模型的高度函数收敛到高斯自由场这一已知结论，从中提取临界指数。

papers.title: Lattice Brownian bees with cooperative reproduction: steady states, collapse, and spreading
papers.abstract: We extend the ``Brownian bees'' model of Berestycki et al. (2021, 2022) to cooperative reproduction, $kA\to(k{+}1)A$, of a population of $N$ symmetric random walkers with removal, at each birth event, of the particle farthest from the origin. Working in the limit $N\to\infty$, we formulate a hydrodynamic free-boundary problem for this model. Using this formalism, we determine steady state population densities for all~$k$ and prove their linear stability for $k\le 2$ and instability for $k\ge 4$. In the marginal case $k=3$, there is a whole continuous family of steady states at a single, critical ratio of the reproduction and diffusion rates. Above criticality the population undergoes an asymptotically self-similar finite-time collapse to the origin. Below the criticality the population spreads diffusively, but the reproduction remains quantitatively relevant. For $k\ge 4$, the unstable steady state separates regimes of a finite-time collapse and a diffusive spreading. Here the collapse dynamics is asymptotically self-similar, and the population density exhibits a scale separation requiring a matched-asymptotic description. Our analytical predictions are confirmed by numerical solutions of the hydrodynamic free-boundary problem and by Monte Carlo simulations of the original microscopic model.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“formulate a hydrodynamic free-boundary problem”、“analytical predictions”、“numerical solutions”和“Monte Carlo simulations”，属于理论建模与数值模拟结合的研究。；研究对象：论文研究的是“布朗蜜蜂”模型的扩展版本，具体为具有合作繁殖机制（kA → (k+1)A）的对称随机游走粒子群体，在每次出生事件中移除离原点最远的粒子。该模型描述了一个有限种群在空间中的演化，涉及稳态、坍缩和扩散行为。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 论文发现，对于合作繁殖指数k，稳态密度在k≤2时线性稳定，在k≥4时不稳定；在临界k=3时存在连续稳态族。在超临界条件下种群发生有限时间自相似坍缩至原点，在亚临界条件下种群扩散传播，但繁殖仍定量影响动力学。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：论文发现，对于合作繁殖指数k，稳态密度在k≤2时线性稳定，在k≥4时不稳定；在临界k=3时存在连续稳态族。在超临界条件下种群发生有限时间自相似坍缩至原点，在亚临界条件下种群扩散传播，但繁殖仍定量影响动力学。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 采用流体力学自由边界问题（hydrodynamic free-boundary problem）进行理论建模，在N→∞极限下推导出宏观方程；通过线性稳定性分析判断稳态的稳定性；利用匹配渐近展开（matched-asymptotic description）描述k≥4时的尺度分离坍缩动力学；并通过数值求解自由边界问题以及蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulations）验证理论预测。

papers.title: Open Problem: Separating Geometric and Algorithmic Compression via Cayley-Table Completion
papers.abstract: Modern statistical learning theory and deep learning characterize generalization primarily in terms of continuous capacity control (e.g., norm-based regularization, margin maximization, low-rank bias). While highly successful in continuous domains, deep learning consistently fails to extrapolate exact algorithmic or discrete algebraic rules, reflecting a missing inductive bias toward algorithmic complexity minimization. We propose the Cayley-table completion as the canonical testbed for this missing bias, serving as the discrete algebraic counterpart to matrix completion. Just as matrix factorization combined with weight decay yields an implicit geometric bias toward low linear rank, recent results demonstrate that operator-valued tensor factorizations paired with a flatness prior yield an implicit algorithmic bias toward exact discrete associativity. We pose the open problem of establishing formal exact recovery bounds for Cayley-table completion, and challenge the community to generalize continuous flatness priors to autonomously discover broader discrete algorithmic axioms without combinatorial search.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（关键词：open problem、theoretical bounds、inductive bias、algorithmic complexity minimization）；研究对象：离散代数规则的学习与泛化问题，具体以“凯莱表补全”（Cayley-table completion）作为测试平台，类比于连续域中的矩阵补全问题。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体物理结论或发现，但指出：在连续域中有效的容量控制方法（如权重衰减、低秩偏置）无法自动推广到离散代数规则的学习；而算子值张量分解结合平坦性先验可隐式诱导出精确的离散结合律（associativity），从而提出建立凯莱表补全的精确恢复理论界限这一开放问题。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：摘要未明确说明具体物理结论或发现，但指出：在连续域中有效的容量控制方法（如权重衰减、低秩偏置）无法自动推广到离散代数规则的学习；而算子值张量分解结合平坦性先验可隐式诱导出精确的离散结合律（associativity），从而提出建立凯莱表补全的精确恢复理论界限这一开放问题。；创新点：首次将“矩阵补全”的隐式几何偏置（低秩）类比推广到“凯莱表补全”的隐式算法偏置（离散结合律），并明确提出该方向作为检验深度学习缺乏算法复杂度最小化归纳偏置的规范测试平台。摘要未突出说明具体技术实现或实验验证。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析框架，涉及：统计学习理论、深度学习的泛化理论、矩阵补全与张量分解的隐式偏置分析、平坦性先验（flatness prior）在离散代数结构中的应用。

papers.title: Gate Parameter Lee-Yang Zeros and Dynamical Phases in Quantum Circuits
papers.abstract: We propose gate-parameter Lee-Yang zeros of Loschmidt amplitudes as probes of dynamical phases in finite quantum circuits. We illustrate this approach using a brickwork model, where the time evolution is generated by repeated application of a Floquet operator. The Loschmidt amplitude can be expressed as a rational function of the gate parameters. At fixed system size and large circuit depth, its zeros in one complexified gate parameter, with the other parameter held fixed, condense onto limiting curves. We show that these curves comprise a universal component governed by equimodular Floquet eigenvalues, as described by the Beraha-Kahane-Weiss theorem, together with state-dependent contributions controlled by the overlap of eigenstate of the Floquet operator with the initial state. As one of the parameters is varied, the set of zeros reorganizes abruptly, providing a finite-qubit diagnostic of a dynamical phase transition. This mechanism does not rely on integrability: while integrability enables an exact calculation of the Loschmidt amplitude, the condensation of zeros follows from spectral competition and local unitarity alone.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：提出理论框架（gate-parameter Lee-Yang zeros）、数学分析（Beraha-Kahane-Weiss定理）、不依赖实验或数值计算的具体实现。；研究对象：有限量子电路中的动力学相，具体通过砖墙模型（brickwork model）和Floquet算符生成的时间演化来研究。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: Loschmidt振幅在复化门参数中的零点会凝聚成极限曲线，这些曲线由等模Floquet本征值（通用部分）和初态与本征态重叠（态依赖部分）共同决定；参数变化时零点集发生突变，可作为有限量子比特系统中动力学相变的诊断。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：Loschmidt振幅在复化门参数中的零点会凝聚成极限曲线，这些曲线由等模Floquet本征值（通用部分）和初态与本征态重叠（态依赖部分）共同决定；参数变化时零点集发生突变，可作为有限量子比特系统中动力学相变的诊断。；创新点：首次提出将门参数Lee-Yang零点作为有限量子电路中动力学相的探针，并证明该机制不依赖可积性，仅需谱竞争和局域幺正性即可实现零点凝聚。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析：将Loschmidt振幅表示为门参数的有理函数，利用Beraha-Kahane-Weiss定理分析零点凝聚行为，并讨论可积性与谱竞争、局域幺正性在零点凝聚中的作用。

papers.title: Low-Magnification SEM May Suffice: Interpretable Deep Learning for Multi-Scale Fracture-Cause Classification in Zirconia-Toughened Alumina
papers.abstract: Reliable identification of fracture origins in alumina matrix composite hip and knee implants is critical for quality assurance and patient safety, yet current fractographic workflows are time-consuming, partly subjective, and reliant on high-magnification scanning electron microscopy (SEM). We present an interpretable vision-transformer (ViT) workflow for automated classification of fracture causes in an alumina matrix composite (BIOLOX delta, CeramTec GmbH) widely used in total joint replacements. A dataset of 8,493 SEM images (50x-10,000x) was curated from five years of in-production burst and proof tests and annotated into three defect categories defined along the manufacturing chain: green body, hard machining, and material defects. Under severe class imbalance, the fine-tuned ViT reached an accuracy of 0.907 and a macro-F1 of 0.888 in stratified five-fold cross-validation, with a two-stage perceptual-hash/SSIM leakage audit confirming negligible specimen overlap. Notably, performance at low magnification (50x) was comparable to that at high magnification (1k-10kx), indicating that macro-scale features - mirror geometry and hackle line fields - already encode sufficient diagnostic signal. Grad-CAM attributions consistently localised on canonical fractographic cues (mirrors, hackles, pores, machining marks), aligning with established fractographic criteria. Together, these results position interpretable ViTs as a complementary tool for ceramic-implant quality assurance, enabling low-magnification pre-screening and reducing reliance on time-intensive high-magnification inspection.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验文章。关键词：SEM图像、fractographic workflow、burst and proof tests（实验测试）、Grad-CAM（可解释性分析）。；研究对象：氧化锆增韧氧化铝（ZTA）陶瓷基复合材料（BIOLOX delta，CeramTec GmbH），用于全关节置换植入物（髋、膝关节）的断裂原因分类。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 低倍率（50x）SEM图像与高倍率（1k-10kx）图像在断裂原因分类上性能相当，表明宏观尺度的镜面几何和放射棱线场已包含足够的诊断信息；可解释的视觉Transformer（ViT）在严重类别不平衡下达到0.907准确率和0.888宏F1分数。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：低倍率（50x）SEM图像与高倍率（1k-10kx）图像在断裂原因分类上性能相当，表明宏观尺度的镜面几何和放射棱线场已包含足够的诊断信息；可解释的视觉Transformer（ViT）在严重类别不平衡下达到0.907准确率和0.888宏F1分数。；创新点：首次将可解释的ViT应用于陶瓷植入物断裂原因自动分类，并证明低倍率SEM预筛选可替代部分高倍率耗时检测，减少对高倍率SEM的依赖。
papers.method_zh: 基于视觉Transformer（ViT）的深度学习工作流，使用8493张SEM图像（50x-10000x）进行五折分层交叉验证；采用两阶段感知哈希/SSIM泄漏审计确保数据无标本重叠；使用Grad-CAM进行模型可解释性分析，定位典型断口特征（镜面、放射棱、气孔、加工痕迹）。

papers.title: Community detection in subject-subject networks from psychometrics data
papers.abstract: Identifying subgroups of respondents in psychometric data is traditionally addressed with Latent Class Analysis, which requires the number of classes to be specified a priori and can perform poorly when strong inter-item correlations violate local independence assumptions. We propose a network-theoretic alternative based on community detection in subject-subject similarity networks. To suppress the systematic artifacts induced by the factor structure of the items, the similarity is computed in a low-dimensional factor-score space and the null model for modularity maximisation is obtained by removing the leading (global) mode of the similarity matrix, rather than via the standard Newman--Girvan model. The significance of a detected partition is then assessed against a column-wise resampling null through four complementary observables: the modularity, the differential entropy of the eigenvector point cloud at two neighbourhood scales, and the overlap of the within- and between-community similarity histograms. On a synthetic benchmark with controlled mixture signal, all four metrics correctly identify the homogeneous case as null-compatible -- including the demanding regime of a dataset dominated by a single factor -- and exhibit a graded departure from the null as the cluster separation grows. Applied to 14 widely used psychometric scales, the pipeline isolates a small group of datasets supporting a genuine and directly interpretable modular structure, while the remaining scales fall either in a mixed-signal regime or in one compatible with a single homogeneous community. The significance analysis is independent of the specific community-detection algorithm and provides an operational way to test for modular subject-level structure in questionnaire data.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据：提出网络理论替代方案、基于模块度最大化、使用合成基准测试和显著性分析。；研究对象：心理测量学数据中的受访者子群识别问题。具体而言，是将受访者视为节点、其相似性构成网络，通过社区检测来发现潜在的群体结构。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种基于社区检测的网络理论方法，用于替代传统的潜在类别分析来识别心理测量数据中的受访者子群。该方法通过去除相似性矩阵的全局模式来构建零模型，并利用四种互补可观测量评估检测到的分区的统计显著性，成功区分了同质、混合信号和真实模块化结构的数据集。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种基于社区检测的网络理论方法，用于替代传统的潜在类别分析来识别心理测量数据中的受访者子群。该方法通过去除相似性矩阵的全局模式来构建零模型，并利用四种互补可观测量评估检测到的分区的统计显著性，成功区分了同质、混合信号和真实模块化结构的数据集。；创新点：1. 提出了一种针对心理测量数据中“受访者-受访者”网络社区检测的定制化零模型（去除全局模式），以抑制项目因子结构带来的系统性伪影。2. 建立了一套独立于具体社区检测算法的、基于四种互补可观测量的显著性分析框架，为在问卷数据中检验模块化受访者结构提供了可操作的方法。
papers.method_zh: 1. **网络构建**：在低维因子得分空间中计算受访者之间的相似性，构建“受访者-受访者”相似性网络。2. **社区检测**：采用模块度最大化算法，但零模型并非标准Newman-Girvan模型，而是通过去除相似性矩阵的领先（全局）模式获得。3. **显著性评估**：通过列重采样零模型，使用四种可观测量评估分区显著性：模块度、两个邻域尺度下的特征向量点云微分熵，以及社区内与社区间相似性直方图的重叠度。4. **验证**：在具有可控混合信号的合成基准上测试，并应用于14个广泛使用的心理测量量表。

papers.title: Inverse generalised spin models of answers to questionnaires
papers.abstract: Network psychometrics conceptualises psychological constructs as emergent properties of systems of interacting variables. Energy-based probabilistic models have gained popularity as models of these interactions, but their psychometric application has so far been limited, since most implementations assume binary or ternary responses and rely on limiting inference assumptions. We infer and analyse three generalised spin models of ordinal questionnaire data: the generalised Ising, Blume-Capel (BC), and Blume-Emery-Griffiths (BEG) models. We prove the concavity of the maximum likelihood estimation of the parameters, as well as the gauge invariance of the Ising and BC models. Afterwards, we propose an inference protocol of approximated likelihood maximisation, based on the Monte Carlo estimation of the likelihood gradients. We apply this procedure to eleven psychometric and sociological questionnaires, comparing the inferred spin models against the multivariate Gaussian. We then assess whether the inferred models reproduce the empirical features of the data in terms of principal-component histograms, and histograms of Euclidean and Mahalanobis distances to the mean answer. The multi-modality observed in the histograms of principal components is partially captured by the spin models. This trait of polarisation can be understood, in the light of mean-field theory, as coexistence of stable and metastable phases of the spin models. The BEG model systematically outperforms the other models in capturing the distribution of distances to the mean, while all models underestimate the heavy tails of the Mahalanobis distance. Overall, the analysis witnesses the predictive power of the BEG model, able to account better than others for the abundance of outliers and mean responders, and reveals highly non-linear features of questionnaire data that both Gaussian and spin models fail to account for.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：能量基概率模型、最大似然估计、蒙特卡洛估计、平均场理论。；研究对象：问卷数据（心理测量学与社会学问卷）的广义自旋模型，具体包括广义伊辛模型、Blume-Capel (BC) 模型和 Blume-Emery-Griffiths (BEG) 模型。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: BEG模型在捕捉问卷数据中距离均值的分布方面系统性优于其他模型，能更好地解释异常值和均值响应者的丰度；但所有模型（包括高斯模型和自旋模型）均未能完全再现数据中马氏距离的重尾特征，揭示了问卷数据存在高度非线性特征。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：BEG模型在捕捉问卷数据中距离均值的分布方面系统性优于其他模型，能更好地解释异常值和均值响应者的丰度；但所有模型（包括高斯模型和自旋模型）均未能完全再现数据中马氏距离的重尾特征，揭示了问卷数据存在高度非线性特征。；创新点：将原本用于物理系统的广义自旋模型（特别是BEG模型）系统性地应用于心理测量学问卷数据分析，并证明了相关参数估计的数学性质（凹性、规范不变性），揭示了问卷数据中类似物理相共存（稳定相与亚稳相）的极化特征。
papers.method_zh: 基于能量基概率模型（广义伊辛、BC、BEG）对有序分类问卷数据进行建模；证明了参数最大似然估计的凹性以及伊辛和BC模型的规范不变性；提出了基于蒙特卡洛估计似然梯度的近似似然最大化推断协议；将推断结果与多元高斯模型对比，并通过主成分直方图、欧氏距离和马氏距离直方图评估模型再现经验特征的能力；利用平均场理论解释极化现象。

papers.title: Kernel Renormalization in Bayesian Deep Neural Networks: the Equivalent Wishart Ansatz in the Proportional Regime
papers.abstract: The scaling limit where both the size of the training set $P$ and the width $N$ of a deep neural network grow at the same rate, the so-called proportional-width regime, has been intensely studied for shallow, single-hidden-layer networks. However, extending these non-perturbative results from shallow architectures to deep non-linear networks has proven very challenging. Here we present an effective approximate approach to predict the generalization performance of Bayesian multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) of fixed depth $L$ on arbitrary high-dimensional data. We propose an equivalent Wishart Ansatz to capture the dominant stochastic fluctuations of the hierarchical empirical kernels of MLPs. This allows us to perform a large deviation analysis for the partition function of MLPs in the proportional limit, expressed in terms of a renormalized NNGP kernel. In this description, even strong representation learning in the proportional limit is encoded in at most $L$ scalar order parameters, determined self-consistently. Extending the approach to convolutional architectures (CNNs), we identify a hierarchical local kernel renormalization mechanism, which allows to quantify more complex data-dependent transformations of the large-width kernel in CNNs due to finite-width effects. We test our effective theory against sampling experiments from the Bayesian posterior of finite deep neural networks with depths $L \sim O(10)$ and $P\sim O(10^3)$ on classic benchmark datasets, finding overall very good agreement together with two distinct types of systematic deviations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“提出等效Wishart假设”“进行大偏差分析”“构建有效理论”，属于理论建模与解析计算。；研究对象：贝叶斯深度神经网络（多层感知机MLP和卷积神经网络CNN）在比例极限（训练集大小P与网络宽度N同比例增长）下的泛化性能与核重整化机制。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出等效Wishart假设，能够捕捉深度贝叶斯MLP中层次化经验核的主要随机涨落，从而在比例极限下用重整化的NNGP核描述配分函数，并将强表示学习效应编码为至多L个自洽标量序参量。对于CNN，进一步揭示了层次化局部核重整化机制，量化有限宽度效应对大宽度核的数据依赖变换。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出等效Wishart假设，能够捕捉深度贝叶斯MLP中层次化经验核的主要随机涨落，从而在比例极限下用重整化的NNGP核描述配分函数，并将强表示学习效应编码为至多L个自洽标量序参量。对于CNN，进一步揭示了层次化局部核重整化机制，量化有限宽度效应对大宽度核的数据依赖变换。；创新点：将浅层网络比例极限下的非微扰结果推广至深度非线性网络，提出等效Wishart假设作为解析处理深度贝叶斯网络有限宽度效应的有效近似框架，并首次在CNN中识别出层次化局部核重整化机制。
papers.method_zh: 采用等效Wishart假设对深度贝叶斯MLP的层次化经验核进行随机矩阵近似，结合大偏差分析计算配分函数；将方法推广至CNN，引入层次化局部核重整化机制；通过贝叶斯后验采样实验（深度L~O(10)，训练集大小P~O(10^3)）在经典基准数据集上验证理论预测。

papers.title: Channel-agnostic finite-temperature phase estimation averaged over variable grids: reconstruction of Green's function for dynamical mean-field theory
papers.abstract: For treating correlated electronic systems on quantum computers, we propose a quantum-classical hybrid scheme for dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT). In the quantum part of the scheme, we use modified quantum phase estimation (QPE) circuits suitable for the one-particle Green's function (GF) at a finite temperature so that we can extract spectral amplitudes and the excitation energies without knowing the excitation channel invoked at each measurement. In the classical part of the scheme, we adopt an approach that estimates reasonably the GF based on the data collected from the QPE sampling. We dub the approach the QPE averaged over variable grids (QAVG), that may help one to reconstruct the GF via optimization of trial parameters and modeling the probability distributions for various settings of the QPE circuits. We apply the QAVG-DMFT scheme to SrVO$_3$ to demonstrate its validity via numerical simulations.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（量子-经典混合方案）。判断依据：提出量子-经典混合的DMFT方案，包含量子相位估计（QPE）电路和经典数据后处理（QAVG方法），并通过数值模拟验证。；研究对象：关联电子体系，具体以SrVO₃为例，研究其有限温度下的单粒子格林函数（GF）重构，用于动力学平均场理论（DMFT）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种无需知道激发通道的有限温度量子相位估计方法（QAVG），能够从QPE采样数据中合理重构单粒子格林函数，并通过SrVO₃的数值模拟验证了该方案的有效性。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种无需知道激发通道的有限温度量子相位估计方法（QAVG），能够从QPE采样数据中合理重构单粒子格林函数，并通过SrVO₃的数值模拟验证了该方案的有效性。；创新点：摘要未突出说明。
papers.method_zh: 量子部分：使用改进的有限温度量子相位估计（QPE）电路提取谱振幅和激发能量；经典部分：采用“变网格QPE平均”（QAVG）方法，通过优化试探参数和建模不同QPE电路设置下的概率分布来重构格林函数。

papers.title: Error-corrected phase estimation averaged over variable grids on a trapped-ion quantum computer: hyperacuity spectra of a CO molecule adsorbed onto $χ$-Fe$_5$C$_2$
papers.abstract: Quantum phase estimation (QPE) is an underlying technology for extracting the excitation spectra of many-electron systems, yet its practical use on current hardware is hindered by low grid resolution and environmental noises. Here we propose QPE averaged over variable grids (QAVG), a vernier-type approach that combines low-resolution QPE with multiple origin shifts and physically motivated continuous parametrization to reconstruct the spectra accurately. We introduce this approach into an end-to-end workflow for the {\it ab initio}-based model system for a CO molecule adsorbed onto the $χ$-Fe$_5$C$_2$ surface. We perform experiments on Quantinuum H2-2 using both physical QPE circuits and logical QPE circuits encoded in the Steane code with offline bit-flip correction. We demonstrate that QAVG accurately reconstructs the spectra with deviations much smaller than the nominal QPE resolution, even when the noisy histograms are used. The cost landscapes averaged over the shifted grids substantially suppress the local minima arising from the spectral leakage, thereby stabilizing the optimization of trial parameters. These results indicate that QAVG provides a robust route to quantum simulations of correlated spectra toward the era of early-fault-tolerant quantum computers.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：混合类型（实验+理论+计算）。判断依据：摘要提及“在Quantinuum H2-2上进行实验”，使用物理QPE电路和逻辑QPE电路（实验），同时提出QAVG方法并用于从头算模型系统（理论/计算）。；研究对象：吸附在χ-Fe₅C₂表面上的CO分子（CO molecule adsorbed onto χ-Fe₅C₂ surface）的激发谱（excitation spectra），具体为基于从头算的模型系统。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出了一种名为QAVG（变网格平均量子相位估计）的方法，能够以远低于名义QPE分辨率（nominal resolution）的偏差准确重构光谱，即使在噪声直方图下也能有效抑制由谱泄漏引起的局部极小值，从而稳定优化过程。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出了一种名为QAVG（变网格平均量子相位估计）的方法，能够以远低于名义QPE分辨率（nominal resolution）的偏差准确重构光谱，即使在噪声直方图下也能有效抑制由谱泄漏引起的局部极小值，从而稳定优化过程。；创新点：提出QAVG方法，通过变网格平均和连续参数化，在低分辨率QPE和噪声环境下实现超分辨率（hyperacuity）光谱重构，并首次将其应用于吸附在χ-Fe₅C₂表面的CO分子模型系统，展示了早期容错量子计算机上量子模拟的鲁棒路径。
papers.method_zh: 采用变网格平均量子相位估计（QAVG）方法，这是一种结合低分辨率QPE、多次原点偏移（origin shifts）和物理驱动的连续参数化（physically motivated continuous parametrization）的游标式（vernier-type）方法。实验在Quantinuum H2-2离子阱量子计算机上进行，使用物理QPE电路和基于Steane码编码的逻辑QPE电路（带离线比特翻转纠错）。

papers.title: Giant Photon Superbunching from Weak Nonlinearity
papers.abstract: Photon superbunching, which occurs when the second-order correlation satisfies $g^{(2)}> 2$, is typically associated with strong optical nonlinearities or collective multi-photon emission processes. We predict that extreme superbunching can also arise in systems of weakly-nonlinear photonic cavities, via the creation of a squeezed vacuum through interference engineering by fine-tuning inter-cavity couplings and drive parameters. We present numerical calculations indicating that a system of four photonic resonators containing representative Kerr media can achieve $g^{(2)}(0) = 135$ with a $80\,\text{kHz}$ emission rate. Unlike earlier superbunching schemes, this mechanism is highly compatible with integrated photonic platforms constructed using conventional optical media.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论/计算文章。关键词：predict、numerical calculations、interference engineering。；研究对象：弱非线性光子腔系统（包含四个含Kerr介质的谐振腔），通过干涉工程实现的光子超聚束现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在弱非线性光子腔系统中，通过精细调节腔间耦合和驱动参数产生压缩真空态，可实现极端光子超聚束（g^(2)(0)=135，发射率80 kHz），且该机制与集成光子平台高度兼容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在弱非线性光子腔系统中，通过精细调节腔间耦合和驱动参数产生压缩真空态，可实现极端光子超聚束（g^(2)(0)=135，发射率80 kHz），且该机制与集成光子平台高度兼容。；创新点：首次提出在弱非线性系统中（而非传统强非线性或多光子集体发射）实现极端光子超聚束，且方案适用于常规光学介质构建的集成光子平台。
papers.method_zh: 数值计算（具体方法摘要未明确说明，如是否采用量子主方程或输入-输出理论等未提及），通过干涉工程调控腔间耦合和驱动参数。

papers.title: Common Noise-Induced Group-Level Synchronization Between Uncoupled Groups of Oscillators
papers.abstract: We investigate group-level synchronization between oscillator groups induced by common noise in the absence of inter-group coupling. Each group receives a common noise shared by all its oscillators and independent local noise inputs to individual oscillators. The same common noise is applied to all groups. The system is studied with both identical and nonidentical oscillators, and with and without intra-group coupling. In the nonidentical case, natural frequencies are drawn from the same distribution for both groups, making them statistically equivalent. Through numerical simulations of this system, we find that the degree of synchronization within each group, measured by the absolute value of a complex Kuramoto order parameter, typically shows significant temporal fluctuations. Importantly, the complex order parameters representing the collective oscillations of the groups synchronize when the groups are driven by the same common noise. By deriving a phase density evolution mapping, we analytically explain how this group-level synchronization is achieved in the absence of intra-group coupling.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章（兼有计算）。判断依据：关键词“通过数值模拟”、“通过推导相密度演化映射”、“分析解释”。；研究对象：由共同噪声驱动的、无相互耦合的振荡器群组之间的群级同步现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在没有群间耦合的情况下，当不同振荡器群组受到相同的共同噪声驱动时，代表各群组集体振荡的复序参量会实现同步。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在没有群间耦合的情况下，当不同振荡器群组受到相同的共同噪声驱动时，代表各群组集体振荡的复序参量会实现同步。；创新点：揭示了在缺乏群间耦合这一传统同步必要条件时，仅通过共同噪声即可诱导出群组级别的同步，并提供了相应的解析解释。
papers.method_zh: 采用数值模拟（对相同和不同振荡器、有无群内耦合等多种情况）和解析推导（通过建立相密度演化映射）相结合的方法。

papers.title: Model-free estimation in scattering analysis of microscopy
papers.abstract: The mean squared displacement (MSD) of particles or probes is commonly estimated from microscopy videos using particle tracking approaches, which rely on tuning parameters manually, and are often unstable over the entire lag time range, especially in dense or low-contrast situations. In this work, we propose model-free ab initio uncertainty quantification (MF-AIUQ), a model-free method for scattering analysis of microscopy video based on a probabilistic framework, which estimates MSD without isolating particles and linking their trajectories. Based on the relationship between the intermediate scattering function (ISF) and the MSD derived from the cumulant theorem, MF-AIUQ estimates the MSD values by the marginal maximum likelihood estimator. To reduce the computational cost, the likelihood function is approximated by a subset of Fourier-transformed intensities. These intensities are equally spaced at the logarithmic values of Fourier basis functions and lag time points. We found that the ISF is smooth in this logarithmic input space, and the information of the ISF can be captured by this subset of inputs. We examine the method through simulation studies covering several representative stochastic processes and three experimental systems: a Newtonian fluid for evaluating performance in optically dense and bright-field settings, a gelation system with an evolving MSD shape, and snail mucin, a viscoelastic biopolymer, for modulus estimation. Across these studies, MF-AIUQ provides smooth and stable MSD estimates over the full lag time range and serves as a useful complementary approach in settings where particle tracking is unreliable or a parametric model of MSD is unavailable or unverifiable.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算/理论文章。判断依据关键词：model-free method、probabilistic framework、marginal maximum likelihood estimator、simulation studies。；研究对象：显微镜视频中粒子或探针的均方位移（MSD）估计，具体应用于密集或低对比度条件下的散射分析，包括牛顿流体、凝胶体系、粘弹性生物聚合物（蜗牛粘液）。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出一种无需粒子追踪和参数模型的模型自由方法（MF-AIUQ），能够基于中间散射函数（ISF）与MSD的累积量定理关系，在全滞后时间范围内稳定、平滑地估计MSD，在粒子追踪不可靠或MSD参数模型不可用时作为有效补充。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：提出一种无需粒子追踪和参数模型的模型自由方法（MF-AIUQ），能够基于中间散射函数（ISF）与MSD的累积量定理关系，在全滞后时间范围内稳定、平滑地估计MSD，在粒子追踪不可靠或MSD参数模型不可用时作为有效补充。；创新点：首次在散射分析中实现无需粒子追踪、无需参数模型的MSD估计，利用ISF在对数输入空间中的平滑性，通过稀疏傅里叶强度子集高效计算，解决了传统粒子追踪在密集/低对比度条件下不稳定、需手动调参的问题。
papers.method_zh: 基于概率框架的模型自由从头不确定性量化方法（MF-AIUQ）。利用累积量定理推导ISF与MSD的关系，通过边际最大似然估计器估计MSD；为降低计算成本，采用傅里叶变换强度子集（在对数傅里叶基函数和滞后时间点上等间距选取）近似似然函数。通过模拟代表性随机过程及三个实验系统（牛顿流体、凝胶体系、蜗牛粘液）进行验证。

papers.title: Source-driven torsional optical activity in geometrically chiral media
papers.abstract: We develop an effective field-theoretical model for source-driven electromagnetic waves in a geometrically chiral optical medium described by a uniform axial torsion. Starting from the gauge-invariant electromagnetic field strength, we introduce a Chern--Simons-type coupling between the vector potential and the medium's axial contortion, thereby obtaining an inhomogeneous Maxwell system with prescribed external sources. For transverse cylindrical source profiles, we derive the coupled radial equations and solve them analytically for a circulating cylindrical-shell current. In the circular basis, the homogeneous problem diagonalizes, yielding torsion-split radial wavenumbers that give rise to longitudinal circular birefringence under guided-mode boundary conditions. In the weak-torsion regime, this birefringence produces a polarization rotation proportional to the propagation length and an oscillatory conversion between orthogonal linear polarizations. The source fixes the jump conditions and the relative excitation of the circular eigenmodes, thereby yielding measurable modal power and Poynting-flow signatures. A two-port scattering analysis shows that the apparent direction dependence remains Lorentz reciprocal, placing the effect in the class of reciprocal geometric optical activity rather than Faraday isolation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确提到“develop an effective field-theoretical model”（发展有效场理论模型）、“derive the coupled radial equations and solve them analytically”（推导并解析求解耦合径向方程）、“two-port scattering analysis”（双端口散射分析），均为理论推导和建模工作。；研究对象：几何手性光学介质中的源驱动电磁波，具体研究由均匀轴向扭转（axial torsion）描述的几何手性介质中的光学活性现象。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在几何手性介质中，由源驱动的电磁波会产生纵向圆双折射，导致偏振旋转与传播长度成正比，并在正交线偏振态之间产生振荡转换。该效应是洛伦兹互易的，属于互易几何光学活性，而非法拉第隔离。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在几何手性介质中，由源驱动的电磁波会产生纵向圆双折射，导致偏振旋转与传播长度成正比，并在正交线偏振态之间产生振荡转换。该效应是洛伦兹互易的，属于互易几何光学活性，而非法拉第隔离。；创新点：摘要未突出说明与已有研究的具体差异，但核心创新在于：将几何手性介质中的光学活性与源驱动（source-driven）机制相结合，通过引入Chern-Simons型耦合项，建立了从介质几何扭转（axial torsion）到电磁波偏振旋转的完整理论框架，并给出了可测量的模态功率和坡印廷流特征。
papers.method_zh: 采用有效场理论模型。从规范不变的电磁场强出发，引入矢量势与介质轴向扭转（axial contortion）之间的Chern-Simons型耦合，构建非齐次麦克斯韦方程组。针对横向圆柱形源分布（具体为环形柱壳电流），推导并解析求解了耦合径向方程。在圆偏振基下对角化齐次问题，得到扭转分裂的径向波数，并利用导模边界条件分析纵向圆双折射。最后通过双端口散射分析检验互易性。

papers.title: Modular non-Hermitian topology and its application to critical sensing
papers.abstract: Non-Hermitian topological systems have attracted a lot of research activities in recent times, both theoretically and experimentally, due to their unique physical properties and association with open quantum systems. We show that modular structures, where specific couplings at regular intervals take distinct values, enrich the unique topological attributes of these systems such as the non-Hermitian skin effect and the breakdown of conventional bulk-boundary correspondence. These systems also possess the capability of displaying criticality-enhanced sensitivity for precision metrology. We establish how the modular structure enhances their sensing performance near spectral topological phase transitions and show that the enhancement can be achieved in multi-parameter estimation scenarios as well.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中提及“We show that...”“We establish how...”，未提及实验或计算手段，属于理论分析。；研究对象：非厄米拓扑系统中的模块化结构（modular structures），以及其导致的非厄米趋肤效应、体边对应失效，以及用于精密测量的临界增强传感。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 模块化结构（特定间隔的耦合取不同值）能够丰富非厄米拓扑系统的独特属性，如非厄米趋肤效应和体边对应失效，并能在谱拓扑相变附近实现临界增强的传感性能，且该增强可推广至多参数估计场景。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：模块化结构（特定间隔的耦合取不同值）能够丰富非厄米拓扑系统的独特属性，如非厄米趋肤效应和体边对应失效，并能在谱拓扑相变附近实现临界增强的传感性能，且该增强可推广至多参数估计场景。；创新点：首次提出模块化结构（modular structures）可系统性地增强非厄米拓扑系统的传感性能，特别是在多参数估计场景中实现临界增强。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析，具体框架为模块化非厄米拓扑模型，结合谱拓扑相变与临界增强传感的理论推导。摘要未明确说明具体数学方法或数值模拟细节。

papers.title: Dynamical Tsallis WIMP Freeze-Out and Residual Memory Channels in the Radiation Sector
papers.abstract: In this work we generalize the thermal decoupling, or freeze-out, of weakly interacting massive particle dark matter within the Tsallis nonextensive formalism. The generalization is implemented through $q$-deformed distribution functions obtained from the maximum entropy principle with Curado-Tsallis constraints. The Tsallis parameter $q$, which measures deviations from extensivity with respect to the limit $q=1$, is promoted to a dynamical quantity depending on the dimensionless variable $x=m_χ/T$, where $m_χ$ is the dark matter mass. This dynamical evolution is characterized by a relaxation toward extensivity, while requiring that the nonextensive deformation is not completely erased before freeze-out. We solve the Boltzmann equation assuming a sectorial deformation, where only the dark matter equilibrium abundance is generalized and the radiation background remains extensive. The relic abundance is computed for different dark matter masses and initial values of the Tsallis parameter. From this evolution, we extract the residual value $q_χ^{\rm fo}$ at freeze-out, which is then used as the initial input for a phenomenological memory channel. This channel propagates the residual nonextensivity into the radiation sector, specifically into the electron-positron plasma and neutrinos, while photons are kept extensive in order to avoid direct tensions with CMB physics. The resulting deformation modifies the neutrino energy density and the photon reheating contribution, producing a correction to $N_{\rm eff}$. We compare the predicted values with the compressed CMB+BAO constraint on $N_{\rm eff}$ and find that the residual-memory scenario can remain phenomenologically compatible with current bounds.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。判断依据：摘要中明确使用“generalize”“formalism”“Boltzmann equation”等理论框架术语，未提及实验或计算模拟。；研究对象：弱相互作用大质量粒子（WIMP）暗物质的热退耦（freeze-out）过程，以及由此产生的残余非广延性对辐射扇区（电子-正电子等离子体、中微子）的影响。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在Tsallis非广延形式中引入动态演化参数q，使得暗物质退耦后残余的非广延性通过“记忆通道”传递到辐射扇区，修正中微子能量密度和光子再加热贡献，从而对有效中微子代数N_eff产生可观测的修正，该修正与当前CMB+BAO约束在现象学上兼容。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：在Tsallis非广延形式中引入动态演化参数q，使得暗物质退耦后残余的非广延性通过“记忆通道”传递到辐射扇区，修正中微子能量密度和光子再加热贡献，从而对有效中微子代数N_eff产生可观测的修正，该修正与当前CMB+BAO约束在现象学上兼容。；创新点：将Tsallis参数q从常数推广为依赖于无量纲变量x=m_χ/T的动态量，并引入“残余记忆通道”概念，将暗物质扇区的非广延性传播到辐射扇区（电子-正电子等离子体和中微子），同时保持光子广延以避免与CMB直接冲突。
papers.method_zh: 基于最大熵原理与Curado-Tsallis约束，采用q-变形分布函数推广WIMP暗物质的Boltzmann方程；假设扇区变形（仅暗物质平衡丰度非广延，辐射背景保持广延）；通过求解Boltzmann方程计算不同暗物质质量和初始Tsallis参数下的残余丰度，并提取退耦时的残余q值作为记忆通道的初始输入。

papers.title: Local diagnostics for strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking and non-equilibrium phase transitions
papers.abstract: We construct strongly $\mathbb{Z}_2$-symmetric local Markov/Lindblad dynamics exhibiting transitions between strong-paramagnetic behavior and strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. In 1+1d, an absorbing-state construction gives a transition with scaling consistent with the parity-conserving branching-annihilating random-walk universality class. In 2+1d, a pair-flip variant of Toom's rule provides evidence for a stable strong-paramagnetic/weakly symmetry-broken regime and a transition into an active SWSSB regime. We also introduce a marginal fidelity correlator of radius $R$, a local proxy for the usual SWSSB fidelity order parameter requiring tomography only on $\mathcal{O}(R^d)$-size regions. For broad classes of states, including symmetry-projected Gibbs-like states satisfying suitable local indistinguishability assumptions, we bound the error between the marginal and global fidelity correlators by terms decaying exponentially in $R$. These marginal fidelities provide a model-independent diagnostic of SWSSB in absorbing-state transitions, where microscopic notions of defects or activity are not universal.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论文章。关键词：构造动力学、提出诊断方法、理论分析。；研究对象：强-弱自发对称性破缺（SWSSB）及其相关的非平衡相变，具体在1+1维和2+1维的马尔可夫/林德布拉德动力学系统中。
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 构造了具有强Z₂对称性的局域动力学，展示了从强顺磁行为到强-弱自发对称性破缺的相变；并引入了一种仅需局域断层扫描的边际保真度关联函数，可作为SWSSB的模型无关诊断工具。
papers.main_content_zh: 核心发现：构造了具有强Z₂对称性的局域动力学，展示了从强顺磁行为到强-弱自发对称性破缺的相变；并引入了一种仅需局域断层扫描的边际保真度关联函数，可作为SWSSB的模型无关诊断工具。；创新点：提出了一个无需全局断层扫描、仅需局域测量的边际保真度关联函数，作为SWSSB的局域诊断工具，适用于吸收态相变等场景，且不依赖于微观缺陷或活性的具体定义。
papers.method_zh: 通过吸收态构造（1+1维）和Toom规则的pair-flip变体（2+1维）构建具体动力学模型；引入半径为R的边际保真度关联函数，并利用局域不可区分性假设，证明其与全局保真度序参量之间的误差随R指数衰减。

papers.title: Comparing Spatially Periodic Feedback and Space-Time Modulation for Unidirectional Wave Propagation in a 1D Mass-Spring-Damper System
papers.abstract: Unidirectional wave propagation has emerged as a key concept in the dynamics of non-reciprocal mechanical and acoustic metamaterials. This work investigates two fundamentally distinct strategies for achieving directional wave propagation in a periodic one-dimensional mass-spring-damper lumped system: space-time modulation and spatially periodic feedback. In the first approach, the stiffness is modulated periodically in both space and time. The resulting space-time periodic system is analyzed using a Plane Wave Expansion (PWE) formulation based on the Bloch-Floquet theory to obtain the dispersion relation. The traveling modulation produces asymmetric dispersion diagrams and directional band gaps, within which elastic waves propagate preferentially in a single direction due to broken time-reversal symmetry. In the second approach, non-reciprocity is introduced through a spatially periodic feedback action. The force can depend on the displacement and/or its derivatives, such as velocity or acceleration, and is applied to the masses along the system. The lumped system with a finite number of unit cells is modeled using classical mechanics principles, yielding a state-space model of the system. The active mechanism can generate directional amplification or attenuation via the non-Hermitian skin effect (NHSE), characterized by boundary-localized modes identified by a topological invariant, the winding number. The stability of the space-time periodic system is assessed through the Lyapunov-Floquet theory. In the periodic feedback case, stability is investigated using the eigenvalues of the state matrix.
